Description: Cala is an innovative technology company focused on transforming residential water heating through intelligent heat pump water heaters. The company aims to decarbonize home water heating by creating a smart system that optimizes energy efficiency and reduces greenhouse gas emissions. Cala's technology allows for flexible water heating by adjusting temperature, timing, and heating speed, integrating with home solar systems and clean electricity grids. The product is designed to lower energy costs, minimize environmental impact, and provide consumers with a more sustainable and comfortable hot water experience.

Name: Mattiq
Description: Mattiq is an advanced clean chemistry company that leverages materials science and artificial intelligence to develop innovative electrochemical solutions for decarbonization. The company focuses on reinventing chemical process development to produce sustainable chemicals, fuels, and plastics. By utilizing AI and advanced technologies, Mattiq designs commercially viable, scalable processes that support supply chain resilience and environmental sustainability, with a particular emphasis on eliminating fossil fuel dependence in industrial chemical and energy sectors.

Name: Mohan Technologies, Inc.
Description: The world model for the subsurface. Once a region is known to host mineralization, the goal is to define the ore body with fewer holes, more hits, less time, and less capital. We are building a subsurface world model to answer that. Generative AI for resource definition. Built by researchers from MIT EAPS, CSAIL, and the Media Lab.

Name: Mursla
Description: Mursla Bio is an AI-powered precision diagnostics company specializing in extracellular vesicle (EV) research and liquid biopsy technologies. Spun out of Cambridge University, the company has developed a proprietary platform for non-invasive organ-specific blood tests. Their flagship product, EvoLiver™, focuses on early liver cancer detection, utilizing AI-enabled multiomics workflows to analyze EV particles from blood. The company aims to revolutionize disease detection and monitoring through advanced biomarker identification and organ-specific diagnostic technologies.

Name: RYND biotech
Description: Rynd Biotech is a healthcare technology company developing a rapid urine diagnostics platform for sexually transmitted infections (STIs). The company specializes in point-of-care and at-home testing solutions that automate diagnosis and prescription delivery. Their innovative technology aims to facilitate early detection and ongoing monitoring of STIs, identifying both symptomatic and asymptomatic cases. Rynd Biotech is expanding its biomarker range to include screenings for urinary tract infections, pregnancy indicators, urology, and oncology markers.

Name: Muse Bio
Description: muse bio is making stem cell access safer, simpler, and more inclusive—by transforming menstrual blood into a powerful, renewable source of mesenchymal stem cells (mscs). today, autologous stem cell collection often requires painful and expensive procedures like bone marrow or fat tissue extraction. we’re changing that. with muse bio’s non-invasive, at-home collection platform, we turn menstrual blood into clinically valuable mscs—enabling accessible stem cell banking, supporting regenerative medicine research, and powering next-generation cell therapy development. our approach lowers financial and physical barriers to stem cell preservation while unlocking underused biological potential. we’re building the first renewable stem cell supply chain rooted in equity, science, and trust. join us in pioneering a new era of regenerative health, rooted in the power of your own biology.  learn more at www.mycells.bio  contact: muse@mycells.bio

Name: Osteocure
Description: OsteoCure Therapeutics is a biotechnology company developing innovative treatments for bone diseases. Spun out of Duke University's Varghese Lab, the company focuses on creating injectable therapeutic products that promote bone tissue regeneration. Their primary technology involves an injectable system utilizing small molecules and microgels to accelerate bone repair, reduce pain, and enhance healing. The company aims to provide advanced therapeutic solutions for bone-related medical challenges through cutting-edge biotechnology research.

Name: Lobe Labs
Description: Tools for developing biological neural networks. Harnessing the efficiency of cellular intelligence for the next era of computation.

Name: Vsim Technology
Description: Vsim is a multi-physics simulation research and deployment company that develops advanced simulation technologies powered by machine learning. Their platform provides real-time, accurate, and scalable physics-based simulations for various industries including visual effects, animation, robotics, and artificial intelligence. Vsim's innovative technology enables AI agents to learn and solve complex tasks in accurately simulated environments, offering a next-generation simulation engine that supports research and drives innovation in robotics and AI applications.

Name: Statefulrobotics
Description: Stateful is a robotics software company developing a decision intelligence engine for mobile robots operating in dynamic, real-world environments. The company spun-out from the University of Oxford in 2025, where the founding team spent more than a decade working on autonomous systems, from quadrupedal robots and underwater vehicles to self-driving cars. The Stateful platform enables organisations to define missions, deploy robots reliably, and continuously improve operational performance. Stateful’s technology is designed to help robotics scale across industries, including infrastructure, energy, logistics, agriculture, and healthcare.

Name: Zethos
Description: Our ethos is critical mineral abundance. Zethos (formerly Zincovery) works tirelessly towards a world where tech-led refining secures reliable access to clean critical minerals, anywhere. The $400B global critical minerals market relies on expensive and outdated refining processes. This geographically concentrates critical minerals production, undermining supply security and amplifying global geopolitical tensions. Zethos has developed a ground-breaking critical minerals refining process with significantly lower production cost than incumbents. Our platform uses selective reduction to efficiently extract minerals from ores and industrial wastes anywhere in the world, securing domestic supply.

Name: Chelonia Robotics
Description: Chelonia Robotics www.cheloniarobotics.co is at the cutting edge of environmental technology, leveraging robotics to revolutionize waste management and resource recovery. Our mission is to create innovative, sustainable solutions that turn waste into valuable resources, reducing environmental impact and driving forward the circular economy.

Name: Noah's Farm
Description: Noah's Farm: The AI Flavor Empire We started with a single, audacious question: "What if we could produce 100+ new flavor molecules, each worth hundreds of millions, every year?" Noah's Farm is a deep-tech startup building the future of taste. We develop proprietary AI that chemically recreates the world's most beloved flavors—and invents entirely new ones—at the molecular level. From Decades to AI: The New Flavor Empire Just as AlphaFold is fundamentally disrupting drug discovery, Noah's Farm is poised to creatively disrupt the massive, multi-billion-dollar global flavor industry. This is a market that has yet to experience true technological innovation—one still reliant on inefficient processes that contribute to environmental strain and food scarcity. Our proprietary AI model, 'N-Palette1', is the engine of this revolution. It generates the precise molecular formulas to replicate any taste, from complex vanilla and specific cuts of meat fat to the rarest fruits. We are moving beyond imitation to invention, creating novel sensory experiences the world has never tasted. Our mission is to chemically recreate every flavor imaginable, secure them all as our intellectual property, and build a new Flavor Empire. This bold vision is backed by world-class investors. Within three months of our founding, we successfully raised a $3M (4B KRW) pre-seed round from top-tier VCs in Silicon Valley and Korea. A Team Built to Win We are a convergence powerhouse. Our team is led by a proven serial entrepreneur—the co-founder of Tapas Media (acquired by Kakao Entertainment for $450M) and founder of Riiid (an EdTech unicorn valued at over $600M). He is joined by a CTO from Seoul National University's School of Medicine (Ph.D. Cand.) and an elite corps of core talent from the world's top AI research organizations, including UC Berkeley, Cambridge, LG AI, and Kakao Brain. We are here to innovate the global food market. Join us.

Name: Tendo Technologies
Description: Tendo Technologies offers a digital platform for managing industrial gas inventory across the global supply chain. The platform provides real-time, geo-tracked data on gas flow, helping reduce emissions and improve operational efficiency. It enables dynamic inventory management, automated processes that eliminate manual handling and inventory errors, and tools for managing hydrogen and carbon footprints. Designed to be cost-effective and adaptable, the solution serves industries including automotive, pharmaceuticals, and food and beverage, with a patent-pending IIoT solution that offers real-time visibility and geo-location data for industrial gas cylinders.

Name: Divea
Description: Duca is an innovative carbon capture technology company that specializes in developing graphene membrane solutions for removing CO2 from industrial emissions. Their unique process involves creating specialized membranes with tiny holes that act as sieves to capture and potentially recycle carbon dioxide. The company offers modular, compact carbon capture installations that can be easily integrated into industrial facilities, providing an efficient and environmentally friendly approach to reducing atmospheric carbon without requiring heat or chemical solvents.

Name: RightHand Robotics
Description: RightHand Robotics (RHR) is a leader in providing end-to-end robotic solutions for e-commerce order fulfillment across industries like electronics, apparel, grocery, and pharmaceuticals. Their intelligent picking platform offers flexible, adaptable automation that improves warehouse workflows, including sorting batch-picked items, picking from automated storage systems, and order quality assurance. Unlike traditional factory robots, RHR's solutions are simple to integrate, data-driven, and scalable, enabling predictable and efficient order fulfillment through advanced robotic piece-picking technologies.

Name: ChargeBot
Description: Mobile charging solution for landscaping electric equipment

Name: CYCLIZE
Description: Cyclize is a technology startup from the University of Stuttgart developing an innovative plasma-based process to defossilize the chemical industry. Their breakthrough technology uses mixed plastic waste and CO2 to produce synthesis gas (syngas), a critical building block for advanced chemicals like plastics, methanol, hydrogen, and e-fuels. By replacing fossil resources with waste materials, Cyclize enables a circular carbon economy and aims to avoid hundreds of megatons of CO2 emissions annually by 2050, supporting sustainable industrial transformation.

Name: melagen labs
Description: Melagen Labs is a technology company specializing in advanced radiation shielding solutions for space and extreme environments. The company has developed a patent-pending Melagen Composite material that provides lightweight, high-efficiency protection against cosmic and solar radiation. Their innovative shielding technology is designed for applications including space suits, nuclear reactors, electronic systems, and potential Mars/lunar habitats. Melagen collaborates with startups to create purpose-specific radiation protection solutions, focusing on enhancing safety and durability of critical systems in space and on Earth through their advanced, low-cost shielding technologies.

Name: Prodigy Clean Energy
Description: Prodigy Clean Energy specializes in developing Transportable Nuclear Power Plants (TNPPs), offering innovative, safe, and sustainable energy solutions for remote and coastal regions. Their technology focuses on small modular reactors (SMRs) that can be transported to various locations, providing reliable, carbon-free power generation. The company prioritizes safety and environmental sustainability, aiming to deliver efficient nuclear energy solutions that can be quickly deployed to meet global energy needs.

Name: Molecule.one
Description: Molecule.one is an advanced AI-powered platform for synthetic chemistry and drug discovery, offering innovative tools to accelerate pharmaceutical research. The platform leverages artificial intelligence to design novel chemical syntheses rapidly, providing researchers with advanced capabilities like M1 RetroScore, SpaceM1, and a predictive AI agent called Maria. Key features include access to over 1 trillion make-on-demand molecules, custom screening libraries, and automated molecular synthesis techniques that enhance efficiency and reduce costs in the drug development process.

Name: Hydron Desalination
Description: Hydron is a water technology company offering innovative liquid-liquid extraction solutions for brine management, primarily serving the oil and gas industry. Their patented technology provides a cost-effective approach to desalination, significantly reducing treatment costs compared to traditional membrane and thermal technologies. The company develops custom water management solutions for various sectors including oil and gas producers, water project developers, and infrastructure owners, with a commitment to commercial readiness through pilot testing and performance guarantees.

Name: Mainspring Energy
Description: Mainspring Energy is an innovative power generation company that develops advanced, flexible energy solutions focused on creating sustainable and reliable power systems. The company's core technology is the Linear Generator, which provides fuel-flexible, scalable onsite power generation for commercial and industrial customers, data centers, utilities, and various sectors including healthcare, oil and gas, and mobility. Their mission is to accelerate the transition to a net-zero carbon grid by offering adaptable power generation solutions that can work with multiple fuel types and support efficient, sustainable energy production across different scales and environments.

Name: Horne Technologies
Description: Horne Technologies is a research and development company focused on advancing fusion energy technology. Founded in 2008 and located in the Rocky Mountains, the company develops hybrid fusion reactors with a mission to create continuous, high-temperature plasma generation for both terrestrial and space applications. Their research emphasizes energy generation and conservation technologies, with ongoing development of fusion-capable devices aimed at creating affordable and innovative energy solutions.

Name: Fletcherbio
Description: A biotechnology company focused on developing advanced protein therapeutics specifically targeting T cell research and treatments.

Name: Kampto Neurotech
Description: Kampto is a deep-tech brain-computer interface company with deep expertise in hardware and software engineering. We build end-to-end BCI systems designed for real-world deployment, centered around a minimally invasive implanted chip that fits between the brain and the dura, conforms to the brain surface, and integrates an unprecedented scale of 65,536 electrodes for recording and stimulation. The system supports wireless power delivery and communication through a wearable relay station. By capturing highly diverse brain data and neural patterns at scale, Kampto unlocks the full potential of AI models running at the edge for next-generation clinical applications across epilepsy, motion, speech, and vision.

Name: Block Biosciences
Description: Block Biosciences is developing first-in-class small molecule therapies combined with a companion diagnostic to prevent brain metastasis-an urgent and underserved cancer complication. Built on novel biology and predictive biomarkers, our proactive approach aims to block metastatic spread before it reaches the brain, extending survival and preserving quality of life for high-risk patients.

Name: Besxar
Description: Besxar is pioneering a new class of space-based manufacturing to overcome the limits of terrestrial semiconductor fabrication. The company builds reusable “Fabships” that harness the ultra-high vacuum (UHV) of space to produce ultra-pure substrates and precursor materials—essential building blocks for next-generation technologies. Manufacturing in space allows purity and yield levels impossible on Earth, effectively doubling chip cost-effectiveness for these critical applications. Traditional chip factories face constraints in power, cooling, and materials. Besxar’s autonomous orbital manufacturing platforms overcome these barriers and return to Earth after each mission—not only delivering materials but also capturing insights to refine performance. Each cycle improves precision, efficiency, and reliability, making every subsequent orbital manufacturing run more effective. Besxar’s materials serve industries that demand the highest-performance semiconductors, from AI and quantum computing to nuclear technologies and defense applications. By combining space-based production with a focus on domestic resilience, Besxar is rebuilding the U.S. semiconductor base and redefining how—and where—humanity’s most critical technologies are made.

Name: Orpheusocean
Description: Orpheus Ocean is an innovative deep ocean intelligence company developing autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) for advanced marine exploration. Their customizable unmanned vehicles are designed for scalable seafloor access, conducting geophysical surveys, and collecting environmental data through advanced sensor technologies. The company aims to revolutionize ocean exploration by providing efficient, AI-powered solutions for marine research, environmental monitoring, and supporting the emerging blue economy through autonomous seafloor interaction and high-resolution survey capabilities.

Name: Hera Health Solutions
Description: Hera Health Solutions is a pharmaceutical device company specializing in advanced drug delivery technologies. The company develops innovative biodegradable implants that enable long-term drug treatments, utilizing existing generic drugs and FDA-approved materials. Their proprietary nanotechnology-based platform can create long-acting therapeutic solutions that last up to 48 months, with potential applications across various medical fields. A key focus is developing biodegradable implants that can be used for different drug delivery methods, including contraception, with the goal of creating more patient-friendly and efficient medical treatments.

Name: NT-Tao
Description: NT-Tao is an innovative clean energy company developing compact fusion power technology to revolutionize the global energy sector. Their breakthrough solution aims to generate 10-20 MW of electricity using a scalable, modular reactor design about the size of a shipping container. The company's proprietary ultra-fast plasma heating method enables more efficient fusion reactions, with the goal of commercializing a clean, flexible energy solution within this decade. NT-Tao seeks to provide sustainable power for industries, cities, and remote locations, addressing energy security and decarbonization challenges.

Name: Allosteric Bioscience, Inc.
Description: Allosteric Bioscience is a biotechnology research company that leverages advanced molecular biology and quantum computing to develop therapeutic technologies. The company specializes in developing research and treatments focused on muscle-related conditions, particularly targeting muscle loss prevention and addressing age-related disorders like Sarcopenia. Their approach combines cutting-edge computational technologies with biological research to advance therapeutic solutions.

Name: Phi Life Sciences
Description: Phi Life Sciences is a molecular diagnostic and laboratory services company focused on improving patient health through advanced screening and diagnostic technologies. The company specializes in providing innovative molecular testing services, with a focus on reducing disease mortality and adverse drug reactions. Their services include clinical diagnostic testing, COVID-19 testing, genetic counseling, and clinical research, with an emphasis on delivering precise, actionable medical insights through cutting-edge diagnostic tools and a HIPAA-compliant online portal.

Name: Avstera Therapeutics Inc.
Description: Avstera Therapeutics is a specialty oncology-focused biopharmaceutical company developing innovative therapeutics using advanced immunological insights. Their primary focus is on creating novel treatments for cancer, including a selective oral HDAC6i immunomodulator and emerging therapies like myeloid cell therapies and mRNA cancer vaccines. The company emphasizes cutting-edge approaches in tumor biology, aiming to break scientific barriers and deliver impactful treatments for patients with significant unmet medical needs.

Name: QodeX Quantum
Description: QodeX Quantum is a company that develops research minded technology solutions that bridge the world of artificial intelligence and machine learning with quantum computing. We are a quantum AI company that seeks to improve the trajectory of humanity by enabling breakthroughs in bioinformatics, finance, earth and life sciences, and cybersecurity through quantum AI models that have reduced cost scaling and/or increased performance over classical models. We leverage research innovations in quantum transformer models, quantum ODE solvers, and other quantum algorithms that have demonstrated reductions in complexity over classical methods.

Name: synteny.ai
Description: Synteny is a techbio company leveraging AI and machine learning to advance disease discovery through immune repertoire analysis. The company specializes in developing precision immunotherapies, particularly focusing on T-cell receptor (TCR) bispecific therapies. Its platform combines high-diversity TCR library generation with generative AI to design potent and safe therapeutic approaches, with a primary emphasis on oncological applications. By decoding signals from immune repertoires, Synteny aims to create innovative treatments and support clinical development in precision medicine.

Name: Moligo Technologies
Description: Moligo Technologies is a biotechnology company specializing in advanced DNA synthesis technology. The firm develops high-quality, ultra-pure single-stranded DNA molecules with exceptional purity (99.9%) and lengths up to thousands of bases. Their enzymatic production method addresses critical limitations in traditional DNA synthesis, enabling breakthrough applications in synthetic biology, precision diagnostics, therapeutics, and nanotechnology research.

Name: Dipole Labs
Description: Optical hardware for AI and quantum infrastructure.

Name: Flow-computing
Description: Flow Computing is a technology startup developing a revolutionary Parallel Performance Unit (PPU) that dramatically enhances CPU performance for demanding computing applications. Their innovative architecture can deliver up to 100x performance improvement over traditional CPUs, specifically targeting challenges in AI, edge, and cloud computing. The technology offers full backwards software compatibility, enables 2x performance improvement for legacy applications after recompilation, and can be integrated into existing or new design architectures. Flow Computing aims to overcome current CPU performance limitations by providing a scalable solution that eliminates the need for expensive GPU acceleration.

Name: Form Energy
Description: Form Energy is an American energy technology company specializing in innovative multi-day energy storage solutions. The company develops cost-effective, long-duration battery systems using iron-air technology, designed to enable a reliable and fully renewable electric grid. Their pioneering technology aims to reshape the global electric system by providing energy storage capabilities for over 100 hours, with manufacturing facilities in West Virginia, Pennsylvania, Massachusetts, and California. Form Energy is committed to climate justice and building a diverse workforce that reflects the communities they serve.

Name: Commonwealth Fusion
Description: Commonwealth Fusion Systems (CFS) is an innovative energy technology company dedicated to developing commercial fusion energy solutions. Collaborating closely with MIT, CFS is pioneering high-temperature superconducting (HTS) magnet technology to create compact, low-cost fusion power plants. Their flagship project, SPARC, aims to be the world's first commercially relevant net energy fusion demonstration device, with the ultimate goal of producing grid-ready fusion power. CFS has raised over $2 billion in capital and assembled a team of experts in fusion science, manufacturing, and technology to accelerate the global transition away from fossil fuels and combat climate change.

Name: Quaise
Description: The Engine is a Cambridge, MA-based venture capital firm founded by MIT in 2016 to support 'Tough Tech' startups addressing complex societal challenges. It provides early-stage science and engineering companies with long-term capital, specialized infrastructure, comprehensive programs, and access to labs, equipment, and workspace. Focused on breakthrough innovations that require patient capital, The Engine aims to catalyze new fields and push technological boundaries by supporting transformative startups that can create material positive impact on society and the environment.

Name: Numem
Description: Numem is a semiconductor technology company headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, specializing in advanced memory solutions based on patented NuRAM (MRAM) and SmartMem technologies. The company provides innovative SOC Subsystem IP Cores and Chiplets that offer a superior alternative to traditional SRAM and eFlash, delivering 2.5x smaller area and over 20x lower leakage power. Numem's solutions target critical technology sectors including IoT, wearables, AI/Generative AI, digital security, autonomous vehicles, and data centers, enabling customers to achieve substantial reductions in system power consumption and accelerated time to market.

Name: linque
Description: Linque is an advanced computing technology company specializing in energy-efficient cloud and AI infrastructure. The company develops silicon-photonic integrated circuits that provide faster, greener computing solutions for next-generation algorithms and computational needs. Their hardware offers programmable circuits that reduce energy consumption while enabling rapid information processing and low-latency computing across various applications.

Name: Tulipbiosciences
Description: Mucin-mimetic biomaterials for mucus barrier restoration.

Name: Coral Innovations
Description: Coral Innovations is a nanotechnology company focused on developing sustainable environmental solutions, with a primary emphasis on water remediation and protection. Utilizing breakthrough research in nanotechnology, the company creates advanced solutions for clean water access, including portable water-quality testing units and specialized filtration materials. Their mission is to address environmental challenges by providing innovative, scalable technologies that help communities improve water quality, reduce environmental harm, and support long-term sustainability.

Name: DeckTherapeutics
Description: Deck Therapeutics is a biotechnology company pioneering intravenous omega-3 therapeutics for preventing acute hypoxic-ischemic injury. Leveraging a technology platform developed at Columbia University, the company focuses on delivering omega-3 to the brain rapidly to mitigate cell death and organ injury. Their lead compound THDG3 is being tested for treating neonatal hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy (HIE), a serious condition that can cause cerebral palsy, epilepsy, and developmental challenges in newborns. The company is supported by a world-class scientific advisory board and is conducting research to demonstrate the neuroprotective potential of specialized pro-resolving mediator derivatives.

Name: AQUAPORO
Description: AquaPoro is a technology company specializing in atmospheric water production using innovative Atmospheric Low-humidity Moisture Adsorption (ALMA) technology. The company develops advanced water capture solutions designed to extract drinking water from air, particularly in arid climates. Their primary product, Droplet, provides residential and commercial water generation systems that leverage proprietary adsorption-driven technology to create sustainable water supplies. By integrating with renewable energy sources and optimizing water production based on local environmental conditions, AquaPoro aims to improve global water security and provide clean water access to communities facing water scarcity.

Name: Rivensystems
Description: AI platform for critical minerals processing chemistry.

Name: Claryx
Description: Claryx is a genomic intelligence company focused on preventing hospital outbreaks. It is developing an immune system for hospitals that detects transmission in real-time and guides intervention by infection prevention teams. The company was founded by brothers Kurt and Dirk Hackenberger.

Name: Walden Robotics, Inc.
Description: we're a full-stack physical ai company building and deploying general-purpose robots that put human ingenuity to work at industrial scale. our robots continuously learn and improve while performing real work, today. and we are working toward a future where ai and robotics expand human potential and improve quality of life for everyone. founded in 2026 by pioneers in robotics and ai from toyota research institute, mit, stanford, and amazon, walden combines large behavior models with real-world operation and its own expert teams to bring capable robots to industry today.

Name: Foli Bio
Description: Foli Bio is a biotechnology company specializing in advanced RNA analysis from exfoliated body materials, focusing on precision medicine in gut health and oncology. Using a next-generation platform, the company analyzes trace amounts of human RNA from non-invasive sources like stool and urine to generate comprehensive health insights. Their proprietary technology enables high-resolution cellular RNA analysis, supporting research and clinical assessments in conditions such as ulcerative colitis, Crohn's Disease, and colorectal cancer. Foli Bio collaborates with researchers and industry partners to develop innovative therapeutic approaches based on their advanced RNA decoding capabilities.

Name: Iceberg Quantum
Description: Iceberg Quantum is a quantum startup focused on developing faster and cheaper fault-tolerant architectures for quantum computing. Cofounded by three former PhD students from the University of Sydney, the company aims to create next-generation quantum computing solutions. The startup also collaborates with PsiQuantum to enhance photonic platforms for quantum applications.

Name: Avyuct
Description: Avyuct is an AI and data analytics company specializing in medical imaging and advanced analytics solutions. The company operates two primary business lines: Avyuct Academy, which provides AI/ML and data science courses, and Avyuct Technologies, which focuses on advanced analytics projects. Their core expertise includes medical diagnostic detection systems utilizing AI algorithms for image analysis, advanced computer vision, and various data analytics techniques such as predictive analytics, deep learning, and reinforcement learning. The company serves multiple industries, with a particular focus on healthcare and technological innovation.

Name: Kyber Labs
Description: Kyber Labs is an innovative robotics technology company developing novel artificial muscle fiber actuators for advanced robotic manipulation systems. Their platform focuses on creating low-cost, dexterous robots that can perform human-like tasks in complex environments. By mimicking biological muscle functionality, the company aims to address manual labor shortages through AI-controlled robotic systems that can learn through demonstrations and execute fluid, natural movements not possible with conventional actuation technologies.

Name: Alithia Power
Description: Alithia Power is a seed-stage technology company developing advanced vertical GaN (Gallium Nitride) power electronics for electrification markets. Founded in 2023 and based in Raleigh, NC, the company focuses on creating innovative power diodes and transistors with a compact design. Their vertiGAN™ technology aims to improve power system efficiency for electric vehicles, industrial motors, and renewable energy applications, emphasizing sustainable and high-performance power devices that can operate at high voltages with reduced reliance on traditional semiconductor chips.

Name: Xtrium
Description: XTRIUM is an innovative AI-powered platform that bridges materials science and advanced technology to optimize supply chain resilience and material application discovery. The platform uses artificial intelligence to rapidly match materials to potential applications, reducing discovery cycles from months to minutes. By providing data-driven insights, XTRIUM supports R&D teams, sourcing professionals, and manufacturers in identifying sustainable alternatives, exploring new markets, and enhancing material utilization across various industries.

Name: Renovaretx
Description: Renovare Therapeutics is developing regenerative therapies for musculoskeletal and inflammatory diseases, with an initial focus on osteoarthritis. The company has a two-arm platform combining advanced biomaterials (novel core-shell particle technologies for drug delivery and tissue repair) and gene therapy (novel AAV approaches). It has a six-product pipeline and is backed by ARPA-H funding, with IND submissions targeted for end of 2027.

Name: Kascaid
Description: Kascaid is developing the first platform to monitor the immune system in real-time at home for patients with chronic immune diseases.

Name: Kvasi
Description: We're building real-world testing infrastructure for physical AI teams

Name: Nionyxbio
Description: Nionyx is a biotechnology company specializing in gene therapy and regenerative medicine, with a primary focus on kidney health. Their innovative Nionyx Engine is a medical device designed for precise and safe gene therapy, utilizing a proprietary AAV platform. The device features a unique capsule and cassette system tailored specifically for targeted kidney treatments, offering a breakthrough approach to genetic medical interventions.

Name: Bryce Therapeutics
Description: Bryce Therapeutics is developing selective small molecule inhibitors targeting the L-type calcium channel Cav1.3 for the treatment of Parkinson's disease.

Name: NucleusRx
Description: NucleusRx is an early-stage digital health company based in New Jersey that provides a device-based virtual care platform focused on managing Heart Failure (HF) patients. The company's mission is to empower healthcare providers by offering real-time insights and tools for proactive remote intervention. Their platform helps patients stay compliant with medications and dietary requirements, integrates with existing healthcare systems, and aims to improve patient quality of life while reducing hospital visits and healthcare costs associated with Heart Failure management.

Name: Ardent Biopharma
Description: Recent advancements in Continuous Manufacturing (CM), artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) and anticipated regulatory shifts—such as the potential waiver of Phase III clinical trials—have paved the way for a new biosimilar development and manufacturing company. Ardent Biopharma is seizing this opportunity to redefine cost efficiency in the production of monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) and other therapeutic proteins. Leveraging these innovations, we aim to deliver biosimilars below 20% of the originator price, significantly improving global affordability and accessibility to life-saving or life-enhancing biologic therapies. Ardent aspires to become a cost leader in the biosimilars industry. Both first and second wave biosimilars will be developed. Development will be done in close collaboration with our partners until we can operate from a proprietary facility in The Netherlands. Future product M&S will be realized through specialized parties per region.

Name: Radify
Description: Radify is a deep-tech, venture-backed company tackling one of the largest and most overlooked gaps in our industrial economy: modern metalmaking. Metal is a critical input to trillion-dollar industries – and today, our nation is almost entirely dependent on foreign supply of critical minerals and outdated technology. We’re here to change that. To make metal modern. To make it here.

Name: Powerdrivethermal
Description: AI infrastructure is power constrained. Grid connections take 3-7 years. Behind-the-meter generation is the default. But at every prime-power data center, up to 16-30% of generator output goes to cooling instead of compute. In a power-constrained world, that's stranded capacity. PowerDrive Thermal is building critical cooling infrastructure that converts generator waste heat into cooling capacity — freeing power for revenue-generating compute. No additional fuel. The fastest path to more megawatts per site. * Technology development backed by a decade of federally funded R&D (DOE, ARPA-E, DOD) * Chevron Studio scale-up program * Schneider Electric Ventures Accelerator Cohort 2

Name: KanopyAI
Description: AI-powered vegetation management for power line inspection.

Name: Precision NeuroMed
Description: Precision NeuroMed is a clinical-stage biotechnology company dedicated to developing advanced drug delivery technologies for brain diseases. Their innovative approach targets the underlying causes of neurological conditions rather than just symptoms, focusing on improving drug delivery to the brain. The company's research and development efforts concentrate on creating treatment solutions for complex conditions including brain tumors, epilepsy, stroke, and neurodegenerative diseases. By addressing the critical challenge of effective brain drug delivery, Precision NeuroMed aims to dramatically improve patient outcomes and develop potentially disease-modifying treatments.

Name: Molten Salt Solution
Description: Molten Salt Solutions is a technology company based in Santa Fe, United States, specializing in lithium isotope enrichment using proprietary chromatography and mass spectrometry technologies. The company develops advanced metal salt synthesis methods designed to enhance the efficiency and safety of nuclear power generation, with applications in renewable and nuclear energy sectors.

Name: Voya
Description: Our abundant electric future demands a radical new energy delivery system - untethered from the grid and powered by a superior new class of carbon-free fuel. We believe that metals will be that fuel – abundant, energy-dense, safe, and affordable. At Voya, we are unleashing the power of metal fuels to rapidly deploy reliable, clean, affordable electricity anywhere on Earth. Our breakthrough technology allows us to convert abundant, high-energy, recycled metals into a powerful, safe, durable fuel. We are also creating a foundational new category of energy generation devices, delivering fast access to power - free from the limitations of the grid. We are assembling a highly-experienced team of visionary founders, tenacious researchers, battle-tested operators and world-class investors to deliver on Voya’s ambitious mission. Join us in fueling our electric future.

Name: Dunia
Description: Dunia is an innovative technology company focused on accelerating the energy transition through advanced materials research. Specializing in electroactive materials discovery for the chemical industry, the company leverages artificial intelligence and advanced robotics to develop cost-effective green chemicals and fuels. Their data-driven approach emphasizes sustainable material development, utilizing efficient sampling techniques to reduce traditional research time and costs. Dunia aims to eliminate bottlenecks in scalable carbon utilization by creating high-quality, traceable materials tested under various industrial conditions.

Name: LightXcelerate, Inc.
Description: Micro-VCSEL optical interconnect

Name: Micromize
Description: A venture capital-backed startup developing ultra-miniaturized electronics for mobile and wearable devices. The company focuses on creating lighter, more compact electronic components that extend battery life and reduce electronic waste. Supported by NSF funding, Micromize utilizes advanced semiconductor technology to enhance energy efficiency, with a product line including the E2CAM device designed for wearable and healthcare applications.

Name: oxipitalai.com
Description: Oxipital AI is a technology company specializing in AI-enabled machine vision solutions for robotic process automation and product inspection across critical industries including food processing, agriculture, and consumer goods production. Their platform delivers advanced visual AI technologies that enable no-code deployment of intelligent inspection systems, allowing manufacturers to automate quality control processes, monitor product characteristics in real-time, and perform automated pick and place inspections.
