Description: Health isn’t simply the absence of disease. AntoZero is developing essential technology to move beyond correlative studies based on static endpoints and towards a mechanistic understanding of dynamic, functional brain network health. Our vision is to accelerate the development of therapies targeting circuit function and resilience across neurological conditions. Building this complex, integrated platform requires a focused, interdisciplinary engineering effort – our mission. We seek partners and supporters who share this vision for a new, function-first approach to neuroscience R&D. Let's work together to define and restore optimal brain network function

Name: vedabio.com
Description: VedaBio is a molecular biology technology company developing an advanced molecular detection platform utilizing engineered CRISPR enzymes. Their breakthrough technology enables rapid, highly accurate detection of multiple molecular targets without traditional amplification methods. The platform can detect over 1,000 target segments quickly and supports diverse applications in molecular diagnostics. Led by industry-leading experts, VedaBio operates at the forefront of scientific innovation, creating scalable solutions for near-instant molecular analysis across various research and medical fields.

Name: Ember
Description: AI-augmented venture studio creating the next-generation of billion-dollar deeptech startups

Name: LiquidCell Dx
Description: LiquidCell Dx is a biotechnology startup specializing in advanced liquid biopsy technology and cell-free DNA analysis. Their platform enables detailed health insights through blood sample analysis, helping healthcare providers monitor treatment responses and personalize patient care by extracting and analyzing cell-free DNA to understand disease processes and potential health interventions.

Name: Signadori Bio
Description: Signadori Bio, is a preclinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing a next generation, off-the shelf, in vivo engineered, monocyte immunotherapy platform to treat solid tumours. Founded by Dr Jean-Luc Perfettini and Professor Nathalie Chaput, and based on research conducted at Gustave Roussy, Signadori’s approach aims to overcome the challenges of the tumour microenvironment by harnessing the immune potential of gene-modified monocytes. Signadori is based in Paris and backed by Sofinnova Partners (Paris) and InVivo Partners (Barcelona).

Name: Trogen Therapeutics
Description: Gene circuit platform for cancer immunotherapy (ovarian cancer is the first indication, then melanoma)

Name: Level12Bio
Description: Creating an IL12 p70-specific antibody with potential to precisely shut down the T and B cells responsible for Th1-driven autoimmune diseases

Name: Graph Therapeutics
Description: A precision immunology technology company leveraging AI-driven approaches to develop targeted therapies for immune-mediated diseases. Using advanced computational modeling and multi-omics data from patient cell samples, the company aims to create innovative treatments for complex immune conditions that currently lack adequate therapeutic options.

Name: Alcove Biosciences
Description: Developing a novel small molecule inhibitor targeting a specific protein ("Target 1") for the treatment of autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease (ADPKD)

Name: Humanbio
Description: Developing new drugs for approved targets in novel, de-risked lead indications (“first-in-indication”), guided by human real-world data and genetics

Name: Interdict
Description: A powerful and innovative small-molecule therapeutics platform for addressing historically undruggable targets

Name: Simplex-Robotics
Description: Enchanted Tools is a robotics technology company specializing in developing advanced humanoid robots called Miroka. Their innovative robots are powered by artificial intelligence and designed to enhance human-robot interactions across multiple sectors including hospitality, healthcare, and education. The company focuses on creating intelligent robots with enhanced mobility and real-time reaction capabilities, aiming to transform robotics through cutting-edge engineering and character design expertise.

Name: Hesy Tech
Description: Developers of an AI-guided robotic platform for preventive dentistry that automates routine hygiene tasks, allowing clinics to increase capacity and consistency under human oversight.

Name: HuMoTech
Description: Humotech is a wearable robotics platform specializing in high-performance prostheses and exoskeletons for research, development, rehabilitation, and evaluation. Their flagship product, the Caplex™ system, allows researchers and clinicians to explore and test assistive device concepts with reduced risk and shorter development times. The innovative platform enables users to emulate real-world physical characteristics of potential devices without switching hardware, with powerful robotic components located off-board for lightweight, wearable testing. Humotech supports clinical research, academia, and industries by providing hardware, software, and custom development services to advance mobility solutions and improve patient outcomes.

Name: HyperSpectral.ai
Description: HyperSpectral is an AI-powered spectral intelligence platform that uses advanced spectroscopy technology to identify unique patterns and detect contaminants across multiple industries. Its SpecAI™ platform is hardware-agnostic and capable of real-time scanning and analysis of materials and surfaces, with proven applications in food safety, healthcare, manufacturing, defense, and environmental monitoring. The technology combines artificial intelligence with spectral signature identification to rapidly detect potential risks like pathogens (E. coli, salmonella, listeria) and enable quick, cost-effective insights for quality control and safety purposes.

Name: Inception Robotics
Description: Inception Robotics is a technology platform designed to accelerate autonomous mobile robotics development. The company provides a cloud-based robotics operations platform with comprehensive tools for early-stage robotics companies. Key offerings include automated data collection, simulation testing, algorithm training, and a user-friendly interface for managing robotic development processes. The platform aims to reduce research and development costs and improve efficiency in creating safe and socially compliant autonomous solutions for various applications.

Name: Lupa Robotics, Inc.
Description: Lupa is building the first mass-scale, transferable human dexterity dataset with glove-captured vision, touch, and motion, to pioneer a robot-hand foundation model that delivers capable hands to the real world.

Name: Ras Labs
Description: Ras Labs is a technology company developing advanced electroactive polymer (EAP) materials and robotic sensing technologies. Their key innovations include a tactile fingertip sensor for collaborative robots, designed to enable more delicate and precise manipulation. The company focuses on material science, robotics, and developing artificial muscle technologies for applications in prosthetics, automation, and advanced gripping systems.

Name: Revolve Surgical Inc.
Description: Revolve Surgical is a medical technology company developing an innovative robotic surgery platform designed to make surgical care more accessible and affordable. Their hybrid manual-robotic approach aims to reduce the size, cost, and training requirements of current surgical systems. The compact, portable platform offers ergonomic controls and advanced vision technologies, enabling surgeons to perform procedures with reduced strain and fatigue while making advanced robotic surgical capabilities viable for a broader range of healthcare providers, from independent outpatient centers to national health networks.

Name: Whelix
Description: Whelix is building the physical validation layer for AI-driven biology, starting with intelligent robotic systems that automate mammalian cell culture end-to-end. As AI accelerates discovery in the digital world, every new hypothesis, molecule, and therapy still needs to be validated in living cells. Cell culture remains one of the most manual, variable, and failure-prone workflows across drug discovery, cell therapy, and biomanufacturing. Our platforms combine purpose-built hardware, computer vision, digital twin simulation, and agentic software to automate incubation, liquid handling, imaging, protocol execution, and cell monitoring. By turning cell culture into reproducible, 24/7 lab infrastructure, Whelix helps scientists run more experiments, generate more consistent biology, and accelerate the path from in silico design to living-cell validation.

Name: Zeus Robotics
Description: at zeus robotics, we are transforming hospital logistics through intelligent automation. our flagship innovation is an autonomous delivery robot designed to streamline the internal transportation of critical items—such as medications, lab samples, and medical supplies—within hospital environments. founded by a team of robotics and autonomy engineers, zeus robotics is driven by the belief that advanced healthcare technologies should be accessible, affordable, and impactful. unlike existing solutions with high price tags and limited flexibility, our robots are engineered for cost-efficiency, modularity, and real-world deployment, empowering healthcare providers to focus more on patient care and less on repetitive, non-clinical tasks. we are currently piloting with select hospitals and actively engaging with healthcare professionals to ensure our solutions are aligned with real-world workflows. whether it’s reducing staff fatigue or increasing operational efficiency, our goal is to bring robotics to the front line of healthcare in a meaningful way.

Name: ProQomics
Description: ProQomics is a biotechnology company pioneering high-throughput proteoform quantitation through an advanced mass spectrometry platform. The company provides innovative analytical solutions for protein research, enabling rapid quantification of over 2,000 proteoforms per minute. Their technology combines multiplexed immunoarrays with high-resolution mass spectrometry to support drug discovery, clinical trials, and biomarker development. ProQomics offers customizable reagents and robust standards designed to enhance the accuracy and reproducibility of protein analysis in pharmaceutical and research environments.

Name: Nephrogen
Description: Nephrogen is a biotechnology company founded in 2015 dedicated to developing curative gene therapies for kidney diseases, with a primary focus on polycystic kidney disease (PKD). The company leverages advanced technologies including CRISPR/Cas9 genome editing and a proprietary AI-powered platform called NeFIND™ to create novel gene delivery vectors. Their scientific approach aims to develop more efficient, less immunogenic therapeutic solutions for kidney and pancreatic diseases, with the goal of improving treatment options for the approximately 50 million Americans affected by these challenging medical conditions.

Name: 8inks
Description: 8inks is an advanced battery technology company that specializes in innovative multilayer battery manufacturing. Their core focus is developing scalable lithium-ion battery production solutions that reduce manufacturing costs by up to 30 percent. The company provides end-to-end battery design and manufacturing services, with capabilities spanning automotive, electronics, and transportation sectors, utilizing a unique single coating line technology to optimize battery performance and cost-effectiveness.

Name: Acytronix
Description: We are a Swiss biotech company, specializing in rapid, high-yield, and selective immuno-purification of extracellular vesicles (EVs). Our mission is to revolutionize EV-based therapeutic and diagnostic applications with our cutting-edge technology. Our flagship product is a portable, versatile device that purifies EVs directly from raw biosamples in under 10 minutes, without requiring bulky or expensive equipment. This solution integrates seamlessly into diverse workflows, ensuring efficiency and convenience. In addition to our device, we offer custom purification services and supply high-quality EVs sourced from various biological materials. We serve biopharmaceutical companies, university research labs, hospitals, veterinary clinics, and scientists in the field of biological nanoparticle research. By leveraging our advanced biopurification technology, we simplify the purification of nanometric entities, making it efficient, accessible, and transformative for researchers worldwide.

Name: Apheros
Description: Apheros is a Swiss deeptech startup founded in 2023 as an ETH Zurich spin-off, specializing in innovative metal foam technologies. Their breakthrough material offers unprecedented surface area properties (100-1000x larger than existing products) with applications in thermal management, cooling, catalysis, and battery technologies. The company produces metal foams in various compositions including iron, stainless steel, copper, and nickel, while retaining fundamental metal properties like thermal and electrical conductivity. Targeting industries such as electronics, automotive, aerospace, and energy, Apheros provides advanced cooling solutions for high-performance computing and sustainable technology applications.

Name: aiNET
Description: aiNET is an ETH spin-off based in Basel, Switzerland, specializing in immuno-informatics services for pharmaceutical and biotech companies. The company leverages artificial intelligence to discover antibodies, design immunity libraries, and develop personalized diagnostic solutions. Using advanced AI and large-scale network expertise, aiNET helps clients understand immune responses, create digital immunity platforms, and support clinical decision-making through innovative technological solutions in the medical and biotechnology sectors.

Name: Augetik
Description: Augetik develops high‑resolution muon imaging detectors and AI‑powered analytics that deliver precise, real‑time insight into critical infrastructure and complex structures. The company combines advanced particle detection hardware with a cloud platform to make muon imaging scalable, reliable, and ready for industrial deployment.

Name: Arbrea Labs
Description: Arbrea Labs is a medical technology company specializing in augmented reality (AR) and 3D imaging solutions for aesthetic medicine professionals. Their primary focus is providing advanced AR tools that enable plastic surgeons, aesthetic doctors, and dental professionals to simulate surgical outcomes through precise 3D imaging. The company offers portable simulators that allow doctors to plan surgeries within one minute, based on patient preferences. Their integrated platform includes marketing tools like Lindapp to help clinics attract patients and streamline aesthetic procedure planning and visualization.

Name: mimic robotics
Description: Mimic is an AI robotics company developing scalable models for universal robotic manipulation. Their technology enables intelligent automation of complex manual labor tasks across retail and manufacturing industries. By leveraging AI, the company creates robotic systems that can learn from human video data and adapt to different work environments. The platform allows robots to perform intricate tasks through natural language commands, making advanced automation more accessible and economical for businesses of varying sizes.

Name: Auxivo
Description: Auxivo AG is a leading technology company specializing in developing innovative wearable exoskeletons designed to enhance worker safety and reduce physical strain. Founded in 2019 as a spin-off from the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology (ETH Zürich), the company creates advanced exoskeleton solutions like the OmniSuit, LiftSuit, and DeltaSuit. These products are tailored for various industries including medical, construction, and transportation, with a core mission of supporting workers by reducing physical workload and minimizing the risk of injury during demanding physical tasks.

Name: Baxiva
Description: Baxiva is a biotechnology startup focused on developing innovative vaccines to prevent bacterial infections, with a primary emphasis on combating urinary tract infections (UTIs) caused by E. coli. The company is developing a next-generation K-antigen-targeting vaccine designed to help the immune system recognize and fight bacterial invasions. Founded by Giorgia Greter, Tim Keys, and Christoph Rutschmann, Baxiva aims to address a significant global health challenge, targeting a condition that causes over 80,000 deaths annually in the United States and represents a substantial healthcare economic burden.

Name: Borobotics
Description: Borobotics is a Swiss technology startup focused on developing an autonomous drilling robot called Grabowski, designed to revolutionize geothermal energy installations. Their compact, lightweight robot operates directly within boreholes, reducing traditional drilling limitations such as high energy consumption, expensive processes, and extensive space requirements. The ZHAW spin-off aims to accelerate the heat transition by providing an energy-efficient solution for geothermal probe installation, with market entry planned for 2025 and a target market of heat pump installers and drilling companies.

Name: BTRY
Description: BTRY is a Swiss technology startup specializing in developing innovative solid-state lithium-ion batteries with breakthrough performance characteristics. Spun out of EMPA and ETHZ, the company creates thin, lightweight batteries that can be charged in just one minute, operate reliably at extreme temperatures, and feature a sustainable, solvent-free manufacturing process. Their battery technologies target applications in IoT, MedTech, and consumer electronics, with a core mission of accelerating the global transition to clean energy through advanced, efficient battery solutions that address limitations of traditional lithium-ion batteries.

Name: Caterra
Description: Caterra is an agricultural technology company specializing in ecological precision farming through autonomous laser weed control technology. Their innovative robotic solution enables chemical-free weed removal by targeting weeds close to crops, reducing manual labor and supporting sustainable organic farming practices.

Name: Synthara Technologies
Description: Synthara develops advanced computing technologies focused on enhancing processor performance and energy efficiency, particularly for communication, IoT, wearable, and extended reality (XR) systems. Their flagship product, ComputeRAM™, integrates in-memory computing (IMC) technology to eliminate memory bottlenecks and improve processing speed. The technology supports multiple programming languages and is designed to enhance performance and reliability across various industries, including AI and robotics, by providing more efficient embedded chip solutions.

Name: compagOs
Description: CompagOs is a biotechnology company specializing in 3D bioprinting and bone health research. Their core innovation is Bon3OID™, an advanced in-vitro bone model technology used for drug discovery, preclinical research, and personalized medicine. The company develops sophisticated bone organoids that enable researchers and clinicians to conduct detailed studies on bone diseases, cancer treatments, and drug efficacy. Their solutions support various research areas including bone metastasis, osteosarcoma, osteoporosis, and personalized treatment development.

Name: Dimpora
Description: Dimpora is a sustainable textile technology company specializing in innovative, eco-friendly waterproof membranes for outdoor wear. Their patented CoreLayer Technology creates fabric membranes that are completely waterproof and breathable without using harmful chemicals like PFAS or toxic solvents. The company collaborates with outdoor wear brands to develop high-performance, environmentally conscious textile solutions, focusing on alternative materials including bio-based, mono-material, and potentially biodegradable options. Dimpora's technology enables the creation of functional, sustainable clothing that maintains performance while minimizing environmental impact.

Name: Distran
Description: Distran is a technology company specializing in ultrasonic cameras designed for gas leak detection across multiple industries including oil and gas, power generation, and chemical plants. Their primary product, the Ultra Pro, is a handheld device with a 124-element microphone array that can detect gas leaks from a distance without direct contact. The camera provides real-time ultrasound imaging, enabling faster and more efficient inspection of potential gas leaks, significantly reducing inspection times compared to traditional methods. Distran offers innovative solutions to enhance safety and operational reliability in industrial environments.

Name: ENANTIOS
Description: Enantios provides instrumentation and services specialized in the characterization of chiral molecules. The company offers advanced measurement technologies that utilize laser techniques to analyze complex molecular structures, particularly in the pharmaceutical and biological research domains. Their services focus on providing precise molecular analysis capabilities, helping researchers and companies unlock structural insights that can accelerate drug discovery and development processes.

Name: ZuriQ
Description: ZuriQ is a quantum computing startup developing innovative quantum computer systems using trapped-ion technology. The company focuses on addressing quantum computing scaling challenges through a unique approach that enables flexible, high-performance qubit architecture. Their technology aims to improve quantum computing capabilities by utilizing advanced electric and magnetic field configurations, with potential applications in pharmaceuticals, chemistry, logistics, and other complex computational domains.

Name: femtoG
Description: FemtoG is a Zurich-based startup specializing in nanoparticle and powdered material analysis. The company offers both online and offline structural characterization services for materials like carbon black, silica, and titanium dioxide. Using advanced aerosol-based measurement techniques, FemtoG provides detailed insights into nanoparticle mass and mobility distribution, supporting industrial partners through comprehensive laboratory sample analysis and real-time process monitoring.

Name: FireDrone
Description: FireDrone is an advanced robotic solution designed for extreme temperature environments, particularly in firefighting and emergency response. Developed through a collaborative project with Swiss Federal Laboratories for Materials Science and Technology, the system features high-performance polyimide aerogel insulation and a camera system that provides real-time situational awareness from a safe distance.

Name: Floating Robotics
Description: Floating Robotics develops advanced robotic automation solutions specifically for greenhouse operations. Their cable-driven robots utilize 3D vision, AI, and real-time analytics to automate complex agricultural tasks such as harvesting, de-leafing, and crop handling. The robots are designed for ease of installation, run on solar power, and can operate 24/7, providing a plug-and-play solution that integrates seamlessly with existing greenhouse environments to enhance plant care efficiency and productivity.

Name: GratXray
Description: GratXray is an innovative medical device company specializing in advanced X-ray imaging technology, with a primary focus on breast cancer diagnostics. The company develops phase contrast enhanced X-ray imaging systems that provide unprecedented soft tissue imaging capabilities. Their breakthrough Grating-Interferometry Breast-Computed-Tomography (GI-BCT) system offers more precise tumor detection without compression, using a true volumetric 3D approach that improves patient comfort and provides enhanced tissue contrast compared to traditional X-ray methods.

Name: Haelixa
Description: Haelixa is a Swiss technology company providing innovative DNA-based traceability solutions for supply chain transparency. Originating from ETH Zurich, the company offers a unique method to verify the authenticity and origin of raw materials across multiple industries, including textiles, diamonds, gold, and other precious materials. Using natural DNA markers, Haelixa enables brands to forensically track products from raw materials to finished goods, addressing counterfeiting issues and supporting sustainability efforts. The company has traced over 30,000,000 garments and is trusted by major global brands like C&A, OVS, and Hugo Boss.

Name: HeiQ Materials
Description: HeiQ is a global leader in material and textile innovation, founded in 2005 as a spin-off from the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology Zurich. The company develops high-performance technologies across multiple industries, serving over 1,000 partners in 60+ countries. With a portfolio of over 200 technologies, HeiQ specializes in creating innovative solutions for textiles, flooring, building materials, cosmetics, and more. The company is known for developing advanced technologies that enhance product functionality, sustainability, and performance across various consumer and industrial applications.

Name: Hemetron
Description: Hemetron is a healthcare technology company specializing in at-home blood testing and remote monitoring for chronic diseases. Their innovative platform enables patients to perform quantitative, lab-grade blood tests using a small blood drop, with a focus on inflammation marker testing. The service allows users to monitor blood values on a smartphone, providing physicians with accurate insights to personalize treatment strategies for conditions like rheumatology, cardiovascular diseases, Alzheimer's, diabetes, and cancer.

Name: IDUN Technologies AG
Description: IDUN Technologies is a Swiss neurotech startup specializing in innovative in-ear EEG (electroencephalography) technology. Their flagship product, the IDUN Guardian, is a smartwatch and earbud system designed to measure brainwaves and auditory data with high accuracy. The device provides advanced brain analytics capabilities, including focus tracking, fatigue detection, and sleep monitoring. Targeting researchers, developers, and businesses, IDUN offers a comprehensive software platform and API that enables third-party integration of neurotechnology. CE-certified and user-friendly, their solution democratizes EEG technology by making complex brain data collection accessible to non-experts across various fields like gaming, mental workload assessment, and scientific research.

Name: InkVivo
Description: InkVivo Technologies is a biotech company specializing in advanced drug delivery systems using a proprietary polymer platform. The company develops innovative pharmaceutical and nutritional technologies that enable precise temporal and targeted release of active ingredients, supporting drug development, reformulation of existing medications, and lifecycle management of pharmaceutical products.

Name: InterAx Biotech
Description: InterAx Biotech is a Swiss biotechnology company specializing in drug discovery for G protein-coupled receptor (GPCR) targets. Spun out from ETH Zurich and the Paul Scherrer Institute, the company leverages a unique platform combining experimental biology, artificial intelligence, and computational chemistry. Their innovative approach uses high-throughput biochemical screening and advanced mathematical modeling to develop drug candidates with improved therapeutic efficacy and reduced toxicity. The company focuses on creating precise drug candidates by using protein-based biosensors and AI algorithms to predict cell signaling effects, enabling faster and more targeted drug development across various GPCR targets.

Name: Iron Energy
Description: Iron Energy is an innovative energy storage technology company specializing in sustainable hydrogen storage solutions. Utilizing patented iron ore-based technology, they aim to create affordable and efficient energy storage systems that address renewable energy's intermittency challenges, with a focus on reducing storage costs and promoting energy independence through sustainable infrastructure.

Name: Oxyle
Description: Oxyle is a wastewater treatment technology company founded in 2020, dedicated to solving PFAS pollution challenges through innovative engineering processes. Their specialized systems permanently eliminate persistent micropollutants, including challenging short and ultra-short chain PFAS compounds. By combining proprietary innovations with advanced technologies, Oxyle designs customized treatment solutions for different wastewater streams, targeting industries, R&D labs, hospitals, and municipal treatment plants. The company's mission is to protect water systems by providing sustainable, efficient, and compliant pollution elimination technologies.

Name: MANUKAI
Description: Manukai is an AI-powered software solution designed to optimize CNC machining processes for high-precision metal parts manufacturing. A spinoff from ETH Zürich, the platform addresses skilled worker shortages by automating repetitive machine programming tasks. Using artificial intelligence, Manukai analyzes production data to suggest optimal programming strategies, significantly reducing time spent on machine setup. The software is applicable across multiple industries including automotive, aerospace, and medical devices, enabling faster and more efficient production of complex metal components through intelligent, data-driven programming assistance.

Name: UniSieve
Description: UniSieve is a Swiss cleantech company specializing in advanced molecular separation membrane solutions for industrial applications. Their innovative technology combines molecular sieves and polymeric membranes to provide customizable filtration solutions for gas-gas, liquid-liquid, and liquid-gas separations. Focused on sustainability, the company offers membrane technologies that enhance carbon capture processes, reduce CO2 emissions, and improve energy efficiency across heavy-emitting industries. Their solutions are designed to integrate with existing infrastructure, providing reliable and adaptable separation technologies for various industrial processes.

Name: MYNERVA
Description: Non-invasive nerve stimulation reducing pain and falls for diabetic neuropathy patients

Name: NexMR
Description: NexMR offers NMR drug design solutions that are 50-100-fold faster and require 30-50-fold less sample material. Our platforms are implemented on: 1) high-field NMR instruments equipped with cryoprobes and automatic sampling robots. 2) low-field NMR benchtop spectrometers. To access our early access program and benefit from ultrafast NMR capacities fill out the contact form.

Name: OBaris
Description: OBaris is a medical technology company focused on improving patient experiences with injectable medications through its innovative OctoPatch technology. The company develops a painless, self-applicable patch designed to be placed on the inner cheek, eliminating the discomfort associated with traditional injectable treatments. Their mission is to enhance patient quality of life by providing a more comfortable and user-friendly method for administering injectable drugs.

Name: Odne
Description: Odne is a medtech startup focused on revolutionizing endodontic care through innovative dental technologies. Founded in 2018 and ISO 13485 certified, the company aims to disrupt the endodontic device market in the US and EU. Their core offerings include advanced root canal treatment technologies, such as the Root Preservation Therapy workflow and light-activated medical fillers. Odne develops cutting-edge solutions designed to improve dental procedures, minimize invasive techniques, and help patients preserve their natural teeth through innovative cleaning technologies and advanced medical devices.

Name: Circular Flow Technologies
Description: ogmo turns around the approach to wastewater treatment: we supply modular on-site treatment units with resource recovery. No need for sewers. No costly excavation works. Safeguarding via online monitoring. Production of value-adding products.

Name: Perovskia SA
Description: A cleantech startup specializing in custom-designed perovskite solar cells with innovative digital printing technology. Located in Switzerland, the company produces highly efficient solar cells for indoor and outdoor applications, targeting industries like IoT, automotive, and industrial electronics. Their technology enables solar cells to be designed around products, offering energy independence, extended battery life, and utilizing low-carbon, recyclable materials. The company aims to produce one million solar elements annually with a focus on sustainability and design flexibility.

Name: Prevision Medicine
Description: Prevision Medicine envisions a world where every patient diagnosed with cancer receives the most effective treatment options through personalized ex vivo drug testing, delivering well tolerated life-extending therapies.

Name: qCella
Description: qCella is a B2B material technology company developing innovative heating solutions using a patented copper-impregnated natural fiber hybrid material. Originating as a spin-off from ETH Zurich, the company creates paper-thin, flexible heating mats that can be customized to almost any shape and size. Their technology enables energy-efficient heating by providing homogeneous heat distribution without requiring additional insulation layers. Applications include automotive interiors, clothing, shoes, medical products, and industrial machinery. The heating mats can be easily integrated into various products, offering a more efficient and adaptable heating solution compared to traditional heating wires.

Name: Scailyte
Description: Scailyte is a precision medicine company that develops diagnostic solutions using advanced AI and single-cell technologies. As an ETH Zürich spin-off, the company employs its proprietary ScaiVision AI platform to analyze complex biological datasets and identify disease-specific biomarkers. Specializing in oncology and immunology, Scailyte collaborates with clinical partners and pharmaceutical companies to develop ultra-sensitive companion diagnostics by leveraging multimodal single-cell data analysis. The company's approach enables unprecedented insights into disease patterns, potential treatment responses, and therapeutic opportunities through high-resolution biological data processing.

Name: Immitra Bio
Description: Immitra Bio is a pioneering genetic medicine company developing innovative cell and gene therapies using Hematopoietic Stem Cells (HSCs) and CRISPR-Cas9 gene editing technologies. The company focuses on treating rare hereditary blood diseases by creating precise, durable, and safe gene modifications within blood stem cells. Their cutting-edge platform enables in-vivo biotherapeutic protein production, offering a versatile and reprogrammable approach to developing transformative treatments for diseases with high unmet medical needs.

Name: Solabs
Description: Solabs Nanotechnology is an innovative materials science company specializing in advanced anti-fog nanocoating technologies. Their ultrathin nanolayers absorb invisible solar energy to generate heat, preventing fog formation across diverse applications including medical devices, automotive, and architectural surfaces. The coating is 10,000 times thinner than a human hair, can operate in low light and darkness, and offers low maintenance with reduced environmental impact. The technology leverages renewable sunlight and infrared energy to create a permanent anti-fog solution that can be integrated with existing coating systems.

Name: Optohive
Description: Optohive develops innovative wearable brain imaging technology using near-infrared imaging (NIRI), making advanced neuroscience research tools more accessible and affordable. Their platform offers customizable hardware and software solutions for capturing high-precision brain activity, supporting research and clinical applications. The technology enables real-time data collection, AI-powered analysis, and aims to revolutionize brain monitoring by providing portable, cost-effective solutions for neuroscience research and patient care.

Name: Treeless Pack
Description: Treeless is an ETH Zurich Spin-off developing microorganism-based cellulose materials with the mission to end plastic pollution by enabling the transition to bio-based, fossil-free material production.

Name: UNISERS
Description: UNISERS is a specialized technology startup focused on contamination control in the semiconductor industry. The company develops advanced machines and detection technologies that identify critical microscopic contaminants in microchip manufacturing processes. Using a unique vacuum-based plasma coating technology, UNISERS helps semiconductor manufacturers detect particles as small as 8nm, providing detailed molecular signatures that reduce manufacturing waste and improve production yield through precise impurity detection and analysis.

Name: Scanvio Medical
Description: Scanvio is a healthcare technology company focused on improving endometriosis diagnosis through AI-augmented ultrasound software. Their primary product, the Scanvio AI Assistant™, enhances gynecological examinations by providing real-time feedback on imaging conditions and organ exposure. The technology aims to dramatically reduce endometriosis diagnosis time from 8 to 3 years by offering advanced ultrasound analysis tools that support healthcare providers in making more accurate and timely diagnostic decisions.

Name: Tandem Therapeutics
Description: Tandem Therapeutics is a Swiss biopharmaceutical discovery-stage company pioneering innovative approaches to treating fibrotic diseases and cancers. Their unique therapeutic platform focuses on the extracellular matrix, using Matrix Targeting Peptides (MTP) to conditionally target disease-associated matrix alterations. Leveraging over 15 years of research from ETH Zürich and Paul Scherrer Institut, the company aims to develop precision therapies that address complex cellular environments in fibrotic conditions. Their research seeks to enhance drug safety and efficacy by targeting critical matrix proteins that contribute to disease progression.

Name: Voliro Airborne Robotics
Description: Voliro is a robotics company specializing in advanced aerial inspection drones with unique 360-degree capabilities. Their innovative flying robots are designed for industrial inspections across sectors like oil and gas, wind energy, infrastructure, and utilities. The drones feature a tiltable rotor system enabling inspection of curved and sloped surfaces, and can be equipped with various sensors for non-destructive testing, operating on a B2B subscription model to enhance safety and efficiency in industrial operations.

Name: Winduction AG
Description: Winduction is an innovative technology company focused on wireless charging solutions for electric vehicles. Their key innovation involves inductive charging technology that utilizes renewable energy sources to charge vehicles while driving. The system offers up to 160 kW of energy transfer, with a low energy consumption rate of 90%, and aims to create a more sustainable transportation ecosystem by reducing the need for large onboard batteries and enabling on-the-go charging.

Name: UNOMR
Description: Unomr is a biotechnology startup specializing in advanced single-molecule protein analysis using innovative nanopore sensor technology. Their platform offers sophisticated protein quantification and site-specific analysis through a unique interface nanopore system that enables chemical-enhanced measurements of individual molecules. The technology is designed for use in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and environmental research, providing researchers with advanced tools for detecting and analyzing low-abundance proteins with high precision and customizable measurement capabilities.

Name: MintNeuro
Description: MintNeuro is a pioneering semiconductor technology company specializing in developing advanced neural implant technologies. The company designs innovative, low-power, and compact integrated circuits for minimally invasive medical applications targeting neurological disorders. By creating scalable and cost-effective electronic components, MintNeuro partners with medical device companies, researchers, and institutions to enhance patient outcomes. Their technology supports critical functions like neural signal acquisition, processing, and power management, with a mission to provide high-performance solutions that minimize surgical invasiveness in neurological treatments.

Name: micrographiaBio
Description: Micrographia Bio is a life sciences company pioneering innovative drug discovery technologies through spatial proteomics. The company has developed a unique platform that combines advanced microscopy imaging with machine-intelligent computer vision to autonomously assess therapeutic mechanisms of action. By visualizing protein-protein networks in cells, their technology aims to accelerate and improve the efficiency of drug development, providing detailed insights into cellular pathways and potentially enabling faster, more accurate therapies for various diseases.

Name: Merge4Energy
Description: Physical AI power infrastructure. Next generation solid state, 800VDC protection and control for data centers, EV charging and the utility grid.

Name: Assetcool
Description: AssetCool is an innovative technology company developing specialized photonic coatings and semi-autonomous application systems for overhead power lines. Their core technology increases electricity network performance by reducing energy losses, costs, and emissions through advanced nanotechnology-based coatings. The company's solutions can increase current carrying capacity by up to 45%, reduce power losses by up to 30%, and provide corrosion resistance for power transmission infrastructure, offering significant operational and financial benefits for utility and energy sectors.

Name: Navia
Description: Developing autonomous robotic intra cardiac echocardiography imaging system

Name: Cellsor
Description: Cellsor is pioneering a new era of chemical sensors by merging natural olfaction with advanced chips. Our proprietary platform harnesses a living olfactory epithelium integrated with microelectrodes to detect volatile organic compounds (VOCs) with unmatched sensitivity and specificity—like a digital dog’s nose, but more precise, tunable, and scalable. Built by a multidisciplinary team of scientists, engineers, and clinicians, Cellsor’s technology is designed to revolutionize detection across sectors—from healthcare and security to environmental monitoring and the fragrance industry. Our goal is simple: to build the most advanced chemical sensing platform ever created—alive, adaptive, and rooted in millions of years of evolution.

Their core offerings include energy-efficient thermal systems that capture and convert low-grade waste heat into usable energy and cooling solutions. The company serves various industries including industrial, commercial, and defense sectors, with products such as heat engines, heat exchangers, and thermal coolers designed to enhance energy efficiency and reduce carbon emissions.

Their core mission involves empowering customers through advanced IT solutions, with a strong commitment to open-source principles and community-driven development. CIQ provides tools and services designed to help organizations optimize their technological capabilities, with a particular emphasis on supporting companies, teams, and individuals in achieving their technological objectives through cutting-edge infrastructure solutions.

Name: Pitch Aeronautics
Description: Pitch Aeronautics is a specialized drone technology company focused on power line infrastructure management. The company develops custom drone platforms, including the Astria drone, designed for precision installations and inspections of electrical infrastructure. Their key products include the WireWarrior Line Sensor for monitoring weather conditions and potential hazards, and the FeatherFender Bird Diverter to prevent avian collisions. The company's WireWeather software enables utilities to optimize power distribution, predict potential faults, and manage wildfire risks through advanced drone-based monitoring and component installation capabilities.

Name: Wavelet
Description: our goal is to eliminate preventable brain injury at birth, reduce the rate of unnecessary caesarean sections, and improve outcomes for both the mother and baby. fetal heart rate monitoring is used in 90% of labors to assess the baby's neurological health and has been associated with a 5x increase in c-section rates. despite decades of use, it has not decreased fetal brain injury and has been associated with an adverse trend in overall c-section rates, resulting in extremely high maternal morbidity and mortality. electroencephalogram (eeg), measuring brain waves via electrodes, is a more accurate and earlier indicator of the baby's neurological health. however the previously proven method is invasive, requiring a scalp electrode on the baby during labor, and is not feasible at scale or in varying fetal positions. we have developed a new, non-invasive method & technology that harnesses the clinical promise of eeg without compromising the health of the mother or baby. better monitoring will lead to better outcomes both for mother and child, in terms of avoiding brain injury during delivery and avoiding unnecessary c-sections and better matching c-sections or other interventions to clinically appropriate situations.

Their mission is to improve patient treatments by producing bioprinted tissue therapeutics that can restore or support organ function. The company leverages expertise in synthetic biology and 3D-bioprinting to replicate human tissue at scale, enabling researchers and doctors to develop more effective clinical treatments.

Description: Netpreme is a technology company focused on photonic networking solutions specifically designed for AI infrastructure. Their key offerings include high-bandwidth photonic networks supporting XPU memory expansion, enabling more efficient data transfer and processing for AI systems. Their core product, the Afference Ring, enables users to experience artificial touch by connecting the nervous system to digital devices. The technology supports wireless Bluetooth connectivity and allows users to feel digital objects in augmented, virtual, and extended reality environments. Based on neuroscientific research, Afference's technology aims to enhance touchless interfaces and digital interaction by providing seamless communication between physical and digital worlds.

Name: Axiomatic_AI
Description: Axiomatic AI is an advanced artificial intelligence platform focused on accelerating research and development in science and engineering. The company aims to achieve Mission 10X30 by developing an AI-driven engineering tool that reduces technical challenge resolution time. Their unique approach combines formal verification with deep learning to create transparent, interpretable AI models for technical applications, particularly in photonics and semiconductor hardware development. The platform generates physics-based models, extracts technical documentation data, and provides automated design verification to minimize errors and improve technology development speed.

Name: Edison Scientific Inc.
Description: Edison Scientific is an AI-powered platform for autonomous scientific research, based in San Francisco. The company's Kosmos platform automates critical research tasks including literature synthesis, data analysis, and molecular design, enabling researchers to accelerate discovery across disciplines like drug development, biochemistry, and computational biology. By running hundreds of research tasks simultaneously, the platform can transform raw datasets into comprehensive, validated reports within hours, dramatically compressing research timelines while keeping scientists in control of the discovery process.

Name: Avalo
Description: Avalo is an agricultural technology company that leverages AI and genomics to accelerate crop breeding and development. Using interpretable machine learning and advanced genomic analysis, the company creates climate-resilient and sustainable crop varieties through a natural, non-GMO approach. Their Rapid Evolution Platform enables predictive modeling of genetic opportunities, whole genome analysis, and the development of more efficient agricultural products designed to address challenges posed by climate change. The platform focuses on enhancing genetic diversity and improving crop efficiency faster and more affordably than traditional breeding methods.

Name: Sequins
Description: Sequins is a biotechnology company specializing in synthetic nucleic acid controls for genomic research. Their innovative platform provides synthetic spike-in DNA controls that accurately mirror naturally occurring genetic sequences across various organisms. The company offers comprehensive solutions for genomic analyses, including Whole Genome Sequencing, Metagenomics, and custom sequencing services. Their technology is designed to enhance genomic research by improving data accuracy, reducing errors, and maintaining sample integrity through precisely engineered synthetic controls.

Name: SPARC Evolution
Description: SPARC Evolution is a clean technology company specializing in advanced lithium-ion battery recycling. The company uses a proprietary process to extract critical materials like lithium, nickel, cobalt, and graphite from battery waste, with a focus on strengthening domestic refining capacity. Their innovative recycling technology offers an efficient, low-environmental-impact solution for recovering high-purity battery-grade materials, supporting the energy transition and reducing dependence on foreign supply chains.

Description: Respire Energy is developing innovative battery technology focused on sustainable and safe energy storage solutions for microgrid applications. The company is creating a new generation of non-flammable batteries constructed with abundant, commodity materials. Their goal is to make clean energy more accessible and dependable, empowering communities with reliable and sustainable energy storage technology that can be deployed in various microgrid environments.

Description: Portal is a cell engineering platform company focused on advanced intracellular delivery technologies for research and clinical applications. The company provides a proprietary mechanical delivery system capable of transporting various cargo types to multiple cell types. Specializing in next-generation cell engineering and analytics, Portal supports breakthroughs in RNA, gene editing, and AI-driven cellular technologies. Description: Atana is a critical minerals exploration company specializing in flowing mineral systems, including lithium brines, hydrogen, helium, and emerging extraction methods for copper and uranium. Description: Stormentum is a technology company specializing in innovative residential solar+storage solutions. Their platform is designed to reduce installation complexity and costs while providing flexible energy solutions for residential and commercial customers. The system features a distributed architecture that optimizes energy harvest, supports battery-agnostic configurations, and simplifies the installation process for modern solar energy deployments.

Description: Kvasir Technologies is a Danish company developing innovative climate-friendly fuel solutions for hard-to-decarbonize industries. Their core technology converts non-edible agricultural waste biomass into a carbon-neutral, drop-in biofuel that can seamlessly integrate into existing marine and refinery fuel supply chains. Description: Skouria is a mining technology company specializing in innovative copper extraction through Deep Brine Mining (DBM), an advanced process designed to reduce environmental impact and capital costs. Name: Bristol Superlight Limited
Description: Bristol Superlight is an automotive technology company based in Hampshire, United Kingdom, specializing in innovative logistics vehicle design. Their primary focus is developing plug-in hybrid trucks with advanced engineering features, including a lighter and stronger chassis constructed from composites and aluminum. The company employs a unique production system that enables efficient manufacturing of multiple vehicle variants, with a key emphasis on creating digital-first vehicles that reduce energy costs and optimize cargo transportation solutions for the modern logistics industry.

Name: DisperseBio
Description: Dispersebio is a biotechnology company specializing in sustainable biofilm management solutions. Name: JuliaHub
Description: JuliaHub is a cloud-based platform for scientific computing and modeling, built on the Julia programming language. Their innovative approach enables the conversion of discarded nylon materials back into new clothing manufacturing inputs, providing a cost-effective and low-carbon solution to reduce landfill waste. By transforming synthetic textile recycling, Syntetica aims to promote environmental sustainability in the textile industry.

Name: Minus Filtration
Description: Minus Filtration is an advanced water technology company developing innovative, chemical-free water treatment solutions. Partnered with the Georgia Institute of Technology, the company has developed patented membrane technologies for removing contaminants, including PFAS, from water systems. Their solutions are designed for municipal drinking water facilities, industrial water treatment, and small community systems, offering up to 99% water recovery. The company provides scalable, cost-effective water purification systems with automated operations and a modular plug-and-play design, focusing on sustainable and health-conscious water treatment approaches.

Name: FluoSphera
Description: FluoSphera is a biotechnology company developing advanced in vitro human biosystems for pharmaceutical drug discovery. Their proprietary stem cell differentiation platform generates advanced stem cell-derived embryo models and works on developing long-term engraftment protocols. The company's research focuses on tackling challenges of aging populations by exploring breakthrough stem cell technologies to potentially extend human health capabilities.

Name: Forta Bio
Description: forta bio is a next-generation biotech company developing odc™ (oligo-dependent cytotoxicity), a new class of precision and programmable dna/rna medicines that selectively eliminate disease-driving cells - without compromising healthy immunity. odc™ combines targeted delivery, intracellular activation, and immune modulation in a single, synthetic molecule. each odc integrates: 1. targeting domain (short cpg oligo or aptamer) that enables selective uptake by specific cells. 2. cytotoxic switch that activates only inside tert+ pathogenic cells. 3. immunomodulatory sequence capable of activating or suppressing immune pathways. this approach enables vector-free delivery, brain penetration, and highly selective activity in cancers and immune-driven diseases - all while preserving healthy tissue. we are accelerating development by building fortaguideai™, an integrated ai engine to design and optimize our odcs. we focus on high-burden, underserved conditions - particularly those affecting women and children - and pursue accelerated regulatory pathways. backed by validated science from city of hope and led by a team with 7+ inds, 30+ pharma deals, and multiple biotech exits, forta bio is on a mission to bring smarter, safer, and more targeted therapies to patients who need them most.

Their lead asset, MOm303, aims to address a critical medical need by binding and eliminating maternal sFlt-1, a known cause of vascular breakdown in preeclampsia, while potentially prolonging pregnancy and reducing preterm birth consequences. The company addresses a significant global health challenge, with preeclampsia causing 70,000 maternal and 500,000 infant deaths annually.

Name: Tessellate2D
Description: there are more transistors made every year than there are grains of sand on earth, and like sand they are primarily made of silicon. improved computer chip performance requires ever smaller transistor sizes, but silicon transistors have reached their fundamental physical limit. the most promising alternative to silicon at ultra-short length scales are two-dimensional (2d) semiconductors. tessellate 2d manufactures the highest quality 2d semiconductors for next generation computer chips. leveraging patented technology developed at columbia university, we deterministically disassemble bulk 2d semiconductor crystals into their component angstrom-thick monolayers. this “gold-stamp” method produces monolayers with record low defect densities, record high performance, and industrially compatible sizes.
