The company provides smart waste management solutions for high-traffic facilities like airports and hospitals, helping organizations approach zero waste goals by collecting detailed waste analytics and improving recycling efficiency through automated sorting technologies.

Name: Cradlewise Inc.
Description: Cradlewise is a Silicon Valley-based baby technology startup that offers an innovative smart crib designed for infants aged 0-24 months. The AI-powered device functions as an all-in-one sleep solution, featuring an integrated contactless baby monitor that learns from the baby's sleep patterns and automatically responds to signs of wakefulness. Key features include responsive soothing techniques, personalized bouncing and music, real-time video monitoring via smartphone, and sleep analytics tracking. Founded in 2019 by parents Bharath and Radhika, the product aims to provide uninterrupted sleep for babies while giving parents peace of mind through advanced monitoring and adaptive care technology.

Name: Darma Inc.
Description: Darma is a digital health company providing innovative continuous patient monitoring solutions using patented fiber optic sensing technology. Their platform offers contact-free bed and chair sensors that track heart rate, respiration, bed occupancy, and sleep patterns. Utilizing advanced algorithms and machine learning, Darma shifts patient monitoring from traditional alarm-based systems to predictive and preventative care. Their SaaS cloud platform delivers real-time monitoring and alerts, with a mission to improve quality of life, increase healthy life expectancy, and reduce healthcare costs for individuals with chronic diseases.

Name: DiviGas
Description: DiviGas is an advanced membrane technology company specializing in hydrogen recovery and purification solutions for industrial processes. They have developed a unique hollow fiber polymeric membrane technology designed for high-temperature gas separation, particularly in refineries, petrochemical, and chemical processing industries. The company's innovative membrane technology offers improved efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and enhanced performance in handling high-purity hydrogen and CO2 separation.

Name: Carv
Description: Carv is a digital ski coaching technology that transforms ski boots into a personal coaching system through wearable motion sensors and a mobile app. The device captures skiing movements and conditions, providing real-time audio feedback and personalized technique tips for skiers of all skill levels. Developed with input from Olympic and professional skiers, Carv analyzes motion and pressure distribution, offering detailed performance metrics and actionable coaching insights to help users improve their skiing technique and confidence on various terrains.

Name: Neptune Robotics
Description: Neptune Robotics is a maritime technology company specializing in automated robotic hull cleaning and inspection services for vessels. Operating in over 60 ports worldwide, the company provides comprehensive underwater drone solutions aimed at reducing maritime fuel consumption and carbon emissions. Their services include real-time vessel condition monitoring, hull cleaning, biofouling management, and specialized robotic inspections. Utilizing advanced AI and cavitational waterjet technology, Neptune Robotics offers a robotics-as-a-service (RaaS) model that helps shipowners and maritime agencies improve vessel efficiency and environmental sustainability.

Name: LIVIN farms
Description: Livin Farms is an innovative insect farming technology company focused on sustainability and alternative protein solutions. They develop advanced insect rearing technologies, including a desktop hive for home insect cultivation and professional insect breeding solutions. The company provides end-to-end services for insect farming, including bio feasibility assessments, engineering support, and automated insect factory technologies. Their products enable the transformation of organic by-products into insect-based animal feed or human food, with a mission to empower people to contribute to a more sustainable food ecosystem through innovative insect cultivation technologies.

Name: ViaBot
Description: ViaBot is a robotics startup headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, focusing on developing next-generation utility robots for commercial property maintenance. Founded in 2016 by Gregg Ratanaphanyarat and Andre Ding, the company creates self-charging, self-emptying sweeping robots that operate autonomously. Their robots provide facility management solutions with capabilities including dynamic path planning, environmental monitoring, and tracking personnel and vehicles to enhance operational insights and efficiency.

Name: WakeCap Technologies
Description: WakeCap is an IoT-based enterprise solution designed to improve construction productivity and safety through innovative technology. The company provides a sensor-powered project control system that integrates smart sensors into construction hard hats, vehicles, and tools to enable real-time workforce tracking, site-wide intelligence, and enhanced logistical management. Their platform offers features like location tracking, daily data management, productivity monitoring, predictive safety alerts, and seamless integration with existing project management software, ultimately helping construction companies optimize workforce efficiency and workplace safety.

Name: Butlr
Description: Butlr is an IoT and machine learning platform that provides thermal wireless occupancy sensors for commercial properties. The company enables real-time analysis of customer behavior and building occupancy through privacy-preserving technology. Its camera-free sensors generate business intelligence on foot traffic and customer trajectories, allowing enterprises to integrate occupancy data into existing systems. With SOC 2 Type II certification, Butlr helps businesses automate building operations, improve sustainability, and strategically enhance revenue through anonymous and secure occupancy tracking.

Name: Windfall Bio
Description: Windfall Bio is an agricultural technology company that develops innovative solutions for methane emissions reduction by using methane-eating microbes to transform harmful methane into organic fertilizer. The company's technology enables industries like agriculture, oil and gas, and waste management to capture methane emissions and convert them into valuable soil nutrients. By providing microbes, digestors, and management software, Windfall Bio helps businesses reduce their carbon footprint while creating economic opportunities for farmers by producing sustainable, equitable food products without increasing consumer costs.

Name: Amper Technologies
Description: Amper is a manufacturing operations management software (MES) platform designed to enhance operational efficiency for manufacturers and job shops. The platform provides real-time machine monitoring and tracking, allowing teams to manage production processes, schedule jobs, and improve productivity. Its key features include automated job tracking, dynamic forecasting, machine utilization monitoring, and easy integration with existing ERP systems. Amper offers a quick-to-install device that connects to machinery, enabling manufacturers to track performance metrics, predict maintenance needs, and optimize factory operations from a centralized 'mission control' interface.

Name: Strados Labs
Description: Strados Labs is a medical technology company specializing in respiratory health monitoring through innovative wearable technology. Their FDA-cleared RESP® Biosensor is a groundbreaking digital device that continuously captures lung sounds like coughing and wheezing, enabling remote patient monitoring for chronic respiratory diseases such as asthma and COPD. Using machine learning and proprietary algorithms, the company provides clinicians and researchers with objective, real-time insights into patient health, facilitating better treatment plans, enhanced disease management, and more accurate clinical trial assessments across respiratory and potentially other chronic conditions.

Name: Unbox Robotics
Description: Unbox Robotics develops innovative software-defined robotics systems for logistics automation, specializing in parcel distribution through swarm robotics technology. Their flagship product, UnboxSort, is a patented AI-powered parcel sorting robotic system that can be installed in under two weeks, saving 50-80% of operational space while improving productivity by 3-5 times. The company applies proprietary swarm intelligence and machine learning algorithms to optimize order sorting and shipping processes for logistics players, offering customizable, low-cost automation solutions.

Name: Unicorn Biotechnologies
Description: Unicorn Biotechnologies develops an advanced biomanufacturing platform that automates and streamlines cell culture manufacturing for biotech and research industries. Their integrated hardware and software solution, called Emmet, enables autonomous scientific discovery by providing automated cell culture processes, reducing manual labor, and improving efficiency in stem cell research, cellular agriculture, and therapeutic product development. The platform aims to accelerate scientific research and support the transition to more sustainable manufacturing methods.

Name: Sana Health
Description: Sana is a digital health company that develops bio-therapeutic devices for chronic pain and insomnia management, backed by 25 years of research. The company manufactures a smart sleep mask that uses audiovisual neuromodulation technology to induce deep relaxation and alleviate pain, tension, anxiety, and stress in just 10 minutes. Headquartered in Colorado, Sana targets individuals with PTSD and neuropathic pain conditions, offering personalized support through certified professionals via a secure online portal. The device is currently undergoing FDA certification and clinical trials, and is not yet approved for specific medical conditions, being marketed for rest and recovery purposes until regulatory approval is obtained.

Name: Smartex
Description: Smartex is an AI-driven technology company revolutionizing the textile industry through advanced quality control and manufacturing solutions. Their flagship products, Smartex CORE and Smartex LOOP, use artificial intelligence and machine learning to detect fabric defects in circular knitting machines, enable real-time quality monitoring, and provide comprehensive data collection. The platform helps textile manufacturers optimize operations, reduce production costs by up to 70%, improve sustainability, and enhance supply chain transparency through automated inspections and digital tracking.

Name: Somatic
Description: Somatic is a robotics company specializing in automated cleaning solutions for commercial bathrooms. Their innovative robots autonomously perform cleaning tasks including chemical spraying, floor vacuuming, and door navigation. The company offers a flat monthly pricing model with no upfront fees, providing businesses with a technology-driven approach to maintaining hygienic restroom environments through advanced robotic cleaning systems.

Name: PureLi
Description: PureLi is a cleantech company that has developed Lilypad, an innovative technology for improving lithium extraction from brine water. Originating as a spin-off from Princeton University, the company focuses on enhancing the efficiency of evaporation ponds through a specialized system that increases heat retention and reduces traditional mining requirements. Their technology features a durable coating and modular design, enabling high recovery rates of up to 90% for lithium, potassium, and nitrate while promoting sustainable extraction practices with minimal energy and chemical usage.

Name: Green Li-ion
Description: Green Li-ion is an innovative battery recycling technology company that addresses environmental challenges in the lithium-ion battery industry. Their patented technology offers a more efficient and profitable approach to battery recycling, capable of handling multiple battery types simultaneously. The company's solution reduces recycling inefficiencies, cuts production time, and increases profitability by 4x compared to current methods. Their modular processing plants enable battery manufacturers and recyclers to improve sustainability, reduce environmental impact, and create a more economically viable approach to recovering critical materials from spent batteries.

Name: Flow Neuroscience
Description: Flow Neuroscience is a medical technology company offering an innovative, drug-free treatment for depression. Their solution combines a transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) headset with a personalized mobile app to address both the physical and behavioral aspects of Major Depressive Disorder (MDD). The treatment is medically approved in Europe and the UK, providing a non-invasive brain stimulation method that targets mood-regulating brain areas. Clinically validated through multiple trials, the headset aims to improve mental health outcomes by helping users manage depression symptoms through an accessible, at-home therapeutic approach.

Name: SEPPURE
Description: SepPure Technologies is an innovative separation technology company developing advanced nanofiltration membrane solutions for industrial chemical processes. Their technology addresses the energy-intensive chemical separation challenge by introducing novel chemical-resistant membranes that separate chemical mixtures at a molecular level with minimal energy consumption. Targeting industries like edible oil, pharmaceuticals, and semiconductor manufacturing, SepPure's sustainable approach eliminates heat-based separation methods, significantly reducing global energy use, emissions, and pollution while offering more environmentally friendly chemical separation techniques.

Name: Pulse Industrial
Description: Pulse Industrial is an IoT technology company focused on improving industrial plant safety and efficiency through advanced steam trap monitoring solutions. Using IoT sensors and machine learning analytics, the company provides real-time remote monitoring of steam traps to detect failures, prevent downtime, and reduce energy consumption. Their innovative system enables industrial sites to immediately identify and rectify steam trap issues, resulting in significant economic and environmental savings by preventing steam loss and potential hazardous events.

Name: Qnetic
Description: Qnetic is an energy storage technology startup developing an innovative flywheel energy storage system (FESS) designed to support the global transition to renewable energy. Their low-cost, grid-scale technology enables daily energy shifting between solar and wind power sources, addressing intermittency challenges in renewable energy. The system is capital cost-competitive with lithium-ion batteries and offers a lower levelized cost of storage (LCOS), making it a promising solution for sustainable energy infrastructure. Targeting mass production by 2025, Qnetic aims to accelerate the shift away from fossil fuels by providing scalable, efficient energy storage that can help integrate more renewable energy into power grids.

Name: Raybaby
Description: Raybaby is an innovative baby monitoring technology company that offers advanced non-contact sleep and breathing monitors for infants. Developed by experienced engineers with support from Johnson & Johnson and HAX, their smart baby monitoring solution features HD video, night vision, two-way audio, and a smartphone app that provides real-time notifications and a comprehensive sleep tracking journal. The device operates from up to 5 feet away and is designed to help parents monitor their baby's respiratory health and sleep patterns with minimal intrusion.

Name: Reach Industries
Description: Reach Industries is an early-stage startup developing Lumi™, an intelligent platform that uses computer vision, voice, and machine learning to augment scientific research. The platform automates data capture and analysis across various stages of life sciences development, from research to production environments. By streamlining experiment monitoring and data collection, Lumi™ helps scientists save time, increase reproducibility, and focus on critical scientific challenges.

Name: Rightbot Technologies
Description: Rightbot is an advanced warehouse automation company developing AI-driven robotics platforms for logistics and material handling. Their flagship product, the Wolverine robot, automates trailer unloading with a capacity of 5,000 unloads per hour. The company creates flexible mobile carton handling robots capable of unloading, loading, case-picking, palletization, and de-palletization across various industrial settings, enhancing operational efficiency through autonomous robotic solutions.

Name: Nuada
Description: Nuada develops innovative soft active exoskeleton technology, specifically designing advanced hand support systems for individuals with mobility limitations. Their flagship product is the Nuada Exo Glove, a lightweight and flexible assistive device that enables users with hand weakness to hold objects up to 40 kg with minimal effort. The glove provides enhanced grip functionality for people with medical conditions like stroke or spinal cord injuries, using breathable smart textiles to restore user autonomy and improve daily task performance.

Name: OpenShelf
Description: Product search engine that enables consumers to quickly determine what's available and where they can buy it

Name: PONS
Description: PONS is a medical technology company developing an AI-powered, compact ultrasound solution designed to democratize and decentralize medical imaging. Their innovative device enables patients to perform preventive medical imaging at home, using artificial intelligence for autonomous risk assessment, image processing, and reporting. The technology aims to reduce hospital overcrowding by providing accessible, instant medical imaging with advanced features like smart image enhancement, tissue characterization, and real-world data collection to support early disease detection and improve patient health outcomes.

Name: Portabledx
Description: PDS makes compact, portable in vitro diagnostic testing technology that provides lab-quality quantitative or qualitative analysis onsite, within minutes, and at a fraction of the cost.

Name: Preemadonna
Description: Preemadonna is a Silicon Valley-based technology startup specializing in AI-powered nail and body art experiences. Their flagship product, Nailbot, is a smart nail art printer that allows users to create custom designs and photos directly on nails in under five seconds. The company offers an innovative platform combining hardware, software, and sustainable consumables, targeting primarily Gen Z and Gen Alpha users. With over 10 issued utility patents, Preemadonna focuses on creative technology that intersects design, engineering, and personal expression, including nail art printers, polish creation tools, and educational STEAM-aligned kits.

Name: InBolt
Description: Inbolt develops a micro-location technology based on cutting-edge 3D computer vision algorithms for all industrial production means.

Name: Japet Medical
Description: Japet Medical is a European technology startup specializing in robotic exoskeleton design for workplace health and medical applications. The company develops advanced wearable devices that help alleviate back pain and reduce musculoskeletal disorders, with key products including the Japet.W+ motorized exoskeleton and specialized devices like the Moon exoskeleton. Their solutions combine medical technologies, textile expertise, and robotics to support employees' mobility and protect workers' backs during various movements, targeting industries seeking to improve workplace ergonomics and employee health.

Name: kegg
Description: Kegg is a women's health technology company that produces an FDA-registered fertility tracking device. The product is a 2-in-1 kegel device that tracks cervical fluid electrolyte levels to help women identify their fertile window up to 7 days in advance. Using advanced sensor technology like impedance spectroscopy, the device provides personalized fertility insights, assists in pelvic floor exercises, and supports women with fertility challenges such as irregular cycles.

Name: Kinexcs
Description: Kinexcs is an AI-driven digital therapy platform and wearables solution focused on mobility and rehabilitation. The company develops innovative healthcare technologies, including a smart wearable sensor system called KIMIA for monitoring joint movement and supporting patient recovery. Their platform enables personalized digital therapy, continuous health monitoring, and direct communication between patients and healthcare professionals, particularly for individuals undergoing orthopedic surgeries or managing musculoskeletal conditions.

Name: Rethinking Bioproduction
Description: Kolibri is a biotechnology company revolutionizing cell production through innovative bioreactor technology using acoustic waves. Their patented platform enables significant improvements in cell engineering, demonstrating a 10x increase in cell density and 50x reduction in production costs. The technology is cell-agnostic and scalable, with particular potential in drug development, gene therapies, and cellular agriculture, offering a next-generation approach to growing and engineering cells at scale.

Name: Flow Bio
Description: FLOWBIO is a technology company focused on advanced hydration solutions for serious athletes. Their innovative system combines a sweat sensor with a mobile app to provide real-time, personalized hydration recommendations. By measuring fluid and sodium loss during physical activities and considering factors like temperature and workout intensity, FLOWBIO helps athletes optimize their hydration strategies. The platform offers insights into pre-session and post-training nutrition, aiming to enhance athletic performance and recovery across various fitness levels and environmental conditions.

Name: Gaia AI
Description: Gaia AI is an MIT and Harvard-backed startup that uses advanced technologies like LiDAR, computer vision, and satellite data to collect high-quality biomass data in forests. The platform helps landowners, project developers, and investors understand forest carbon stock and timber content by providing accurate carbon measurements. By creating trust in carbon credit verification, Gaia AI aims to unlock and expand the carbon credit market through precise environmental data collection and analysis.

Name: Grounded AI
Description: Grounded AI is an AI enablement service that specializes in scientific research technology, focusing on citation verification and peer review enhancement for publishers. The company offers a platform called Veracity that automates citation checks, streamlines review workflows, and improves research publication accuracy. Their approach emphasizes creating specialized AI assistants that help researchers and publishers work more efficiently, with a core philosophy of keeping humans in the director's seat of AI-powered processes.

Name: CRIAM
Description: CRIAM is a medtech startup specializing in portable blood testing diagnostics. Their innovative point-of-care device enables rapid, accurate blood typing and disease detection with a 3-minute processing time and 99.2% accuracy. The device features a touch screen, wireless connectivity, and can operate in various settings including emergency services and remote areas. CRIAM's mission is to make diagnostics more accessible, affordable, and user-friendly, with the goal of preventing disease transmission and ensuring timely medical interventions.

Name: Dia
Description: DIA Sensor is an early-stage technology company developing innovative electrochemical sensor technology for real-time health monitoring. Their patent-pending platform enables portable and wearable sensors that can measure both endogenous and exogenous chemical biomarkers through sweat and saliva analysis. The system is designed for short daily monitoring sessions, providing users with instant access to personalized health data through a mobile app, supporting health assessments, training protocols, and wellness interventions.

Name: Drip.ai
Description: Drip.ai is an innovative water technology company developing sustainable water production solutions that harvest moisture directly from the atmosphere. Their technology enables water generation at industrial scales without CO2 emissions, creating a completely sustainable water production method. The company is currently partnering with public utility companies, farmers, and industrial clients to pilot their atmospheric water harvesting technology, with the goal of providing affordable and unlimited water access through an environmentally friendly approach.

Name: ZiO Health
Description: ZiO Health is a medical technology and digital health company developing innovative point-of-care diagnostic tools. The company specializes in creating pocket-sized, proprietary biosensor technology that enables real-time therapeutic drug monitoring and precision dosing. Using AI-guided algorithms, ZiO Health's devices provide immediate blood drug concentration analysis, helping healthcare providers optimize medication effectiveness, minimize toxicity, and support continuous patient monitoring across various clinical applications including heart failure screening and antibiotic susceptibility testing.

Name: Nascentmaterials
Description: Nascent Materials is an advanced battery materials startup based in Newark, NJ, focused on revolutionizing cathode material production for lithium-ion batteries. The company develops proprietary manufacturing technologies that produce cost-effective, high-performance cathode materials for electric vehicles, energy storage systems, and data centers. Using a patented thermo-fusion synthesis method, Nascent aims to reduce production costs, enhance material quality, and support domestic manufacturing in the US, ultimately contributing to the acceleration of the energy transition with Made in the USA battery technologies.

Name: NeuPeak Robotics
Description: Neupeak is an agricultural technology company developing robotic solutions for strawberry harvesting. The company addresses labor shortages in agriculture by creating advanced robotic harvesters that can pick strawberries efficiently. Their technology uses data and analytics to enhance productivity, offering a 'picking as a service' model with fixed pricing. Neupeak's mission is to increase farm yields, reduce food waste, and support sustainable agricultural practices amid growing global food demand.

Name: Neurode Landing Page
Description: Neurode is a digital health technology company that develops a wearable headband designed to help individuals with ADHD manage their symptoms non-invasively and drug-free. The device tracks brain activity and provides real-time insights, featuring an AI assistant named Rae that helps users create task lists and improve focus, impulse control, and memory. By monitoring brain activity and offering personalized cognitive support, Neurode aims to provide an alternative approach to traditional ADHD treatment, focusing on enhancing mental health and productivity without medication.

Name: Nordetect
Description: Nordetect is a Copenhagen-based analytical technology company that develops innovative Lab-on-a-chip devices for agricultural and environmental diagnostics. Their core product is a real-time chemical analysis system with cloud-connected hardware and accessible software, designed to provide immediate nutrient data for controlled environment agriculture. The platform enables farmers and agricultural professionals to conduct rapid soil and irrigation water analysis, optimize fertilizer strategies, and make data-driven decisions to improve crop performance and reduce waste.

Name: Lief Therapeutics
Description: lief’s hrv wearable helps reduce stress and anxiety in real time using personalized heart rate variability biofeedback training

Name: Lilu
Description: Lilu is a technology company developing smart products for new mothers, with a primary focus on innovative breastfeeding and pumping solutions. Their flagship product is a tech-enabled pumping bra featuring automated compression technology, designed to make postpartum care more comfortable and efficient. The company aims to leverage cutting-edge technologies to simplify and improve the breastfeeding experience for mothers, offering products that are scientifically designed and focused on enhancing maternal comfort and convenience.

Name: Lura Health
Description: Lura Health is a health technology company developing innovative wireless intra-oral sensors that enable users to monitor and track health through saliva diagnostics. Their platform provides real-time health insights by analyzing key diagnostic metrics within the oral environment, allowing users to track various health and disease markers non-invasively. The system can be integrated with existing dental equipment like aligners and implants, offering long-term data analysis, early condition detection, and personalized health management through a user-friendly app that ensures privacy and convenience.

Name: Mazlite
Description: Mazlite is an advanced industrial spray and manufacturing technology platform that uses AI and IoT to optimize production processes. Specializing in automotive and other industrial applications, the company provides real-time monitoring and optimization of spray and powder manufacturing lines. Their technology enables automated inline production monitoring, AI-powered process optimization, equipment fault detection, and rapid atomizer setting adjustments. Mazlite helps manufacturers improve product quality, reduce waste, enhance operational efficiency, and support sustainability across chemical processing, automotive, and food and beverage industries.

Name: HAX
Description: HAX is a pre-seed venture capital program within SOSV specializing in hard tech startups across robotics, IoT, material science, medical devices, and consumer electronics. The program provides comprehensive support including initial investment, hands-on engineering assistance, business strategy, and access to a global network of mentors and investors. HAX invests over $25 million annually, supporting startups from prototype to scaled business, with a focus on transformative technologies that can create positive industry change.

Name: Mesh++
Description: Mesh++ develops innovative solar-powered wireless network solutions that enable efficient, cable-free mesh networking across large areas. Their flagship product, the S618 node, features a patented distributed TDMA protocol that minimizes signal loss and supports up to 2Gbps backhaul. The technology is designed for creating networks in underserved areas, public spaces, and challenging environments, offering fast internet access with minimal infrastructure requirements. The solution supports community initiatives, including disaster relief communication and remote learning applications.

Name: Untap
Description: Untap is a health technology company that provides an innovative early warning system for monitoring pathogens and health risks in various communal environments. Their platform enables real-time detection and monitoring of infectious disease transmission in workplaces, schools, hospitals, care homes, and other facilities. By scientifically tracking community health indicators, including COVID-19 prevalence, the technology allows organizations to quickly implement targeted health measures, improve workplace safety, and manage potential outbreak risks through non-invasive monitoring.

Name: Vertiq
Description: Vertiq is a Philadelphia-based technology company that designs and builds industrial-grade propulsion systems for unmanned aerial systems (UAS) and mobile robots. Spun out of the University of Pennsylvania's robotics lab, the company specializes in developing high-performance, lightweight integrated motor and electronic speed control (ESC) systems. Their core products feature advanced telemetry, motor health monitoring, and custom control firmware, serving commercial and defense markets. Vertiq aims to advance robotics by perfecting vehicle propulsion components, offering custom development services to ensure seamless integration of their innovative propulsion technologies.

Name: Vue Glasses
Description: Vue is a technology eyewear company specializing in smart glasses that combine advanced functionality with stylish design. Their product line includes connected eyewear with integrated features such as Bluetooth audio, voice assistant compatibility, and prescription lens options. Vue glasses allow users to listen to music, make phone calls, and control smart home devices directly through their eyewear. The company offers various models like Vue Lite 2 and Cygnus, providing customers with innovative wearable technology that enhances daily connectivity and convenience.

Name: Wazer
Description: WAZER is a pioneering technology company that developed the world's first desktop waterjet cutter, making professional-grade fabrication and prototyping capabilities accessible to manufacturers, artisans, educational institutions, and hobbyists. Their compact, precise cutting machine can slice through multiple materials including metal, glass, stone, ceramic, carbon fiber, wood, plastic, and rubber, democratizing advanced manufacturing technology for small-scale and individual users.

Name: Caldo Restaurant Technologies
Description: Caldo is a technology company developing robotic assistants for commercial kitchens, focusing on automating tedious food preparation and service tasks. Their innovative solutions include smart dispensers and compact robotic systems designed to enhance kitchen efficiency. The company's AI-powered technology aims to reduce food costs, minimize waste, and provide touchless, on-demand food distribution with personalized portion control. Their systems can track user preferences and offer data-driven insights to improve kitchen operations.

Name: ACiiST
Description: Connecting outdoor Cameras, Sensors, Lidars, or any other Edge-Devices as many as needed, faster, easier, reliable, cost-effective, and with no disturbance to routine, enabling Smart City / Roads / Campuses implementation. ACiiST's distributed switching technology upgrades any outdoor with broadband networks & electricity ready to connect rich content everywhere needed. A scale-able network with superb reliability, higher performance, and enhanced security, all these with 10% of cabling than other solutions while eliminating the need for street cabinets. ACiiST technology is integrated into the infrastructure of the existing outdoor pillars and serves as the infrastructure for security and emergency needs, traffic management, HLS, and advanced control systems.
