Name: Amber Agriculture
Description: Amber Agriculture is an agricultural technology company that leverages advanced Internet of Things (IoT) and cloud analytics to automate post-harvest practices for farmers. Their flagship product, ACE AIR, is a wireless and solar-powered monitoring system designed for grain bins that enables real-time tracking of grain conditions. The platform provides farmers with remote management capabilities, using CO2 sensors to monitor grain tipping and degradation, and offers a web-based interface for effective grain asset management and protection.

Name: Atome
Description: atome (pronounced atom-e) is a startup company seeking to leverage the exciting capabilities of 3d printing to design enhanced materials for high-need sectors such as energy, transportation, and aviation/aerospace. by developing unique nanoparticle-reinforced powders and adopting a machine learning high-throughput approach to optimization, we can improve the properties of today's best-in-class metals faster than ever before and in a way that is highly customizable to the specific needs of the end-user. born out of research conducted for nuclear fusion reactors by its founders at mit, atome's materials achieve higher strength, better temperature resistance, and improved radiation survivability, while also decreasing the cracking and pore formation traditionally found in 3d printed metals.

Name: Striemo
Description: Striemo is an innovative electric personal mobility company that develops advanced e-scooters with enhanced stability and maneuverability. Spun out from Honda, the company specializes in creating safer mobility solutions for urban transportation. Their e-scooters are designed to perform effectively in challenging conditions like rough roads and rainy weather, offering users a reliable alternative to traditional personal transportation methods. The company provides electric kickscooters with advanced features such as automatic brake control and a user-friendly interface, targeting urban commuters seeking safer and more versatile personal mobility options.

Name: SunGreenH2
Description: SunGreenH2 is an award-winning renewable energy technology company specializing in green hydrogen production through advanced electrolysis. They develop proprietary nanostructured materials and electrolyzer components that enhance hydrogen output while reducing energy consumption. Their technology enables hydrogen production at lower costs, targeting applications in industry, mobility, and energy storage. With over 10 years of research in electrochemistry and nanotechnology, the company aims to revolutionize zero-emissions energy by producing green hydrogen at under $2/kg through innovative electrode and electrolysis technologies.

Name: Swap Robotics
Description: Swap Robotics is an innovative robotics company specializing in electric robots for utility-scale solar site management and urban maintenance. Their primary focus is developing autonomous robots for solar vegetation management, panel installation, and snow removal. The company's 100% electric robotic platform is designed and built in-house, capable of performing tasks like grass cutting, materials movement, and sidewalk maintenance across solar sites and urban environments in the USA and Canada.

Name: Terranrobotics
Description: Terran Robotics is a construction technology company that develops AI-powered robotics solutions for building affordable and sustainable homes. The company specializes in automated construction processes, including AI-driven pick-and-place systems, cable-driven material transport platforms, and simplified wall assembly technologies. Their approach integrates various materials and labor processes to create solid, soundproof, and fireproof homes using natural materials like clay and aggregates. Terran Robotics targets housing developers and construction companies, offering tools to design and build residential and commercial buildings while reducing environmental impact through sustainable construction practices and automation.

Name: The Last Gameboard
Description: Gameboard is an innovative tabletop gaming platform based in Denver, Colorado, that bridges physical and digital gaming experiences. Their unique gaming console combines tactile gameplay with digital connectivity, allowing players to enjoy interactive tabletop games with unprecedented touch technology. The platform provides game creators tools to develop immersive experiences and enables players to engage in multiplayer games anytime and anywhere, with support for physical game pieces and a companion app that extends the gaming experience.

Name: RxAll Inc.
Description: RxAll is a digital health infrastructure platform that enables on-demand access to high-quality medicines through a comprehensive ecosystem of drug authentication, marketplace, and financial services. The platform provides pharmacies and hospitals with a proprietary drug testing technology using AI and IoT nanoscanning, a B2B2C marketplace for pharmaceutical products, and embedded fintech solutions. Focused initially on the African market, RxAll aims to solve drug accessibility challenges by connecting pharmacies, wholesalers, and patients through a technology-driven approach that ensures medication quality and affordability.

Name: Samphire Neuroscience
Description: Samphire Neuroscience is a medtech startup developing innovative neurotechnology solutions for women's health. Their flagship product is Nettle, a brain-stimulating headband designed to alleviate PMS, period pain, and menstrual symptoms through non-invasive brain stimulation. The company offers a companion mobile app for cycle tracking and provides neuroscience-backed solutions to empower women in managing their health. Currently available in the UK and EU, the company is conducting clinical trials and actively developing additional neurotechnology products.

Name: Skygauge
Description: Skygauge is an innovative drone technology company that transforms industrial inspections and maintenance processes. Their specialized drone system is designed for remote inspections of tall infrastructure, particularly in oil and gas industries, using advanced technologies like ultrasonic testing and aerial photography. The drone can perform complex tasks such as contact inspections, window washing, pressure washing, and painting, significantly reducing operational costs and worker safety risks by eliminating the need for traditional rope or scaffolding-based manual inspections.

Name: Solano Energy
Description: Solano Energy is a smart power company specializing in solar energy solutions that automatically generate, store, and distribute renewable energy. Their innovative system provides a 5,000-watt solar power system with a daily energy supply of 22,000 watts and low energy density up to 160Wh/kg. The company aims to deliver energy independence and a zero-emission lifestyle for both residential and commercial customers by offering an accessible, efficient renewable energy solution that reduces electricity bills and supports sustainable living.

Name: MATERIAL
Description: Material Hybrid Manufacturing is an innovative technology company specializing in advanced 3D-printing solutions for energy storage systems. The company uses HYBRID3D printing technology to produce high-performance, custom-shaped batteries for various sectors including climate tech and health industries. Led by experienced engineers with backgrounds in Formula 1 design and materials science, the company can print batteries in unique configurations for applications like drone batteries, smart glasses, and advanced cell-to-pack systems. Supported by venture capital firms including SOSV HAX and Pathbreaker VC.

Name: Silana
Description: Silana is a robotics startup focused on fully automating the fashion production process to address sustainability and ethical manufacturing challenges. The technology aims to reduce labor costs, minimize CO2 emissions, and improve production efficiency by automating the entire garment manufacturing value chain. By targeting issues in current global manufacturing practices, particularly in Southeast Asia and African countries, Silana seeks to transform the fashion industry through technological innovation that reduces environmental impact and improves working conditions.

Name: Altiro Energy
Description: Altiro is a Montreal-based clean technology start-up working to accelerate the green energy transition by improving the reliability of renewable power systems with our novel long duration energy storage technology. Our iron based clean fuel lets us commodify clean energy, allowing both storage and transport of green electricity as never before.

Name: Allozymes
Description: Allozymes is a biotechnology startup specializing in enzyme engineering using proprietary microfluidics technology. The company develops custom-designed enzymes for sustainable manufacturing across multiple industries including pharmaceuticals, food, chemical, and personal care. Their ultra-high-throughput platform can screen 20 million enzyme variants daily, enabling 10x faster enzyme engineering with a 200x higher success rate compared to traditional robotics. Allozymes aims to build the world's largest enzyme data library, providing innovative biosolutions that help companies reduce waste and improve production processes.

Name: algoma
Description: Algoma is an AI-powered proptech platform that automates real estate development processes, helping developers accelerate site planning and construction timelines. The technology provides instant analytics and market insights, enabling rapid feasibility studies and design generation for multifamily and residential projects. By streamlining pre-construction workflows, Algoma helps developers reduce costs, create efficient layouts, and support the development of zero-carbon buildings through automated site analysis and centralized project management tools.

Name: DeepSpin
Description: DeepSpin is an innovative medical technology company developing an advanced, AI-powered MRI imaging system that dramatically reduces the cost, size, and weight of traditional MRI machines. Their revolutionary technology transforms medical imaging by creating lightweight, portable MRI devices that weigh hundreds of kilograms instead of several tons. Using generative topological design and deep learning super-resolution techniques, DeepSpin aims to make MRI technology globally accessible, reducing equipment costs by up to 20x while improving image quality and operational efficiency across various medical domains.

Name: Hydrostasis
Description: Hydrostasis is a technology company specializing in personalized hydration monitoring solutions. Their innovative platform provides real-time, actionable hydration information for athletes, consumers, and clinical applications. Using advanced optical sensor technology, Hydrostasis develops monitoring devices like the GecaTM Watch that track hydration levels across different demographics. The company works with smart device manufacturers to enable hydration monitoring capabilities, with a mission to establish hydration as a critical vital sign that impacts performance, health, and safety.

Name: Kniterate
Description: Kniterate is an innovative digital knitting machine designed for small fashion businesses, design studios, and educational institutions. The desktop 3D knitting technology allows users to design, print, and wear custom knitted products like scarves, beanies, and sweaters. Featuring up to six yarn feeders and customizable templates, the machine automates stitch transfer and enables the creation of unique patterns and shapes beyond traditional knitting methods. The product gained significant crowdfunding support, raising over 600% of its initial Kickstarter goal, indicating strong market interest in democratizing textile design.

Name: Forward Robotics
Description: A technology company specializing in autonomous drone solutions, with expertise in developing heavy-lift, long-range cargo drones and precision agricultural VTOL (vertical takeoff and landing) drones. The company focuses on creating advanced aerial vehicles with proprietary avionics and control software, targeting applications in cargo transportation and agricultural crop spraying.

Name: Gemma
Description: Gemma is an innovative beauty tech startup that has developed the world's first automatic makeup application machine. The technology allows users to apply a full face of makeup in three minutes or less, using a patented system that learns user preferences based on skin tone and facial features. The device creates personalized makeup applications by mixing airbrush formulas in real-time and partners with beauty brands to develop compatible makeup pods. As a women-led international company based in Dallas, TX and Haifa, Israel, Gemma aims to provide a professional makeup experience in the home.

Name: Harae Dx
Description: Harae Dx is a medical technology company developing an innovative, low-cost portable automated AI-based cancer detection system. The platform focuses on quickly and efficiently detecting cancer biomarkers for diseases like ovarian, cervical, and breast cancer. By utilizing a proprietary biomarker panel and advanced automation, the technology reduces human processing errors and increases test turnaround times. The compact and affordable system is designed to make advanced cancer screening more accessible, enabling non-destructive surveillance and early detection across various healthcare settings.

Name: HausBots
Description: HausBots is a robotics technology company developing innovative wall-climbing robots for inspection, maintenance, and painting applications. Their primary mission is to use technology to protect and maintain built environments. The company's patent-pending robots can perform exterior painting, warehouse painting, building inspections, and infrastructure surveying. Their advanced robotic platforms, including the HB2 and HB3 crawlers, utilize AEROGRIP technology to operate on various surfaces like concrete and stainless steel, offering customized solutions for industries such as chemicals, food and beverage, energy, and nuclear.

Name: Hearth Labs
Description: Hearth Labs develops thermal-LiDAR technology specifically for the architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) industry. Their innovative sensors quantify heat transfer in built environments, providing real-time data collection and analysis to improve energy efficiency and occupant comfort. The platform enables professionals to identify precise heat transfer patterns, optimize energy consumption, and support decarbonization efforts in commercial and industrial building applications.

Name: Danu Robotics
Description: Danu Robotics is an innovative technology company that develops AI-controlled robotic systems for waste management and recycling. Their specialized robots are designed to sort mixed recyclable materials with high precision using advanced computer vision technology. The systems can be easily retrofitted into existing waste sorting facilities, enabling more efficient and sustainable recycling processes. Focused on operational efficiency and circular economy principles, Danu Robotics provides modular robotic solutions that can operate 24/7 with minimal downtime, helping material recovery facilities improve sorting accuracy and material purity.

Name: Digi.Bio
Description: Digi.Bio is a biotechnology company developing an advanced lab-on-a-chip platform that revolutionizes therapeutic research through AI-driven, single-cell analysis. Located in Leiden Bio Science Park, the company provides high-content, real-time monitoring of cell therapies with unprecedented spatial and temporal insights. Their microfluidic technology enables dynamic tracking of therapy performance, offering automated digital testing for cell cytotoxicity, motility, and interactions, making it particularly valuable for immunotherapy and personalized medicine research.

Name: XN Health
Description: XN Health is a medical device company specializing in respiratory care technology. Their flagship product, the Phlex Diaphragm Stimulator, is a minimally invasive treatment solution designed to enhance recovery for mechanically ventilated patients. The device utilizes phrenic nerve stimulation to activate the diaphragm during ventilation, improving lung ventilation efficiency and preventing complications associated with prolonged mechanical ventilation. The technology aims to help patients wean off ventilators faster and improve overall breathing outcomes.

Name: Mowito
Description: Mowito is a technology company specializing in vision-guided automation systems for industrial robotics. Their core product is an advanced robotic arm solution designed for warehouse and factory automation, featuring real-time vision data integration, precise part handling, and automated assembly capabilities. The company develops intelligent picking robots that enhance manufacturing efficiency by reducing human intervention and enabling precise operations across various industrial environments.

Name: Namu Robotics
Description: Nu Robotics develops autonomous, AI-powered tree planting systems designed to enhance global reforestation efforts. Their advanced robotic technology uses sensors and artificial intelligence to plant trees with high precision across diverse terrains, achieving improved survival rates and lower operational costs. The company's solution includes a custom dashboard for environmental impact tracking and data analytics, serving forestry companies, governments, and indigenous communities. By automating tree planting operations, Nu Robotics aims to accelerate reforestation, overcome labor shortages, and provide critical insights into ecosystem restoration.

Name: Navion Energy
Description: Navion Energy is a technology company specializing in advanced sodium-ion battery development for industrial and defense applications. Their proprietary battery technology offers an alternative to traditional lithium-ion systems, emphasizing U.S. supply chain independence, cost-effectiveness, and eco-friendly energy storage solutions. The company focuses on creating high-performance batteries for diverse applications including electric vehicles and grid storage, with a strategic emphasis on using domestically sourced materials.

Name: Neurocess
Description: Neurocess is a sports technology company that provides advanced wearable sensor solutions for athlete performance monitoring. Their innovative system uses wireless, clinical-level EMG sensors to track physiological metrics such as muscle fatigue, strength, balance, lactate accumulation, and injury risk. Designed specifically for football environments, the technology enables real-time, multi-channel data acquisition from up to 30 athletes simultaneously. Developed in collaboration with research institutions like MIT and King's College London, Neurocess offers a comprehensive dashboard for practitioners to analyze performance data and make informed decisions about training management and injury prevention.

Name: Mechasys
Description: Mechasys is a global technology company that develops innovative laser positioning technology for the construction and manufacturing industries. Their primary product is an XR Projector that displays construction plans in real scale directly on job sites with 3mm accuracy, projecting 2D and 3D CAD files onto floors, walls, and ceilings. The technology aims to improve productivity, reduce human error, and optimize workflow by eliminating manual drawing and providing precise visual representations of construction plans, with applications across construction, surveying, and engineering sectors.

Name: Vici Robotics
Description: Vici Robotics is a technology company focused on developing robotics solutions for retail automation. Their core mission is to create robots that handle repetitive and mundane tasks, specifically targeting the retail sector. The company's primary focus is on automating tedious warehouse and store operations such as stocking shelves, managing product facing, and fulfilling online orders, effectively serving as a 'human multiplier' by streamlining manual labor processes.

Name: XERA Energy
Description: Xera Energy is a U.S.-based sustainable technology company specializing in lithium-ion battery materials manufacturing and recycling. Headquartered in San Francisco, the company focuses on developing low-carbon processes to transform spent batteries and nickel ore concentrates into battery-grade cathode powders. Their innovative approach supports the electric vehicle and energy storage industries, with plans to generate up to 500,000 tons of battery scraps annually by 2030, promoting a more economical and eco-friendly approach to battery material production.

Name: Home-Scale Biogas Machine
Description: Benerg is an innovative clean energy technology company specializing in biogas machines that convert food waste into electricity and heat. Their core technology enables buildings to achieve energy independence through an IoT-enabled system that transforms biowaste into renewable energy. The company's solutions focus on zero-waste and zero-carbon emissions, providing scalable off-grid energy production through advanced mechanical and electronic components that directly connect to generators or boilers.

Name: BioMetallica
Description: BioMetallica is an innovative environmental technology company specializing in sustainable precious metal recycling through advanced biometallurgy and synthetic biology. Their core process involves a four-step approach to metal recycling that maximizes value extraction from waste materials while minimizing environmental impact. The company offers an eco-friendly solution for recycling platinum group metals, providing a more energy-efficient and cost-effective alternative to traditional metal production methods, with a strong commitment to promoting circular economy principles.

Name: Cargo Kite
Description: CargoKite is a Munich-based deep-tech startup revolutionizing maritime transport through innovative, autonomous wind-powered cargo ships. Their primary innovation is a 80-meter catamaran designed to carry 280 TEU containers, utilizing an advanced airborne wind energy system with a kite that provides up to 100% propulsion. The company addresses maritime industry challenges by creating a sustainable shipping solution that eliminates emissions, enables customized routing, and provides an efficient alternative to traditional fossil fuel-powered cargo vessels. By harnessing high-altitude winds at 100-300 meters, CargoKite offers a technologically advanced approach to reducing carbon emissions in global shipping.

Name: Chirp
Description: Chirp is a cloud-connected sensor system designed for monitoring elderly individuals, particularly those with limited mobility or long-term health conditions. Using advanced AI algorithms and non-intrusive radar and acoustic technologies, the system builds behavioral models to detect anomalies and predict potential health risks. The platform provides real-time monitoring of home activities, offering detailed reports on occupancy, visitor hours, and potential issues to enhance safety and provide peace of mind for families caring for aging adults.

Name: 3DK Tech
Description: 3DK Tech is an industrial metal 3D printing service that offers advanced manufacturing solutions for aerospace, medical, automotive, and other high-tech industries. The company provides a specialized metal 3D printing technology that enhances the Selective Laser Melting process, enabling the production of high-complexity parts with improved efficiency, reliability, and lower costs. Their 3DK USLM V1 system allows customers to upload designs for quick printing and delivery, with a streamlined process that supports various design options and material selections.

Name: AMATEC
Description: Amatec is an innovative construction technology startup developing High-Density Gypsum (HDG), a patented building material that serves as an advanced alternative to concrete. The company focuses on sustainable construction by creating a material with a smaller carbon footprint, faster curing rate, and comparable strength to traditional materials. Their technology enables mass production of custom houses using automation, with manufacturing cycles as short as 12-16 hours and assembly taking 1-2 days. Amatec's core mission is to transform the global housing industry by introducing more efficient, eco-friendly construction methods that reduce CO2 emissions and promote a circular economy.

Name: Tandem
Description: Tandem is a technology company specializing in electrification solutions for heavy-duty vehicles, focusing on Class 8 transportation. The company produces modular electric vehicle (EV) attachments and solutions designed to lower operational and entry costs for sustainable transportation. Their product lineup includes electric reefer trailers, electric genset systems, hybrid electric trucks, and auxiliary power units (APUs) targeted at industries such as agriculture, construction, and transportation logistics.

Name: Tumi Robotics
Description: Tumi Robotics is a specialized technology company that develops advanced robotic solutions for challenging and confined environments, including underground and underwater settings. The company focuses on creating sophisticated inspection and monitoring technologies utilizing artificial intelligence and specialized sensors. Their primary services include real-time visual inspection, remote monitoring, 3D modeling, and georeferencing of infrastructure in industries such as mining, oil and gas, marine exploration, and civil works. By leveraging robotics and AI, Tumi Robotics enhances safety and security in high-risk, hard-to-access locations, providing critical infrastructure protection and environmental impact assessment capabilities.

Name: Serene Sleep
Description: Serene Sleep is a medical device company developing a minimally invasive treatment for snoring and sleep apnea. Currently in the clinical-stage, the company is working on a product under 510(k) clearance review that aims to improve sleep quality by addressing the significant impact of snoring on individuals and their sleep partners. The company specializes in innovative procedures to tackle a widespread sleep-related health issue affecting millions of people.

Name: LightHearted AI
Description: LightHearted is a medical technology company dedicated to revolutionizing heart disease diagnostics through advanced AI and laser-based technology. Their innovative medical device can detect heart conditions quickly and accurately by gathering essential biomarkers through clothing and at a distance in less than a minute. Founded with the mission of preventing 10 million heart-related deaths by 2030, the company offers a groundbreaking, non-invasive solution that makes heart condition detection more accessible, efficient, and affordable compared to existing technologies.

Name: OLI
Description: OLI Technologies, Inc. is a medical technology company specializing in innovative kidney care solutions. Their primary product is the OLI Kid Kidney System, a portable hemodialysis device designed to be compact, user-friendly, and accessible. The company focuses on developing advanced medical technologies that enable more efficient and personal kidney health management, with an emphasis on creating portable and intuitive solutions for hemodialysis treatment.

Name: Verdex Technology
Description: Verdex Technologies is a Richmond, Virginia-based technology company specializing in advanced nanofiber production and innovation. The company develops proprietary nanofiber technology for multiple industries including filtration, automotive, textile, pharmaceutical, and medical markets. Verdex creates high-quality nanofiber products using a green, solvent-free process, offering custom solutions for air and liquid filtration, technical textiles, and other applications. Their mission is to be a global leader in nanofiber technology, focusing on innovation, sustainability, and meeting customer needs.

Name: Cool Amps
Description: Cool Amps is a technology company specializing in lithium-ion battery production, recycling, and metal reclamation. The company focuses on developing sustainable battery technologies and creating a circular supply chain for critical battery metals. Their core capabilities include producing high-reliability lithium-ion batteries for automotive, medical, and industrial applications, while also working to enhance American competitiveness and national security through responsible battery metal reclamation and innovative battery chemistry solutions.

Name: Cocoon
Description: Cocoon is a London-based climate technology startup focused on decarbonizing heavy industries, particularly steel and concrete manufacturing. The company develops innovative modular technology that transforms industrial waste like steel slag into low-carbon construction materials. By repurposing industrial by-products, Cocoon creates sustainable cementitious materials that reduce CO2 emissions and waste in the construction sector. Their technology aims to provide green building solutions, create new revenue streams for steel producers, and address critical environmental challenges in infrastructure development.

Name: AuraSense: Wellness for All
Description: Breaking Down Barriers to Wellness with Technology, Compassion, and GRIT.

Name: Pushme Inc
Description: TIER Mobility is a vision and mission-driven company for shared micro-mobility based in Berlin. Our vision is to lead the way towards seamless and sustainable mobility joyful for everyone. We are rethinking urban transportation and reshaping our cities’ landscapes by offering easily-accessible and affordable mobility services by partnering up with municipalities, public and private organizations as well as other transportation providers. In all our actions, we focus equally on our core values of sustainability, customer centricity, diversity, excellence, appreciation and transparency.

Name: Revol Technologies
Description: Revol Technologies is a premium earphone technology company founded in 2014, revolutionizing the wireless headphone market with custom-fit earphones. Their patent-pending technology allows earphones to conform to users' unique ear contours within 60 seconds, solving comfort and fit issues common with traditional earbuds. The company focuses on creating personalized, comfortable wireless earphones that offer high-quality sound, adjustable noise isolation, and an affordable price point, addressing the challenge of one-size-fits-all audio solutions.

Name: Petronics
Description: Petronics is a technology company focused on creating innovative pet products, with a primary emphasis on developing advanced robotic toys for cats. Founded with a mission to improve the interaction between pets and their owners, the company has developed products like Mousr, an automated cat toy designed to provide engaging and interactive play experiences. Their team is dedicated to understanding pet behavior and creating solutions that enhance the lives of pets and their owners through technological innovation.

Name: Dispatch
Description: Dispatch is a technology startup developing an autonomous local delivery platform powered by sidewalk and pedestrian-space vehicles. The company is focused on creating innovative transportation solutions for urban last-mile delivery, and has secured funding from notable venture capital firms including Andreessen Horowitz and Precursor Ventures.

Name: Babybe
Description: BABYBE is a medical technology company focused on improving care for premature infants through innovative healthcare solutions. Their primary product is a bionic mattress system that reconnects premature babies with their mothers by replicating the mother's heartbeat, breathing, and voice in real-time. The system aims to reduce stress for premature infants and enhance mother-child bonding by creating a more nurturing incubator environment. BABYBE is CE certified and actively seeks clinical partners for research in attachment, music therapy, and patient comfort.

Name: AiSight
Description: AiSight is a technology company that develops advanced machine diagnostics and predictive maintenance solutions using artificial intelligence. Founded in 2018 and now part of Sensirion Connected Solutions, the company provides a sophisticated hardware and software system that uses machine learning algorithms to monitor industrial equipment in real-time. Their solution can predict potential malfunctions, detect process errors, and dynamically regulate machine parameters to maximize uptime and operational efficiency in manufacturing environments.

Name: The VIT Initiative, LLC
Description: VIT (Vigilant Technologies) is a safety and data analytics company that helps organizations reduce workplace injuries through advanced employee monitoring and analytics technologies. Their platform automates incident reporting, integrates safety data, and provides predictive analytics to identify and prevent potential workplace risks. The company serves organizations ranging from small businesses to Fortune 1000 companies, offering solutions that can reduce injuries by up to 33% and improve workforce productivity.

Name: R-Zero
Description: R-Zero is a smart building technology company that provides integrated solutions for optimizing indoor environments through IoT-connected sensors, air quality monitoring, and UV-C disinfection technologies. The platform focuses on improving building efficiency, occupant health, and safety across industries including healthcare, education, and corporate real estate. By combining advanced sensors, AI, and automated systems, R-Zero enables organizations to monitor and enhance indoor air quality, space utilization, energy performance, and environmental safety in shared spaces.

Name: nura
Description: Nura makes headphones that adjust themselves to you, bringing you closer to the music you love with personalised sound. Hearing varies significantly from person to person, and these variations make a big difference to how you experience music. Nura headphones automatically measure your hearing, working out which frequencies your ears are more or less sensitive to, then adjust the music to match your hearing. Our team was founded in Melbourne, Australia in April 2015. We are connected by music more than anything. We combined our expertise in engineering, acoustics, biology, and hearing science to create Nura personalised sound. Our headphones and earbuds have turned heads at Forbes, Wired, Wall Street Journal, GQ, The Huffington Post, Engadget, Mashable, CNET and more.

Name: Particle
Description: Particle is a leading integrated Internet of Things (IoT) platform-as-a-service that provides comprehensive infrastructure for developing, deploying, and managing connected devices. The platform offers end-to-end solutions including hardware, software development tools, cloud infrastructure, and device management capabilities. Used by thousands of companies and 260,000 developers, Particle enables businesses to create intelligent connected machines across various industries, with features like web and mobile app access, over-the-air updates, device protection, and multiple connectivity options including Wi-Fi, cellular, and LoRaWAN.

Name: Pixmoving
Description: PIX Moving is an autonomous mobility technology company dedicated to developing innovative urban transportation solutions. Specializing in self-driving vehicles and modular mobility platforms, the company focuses on creating sustainable urban mobility ecosystems. Their key innovations include autonomous chassis with detachable pods, AI-driven vehicle design that reduces manufacturing parts by 70%, and products like the PIX Robobus autonomous shuttle. The company aims to revolutionize urban transportation through intelligent manufacturing, customizable autonomous vehicles, and a vision of reimagining city mobility infrastructure.

Name: Yeelight
Description: Yeelight is a leading smart lighting startup founded in 2012, specializing in wireless and intelligent LED lighting products for smart homes. The company collaborates closely with major tech companies like Amazon, Google, and Microsoft to develop cutting-edge lighting solutions. Their product line includes over 10 smart lighting products that feature advanced technologies such as AI integration, Wi-Fi connectivity, and remote control capabilities. Yeelight has received multiple international design awards, including IF Design Award and Reddot Award, and focuses on creating innovative lighting experiences for smart home enthusiasts.

Name: Makeblock
Description: Makeblock is a global STEAM education technology company specializing in robotics, educational hardware, and learning solutions for students from early childhood through post-secondary education. Founded in 2013, the company develops comprehensive robot kits, laser cutters, and interactive learning platforms that enable students to explore coding, robotics, and maker technologies. Makeblock provides schools, educational institutions, and families with integrated hardware, software, and content solutions, including global robotics competitions through their MAKEX division. Their mission is to empower educators and students with accessible, engaging tools that develop 21st-century skills and foster creativity and innovation.

Name: VoltStorage
Description: VoltStorage is a Munich-based energy storage technology company developing innovative battery solutions for renewable energy applications. Founded in 2016, the company specializes in developing sustainable, long-duration energy storage systems using ecological Redox Flow technology. Their primary product, the Iron Salt Battery Vault, offers low-cost, non-flammable battery storage with capacities ranging from 1-100 MW and discharge times of 8-24 hours. VoltStorage aims to make renewable energy continuously available, reduce CO2 emissions, and support the transition to clean energy infrastructure.

Name: Avidbots
Description: Avidbots is a robotics company specializing in autonomous floor cleaning solutions for commercial and industrial facilities. Founded in 2014 and headquartered in Kitchener, Ontario, Canada, the company develops advanced robotic systems like Neo, Neo 2W, and Kas autonomous floor scrubbers. These robots are designed to enhance cleaning efficiency and productivity across various sectors including retail, healthcare, education, and transportation. Avidbots provides a comprehensive platform with real-time monitoring and analytics tools, enabling organizations to optimize cleaning processes, reduce human labor, and maintain consistent cleanliness standards across different environments.

Name: Simbe Robotics
Description: Simbe Robotics is a retail technology company that provides AI-powered store intelligence solutions, centered around Tally, an autonomous robot that scans store shelves to track inventory, pricing, and product placement. Founded in 2014 and headquartered in San Francisco, the company uses advanced computer vision, RFID sensors, and robotics to help retailers improve operational efficiency. Their platform delivers real-time insights with 99% accuracy, enabling retailers to achieve key performance improvements such as 2% margin growth, 98% on-shelf availability, and 90% improved price accuracy while reducing manual labor costs.

Name: Artyc
Description: Artyc is an innovative cold chain logistics technology company specializing in zero-emissions solutions for temperature-sensitive product transportation. The company develops advanced, battery-powered cooling containers designed specifically for medical and pharmaceutical products, featuring real-time monitoring, extended battery life over 72 hours, and precision cooling capabilities. Their solutions focus on sustainable logistics by reducing waste and emissions while ensuring safe and efficient transport of critical temperature-sensitive goods across various industries and locations.

Name: OpenTrons
Description: Opentrons is a life science technology company providing open-source, flexible lab automation robots and software for research and healthcare institutions. Their primary product, Opentrons Flex, enables researchers to automate molecular biology workflows like nucleic acid extraction, PCR, and protein purification without coding. Operating in over 40 countries, the company serves academic, biopharma, synthetic biology, and clinical research labs, offering a no-code protocol library and an ecosystem that allows scientists to automate experiments and reproduce research results.

Name: Gridient.io
Description: Gridient is an energy technology company offering AI-driven grid optimization solutions focused on enhancing energy efficiency and grid decarbonization. Their product suite includes the SUMMIT System for Unified Modeling, CRAG Control and Response Agent, and Grid-Resilient Adaptive Node for Intelligent Energy Trading. The company provides real-time monitoring of energy consumption, supports renewable energy integration, and helps organizations improve infrastructure reliability through advanced technological solutions across energy management, infrastructure, and renewable energy sectors.

Name: Uroboros Innovations
Description: Uroboros Innovations is an AI-driven technology company specializing in critical mineral exploration solutions. Their platform provides advanced AI tools for geologists to accelerate early-stage exploration analytics, offering predictive prospectivity modeling and custom analysis capabilities. The company focuses on enhancing mineral discovery rates by providing robust AI-powered tools that can confirm source data and facilitate analytical processes up to 95% faster than traditional methods. Their technology supports critical mineral exploration efforts and aims to address mineral supply challenges for sustainable development and net-zero goals by 2050.

Name: GLX ANALYTIX
Description: GLX Analytix is a personalized medicine company developing an innovative diagnostics platform powered by AI and advanced glycobiology research. Their proprietary GLX Signature Platform uses novel blood biomarkers and machine learning to enable early detection and monitoring of chronic diseases, including neurodegenerative, autoimmune, cardiovascular, and psychiatric conditions. The company collaborates with leading medical institutions to develop noninvasive, cost-effective solutions for improved patient care.

Name: Jooni
Description: A data processing and management platform serving businesses and government organizations globally. The platform processes over 6 billion data points annually and offers a robust operational solution with a 99.99% uptime guarantee. It provides flexible, scalable data management capabilities that can be customized to meet various organizational needs across multiple continents.

Name: Calcarea
Description: Calcarea is a climate technology company focused on carbon sequestration, specializing in Accelerated Weathering of Limestone (AWL) technology. The company aims to decarbonize challenging industrial sectors, with a primary focus on the shipping industry. Their innovative approach involves using large ships as platforms for carbon capture, developing scalable solutions to reduce CO2 emissions and address hard-to-decarbonize economic sectors through natural carbon sequestration processes.

Name: Quantum Diamonds
Description: QuantDiamonds is a technology company specializing in advanced metrology tools for semiconductor testing using quantum sensing technology. Their core functionality involves developing sophisticated 3D imaging tools that extract electrical activity images from microelectronics, enabling precise failure analysis and defect identification. The company's key offerings include high-resolution (up to 1,000 nm) 3D imaging capabilities, quantum sensing technologies, and in-house testing services designed to enhance semiconductor yield improvement and process control.

Name: Cephia
Description: Cephia AI is an advanced computational imaging and computer vision technology company that develops innovative multimodal sensing solutions. Their core technology utilizes neural nano-optics and AI-designed metasurface technology to create compact, high-performance vision systems. The company's primary product is the Cephia Camera, which offers real-time sensing capabilities across multiple spectrums including RGB, polarized, and hyperspectral imaging. Their solutions are designed to capture high-resolution images in challenging environments, with advanced post-processing algorithms that transform vision technology from a hardware-limited function to a flexible, software-defined capability.

Name: Chiral Nano
Description: Chiral is a nanotechnology company specializing in robotic assembly and high-speed manufacturing of next-generation nanotransistors. The company provides a fully automated manufacturing solution for nanomaterial-based transistors, focusing on achieving high-speed production and exceptional yield. Their services support the development of advanced electronics by offering nanotechnology solutions, including nanoassembly technology and foundry equipment for clients in the nanotechnology sector.

Name: DiffraQTion
Description: A deep-tech startup developing advanced quantum optical sensing hardware for high-precision imaging and AI applications. Founded by researchers from MIT, University of Arizona, and University of Maryland, the company creates ultra-sharp imaging sensors using quantum technology. Their innovations are designed for edge AI, offering ultra-high magnification, low energy consumption, and enhanced processing speed. The technology has potential applications in space exploration, with development supported by NASA for the Habitable Worlds Observatory, and includes applications in autonomous vehicles, object detection, and facial recognition.

Name: Mythic
Description: ai.com is on a mission to accelerate the arrival of AGI by building a decentralized network of autonomous, self-improving AI agents that perform real-world tasks for the good of humanity. Learn more: ai.com

Name: Semidynamics Technology
Description: Semidynamics is a European semiconductor IP core provider specializing in customizable 64-bit RISC-V processors designed for high-performance computing and AI applications. The company offers scalable neural network processing units like Cervell and Atrevido, which provide high-efficiency processor solutions for machine learning workloads. With expertise in microprocessor architecture, front-end design, and verification, Semidynamics develops high-bandwidth cores with vector units targeted specifically at artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies, offering both ASIC and FPGA solutions with a cloud-based configurator for custom processor setups.

Name: AMPeers
Description: AMPeers is an advanced materials technology company specializing in innovative superconductor wire solutions. Partnered with the University of Houston, they develop and manufacture high-temperature superconductor wires for various energy applications. The company provides consulting and research services, focusing on creating unique materials solutions through collaboration with national laboratories and universities. Their core expertise lies in developing advanced superconductor tape and wire technologies that address complex materials challenges across multiple industries.

Name: Brainify
Description: Brainify is a French e-commerce startup based in Bordeaux that provides analytics and sales optimization solutions for small and medium-sized online merchants. The company develops data-driven tools to help e-commerce businesses improve their performance through advanced analytics and insights.

Name: Anvildiagnostics
Description: Anvil Diagnostics is a medical technology company developing an advanced diagnostic blood test for comprehensive pathogen gene detection in hospitalized patients. Their innovative solution enhances digital PCR hardware with machine learning and programmable chemistry to detect pathogen DNA at early infection stages. The company aims to revolutionize infection management by creating a more sensitive and comprehensive diagnostic approach that overcomes limitations of traditional blood culture methods.

Name: Solideon
Description: Solideon is an advanced manufacturing technology company that creates autonomous micro-factories using integrated robotics and proprietary software. Their innovative system enables end-to-end manufacturing processes including 3D printing, post-processing, assembly, and inspection of structures and vehicles without human intervention. Focusing on aerospace and advanced manufacturing sectors, the company aims to dramatically reduce production timelines and increase manufacturing efficiency by removing traditional tooling constraints and minimizing human involvement in production processes.

Name: Carbonyx
Description: Carbonyx is an innovative industrial materials company specializing in transforming industrial waste into high-performance silica products for carbon capture and storage. Founded in 2000, the company utilizes a proprietary Carbon Alloy Synthesis Process (CASP) to create advanced carbon-based chemical products. Their core business focuses on developing scalable solutions for CO2 reduction, including high-purity silica materials with 99.9% purity and modular production options that support circular economy principles and sustainable industrial practices.

Name: Precision Impulse
Description: Precision Impulse has the world’s only technology capable of continuously imaging the earth’s subsurface for the purposes of underground CO2 storage monitoring, oil & gas exploration and certain mining applications. For Carbon Capture, Utilization and Storage (CCUS) or enhanced hydrocarbons recovery, Precision Impulse source units can remain permanently installed on the ocean floor to provide data of unmatched resolution—without costly deployment of conventional marine seismic vessels, and without the environmental and sea life damage caused by air guns. On land the source can be buried, thus vastly improving the monitoring data and reducing environmental impact. Precision Impulse possesses international patents relative to producing precisely controlled chemical energy impulses—the key scientific breakthrough in its technology. This recently discovered phenomenon enables Precision Impulse technology to produce virtually unlimited impulsive power with precise timing and repeatability, a wide range of frequency and unrivaled energy efficiency.

Name: Tobe Energy
Description: Tobe Energy is a clean energy technology company specializing in advanced hydrogen production through proprietary electrolysis technology. Founded by engineers with experience in oil & gas and renewables, the company develops high-performance electrolysis systems that dramatically improve hydrogen efficiency. Their turnkey hydrogen infrastructure solutions are designed for industrial use, data centers, and energy hubs, with the goal of delivering low-cost, zero-emission hydrogen at rates significantly below market prices. The company is scaling production from its Oklahoma facility, aiming to make renewable and financially viable hydrogen energy a reality.

Name: Ambrosiabiotx
Description: We’re pioneering a new class of therapies that restore natural tolerance instead of suppressing the immune system. A new class of therapies that could cure autoimmune disease, forever.

Name: Informuta
Description: Informuta is a precision medicine technology company focused on transforming infectious disease diagnostics using machine learning and DNA analysis. Their platform provides advanced diagnostic tools that analyze bacterial DNA to guide effective treatment and predict potential drug resistance. The company's key innovation is RESISIVE, a system that helps healthcare providers assess and manage antimicrobial resistance with real-time monitoring and personalized treatment recommendations. By reducing diagnostic turnaround time and offering predictive insights, Informuta aims to address the global health crisis of antimicrobial resistance and improve patient outcomes.

Name: Endolith
Description: Endolith is a pioneering sustainable mining technology company that leverages microbes, synthetic biology, and cloud computing to transform mineral extraction processes. Specializing in copper and lithium recovery, the company develops innovative microbial solutions to enhance mining efficiency while minimizing environmental impact. Their technology includes custom microbial community development, adaptive biohatcheries, and a cloud-native platform for real-time monitoring and optimization of microbial activity in mining operations, setting new standards for sustainable resource management.

Name: Halo Air
Description: First AI-powered environmental sensor for your phone

Name: Reegen
Description: REEgen is an innovative technology company specializing in sustainable rare earth element (REE) extraction using engineered bacteria. Their groundbreaking process extracts clean REEs from recycling and industrial waste at room temperature, reducing environmental impact by up to 90% compared to traditional methods. The company aims to secure critical materials for renewable energy infrastructure by developing a low-emission, environmentally friendly approach to rare earth element production that supports domestic industry and promotes sustainable supply chain solutions.

Name: Metri
Description: We are a preclinical stage endometriosis therapeutics company.

Name: Composite Recycling Sàrl
Description: Composite Recycling is an innovative environmental technology company specializing in recycling hard-to-recycle composite materials, particularly fibre-reinforced plastics (FRP) from industries like wind energy, marine, aerospace, and automotive. Using a proprietary pyrolysis technology, they transform waste from boat hulls, wind turbine blades, and other composite sources into high-quality reclaimed glass and carbon fibers and thermolysis oil. Their mission is to divert composite waste from landfills and incineration, creating a circular economy solution by supplying recycled materials to manufacturers and offering recyclability testing and advisory services.

Name: Ramona Optics
Description: Ramona Optics is an advanced microscopy technology company developing cutting-edge computational microscope hardware and machine learning software for scientific research. Their proprietary Multi-Camera Array Microscope (MCAM) technology enables high-resolution, large field-of-view imaging (300mm by 200mm) with gigapixel capabilities. The company provides innovative solutions for life sciences research, allowing scientists to capture cellular-level details and analyze biological processes in real-time with advanced imaging and data processing tools.

Name: Soarce
Description: Soarce is transforming biomass waste into high-performance, eco-friendly materials using our proprietary refining process. by converting renewable resources like seaweed into non-toxic, high-quality chemistries, we enable industries to create sustainable products across various sectors, starting with textiles. our technology eliminates the need for petrochemicals by selectively tuning natural materials to achieve superior properties like uv and fire resistance, all while using less water and energy. our flagship product, seabind™, is an advanced biopolymer that meets regulatory demands without sacrificing performance. soarce simplifies production processes, helping companies make the sustainable switch seamlessly and efficiently.

Name: Marathonfusion
Description: Marathon Fusion is a technology company developing advanced fuel processing solutions for fusion power plants. They specialize in creating innovative hydrogen pump technologies and plasma-based separation membranes that enhance tritium processing. The company aims to make fusion energy more robust and practical by engineering next-generation technologies that can be integrated into the fusion ecosystem, with a mission to enable clean and abundant energy generation through advanced fuel cycle technologies.

Name: Animate
Description: Animate Biosciences is a biotechnology company focused on combating fibrosis through innovative AI-driven research. Their platform leverages multi-omic insights and advanced computational techniques to design and optimize peptide-based solutions targeting fibrosis in human skin, lung, cardiac, and liver cells. With a robust pipeline of peptide candidates, the company aims to revolutionize treatment approaches for fibrosis-related diseases by developing targeted therapeutic interventions.

Name: SyzOnc
Description: SyzOnc is a biotechnology company developing innovative tumor microenvironment modulators for cancer treatment. The company employs a sophisticated, tech-enabled systems-level approach to cancer therapeutics, focusing specifically on solid tumors. Utilizing advanced AI and machine learning technologies, their STEM 3 platform maps and analyzes the entire tumor ecosystem to identify and validate potential drug candidates. The core mission is to improve cancer patient survival rates and clinical outcomes by creating targeted therapies that can more effectively disrupt the tumor's protective environment.

Name: Quantistry
Description: Quantistry is a Berlin-based chemical simulation startup that develops an intuitive computational chemistry platform for advanced research and development. Their web-based QuantistryLab enables researchers to conduct molecular simulations and material optimization without coding, providing access to over 100 million molecular structures. The platform supports multiscale simulations across various industries including energy storage, automotive, and biomedical, using quantum chemistry and machine learning to facilitate data-driven rational design of materials like battery components, metals, alloys, and lubricants.

Name: Qubit Pharmaceuticals
Description: Qubit Pharmaceuticals is a drug discovery company that leverages quantum physics and high-performance computing to develop innovative treatments for complex diseases. Using their proprietary ATLAS platform, they conduct advanced molecular dynamics simulations and drug optimization across therapeutic areas like oncology and inflammatory diseases. Founded by renowned scientists from leading universities, the company has a multidisciplinary team of 60 experts based in Paris and Boston, focusing on creating novel drug candidates and exploring previously undruggable biological targets through advanced computational methods.

Name: Cdimension
Description: CDimension is reinventing the foundation of computing hardware to meet the demands of tomorrow’s most complex technologies. We develop ultra-thin 2D materials and vertically integrated chip architectures that dramatically improve energy efficiency, performance, and scalability. By advancing materials, design, and integration methods, we’re enabling next-generation systems across AI inference, robotics, quantum computing, and other high-performance applications. Our proprietary processes allow us to grow atomically thin semiconductors directly onto finished silicon wafers, unlocking up to 1,000× improvements in energy efficiency and paving the way for compact, unified chips that combine compute, memory, and power in a single system. CDimension’s technology is built to overcome the physical and architectural limits of traditional silicon, and we’re partnering with researchers and industry leaders to bring this vision to life. We’re building the materials backbone of the future of compute.

Name: Flocean Green
Description: Flocean is an innovative water technology company specializing in sustainable subsea desalination solutions. Their modular system utilizes deep ocean water at 300-600 meter depths to produce freshwater with significantly reduced energy consumption and environmental impact. Using a proprietary 'Build-Own-Operate' model, Flocean provides water-as-a-service for municipalities, agriculture, and industrial sectors. The technology offers low-cost, eco-friendly water production with up to 50% energy reduction, storm resilience, and minimal ecological disruption, addressing water scarcity challenges in over 90 water-stressed markets globally.

Name: SquareMind
Description: SquareMind is a software technology startup dedicated to revolutionizing healthcare through disruptive technologies. Founded in 2019 and backed by prominent venture capital firms like Entrepreneur First, the company focuses on developing innovative solutions to save lives and optimize medical time. Their core mission involves creating advanced software technologies that can significantly improve medical processes, with a particular emphasis on leveraging AI to transform healthcare delivery and patient care.

Name: Orbit Genomics
Description: Orbit Genomics is a precision medicine company developing advanced genomic diagnostic technologies. Their proprietary OrbiSeq™ platform analyzes novel genomic markers to assess disease risk, combining both inherited and acquired genetic factors. Specializing in complex disease diagnosis, the company focuses on developing clinically actionable genetic tests for conditions like lung cancer, heart disease, and neurological disorders. Their innovative approach uses microsatellite analysis to provide more personalized risk assessment beyond traditional genetic mutation testing, with the goal of enabling earlier disease detection and prevention.

Name: Woodoo
Description: Woodoo is an innovative technology company that molecularly transforms low-grade wood into high-performance, sustainable materials for multiple industries. Their core technology augments wood at the molecular scale, creating innovative materials with enhanced properties for automotive, luxury, and construction applications. Woodoo's flagship product STACK offers a low-carbon alternative to traditional building materials like steel and concrete, providing improved structural performance and sustainability. The company focuses on utilizing underutilized wood species to create biomaterials with superior technical characteristics, unique sensing capabilities, and reduced environmental impact.

Name: ardenttechnologies.com
Description: Ardent Technologies is an innovative industrial technology company specializing in advanced membrane solutions for carbon capture and chemical separations. Their OptipermTM platform provides scalable, energy-efficient technologies targeting challenging industrial processes in sectors like cement, steel, petrochemicals, and oil and gas. The company's membrane-based systems aim to reduce carbon capture costs by up to 40%, offering modular designs that integrate with existing infrastructure and support significant emissions reductions across various industrial applications.

Name: Exowatt
Description: Exowatt is a next-generation renewable energy company providing modular, scalable power solutions for commercial and industrial customers. Specializing in dispatchable solar energy systems, the company offers technologies that convert solar energy into heat and electricity on demand. Their innovative approach targets energy-intensive applications like data centers and AI infrastructure, delivering clean power that can be generated for up to 24 hours per day. Exowatt's mission is to make sustainable renewable energy more accessible and affordable, utilizing bi-integrated technologies to optimize energy efficiency and meet the growing power demands of modern industries.

Name: Secant Fuel
Description: Secant Fuel is an innovative clean energy technology company that converts captured carbon dioxide into carbon-neutral syngas and base chemicals. Using a simplified, cost-effective electrocatalytic conversion process, they enable industrial decarbonization by transforming CO2 waste into high-value fuel alternatives. Their technology operates under atmospheric pressure, eliminates the need for electrolysis, and can reduce carbon emissions by up to 80%. The company aims to provide fuel and chemical producers a practical pathway to decrease carbon footprint without disrupting existing production infrastructure.

Name: Maple Materials
Description: Maple Materials is an innovative clean technology company that transforms carbon dioxide into graphite anode materials for lithium-ion batteries through an electricity-driven electrolysis process. Their sustainable production method aims to create battery-grade graphite at lower costs while potentially achieving carbon-negative manufacturing when powered by renewable energy, supporting the broader transition to more environmentally friendly energy technologies.

Name: Nanodex
Description: The synthesis and application of folate-modified cyclodextrins as artificial cancer antibodies

Name: RotorVault
Description: RotorVault is an energy storage technology company developing innovative grid-scale storage solutions using advanced flywheel technology. Their modular, containerized systems are designed for commercial and industrial applications, supporting decarbonization, grid resilience, load-following, and peak shaving. The technology offers a low-cost, long-lasting alternative to battery storage, with no performance degradation and high cycling capability, making it particularly suitable for AI data centers, EV charging facilities, utilities, and microgrid applications.

Name: Windlift
Description: Windlift is an engineering company developing innovative Airborne Wind Energy (AWE) systems using tethered drones that generate electricity at 200-400 feet altitude. Their technology uses unmanned aerial vehicles to harvest wind energy with significantly reduced material requirements compared to traditional wind turbines. Windlift has secured over $24 million in contract revenue from the Department of Defense and Department of Energy, with a focus on providing mobile, adaptable energy solutions for military bases, disaster response, and remote installations.

Name: Jian-Ping Wang NewCo (CRAM)
