Name: Lukera Energy
Description: Lukera Energy is a sustainable energy technology company specializing in transformative electrochemistry for green hydrogen and methane-to-methanol production. The company develops innovative solutions for converting greenhouse gas emissions into valuable, carbon-neutral fuels. Their technology focuses on creating energy-efficient and cost-effective processes for producing sustainable fuel alternatives, with particular applications in the maritime, manufacturing, and transportation sectors.

Name: Plasticentropy
Description: Plastic Entropy is a biotechnology research organization focused on innovative plastic waste reduction through advanced enzymatic degradation. The company has discovered unique enzymes, originally produced by wax worms, that can decompose polyethylene rapidly at room temperature. Their key scientific breakthrough involves four biological enzymes (Demetra, Ceres, Cora, and Cibeles) that efficiently break down plastic waste through oxidation and depolymerization processes. The organization aims to provide sustainable waste disposal solutions and address one of the 21st century's critical environmental challenges by developing biotechnological methods to neutralize plastic pollution.

Name: Laura Lewis NewCo (Brain Health + Sleep)
Description: Neurofeedback method for CSF enhancement during sleep

Name: Gautam Dantas NewCo (Yeast LBP)
Description: Yeast engineering: agent for living biological tehrapeutics

Name: Steve Jacobsen NewCo (Viral Editing)
Description: Viral editing of plants using a new nuclease

Name: Todd Schaef NewCo (Subsurface Extraction)
Description: CO2 injection for sequestration and in-situ mineral extraction

Name: Vuecason
Description: VueCason is developing next-generation metal 3D printing technology, aiming to revolutionize metal fabrication by enabling 3D printing capabilities that are comparable to plastic printing techniques. The company is focused on innovating advanced manufacturing processes to make metal 3D printing more accessible and efficient.

Name: Clearskiesh2
Description: ClearSkies H2 is a transportation technology company focused on developing low-emissions solutions for heavy-duty transportation. The company aims to provide diesel-parity cost alternatives that support the transition to more sustainable transportation technologies. By offering innovative solutions that address the economic and environmental challenges of fleet operations, ClearSkies H2 helps organizations reduce their carbon footprint while maintaining operational efficiency and cost-effectiveness.

Name: breaking.com
Description: Breaking is a synthetic biology company focused on plastic waste degradation and environmental sustainability. The company develops innovative microorganism-based solutions to break down plastic waste more efficiently, with their flagship product MICROBE X-32™ capable of decomposing plastics within 5 to 1000 years. Founded by a team of scientific experts including George Church and Ben Lamm, the company aims to address global plastic waste challenges by enhancing natural microbial processes to digest and transform plastic into harmless organic matter.

Name: Apeiron Labs
Description: Apeiron Labs is an innovative ocean monitoring technology company developing solutions to dramatically reduce the cost and effort of ocean sensing. The company aims to address the critical gap in real-time ocean data collection, targeting the expanding blue economy estimated at $1.5 trillion. By creating cost-effective and efficient data collection methods, Apeiron Labs seeks to provide comprehensive oceanic insights that are crucial for understanding global economic, weather, and long-term climate trends. The company is backed by applied invention and venture capital firms.

Name: ArkVax
Description: ArkVax is a biotechnology company specializing in advanced glycoengineering for animal vaccines. Their proprietary Protein Glycan Coupling Technology (PGCT) enables the development of innovative, low-cost recombinant glycoconjugate vaccines for livestock. The company focuses on creating more potent and effective vaccines that address common animal diseases while simultaneously combating antimicrobial resistance. By modifying bacterial cells to produce sugar-based vaccines, ArkVax aims to improve animal health, agricultural productivity, and indirectly support human health through more resilient food production systems.

Name: Fourth Power
Description: Fourth Power is a thermal battery energy storage company developing innovative solutions for renewable energy. Their technology enables utility-scale thermal storage that transforms wind and solar production into an on-demand energy source. The company offers modular battery systems capable of storing energy for 5 to 10 hours, with potential scaling up to 100 hours of storage. Fourth Power's approach provides a cost-competitive alternative to fossil fuels, addressing grid needs through advanced thermal storage technology that supports the transition to clean, sustainable energy infrastructure.

Name: Cerberus Therapeutic
Description: Cerberus Therapeutics is a biotechnology company developing novel immunomodulatory therapeutics using nanobody-based platforms. Founded by prominent researchers Dr. Novalia Pishesha, Prof. Hidde Ploegh, and Prof. Harvey Lodish, the company focuses on creating precise immune system modulation strategies. Their research targets autoimmune disorders and infectious diseases, leveraging alpaca-derived nanobodies as versatile drug targeting agents to develop innovative immunological solutions for enhancing immune system responses.

Name: Activesurfaces
Description: Active Surfaces is an innovative solar technology company developing ultra-thin film flexible solar cells designed to transform various surfaces into efficient energy-generating assets. Founded in 2022 and backed by venture capital, the company leverages MIT-patented technology to create lightweight, low-cost solar solutions that can be integrated into urban landscapes and structurally limited areas. Their mission is to accelerate solar deployment by increasing adaptability and reducing manufacturing costs, with a vision of enabling power generation on previously unusable surfaces and contributing to significant CO2 emission reductions.

Name: Plaid Semiconductors
Description: Plaid Semiconductors is an advanced semiconductor technology company specializing in high-performance computing and AI applications. The company develops innovative interposer solutions that reduce signal losses and enhance computing efficiency by up to 50%. Their technology enables multi-chiplet integration with larger substrate areas, targeting AI, data center, and high-performance computing markets. With a focus on domestic manufacturing in the US, Plaid Semiconductors provides cutting-edge semiconductor substrate solutions to improve bandwidth, latency, and power efficiency for advanced computing technologies.

Name: Divan GeorgiaTech NewCo (SST)
Description: Solid State Transformers

Name: Modulate Bio
Description: Modulate Bio is a biotechnology company developing innovative therapies for central nervous system (CNS) disorders, with a specific focus on conditions like Essential Tremor (ET), epilepsy, and anxiety. The company utilizes advanced allosteric modulator technologies to create targeted treatments that address neurological challenges. Their research involves developing GABA-A modulators with unique properties that balance efficacy and toxicity, aiming to provide improved treatment options without the sedative effects associated with traditional medications. Modulate Bio is committed to advancing neurological treatments through preclinical research and clinical trials.

Name: RT MicroDx
Description: RT MicroDx is a biotech company developing innovative molecular diagnostic technologies for affordable and accessible home testing. Their primary focus is creating self-administered, saliva-based PCR-quality tests that can be used via telehealth platforms. The company is developing over-the-counter molecular tests, with their first product targeting strep detection, offering high accuracy (97% specificity, 99% sensitivity) and a user-friendly alternative to traditional invasive testing methods.

Name: CircNova
Description: CircNova is a Michigan-based biotechnology startup specializing in AI-driven circular RNA therapeutics. The company leverages its proprietary NovaEngine™ AI technology to generate, analyze, and identify circular RNA structures for developing targeted therapies. Focused on addressing previously challenging diseases like ovarian cancer, neurodegenerative conditions, and breast cancer, CircNova aims to improve drug discovery and gene therapy through advanced AI-guided RNA folding and structure prediction techniques. The company is building a robust intellectual property portfolio to advance programmable RNA therapies for undruggable diseases.

Name: OxCCU
Description: OXCCU is a sustainable energy technology company spun out from the University of Oxford in 2021, specializing in converting CO2 and renewable hydrogen into low-carbon fuels, chemicals, and biodegradable plastics. Their innovative one-step catalyst process transforms waste carbon into sustainable aviation fuel, petrochemicals, and biodegradable materials. The company aims to provide zero-emission hydrocarbon solutions for hard-to-decarbonize sectors like long-distance transportation and chemical production, with their first demonstration plant located at Oxford Airport.

Name: Rockburst Technologies
Description: Rockburst Technologies is an innovative mining technology startup developing Transcritical CO2 Pulverization, an energy-efficient rock comminution technique designed to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and energy consumption in mining processes. Their technology breaks rock using CO2 in a pressurized environment, eliminating traditional grinding methods and potentially reducing energy usage by up to 55%. The company aims to support sustainable practices across mining, cement, and recycling industries.

Name: ChronosDx
Description: ChronosDx is a biotechnology company developing high-performance, low-cost bioassay technology for diagnostics and drug development in healthcare. The company focuses on creating scalable diagnostic solutions that can be applied to medical research and in vitro testing, aiming to provide innovative technological approaches to biomedical research and diagnostic processes.

Name: Sea2carbon
Description: Sea2Carbon is an environmental technology company that transforms invasive seaweed into sustainable marine biomass to promote climate action and biodiversity. Their innovative approach converts seaweed species into products that reduce CO2 emissions and provide alternatives to fossil fuels. The company aims to create climate-positive industries that restore marine ecosystems and support coastal communities in Small Island Developing States (SIDS), with a mission to develop sustainable solutions for carbon capture and utilization.

Name: Pumpkinseed
Description: Pumpkinseed is a biotechnology company specializing in advanced protein sequencing using silicon photonics and machine learning. Their innovative approach provides high-resolution, quantitative insights into protein sequences, post-translational modifications, structure, and interactions. By amplifying light interactions with proteins, the company aims to revolutionize medical and sustainability research, enabling proactive solutions in diagnostics, treatment design, and therapeutic development across personal, population, and ecosystem health domains.

Name: 400c energy
Description: 400C Energy is a renewable energy technology company specializing in advanced enhanced geothermal systems that generate carbon-free electricity. The company develops proprietary stimulation technologies to create 24/7 sustainable power generation from hot rock formations. Their innovative approach aims to produce low-cost, carbon-free electricity by utilizing super-hot, temperature-controlled geothermal technologies, with a strategic goal of supporting America's transition to carbon-free energy infrastructure by 2045.

Name: SPREAD
Description: SPREAD is an engineering intelligence platform that uses AI to enhance product data management across industries like automotive, aerospace, and defense. The platform connects and contextualizes hardware and software product data, creating intuitive 'Product Twins' that enable AI-powered decision-making throughout the product lifecycle. Trusted by industry leaders such as Volkswagen, Mercedes-Benz, and Rheinmetall, SPREAD aims to accelerate development cycles, reduce inefficiencies, and support sustainable engineering innovation.

Name: Xavveo
Description: Xavveo is a technology company specializing in advanced radar sensor technology with applications in autonomous driving, factory automation, and healthcare monitoring. Their innovative silicon photonics-enabled sensors provide comprehensive environmental sensing, enabling real-time decision-making for vehicles, enhancing industrial efficiency and safety, and supporting continuous health monitoring through accurate data collection and environmental analysis.

Name: Advanced Ionics
Description: Advanced Ionics is an innovative clean energy company developing advanced electrolyzers for green hydrogen production. Their technology significantly reduces electricity consumption and steam requirements for industrial hydrogen generation, targeting industries such as oil and gas, pharmaceuticals, and biotechnology. The company aims to eliminate the traditional 'green premium' associated with hydrogen production by creating more cost-effective and efficient electrolysis solutions that can be integrated into existing industrial facilities.

Name: AGreatE
Description: AGreatE is a clean energy company focused on developing innovative battery energy storage systems (BESS) with integrated AI technologies. Specializing in zero-emissions solutions, the company designs and manufactures lithium-ion battery modules and energy storage systems for renewable energy applications. Their ecosystem supports various sectors including residential, commercial, industrial, and utility markets, with a focus on improving energy system optimization, extending battery life cycles, and enhancing safety through advanced AI-embedded battery and energy management systems.

Name: Agriburbia
Description: Agriburbia is a multidisciplinary real estate development firm specializing in agricultural lifestyle communities and sustainable land use integration. Since 2003, the company has focused on creating resilient developments that combine urban and rural design principles. Their comprehensive services include land acquisition, professional planning, farm design, architectural consulting, and feasibility studies aimed at establishing innovative agricultural communities that support local food production, sustainable living, and integrated urban-agricultural environments.

Name: Airloom Energy
Description: Airloom is a renewable energy technology company specializing in next-generation wind turbine design. Their innovative turbines are engineered for utility-scale applications, focusing on low-cost, reliable wind energy solutions that maximize energy production per square kilometer. The company develops compact, efficient turbine designs that require minimal infrastructure and can operate in diverse environments, including low wind sites and military installations. By emphasizing a robust structure for kinetic wind energy conversion, Airloom aims to make wind energy more affordable, scalable, and accessible for various energy needs.

Name: Airovation Technologies
Description: Airovation Technologies is a climate-tech company specializing in innovative carbon capture and utilization solutions. The company has developed a proprietary mineralization technology that captures post-combustion carbon dioxide emissions with over 90% efficiency, creating a circular economy approach. Their process co-produces high-purity sulfuric acid and calcium carbonate, enabling industrial emitters to achieve net-zero targets while generating valuable chemical byproducts. Airovation aims to support hard-to-abate industries by providing sustainable carbon reduction technologies that can be integrated across manufacturing, agriculture, and other sectors.

Name: aquarry, inc.
Description: Aquarry is a deep-tech climate startup specializing in carbon dioxide removal using innovative techniques involving post-mining pit lakes. The company transforms open-pit mine lakes into permanent carbon sinks, offering a scalable and low-cost approach to carbon removal. Their method focuses on improving water quality and converting mining liabilities into environmental assets by utilizing geochemical carbon removal techniques. Aquarry integrates renewable energy and biogas technologies to reduce carbon emissions in mining operations, providing a sustainable solution for environmental remediation and carbon sequestration.

Name: Aris Hydronics
Description: Aris Hydronics is a clean energy technology company providing innovative HVAC and hot water solutions for multi-family buildings. Their modular system offers net-zero energy solutions with significant energy savings of 45% to 70% compared to traditional HVAC systems. The company delivers high-performance, green heating, cooling, and ventilation products powered by air and water, with a focus on accessibility and affordability for homeowners and builders. Their system features low maintenance, energy efficiency, and the ability to circulate heat without toxic refrigerants.

Name: Sustainable Water
Description: AtmoSpark Technologies develops innovative moisture management and cooling solutions using advanced electroseparation technology. The company focuses on sustainable atmospheric technologies, particularly in atmospheric water generation for applications like hydrogen fuel cells. Their solutions aim to reduce energy consumption by up to 70% compared to traditional dehumidification methods, improving indoor air quality and productivity through cutting-edge electric field technology that transforms humidity management into an efficient resource.

Name: Austere Environmental
Description: Austere Environmental is an environmental remediation technology company specializing in cleaning up petroleum-contaminated soils. The company provides advanced machinery and on-site solutions for extracting hydrocarbon contaminants from soil resulting from industrial incidents like road-side accidents, pipeline leaks, and drilling operations. Their technology enables the extraction and containment of petroleum products, allowing decontaminated soil to be returned to its natural environment while reducing waste, environmental liability, and associated disposal costs.

Name: Batteryze
Description: Batteryze provides a cloud-based battery health diagnostics platform using advanced AI and physics-based modeling. The platform offers real-time monitoring of battery performance, predictive maintenance, and aging analysis to support battery circularity. Key features include a digital twin system, active testing models for monitoring battery health and lifespan, and integration with existing battery management systems to optimize maintenance strategies and determine battery reuse or recycling potential.

Name: BatugaTech
Description: BatugaTech is a climate tech company specializing in decarbonizing Ordinary Portland Cement (OPC) production. The company focuses on optimizing cement manufacturing processes to achieve significant CO2 emissions reductions and support a path to net zero. Their technology leverages modern equipment and competitive raw materials to develop sustainable chemical solutions that contribute to food security and green energy transition. BatugaTech offers comprehensive services including new cement plant construction, existing plant conversion, and technology licensing to support industrial sustainability efforts.

Name: Home
Description: BiaTech is an AI technology company focused on optimizing energy and industrial resource management through advanced artificial intelligence solutions. The company develops innovative platforms like BiaShield that use AI, machine learning, image analytics, and advanced sensors to provide real-time actionable insights for responsible production and protection of energy and natural resources. BiaTech partners with industry leaders to improve operational efficiency, reduce risks, and enable intelligent decision-making across sectors such as geothermal, oil and gas, and renewable energy.

Name: blip energy
Description: Blip Energy is a smart home battery technology company focused on transforming energy management for residential spaces. Their portable, affordable battery system allows households to optimize energy consumption, take advantage of changing energy prices, and enhance grid stability. The product is designed for easy installation across various home types, providing users with greater control over their energy use while supporting broader grid efficiency and reducing carbon footprint.

Name: CarboMat Inc.
Description: CarboMat Inc. is a materials technology company that specializes in producing low-cost, high-value carbon fibers from waste byproducts, particularly Alberta oil sands asphaltenes. The company has developed proprietary technology that reduces carbon fiber production costs by up to 60% while significantly reducing greenhouse gas emissions compared to traditional manufacturing methods. Their carbon fibers are designed for multifunctional applications across industries including automotive, aerospace, and sports equipment. CarboMat's products are suitable for 3D printing into various composite structures, and the company also provides laboratory services for research and development, including optical microscope grinding and pre-processing services for advanced materials applications.

Name: Carbon Clear
Description: Carbon Clear is a specialized software platform designed for the built environment that streamlines building performance compliance. The platform automates complex regulatory filing processes for regulations like LL84, 88, and 97, integrating building data and providing AI-driven checks. It offers a centralized dashboard for tracking compliance tasks, helping energy professionals audit buildings and reduce time and errors in mandatory reporting processes.

Name: Carbon
Description: CarbonBridge is a climate-action company specializing in innovative gas conversion technologies. They generate industrial and transportation gases from agricultural waste streams using advanced bioreactor technology. The company focuses on converting methane to methanol through biological processes, creating carbon dioxide removal (CDR) solutions and carbon credits. Their specialized direct-gas bioreactors utilize microbes to efficiently synthesize molecules, offering a rapid and productive method of transforming waste gases into energy with minimal processing time.

Name: Centroid LAB
Description: Centroid Lab is an engineering solutions provider specializing in fluid simulation, visualization, and 3D computer graphics. The company works with national laboratories, including the U.S. Department of Energy, to develop advanced simulation software for various industries. Their platform offers sophisticated 3D modeling and visualization services with a focus on dynamic fluid flow simulation, supporting sectors like marine, aviation, and fire safety. Centroid Lab employs proprietary technologies in hardware and software to solve complex visualization, computer graphics, and computer vision challenges.

Name: CH4 Microbial Solutions
Description: CH4 Microbial Solutions is an environmental technology company focused on mitigating methane emissions using methanotrophic bacteria. Their innovative approach targets methane reduction in diverse environments including lakes, landfills, mining, and agriculture. By utilizing highly active methanotrophic microbes, the company develops sustainable solutions to prevent methane from entering the atmosphere or to digest existing methane, addressing the critical environmental challenge of reducing greenhouse gas impacts.

Name: Civilized Cycles
Description: Civilized Cycles is an electric bicycle manufacturer developing next-generation e-bikes designed to compete with cars by improving the overall biking experience. Their innovative vehicles combine the comfort, utility, and active safety of a scooter or light motorcycle with the accessibility and legality of a bicycle. With seven patents supporting their design, the company initially launched a limited first run of 40 bikes exclusively in NYC, Washington DC, and San Francisco, focusing on creating light electric vehicles for urban cargo and passenger transportation.

Name: CLIMFORMATICS
Description: Climformatics is an AI-powered climate prediction platform that uses physics-based models and observations to provide highly accurate localized climate and extreme weather forecasts. The women-owned company delivers business-specific climate predictions across hourly to annual timescales, with up to 95% accuracy. Targeting sectors like agriculture, energy, and healthcare, the platform enables proactive risk assessment and mitigation by anticipating climate changes and extreme events. Developed by climate scientists with expertise in atmospheric and oceanic sciences, the platform aims to help businesses make informed decisions, reduce potential catastrophe losses, and build long-term climate resilience.

Name: Danaher Cryogenics
Description: Pursue the near impossible with elegant, classic solutions to manifest optimal cryogenic performance from initial concept to fruition.

Name: Deep Anchor Solutions
Description: Deep Anchor Solutions (DAS) is an innovative engineering company focused on developing advanced anchoring solutions for floating infrastructure, with a primary emphasis on renewable energy projects. Their flagship product, the Deeply Embedded Ring Anchor (DERA), offers a cost-effective and versatile anchoring system designed for applications in offshore wind, marine energy, aquaculture, and large-scale infrastructure like floating runways. The company distinguishes itself through locally manufactured, rapidly fabricated anchoring solutions that can potentially reduce total project costs by up to 75% while maintaining environmental sensitivity.

Name: Electra Network
Description: Electra is a sustainability-focused technology platform specializing in solar panel lifecycle management. The company provides an innovative solution for tracking, collecting, and routing retired photovoltaic panels through a comprehensive digital management system. Their platform connects solar panel owners with recycling and refurbishing centers, using compatibility metrics like location, panel type, and recycling facility specialization. Electra aims to promote a circular economy in the solar energy sector by facilitating panel reuse, tracking panels from installation to end-of-life, and ensuring sustainable and regulatory-compliant management of solar panel resources.

Name: Electric Fusion Systems
Description: Electric Fusion Systems is an innovative energy technology company developing compact, scalable fusion power generators using proton-lithium fusion technology. Their breakthrough design promises clean, safe, and environmentally friendly energy production with potential to dramatically reduce global carbon emissions. The company has created a portable fusion power appliance capable of generating kilowatts to megawatts of electricity, with projections of extremely low energy costs around $8 per megawatt-hour. Their technology aims to transform energy generation across multiple sectors through a revolutionary approach to fusion energy.

Name: ElectricFish
Description: ElectricFish is a climate technology company developing innovative microgrid and energy storage solutions, with a primary focus on electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure. Their flagship product, the 350 Squared™ system, provides flexible energy solutions that enhance grid resilience and support sustainable urban energy needs. The company aims to disrupt traditional electricity infrastructure by deploying extreme fast charging (XFC) stations using advanced microgrid scale energy storage, ultimately reducing carbon emissions in the transportation sector and providing businesses with more efficient, cost-effective power resources.

Name: ElektrikGreen
Description: ElektrikGreen is a clean energy technology company developing innovative hydrogen storage and fueling systems. The company produces environmentally friendly energy solutions that convert renewable energy from solar and wind sources into hydrogen. Their patented technology offers zero-carbon storage systems for various applications, including backup power, seasonal storage, and emergency power. The company's solutions are designed to help customers become more energy-independent by providing efficient, sustainable alternatives to traditional battery storage systems.

Name: Muro Eólico
Description: Eolic Wall develops innovative modular wind energy systems designed for distributed generation, focusing on small-scale, high-efficiency renewable energy solutions. Their technology uses unique 'Eolic Cells' with wind speed augmentation and magnetic levitation rotors to enable businesses and homeowners to generate clean electricity at a smaller scale, addressing the limitations of traditional large wind turbines.

Name: EcoTech Fuels,
Description: EcoTech Fuels is a sustainable energy company that specializes in converting waste materials, particularly dead and sick trees, into advanced aviation fuel and diesel. They utilize innovative technologies to transform forest waste into environmentally sustainable energy solutions. The company has received a U.S. Forest Service Wood Innovations Grant and works in partnership with engineering firms to develop advanced synfuel technologies that create renewable energy while supporting community job creation.

Name: Evaleric
Description: ecovaleric is building a sustainable chemicals platform derived from e-hva (4-hydroxyvaleric acid), a bio-based building block produced electrochemically from plant-derived feedstocks. its well-defined molecular structure enables precise control over downstream chemistry — from high-performance solvents to tunable compostable polymers — making it a versatile foundation for multiple chemical and material markets measured in the hundreds of billions of dollars annually.

Name: Flow Aluminum
Description: Flow Aluminum is an innovative battery technology company developing high-performance aluminum-CO2 batteries. Their PowerCore Capsule battery offers a sustainable alternative to traditional lithium batteries, featuring a high energy density of up to 500-695 Wh/kg. The technology uses 100% recycled aluminum and uniquely captures CO2 during operation, providing a green energy storage solution with enhanced safety and efficiency for applications in renewable energy, medical devices, and other sectors.

Name: fluid-7.com
Description: Fluid-7 is an energy technology company specializing in trenchless pipeline membrane barrier solutions for the oil and gas industry. Their innovative technology enables cost-effective pipeline rehabilitation, remediation, and repurposing for green energy applications like hydrogen, ammonia, and CO2 transmission. By developing advanced membrane solutions, the company aims to reduce capital and operational expenses by up to 50%, extend asset lifecycle performance, and support decarbonization efforts through emission reduction and sustainable infrastructure solutions.

Name: Green Steel Environmental
Description: Green Steel Environmental is a technology company focused on sustainable wastewater and biogas treatment solutions. Originating from research at the University of Colorado, Boulder, the company develops patented and patent-pending technologies that provide eco-friendly alternatives to traditional chemical treatment processes. Their primary innovations include sustainable chemical alternatives for wastewater treatment and methods for cleaning hydrogen sulfide from biogas operations, enabling more effective resource recovery and renewable natural gas production.

Name: Helix Earth Technologies
Description: Helix Earth Technologies is an innovative environmental technology company specializing in advanced liquid-gas chemistry developed from NASA space mission research. The company focuses on creating energy-efficient solutions for HVAC systems and carbon capture technologies, with breakthrough devices that can reduce energy consumption by up to 50%. Their technology accelerates chemical reactions 1000x, targeting critical environmental challenges like CO2 emissions from air conditioning, and aims to improve cooling system efficiency and sustainability across industrial applications.

Name: Hywaves.com
Description: HyWaves is a green hydrogen technology company developing innovative power management solutions for renewable energy production. Their technology enhances electrolyzer efficiency by optimizing connections between renewable energy sources and hydrogen production systems. By improving solar-to-hydrogen power electronics, HyWaves aims to reduce the Levelized Cost of Hydrogen (LCOH) by up to 15% and decrease operating costs by 20%. The company focuses on increasing local hydrogen production through more efficient and economically viable green energy technologies.

Name: IEE Solutions
Description: IEE Solutions LLC is a sustainability and regulatory compliance consulting firm specializing in environmental, health, safety, and security services. The company offers comprehensive solutions for asset management, regulatory compliance, and technological innovation across industries including oil and gas, power, renewables, mining, and manufacturing. Their services focus on critical asset monitoring, leak detection, environmental social governance (ESG), and implementing innovative technologies to enhance operational efficiency and sustainability.

Name: InductiveRobotics
Description: InductiveRobotics develops autonomous electric vehicle (EV) charging solutions for commercial fleets and parking lot operators. Their innovative platform allows rapid EV charging infrastructure scaling without upfront costs, providing a flexible, subscription-based model. The solution focuses on sustainable energy efficiency, reducing emissions, and optimizing charging infrastructure for electric vehicle owners. Their system offers a pay-as-you-go approach with low energy consumption and automated charging capabilities designed to enhance the EV charging experience.

Name: Kronfeld Motors
Description: Kronfeld Motors is a Minnesota-based startup developing innovative transportation solutions, specifically the Hypercycle - a pedal-electric vehicle designed for high-speed transportation and fitness training. The vehicle enables users to reach highway speeds of 65-75 mph while maintaining fitness goals, featuring customizable virtual terrain modes and an eco-friendly design with lower energy consumption compared to traditional electric vehicles. The company advocates for clean, green transportation technologies.

Name: Litus
Description: Litus is a nanotechnology company founded in Calgary, Canada in 2019, specializing in innovative lithium extraction technology. Their proprietary nanomaterial composite enables selective lithium extraction from water sources with unprecedented purity, speed, and efficiency. The company aims to revolutionize lithium production by reducing environmental impact and financial costs, providing cutting-edge solutions to address global energy challenges through advanced chemistry and nanotechnology.

Name: Marvel Fusion
Description: Marvel Fusion is an innovative energy technology company developing advanced laser-driven fusion power plants. The company focuses on creating clean, safe, and reliable energy solutions using low-neutronic fuels, short-pulsed lasers, and nanostructured targets. Their approach aims to develop a commercially viable nuclear fusion technology that can provide scalable and efficient alternative energy solutions for addressing global energy challenges.

Name: Mercurius Biorefining
Description: Mercurius Biorefining is a sustainable technology company focused on producing biomaterials and drop-in biofuels for aviation and diesel engines. Using their patented REACH (Renewable Acid-hydrolysis Condensation Hydrotreating) process, they convert cellulosic non-food waste and residues from sources like municipalities, forestry, and agriculture into high-value products. The company's technology generates hydrocarbons, bio-char, and chemical monomers like FDCA for bioplastics. With pilot plants in Australia and plans for a demonstration plant, Mercurius Biorefining aims to develop carbon-negative fuels and chemicals that support sustainable energy and materials production.

Name: Mitico (formerly known as C-Quester)
Description: Mitico is a carbon capture technology company developing innovative solutions to reduce industrial carbon dioxide emissions. Leveraging breakthrough technology originally developed at Caltech, the company provides advanced carbon capture, utilization, and storage services for industrial point source emitters. Their solution uses non-toxic granulated metal carbonates to efficiently collect and purify CO2 before it enters the atmosphere, offering a low-cost and environmentally friendly approach to industrial emissions reduction. The technology is designed for easy integration across various industries, focusing on making carbon capture more accessible and economically viable.

Name: Modal Motors
Description: American motor manufacturer that manufactures non-rare-earth electric motors that outperform foreign-made rare-earth motors at a fraction of their cost.

Name: Naki V
Description: Naki is an innovative environmental technology company that transforms untreatable food industry sludge into valuable sustainable materials. Their process converts waste into biofuel raw materials, including sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) and biogas, creating a carbon-negative solution. By enabling food industry factories to decarbonize operations and generate additional revenue streams, Naki develops a localized circular oil ecosystem that reduces landfill volumes and eliminates the need to import SAF feedstock from overseas.

Name: Newdayhydrogen
Description: New Day Hydrogen is a clean energy startup focused on developing hydrogen fueling infrastructure in the Denver area. The company aims to address climate change by creating alternative energy markets, with a specific goal of installing nine hydrogen fueling stations for fuel cell electric vehicles within nine years. Founded by environmental professionals passionate about sustainable energy solutions, the company is working to provide green transportation alternatives and expand hydrogen-based clean energy infrastructure.

Name: NitroCat Energies
Description: NitroCat Energies is a technology company specializing in hybrid catalyst development for energy conversion and sustainable agricultural solutions. Their innovative catalysts are designed to enhance efficiency in complex catalytic systems, supporting applications in nitrogen transformation, CO2 conversion, and water splitting. The company serves diverse industries including agriculture, automotive, and energy sectors, with a focus on providing low-cost, sustainable fertilizer solutions to crop farmers. By developing advanced catalytic technologies, NitroCat aims to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and provide price stability in agricultural and energy markets.

Name: NitroFix
Description: NitroFix is a sustainable technology startup focused on revolutionizing ammonia production through an innovative electrochemical process. The company has developed a green ammonia production method that uses water and air to create emission-free ammonia under ambient conditions with a novel catalyst. Their technology addresses the significant CO2 emissions associated with traditional ammonia production, offering a modular solution that can produce 100 to 100,000 tons of green ammonia annually. NitroFix aims to provide an environmentally sustainable alternative for industries including agriculture, energy, and maritime fuel sectors.

Name: NovaBioRubber
Description: Nova-BioRubber is a sustainable agricultural technology company focused on developing hypoallergenic biorubber and biolatex from alternative sources, particularly Russian Dandelions. The company aims to establish a new biorubber industry in North America, offering services in crop production, greenhouse trials, and third-party evaluations. With an anticipated market potential of around $200 billion, Nova-BioRubber develops green processing technologies to create sustainable latex alternatives that address latex allergy concerns while supporting innovative agricultural practices.

Name: Novapont Technology, LLC
Description: Novapont Technology is a clean energy solutions provider specializing in hydrogen generator systems for diesel engines. Their innovative technology enhances fuel efficiency by adding hydrogen directly to the air intake, resulting in improved performance and reduced emissions. The system is designed for versatile applications across industries including military, commercial vehicles, and public transportation, offering real-time diagnostics and potential fuel cost savings of up to 10%. The company provides technical support to help customers effectively implement and utilize their hydrogen enhancement technology.

Name: Octet Scientific
Description: Octet Scientific is an innovative battery chemistry company founded in 2017 in Cleveland, OH, specializing in electrolyte development and manufacturing solutions for zinc-based batteries. The company focuses on enhancing battery performance through targeted electrolyte upgrades, helping clients improve battery capacity, efficiency, and operational life. Supported by the National Science Foundation and the State of Ohio, Octet Scientific develops OctoLyteTM electrolyte chemicals to enable high-performance, sustainable battery technologies for various applications including devices, backup power, and grid storage.

Name: PFC-X
Description: PFC-X is an environmental technology company specializing in plasma-based solutions for PFAS (per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances) destruction and granulated activated carbon (GAC) reactivation. Their innovative technology offers an eco-friendly method for removing and recycling contaminated filter media with minimal energy consumption. The company provides a sustainable approach to eliminating 'forever chemicals' from the environment, using customized plasma technology to reactivate adsorbents and prevent PFAS from returning to ecological systems. PFC-X is currently seeking investment to scale its technology to commercial manufacturing levels.

Name: Phasic Energy
Description: Phasic Energy is a clean energy technology company specializing in waste heat recovery solutions for residential, commercial, and industrial sectors. The company designs and manufactures innovative heat recycling engines and AI-optimized heat exchangers that convert low-grade waste heat into clean, carbon-free electricity. Their technology enables 24/7 energy generation by capturing and recreating heat from various sources including data centers, commercial real estate, and industrial systems, with a focus on improving energy efficiency and reducing carbon emissions.

Name: Phaxtec
Description: PHAXTEC is an advanced materials startup developing sustainable, biodegradable alternatives to fossil plastics using PolyHydroxyAlkanoates (PHA). Their innovative materials are recyclable, marine and industrially compostable, with potential to replace over 50% of current fossil plastic usage across packaging, personal care, agriculture, textiles, and electronics. The company utilizes biogas as a raw material and employs proprietary microorganism technologies to create environmentally friendly materials with applications in food service packaging, slow-release fertilizer coatings, and sustainable product development.

Name: phelas GmbH i.G.
Description: Phelas is an energy technology company developing innovative electricity storage solutions for the renewable energy transition. Their core product is a modular, mass-produced, and cost-effective electricity storage system designed to help utilities, grid operators, renewable energy developers, and industrial clients provide continuous renewable energy. The company focuses on creating scalable and safe energy storage technologies that enable 24/7 renewable energy supply, addressing critical challenges in grid stability and sustainable energy infrastructure.

Name: Projectk
Description: Project K Energy is an innovative clean energy startup developing potassium-ion battery technology for electric vehicle charging and stationary energy storage. Focused on creating low-cost, environmentally friendly battery solutions, the company specializes in developing batteries without using lithium or cobalt. Supported by the US Department of Energy's ARPA-E program with a $2.6M grant, the company is headquartered in Pasadena, California, and aims to provide sustainable energy storage solutions that minimize environmental impact through advanced battery technology.

Name: RE-DU
Description: Reduplastic is an innovative recycling technology company specializing in advanced plastic waste deconstruction. Their patented process can break down complex mixed plastics, including colored, multi-layered materials from various sources like bottles, packaging, automotive components, and textiles, into basic chemical monomers. The technology aims to reduce landfill waste, create commercial value from plastic waste, and contribute to a net-zero carbon society by transforming mixed plastic waste into valuable raw materials through an efficient recycling process.

Name: Reformed Energy
Description: Reformed Energy is a Houston-based waste-to-energy company that converts various waste streams into sustainable power and fuels using proprietary L50 gasification technology. The company processes municipal solid waste, plastics, tires, hazardous waste, and medical waste to produce sustainable aviation fuel, green diesel, hydrogen, and clean power. Reformed Energy's scalable system can handle up to 150 tons of waste per day and aims to eliminate landfills globally while generating renewable energy solutions for off-grid operations and industrial applications.

Name: ReMo Homes
Description: ReMo Homes is a sustainable modular home manufacturing company focused on solving housing and climate challenges through innovative design. Specializing in steel-framed, zero-carbon homes, the company produces energy-efficient living spaces with pre-installed solar and battery storage. Their factory-built homes feature advanced fabrication techniques, eco-friendly materials, and designs that enhance indoor air quality while reducing utility costs. Supported by industry partners and recognized by the California Energy Commission, ReMo Homes aims to revolutionize sustainable housing market.

Name: Renewellenergy
Description: Renewell Energy is an innovative energy technology company focused on repurposing idle oil and gas infrastructure for sustainable energy storage. Using patented gravity energy storage technology, the company transforms abandoned oil wells into valuable energy storage solutions. Their approach aims to create a low-cost, flexible energy storage network that reduces greenhouse gas emissions while providing economic opportunities for well owners by offering cash for repurposing their idle wells, contributing to a more sustainable energy infrastructure.

Name: Rivalia Chemical
Description: Rivalia Chemical Co. is a TechStars-backed startup focused on sustainable rare earth element (REE) production. The company specializes in recovering critical minerals from waste materials, simultaneously addressing environmental cleanup and domestic REE production. Using innovative recyclable chemical processes, Rivalia aims to extract valuable rare earth elements while improving waste sites, contributing to both resource recovery and environmental sustainability.

Name: Robert Cohen Architect
Description: Robert Cohen Architect LLC is a full service architectural firm offering architectural and interior design services. These services cover diverse commercial, institutional, and residential building types including: offices and restaurants, museums and schools, as well as, mixed-use development. Robert Cohen studied architecture at the Cooper Union, the only private full tuition scholarship college in the US. He strives to develop new effective, forceful and spirited architecture. Robert Cohen works with a highly qualified team of specialists, tailored to the needs of each project. This allows the firm to handle the most technically sophisticated architecture projects, while guaranteeing personal attention to every detail.

Name: Corrolytics
Description: Corrolytics is a technology company specializing in corrosion monitoring and detection for industrial assets, particularly in the oil and gas sector. Their innovative Microbial MIC Test Kit uses electrochemical technology to provide near-real-time, on-site analysis of corrosion rates, helping to prevent catastrophic failures. The company addresses the global $2.5 trillion corrosion problem by offering solutions that enhance asset safety, improve operational efficiency, and extend the lifespan of industrial infrastructure while reducing environmental impact.

Name: samtracs
Description: Samtracs is an innovative solar technology company developing advanced tracking and analytics solutions for utility-scale solar construction. Their key innovations include a patented single-axis tracker system that reduces construction time by over 60% and cuts project costs by at least 13%. The company offers AI-powered solar forecasting software that can increase utility solar farm revenue by 10%, with a focus on construction automation and real-time solar asset tracking.

Name: Sandbox Carbon
Description: Sandbox Carbon is an environmental technology company that develops innovative solutions for carbon emission capture, specifically the Carbon Dumpster™ system. Their equipment captures CO2 and air pollutants from gas-powered equipment like natural gas, propane, and diesel engines. The modular, scalable system is designed for various industries including commercial buildings, construction sites, and small manufacturers. It provides an easy-to-implement emission reduction solution that helps businesses meet regulatory requirements and sustainability goals without significant operational disruption.

Name: Sitkana
Description: Sitkana is a Juneau-based technology company developing innovative hydrogenerator solutions for renewable energy generation using ocean tidal currents. Their systems are designed to provide lower-cost electricity to coastal communities through quickly installable tidal energy generators. Key features include predictable energy production, high capacity, and low maintenance requirements. The company's technology is suitable for various applications ranging from residential to industrial use, with a focus on creating sustainable energy solutions that leverage oceanic tidal resources.

Name: SoFab Inks, LLC
Description: Sofab Inks is a specialized chemical manufacturer founded in 2022 as a spin-out from the University of Louisville's Conn Center for Renewable Energy Research. The company focuses on developing and manufacturing nanoparticles for perovskite solar cell technologies, including key materials like Tinfab (SnO2) and NicFab (NiO). Their core mission is to accelerate decarbonization by improving solar cell efficiency, scalability, and stability. Sofab offers cost-advantageous products with enhanced process flexibility, providing custom nanoparticle solutions for energy storage and photovoltaic systems with a strong commitment to sustainability in energy technology.

Name: Spark Ionx
Description: Spark Ionx is a technology company specializing in advanced ion exchange membrane (AEM) solutions. They offer a patented membrane technology called TuffBraneTM, designed for high ionic conductivity and durability in alkaline environments. Their innovations target applications in electrochemical technologies including alkaline electrolyzers, redox flow batteries, electrodialysis desalination, alkaline fuel cells, and zinc-air batteries, with a focus on improving performance and reducing operational costs.

Name: Sunflower Fuels
Description: Sunflower Fuels is a renewable energy company that produces low-carbon, renewable gasoline from plant-based and waste-derived feedstocks. The company provides bio-based feedstocks to the power and refining industries, with a focus on growing energy crops like Miscanthus across Kentucky, Illinois, Indiana, Ohio, and West Virginia. Their products support renewable energy production, carbon capture solutions, and the development of a cleaner, more sustainable energy system.

Name: Supercarb
Description: Supercarb is a San Francisco-based sustainable textile technology startup that transforms carbohydrate biomass into high-performance, biodegradable fibers. Their innovative solution uses materials like brown seaweed, red seaweed, and fruit waste to create eco-friendly textile alternatives with significantly reduced carbon footprint and water consumption. Backed by the U.S. Department of Energy's Activate Fellowship, the company aims to revolutionize the textile industry by eliminating toxic chemicals and providing sustainable fiber solutions for fashion and industrial applications.

Name: Sust Chem
Description: Sust-Chem is an innovative materials company focused on developing sustainable bioplastics to reduce environmental impact in the plastics industry. The company creates cost-effective bioplastic products made from renewable materials, with a particular emphasis on reducing carbon footprint compared to traditional petrochemical plastics. Their goal is to bring environmentally friendly materials to market, offering solutions that can be recycled or repurposed, and supporting producers and consumers in transitioning to more sustainable plastic alternatives.

Name: TasmanIon
Description: TasmanIon is a New Zealand-based technology startup developing innovative aluminum-ion battery technologies. Their research, originating from Victoria University of Wellington, focuses on creating safer, more sustainable, and cost-effective battery solutions for grid storage and portable applications, with a key emphasis on non-flammable electrolytes and enhanced energy density.

Name: Terrajoule
Description: Why we're betting on steel and glass instead of lithium The race to scale clean energy has a bottleneck: batteries. For electric vehicles, battery innovation is essential. But for 24/7 solar power? Scaling up battery production is proving too slow and too capital-intensive to meet demand. Here's the challenge: -Gigafactory investments run into the billions -There's a risky delay between investment and return -Material costs and availability are unpredictable -Chinese supply chains dominate We took a different path. Our patented DSM (Direct Steam Module) thermal storage technology uses steel and glass—materials with massive existing global manufacturing capacity. No new gigafactories needed. No lithium supply chain dependencies. The result: ✓ Decisively lower cost than PV + battery from day one ✓ Faster scale-up with far less capital ✓ 25+ years of reliable performance with no degradation For fully-dispatchable solar power, energy storage is the biggest cost driver. Our innovation leapfrogs that barrier at a fraction of lithium-ion battery costs. And we're not doing this alone. Our founding partner, KGiSL of Coimbatore, India, is a $750M/year group with an unmatched solar thermal team that's been developing and deploying these systems at scale. The infrastructure to power the AI era, electrify industry, and decarbonize the grid needs to be as scalable as the ambition. That's what we're building. #CleanEnergy #SolarPower #EnergyStorage #ClimateInnovation #ThermalStorage #Sustainability

Name: Thermal Smart
Description: Thermal Smart is an innovative technology company specializing in aerogel-based thermal management solutions, with a primary focus on preventing thermal runaway in lithium-ion batteries. Their flagship product, the AeroShield Crate, provides advanced safety containment for battery transportation and storage across energy, transportation, and electronics sectors. Using cutting-edge aerogel technology, they develop customized thermal protection solutions that enhance safety, prevent explosions, and ensure compliance with transportation regulations like NFPA and DOT.

Name: ThermoShade
Description: ThermoShade is an innovative outdoor cooling technology company developing passive cooling panels designed to make urban spaces more resilient to extreme heat. Their patented shade panels can be retrofitted to outdoor structures, creating environments up to 20°F cooler without using electricity or water. The solution aims to improve comfort in public spaces, support climate change adaptation, and provide an energy-efficient cooling alternative for various outdoor settings.

Name: Universal Fuel Technologies
Description: Unifuel is a chemical technology company specializing in sustainable energy solutions, focusing on producing renewable fuels through its proprietary Flexiforming technology. The company develops sustainable aviation fuel (SAF), renewable gasoline, renewable LPG, and renewable chemicals. Unifuel's innovative approach allows for flexible production of synthetic fuels, enabling operators to adjust feed levels and pricing based on market conditions. The technology aims to reduce carbon emissions and provide cost-effective alternatives to traditional fossil fuels.

Name: Vellex Computing
Description: Vellex is a technology company focused on accelerating electric grid deployment through advanced AI and high-performance computing solutions. The company provides innovative grid computing technologies that help enterprise energy users, project developers, and utilities optimize energy infrastructure and reduce costs. Using a patented Grid Compute platform and neural-network-inspired approaches, Vellex aims to address the growing challenges of electrification and increasing energy demands by enabling faster, more efficient grid simulations and resource optimization.

Name: Virtus Solis
Description: Virtus Solis is a renewable energy company developing an innovative space-based solar power system aimed at addressing global energy challenges. Their mission is to provide clean, low-cost renewable energy that can replace fossil fuels, which currently power 85% of global energy production. The company focuses on creating a scalable solar energy solution that tackles energy poverty and provides ubiquitous, inexpensive clean energy for terrestrial and potential extra-terrestrial applications, targeting the $8 trillion global energy market.

Name: Voltaic Marine
Description: Voltic Marine specializes in high-performance aluminum electric boats designed for water sports and recreational activities. The company produces customizable electric watercraft with advanced 300kWh battery technology, providing a quiet and powerful boating experience. Their boats eliminate traditional engine noise and vibration while offering integrated charging solutions. Focused on environmental responsibility, Voltic Marine delivers innovative electric boats that cater to various water activities, emphasizing sustainable marine transportation technology.

Name: Vroom Solar
Description: Vroom Solar is an innovative solar energy technology company that develops Smart Solar Management Systems designed to provide direct, grid-independent solar power solutions. Their technology enables plug-and-play solar energy generation for homes, businesses, and mobile applications like RVs, trucks, and disaster relief scenarios, eliminating the need for batteries or complex grid connections through a patented control center that efficiently manages solar power conversion and load distribution.

Name: Water Current Energy
Description: Water Current Energy is an innovative marine technology company specializing in renewable energy and water generation solutions. They develop advanced aquatic technologies, including the Water Bee air-to-water generator for energy-efficient desalination and a gravity-based energy storage system that operates without battery degradation. The company holds multiple patents focused on water generation and energy storage technologies, with a commitment to addressing water challenges through clean energy innovations. Their solutions leverage natural sea pressure and aim to provide sustainable alternatives in the marine and water technology sectors.

Name: WattHour24
Description: High-capacity energy storage systems with advanced battery technologies and management solutions

Name: WattShift
Description: WattShift is an energy management platform that helps residential and commercial users optimize energy consumption and reduce carbon emissions. The app connects to smart thermostats to analyze energy usage, track savings, and automatically shift energy consumption to cleaner times of the day when renewable energy is at peak availability. Users can customize temperature preferences, monitor their environmental impact, and save money on utility bills while contributing to climate change mitigation efforts.

Name: Wildfire Alliance
Description: Wildfire Alliance is a fire protection technology company founded in 2003, originally known as Firebreak Spray Systems. The company specializes in developing environmentally friendly fire retardant solutions to protect properties from wildfires. Their innovative approach involves using phosphate-based, long-term retardants and organic composting blends to safeguard homes and vegetation. The company aims to expand fire protection services more affordably and broadly, working with insurance providers to enhance property safety in wildfire-prone regions.

Name: Wind Harvest International
Description: Wind Harvest is an innovative renewable energy company developing advanced vertical-axis wind turbines designed to harness mid-level wind (15'-100' above ground) in turbulent conditions. Their Wind Harvester 4.0 technology uniquely captures wind energy in areas traditional propeller-type turbines cannot, potentially increasing wind farm efficiency by over 20%. The company focuses on sustainable energy solutions, using steel and aluminum construction to create utility-scale turbines that can be deployed in diverse environments, from large utility projects to remote areas with limited infrastructure.

Name: XTS Energy
Description: XTS Energy LLC is a Texas-based energy development company focused on low-carbon energy projects across multiple sectors. The company specializes in developing and financing energy assets including liquefied natural gas (LNG), sustainable aviation fuel, blue ammonia, and methanol production. With experience in natural gas and renewable energy sectors, XTS has successfully funded over 25 energy projects across the US, Europe, and Mexico, working with strategic partners to develop and operate energy infrastructure with a combined capital value exceeding $4.5 billion.

Name: ZILA BioWorks
Description: ZILA BioWorks developed a patented bio-epoxy resin made from industrial hemp, which produces economic and soil health benefits for farmers, reduces toxins for workers and consumers, and enables manufacturers to lock up captured carbon into durable goods while maintaining performance.

Name: Zohar CleanTech
Description: ZoharTech is an innovative cleantech company developing ZoharX, a patented waste-to-energy solution for decentralized, on-site waste disposal. Their system uses thermal gasification technology to convert unsorted household waste into energy, eliminating landfill transportation and reducing greenhouse gas emissions. The technology can convert 80% of waste into energy at the source, with the remaining 20% transformed into usable materials like slag, providing an efficient and environmentally friendly waste management solution for urban areas.

Name: PipeDream Labs
Description: Pipedream is an innovative autonomous underground rail system designed to provide near-instantaneous delivery of objects to and from homes and businesses. The technology utilizes subterranean pipes and fully autonomous robots capable of transporting goods at high speeds (over 60 mph). The delivery system aims to revolutionize logistics by offering a faster, more efficient alternative to traditional delivery methods, with a secure online platform that enables convenient pickup services for various types of products.

Name: LAVA
Description: LAVA Power is an innovative clean energy technology company developing advanced isothermal heat engines that convert heat into zero-emission electricity. Their proprietary liquid-based thermodynamic cycle achieves high efficiency (70-80% of Carnot), enabling scalable solutions for industrial heating, data centers, and cooling applications. The company focuses on making clean energy economically viable by offering technologies with rapid return on investment, low upfront costs, and short payback periods of 1-3 years. Their roadmap includes an isothermal heat engine, high-efficiency heat pump, and Carnot Battery for long-duration energy storage, targeting industries seeking sustainable and financially attractive energy solutions.

Name: ALT TEX
Description: ALT TEX is a sustainable textile startup that creates innovative polyester fabrics from food waste, addressing environmental challenges in the fashion industry. Using a patented technology, the company transforms food waste into bioplastic fiber that can be melt-extruded into high-quality, durable fabric. Their approach focuses on reimagining textile production with an environmentally conscious method that reduces waste, promotes biodiversity, and offers a more sustainable alternative to traditional polyester manufacturing, with key features including biodegradability, energy efficiency, and a carbon-neutral production process.

Name: Acceleware
Description: Acceleware is an innovative clean-tech company specializing in electromagnetic heating solutions for industrial decarbonization, with two primary business units: Radio Frequency (RF) Heating and Seismic Imaging Software. Their RF XL technology offers a low-carbon, water-free approach to heavy oil and oil sands production, dramatically reducing greenhouse gas emissions. The company develops scalable electromagnetic solutions for various industries including heavy oil, mining, agriculture, and clean fuels, with patented technologies that enable electrification of industrial heating processes previously considered difficult to abate.

Name: Linebird
Description: Linebird is an innovative technology company specializing in drone-based power transmission infrastructure inspection and maintenance. Using patented unmanned aerial systems, the company transforms dangerous and costly manual inspection processes by enabling remote, safe, and efficient monitoring of live power lines. Their Osprey NPS system allows direct contact and measurement of transmission lines, significantly reducing hazardous man-hours and improving operational efficiency through advanced drone technology and real-time data collection.

Name: Skip Technology
Description: Skip Technology is an energy storage innovation company developing advanced flow battery systems for renewable energy applications. Their technology focuses on creating sustainable, utility-scale energy storage solutions that address key challenges in current battery technologies. Using a unique hydrogen bromine flow battery with a revolutionary liquid membrane, the company provides a cost-effective, safe, and scalable energy storage system that enables renewable energy providers to store and deliver electricity on demand, with improved energy density and minimal environmental impact.

Name: Kvector
Description: KVector is a technology company specializing in high-efficiency communication and sensing products, particularly in radar, satellite communications, and telecom systems. The company develops innovative RF devices and antennas using patented metasurface structures that enable advanced beam scanning capabilities. Their technology focuses on creating low-complexity, high-performance solutions that can operate up to sub-terahertz frequencies, with a key aim of enhancing communication and sensor system efficiency while reducing overall costs.

Name: HyWatts
Description: HyWatts is a renewable energy technology company offering a Power-Plant-in-a-Box™ system that provides flexible, on-demand electricity generation through solar energy and hydrogen conversion. The system enables on-site power generation for various applications including EV charging stations, data centers, and off-grid communities. Designed for scalability and long-term use, HyWatts' solution converts excess solar power into electricity and hydrogen, ensuring reliable and cost-effective renewable energy across different installation sizes.

Name: Circuits Integrated
Description: Circuits Integrated (CI) is a technology company specializing in advanced integrated circuit design for the Satcom, 5G, and IoT industries. They develop high-performance integrated circuits, mixed signal designs, and integrated antenna systems with a focus on low-cost, high-efficiency components. CI provides expertise in analog, RF, and mmWave technologies, supporting electronic design communities with cutting-edge semiconductor solutions for applications in mobile phones, automotive, and military services.

Name: Decibel Therapeutics
Description: Decibel Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, dedicated to developing transformative treatments for hearing and balance disorders. Founded in 2013, the company leverages advanced single-cell genomics, bioinformatics, and precision gene therapy technologies to research and develop innovative medical solutions. Their primary focus is on advancing gene therapies that can selectively replace genes for congenital hearing loss and regenerate inner ear hair cells, with the goal of restoring and improving hearing function for patients.

Name: Noaratx
Description: Modified circular RNA team from ORNA

Name: Mote
Description: Targeted delivery using circRNA and LNPs

Name: Mother Wild Project
Description: Mother Wild is a women-led AgTech company developing innovative agricultural technology solutions to address global food security challenges. Leveraging scientific research, particularly focused on drought-resilient plant adaptations from South Africa, the company develops technologies to enhance crop resilience, improve soil health, and support sustainable agricultural productivity. Description: Vividgrd is a digital energy management platform utilizing artificial intelligence and high-resolution sensors to optimize smart grid operations for businesses and organizations. Their fiber optic sensors provide real-time temperature monitoring for electrical assets like distribution transformers, enabling proactive maintenance prediction, operational efficiency, and enhanced equipment safety. The company aims to address growing electricity demands and climate change challenges by developing low-cost, intelligent sensing solutions that extend the lifespan of critical electrical equipment.

By generating energized steam through innovative heat pump solutions, Hydram Research seeks to transform industrial heat management and support more sustainable manufacturing processes.

Their technology focuses on improving water quality, human health, and environmental sustainability by addressing the growing global concern of microplastic contamination.

The technology can reach temperatures up to 1700°C, enabling the replacement of fossil-fired processes with clean, renewable energy-powered alternatives, supporting industrial sector transitions to carbon-zero operations.

Description: Nurture Genomics is a genomic health platform providing comprehensive genetic screening services for children from birth. Led by clinical geneticists and genetic counselors, the company offers genome sequencing to identify over 400 actionable genetic conditions. The company focuses on developing solutions for cancer immunotherapies, diabetes, and neurodegenerative diseases, leveraging a multidisciplinary team of scientists and engineers to create scalable and affordable therapeutic approaches that can potentially transform treatment strategies for various challenging health conditions.

The company develops innovative technologies to sequester greenhouse gases while creating alternative materials. By commercializing an NREL-developed process to produce carbon-negative acrylonitrile using CO2 and biomass, Mars Materials aims to enable decarbonization applications in industries like carbon fiber production and wastewater treatment, ultimately reducing greenhouse gas emissions and creating more affordable, long-lasting products.

Name: Applied Biorefinery Sciences
Description: Applied Biorefinery Sciences (ABS) is a sustainable technology company specializing in biorefinery processes that transform woody biomass into high-value products and chemicals. Their patented hot water extraction technology creates carbon-neutral, biodegradable alternatives to petroleum-based fuels and industrial chemicals. The company focuses on producing wood pellets, renewable energy solutions, and developing innovative processes to extract valuable chemicals from biomass while supporting rural communities and forest land management.

Name: Rare Flora
Description: Rare Flora is an innovative biotechnology company specializing in sustainable rare earth element (REE) extraction using engineered plants. Their phytomining technology involves cultivating plants on metal-rich soil to extract critical metals like neodymium, dysprosium, and praseodymium through a bio-based process. By harvesting and converting plant biomass into REE-rich bio-ore, the company aims to reduce environmental impact and lower capital costs associated with traditional mining, offering a more environmentally responsible and cost-effective method of producing rare earth elements.

Name: Khemiametals
Description: Khemia Metals is a sustainable technology company focused on developing innovative battery technologies. They specialize in creating earth-abundant alloy solutions to replace critical metals, aiming to produce lighter, cheaper, and more environmentally friendly battery components. The company leverages high-throughput alloy discovery to develop mechanically robust and electrochemically stable materials for next-generation battery technologies.

Name: Silisiumtech
Description: SilisiumTech is a Carnegie Mellon University spinoff dedicated to rebuilding and decarbonizing the US solar supply chain. The company has developed an innovative continuous process for manufacturing silicon wafers that reduces production costs by 50% and cuts CO2 emissions significantly. Supported by grants from DOE and NSF, SilisiumTech aims to address the solar industry's dependence on Chinese manufacturing by creating a more sustainable and cost-effective silicon wafer production method. The company has won multiple awards, including the DOE Made in America Solar Prize, and focuses on advancing clean, efficient solar manufacturing technologies.

Name: hidrogenics
Description: Hidrogenics is an innovative clean energy technology company specializing in advanced carbon material production and hydrogen generation. Their core technology involves a low-temperature pyrolysis process that transforms hydrocarbons like natural gas into clean hydrogen and high-value carbon nanomaterials including graphite, carbon nanotubes, and graphene. The company focuses on developing scalable, greenhouse-gas-free solutions for energy transition, with applications in automotive, pharmaceutical, and energy production sectors. Their breakthrough technology aims to minimize environmental impact while creating efficient, cost-effective carbon and hydrogen products.

Name: Wildfire Energy
Description: Wildfire Energy is a renewable energy startup developing advanced gasification technology for converting waste into sustainable energy products. Their proprietary process enables cost-effective transformation of low-value biomass and waste feedstocks into high-quality syngas for electricity generation and fuel production. The company's modular technology focuses on reducing greenhouse gas emissions and promoting sustainability by processing non-recyclable solid waste into renewable energy sources like electricity, hydrogen, and biofuels. Currently testing a pilot plant in Brisbane, Australia, they aim to scale up and commercialize their innovative waste-to-energy solution.
