Name: syenex
Description: Syenex is a synthetic biology technology company focused on advancing genetic medicine development. The company provides targeted delivery technologies for cell and gene therapies, offering customized solutions that streamline the development process from pre-clinical prototyping to clinical validation. Syenex supports biotechnologists and drug developers by providing access to high-quality delivery platforms for various therapeutic cell types, with the goal of accelerating clinical impact and enhancing innovation in genomic medicine.

Name: Heritable
Description: Heritable Agriculture is an innovative agricultural technology company that leverages artificial intelligence, biotechnology, and traditional breeding to enhance global food systems. Founded at Alphabet's moonshot factory, the company has developed an AI platform designed to make plant breeding more efficient and sustainable. Their technology focuses on phenotypic prediction, causal gene identification, and genome editing, with the goal of improving crop yields, nutrition, and resilience while reducing the time and cost associated with traditional agricultural research.

Name: Homeostasis Systems Corp
Description: Homeostasis is an advanced materials startup developing innovative technology to convert atmospheric CO2 into critical carbon materials, particularly battery-grade graphite. Located in the Pacific Northwest, the company focuses on domestic production using small, modular, and portable electrochemical reactors. By transforming the primary cause of climate change into a solution for critical material production, Homeostasis aims to contribute to sustainable technological development through original research and strategic partnerships.

Name: Pangea Botanica
Description: Pangea Bio is a biotechnology company specializing in developing transformative medicines for neurological and neuropsychiatric disorders. Utilizing advanced AI technology, the company identifies and develops novel therapeutic molecules from natural sources, leveraging traditional human evidence of safety and efficacy. Their proprietary AI engine analyzes natural compounds to create a scalable pipeline of treatments for Central Nervous System (CNS) disorders, with a focus on uncovering promising molecules that have demonstrated potential for addressing complex neurological conditions.

Name: Fabriusa
Description: Fabri USA is a technology-driven investment casting foundry focused on producing precision metal castings for critical U.S. industries. The company aims to accelerate manufacturing processes, reducing casting times from months to days. With a mission to restore U.S. manufacturing leadership and strengthen domestic supply chains, Fabri USA leverages advanced software-defined technologies to enhance manufacturing efficiency and support national economic security.

Leveraging MIT-originated innovations, the company develops specialized electrolyzers that integrate with existing petrochemical facilities like ironmaking and ethane cracking plants. Their technology enables upcycling of CO2 emissions by creating cost-competitive carbon feedstocks using improved catalysts and cheaper materials, helping industrial processes reduce their carbon footprint through a more sustainable approach to chemical production.

Name: FemTherapeutics
Description: FemTherapeutics is a medical technology company revolutionizing women's pelvic health through personalized, AI-driven solutions. Specializing in custom-designed pessary devices for pelvic floor disorders, the company leverages 3D printing and artificial intelligence to create patient-specific gynecological prosthetics. Their innovative approach addresses conditions like pelvic organ prolapse and stress urinary incontinence, aiming to make pelvic health care more accessible, comfortable, and tailored to individual anatomical needs.

Name: Tacticaledgesystems
Description: Tactical Edge Systems is a technology company that supports businesses and defense organizations by addressing complex challenges in energy, logistics, and autonomous systems. Leveraging advanced scientific approaches and robust hardware solutions, the company draws on extensive engineering and energy expertise to help organizations gain a competitive technological advantage across various industries.

Name: Aralez Bio
Description: Aralez Bio is a biotechnology company specializing in the manufacturing of noncanonical amino acids (ncAAs) for pharmaceutical and biotechnology applications. The company has developed a proprietary enzymatic method that enables the synthesis of over 100 high-quality, sustainable ncAAs with perfect enantiopurity in a single step, using water as the only byproduct. Their platform supports protein engineering, fermentation, and biocatalysis, which simplifies the manufacturing process for drug discovery and development, helping companies efficiently create innovative therapeutics.

Name: Adaract
Description: Adaract is a technology company specializing in proprietary artificial muscle actuators designed for advanced motion solutions in robotics, bionics, and aerospace industries. Their innovative actuator systems provide stronger, lighter, and more compact motion capabilities, with additional benefits including improved reliability, enhanced compliance, and superior energy efficiency. The company focuses on developing cutting-edge motion technologies that can be applied across multiple high-performance technological domains.

Name: Napigen
Description: NAPIGEN is a biotechnology company specializing in novel genome engineering of organisms including plants, microbes, and animals. The company focuses on advanced genome editing techniques targeting mitochondria and chloroplasts - cellular organelles that play critical roles in energy production and biochemical molecule generation. Their technology has broad applications across industrial biotechnology, agriculture, animal and human healthcare, with specific research into mitochondrial gene editing for hybrid seed production in crops like wheat and rice, as well as potential applications in human mitochondrial DNA research.

Name: PreDicta Biosciences
Description: Predicta Biosciences is a precision oncology company that integrates advanced multiomics and liquid biopsy technologies to develop innovative diagnostic and therapeutic products. Their platform focuses on hematological malignancies, utilizing whole genome sequencing and AI-powered molecular diagnostics to enable non-invasive blood-based testing. The company aims to revolutionize cancer diagnostics by removing the need for bone marrow biopsies, providing personalized treatment guidance, and developing an in-house immunotherapy pipeline with advanced diagnostic capabilities.

Name: atopile
Description: Atopile is an innovative hardware design platform that enables engineers to describe and design circuit boards using code. The company introduces software development paradigms to hardware design, offering a unique approach that allows for more efficient and flexible circuit board creation. Their solution aims to streamline the hardware design process by applying software-like development techniques, making circuit board design more accessible and adaptable for engineers across various industries.

Name: Building Machines
Description: Building Machines is a technology company specializing in 3D Casting, an innovative additive manufacturing technology for precast concrete construction. Led by technologists from Amazon, iRobot, and MIT, the company uses robotic technology to create solid concrete structures and components. Their advanced manufacturing approach enables the construction of entire structures including houses, slabs, floors, walls, and outdoor structures with improved speed, flexibility, and profitability. The company focuses on revolutionizing the construction process through cutting-edge robotic and 3D printing technologies.

Name: IONATE
Description: IONATE is a deep-tech innovator developing Hybrid Intelligent Transformers for smart electricity grids. The company creates advanced technology that revolutionizes power flow control, offering comprehensive sensing, monitoring, and dynamic control capabilities. Their all-in-one devices provide real-time electricity grid operations monitoring, minimal energy loss distribution, and increased capacity for renewable energy integration. IONATE's technology aims to improve grid efficiency and support the ongoing energy transition.

Name: Solutum
Description: Solutum is an innovative CleanTech company focused on reducing plastic pollution by developing sustainable packaging alternatives. They have created a patented compound that produces biodegradable flexible packaging materials with superior mechanical properties. Their unique solution allows manufacturers to use existing plastic machinery while creating environmentally friendly products that can be easily disposed of through water dissolution. The company aims to support recycling, industrial composting, and complete biodegradation without leaving microplastics or toxic residues, contributing to global sustainability efforts and providing an eco-friendly alternative to traditional single-use plastics.

Name: H3X Technologies
Description: H3X is a technology manufacturer specializing in high-performance integrated motor drives for sustainable transportation and industrial applications. The company designs advanced electric motors with exceptional power density, ranging from 30 kW to 30 MW, and offers products that are significantly lighter than competitors. Their motors are engineered for diverse sectors including aerospace, defense, marine, and heavy industry, with a focus on weight-sensitive and volume-constrained applications. All products are designed and manufactured in the USA, emphasizing domestic innovation and technological advancement.

Name: Sonochargeenergy
Description: Sonocharge Energy is a technology company developing an innovative piezoacoustic platform to enhance lithium-ion battery performance. Their proprietary technology uses a custom-fabricated piezoelectric device to reduce lithium plating and dendritic formation in battery cells, resulting in significant improvements in battery life, charging speed, and safety. The solution is designed for diverse applications including passenger and commercial vehicles, as well as energy storage systems, with the potential to extend battery life 2-5x and reduce charging times by up to 50%.

Name: Plastic2green
Description: Plastic 2 Green is a seed-stage company currently building a proof-of-concept mobile lab to showcase a method we developed to convert dirty, unsorted, unrecyclable plastics of all varieties into high-value, "double green" (Emerald) ammonia and varying grades of carbon black. We are well on our way to reaching our pre-seed fundraising goal of $1 million and appear poised to oversubscribe the round before kicking off our seed round. We are a team of over a dozen energized volunteers, as most of us are not paid and will not take payment from the company until we complete our seed round. We are a lean and mission-driven crew determined to spur the hydrogen fuels economy of the future by building plants capable of generating truly upcycled, green ammonia from plastic pollution. Ammonia carries hydrogen with far greater efficiency than hydrogen gas: ammonia is far less flammable; its safety protocols and distribution networks make for cost effective transportation. Industry appears aligned with this vision as leading automotive and shipbuilding companies have commitmented to build ammonia-burning engines to move humanity and commerce using clean fuels by the end of this decade. All carbon gases are captured and sequestered in our process by conversion to carbon black. Since our carbon black comes from reforming a waste product, it qualifies as "recycled." High-quality, recycled carbon black will command a premium in the production of nanotubes and graphene, while lower grades of carbon black are already desired by tire manufacturers. By taking readily available processes and adding our own trade secrets and intellectual property to integrate these processes, Plastic 2 Green promises to rapidly address the global plastic pollution scourge on a global scale, with each of our full-capacity plants capable of ingesting 600 tons of plastic pollution a day. It's a highly profitable endeavor, as we estimate that just three such plants will generate over $1 billion annually.

Name: Avronna Incorporated
Description: Avronna is pioneering Avronna Reasoning Intelligence (Ari) to solve the hardest interdisciplinary problems in chipmaking. Ari dynamically and autonomously assesses why, whether, and how the chip designs work throughout the journey from concept to manufacture. Ari reasons through interdependencies, anticipates failure points, and actively improves the design. Ari radically boosts productivity of chip design teams and EDA tools; leads to 25% faster go-to-market; and creates over $1bn in savings per volume chip. Ari goes beyond the limitations of Large Language Models (LLMs) and flexibly combines traditional test-based stimulus with machine learning, theorem proving, formal methods, and large language models. Ari makes human readable, industrial quality testbenches and formal verification proofs that are able to explain themselves quickly to other expert human verification engineers so that system-level debug is a managed process, and not a “whodunit” mystery. We are emerging from stealth and seeking seed investors.

Name: Edacious,
Description: Edacious is a technology platform focused on food system transparency and quality verification. As a Public Benefit Corporation, the company develops innovative solutions for analyzing food data, including nutrition density and safety measurements. Their platform enables food professionals to integrate lab testing tools, visualize nutrition data, and address broader connections between climate, agriculture, food, and health systems through radical transparency in food quality assessment.

Name: Sonocharge Energy
Description: Sonocharge is a technology company specializing in innovative lithium-ion battery enhancement through advanced acoustic wave technology. Their platform develops solutions to improve battery performance by minimizing lithium plating and dendritic formation using a custom-fabricated piezoelectric device. The technology aims to increase power and energy density across various markets and applications, including passenger and commercial vehicles, energy storage systems, and data centers. Sonocharge focuses on enhancing battery longevity and safety through cutting-edge engineering approaches.

Name: Paradox Immunotherapeutics
Description: Paradox Immunotherapeutics is a pharmaceutical company developing innovative immunotherapies for rare diseases using a specialized drug design platform. The company focuses on creating treatments that harness the body's immune system to clear lethal protein deposits and reverse organ damage. Their lead research includes potential treatments for immunoglobulin light chain cardiac amyloidosis, chronic renal failure, and neurodegenerative diseases. With an orphan drug discovery platform capable of addressing approximately 30 rare diseases, Paradox has attracted significant interest from major pharmaceutical industry players.

Name: sensmore
Description: Sensmore is a Berlin-based robotics startup specializing in AI-powered autonomous solutions for heavy machinery in industries like mining, construction, and agriculture. Using advanced 3D-radar technology and artificial intelligence, the company develops systems that enhance machine autonomy, safety, and operational efficiency. Their platform offers features such as collision warning systems, precision data collection, and machine automation, enabling the transformation of traditional heavy vehicles into intelligent, self-operating robots capable of complex tasks in challenging environments.

Name: Layer Metrics Inc.
Description: Layer Metrics Inc. specializes in advanced optical metrology monitoring systems for manufacturing, focusing on real-time control and measurement of production processes. Their technology enables precise monitoring of optical and surface layer sensors, supporting the production of high-integrated, 3D, and nano-scale components. By providing advanced metrology solutions, the company enhances manufacturing accuracy through comprehensive data point tracking and process control technologies for advanced manufacturing platforms.

Name: Destination 2D
Description: Destination 2D is a nanotechnology equipment company specializing in advanced semiconductor technologies. The company focuses on developing innovative solutions for next-generation integrated circuits by integrating graphene into mainstream CMOS processes. Their core expertise lies in creating technologies that improve semiconductor performance, energy efficiency, and reliability for the electronics industry, with potential applications in medical, consumer electronics, and digital transformation sectors.

Name: Crop Diagnostix
Description: Crop Diagnostix is a technology-driven agricultural company focused on predictive agriculture solutions. The company provides innovative tools and services to help farmers and agricultural professionals identify and manage crop health issues. Their platform leverages data analysis and predictive technologies to support various agricultural sectors, including crop and livestock management, with the goal of enhancing agricultural efficiency and crop health through advanced technological approaches.

Name: Flowing Energy
Description: Flowing Energy is a specialized renewable energy technology company focusing on advanced geothermal electricity generation. The company develops innovative geothermal solutions using advanced Stirling engines that offer significantly higher efficiency compared to traditional Organic Rankine Cycle systems. Their scalable designs target industrial waste heat recovery and enhanced geothermal projects, aiming to increase energy generation capacity while maintaining long-term reliability and performance.

Name: HGenium
Description: HGenium is a green hydrogen technology company focused on commercializing sustainable hydrogen production through thermochemical water splitting using heat below 1000°C. Based on patented research from the California Institute of Technology's Mark E. Davis research group, the company's technology offers high-efficiency hydrogen production from renewable energy sources without requiring expensive or toxic materials. HGenium's process converts water into hydrogen and oxygen through a complete chemical cycle, utilizing energy sources like solar, geothermal, and nuclear power to create carbon-negative industrial feedstocks for sustainable fuels and materials.

Name: BeDimensional
Description: BeDimensional is a specialized materials technology company focused on producing high-quality two-dimensional (2D) materials, particularly graphene and hexagonal boron nitride. Emerging from the Graphene Labs of the Italian Institute of Technology, the company has developed a unique patented production process that manufactures atomic-thick materials with exceptional electrical, thermal, and mechanical properties. Their advanced technology enables large-scale production of 2D crystals for various industrial applications, including batteries, lubricants, coatings, and advanced manufacturing. With a production capacity exceeding 3 tons, BeDimensional aims to revolutionize manufacturing by introducing innovative materials that enhance product performance across multiple industries.

Name: SOTIRIA
Description: SOTIRIA Technology is a Greece-based deep-tech company developing advanced underwater intelligence hardware and software for defense and national security applications. Their core products include magnetic sensors, hydrophones, and AI-powered software platforms designed to enhance detection and monitoring of critical offshore and seabed infrastructure. Recognized by NATO DIANA and MIT Technology Review, the company provides specialized solutions for NATO-allied navies and infrastructure protection using beyond-acoustics, AI-empowered technologies.

Name: Magma Space
Description: Magma Space is a technology company developing advanced satellite control systems with a focus on precision and high-performance space technologies. Their innovative solutions feature magnetically levitated actuators that dramatically reduce satellite vibrations, AI-enhanced control software, and ultra-stable platforms. Supported by NASA and other government agencies, the company aims to revolutionize satellite operations through improved pointing accuracy, autonomous capabilities, and reliable spacecraft control systems.

Name: InPHRED
Description: InPHRED is a technology company specializing in advanced optoelectronics, focusing on commercializing short-wave infrared (SWIR) vertical cavity surface emitting lasers (VCSELs). Their groundbreaking technology addresses a 30-year industry challenge by enabling cost-effective, high-quality, and eye-safe imaging systems. The company's innovations have potential applications across multiple industries including consumer electronics, augmented/mixed/virtual reality, automotive LIDAR, communications, defense, and medical/life sciences, with a core focus on delivering high-performance, signal-to-noise sensitive solutions.

Name: Infinite Cooling
Description: Infinite Cooling is an MIT-originated cleantech startup dedicated to transforming industrial water management. Using innovative electric field technology, the company develops solutions like WaterPanel™ to recapture and recycle water from cooling tower exhaust in industrial facilities such as power plants, data centers, and factories. Their mission is to reduce water consumption, lower treatment costs, and address water scarcity through cutting-edge technology that helps industries optimize their environmental and operational efficiency.

Name: NuCube Energy
Description: NuCube Energy is an innovative nuclear energy technology company developing a groundbreaking, simplified nuclear fission power system. Their compact reactor operates at high temperatures (1,300°C) and can run for over 20 years without refueling, utilizing a patented fuel and control system. The technology aims to make nuclear energy more affordable, safe, and accessible as a carbon-free energy source. Designed to complement renewable energy like wind and solar, NuCube's scalable system can generate electricity and process heat for various applications, including industrial processes and data centers, with minimal maintenance requirements.

Name: Eyedaptic
Description: Eyedaptic is a medical technology company developing augmented reality vision assistance devices for individuals with retinal disorders, particularly age-related macular degeneration (AMD). Their proprietary Simulated Natural Vision software powers wearable devices designed to enhance visual clarity and assist with everyday tasks. Developed in collaboration with ophthalmology specialists and low vision experts, their non-invasive eyewear uses advanced technologies like AR and AI to improve quality of life for people with central vision disorders, offering a battery-powered optical vision aid.

Name: Becoming
Description: Becoming

Name: Bedrock Materials
Description: Bedrock Materials is a technology startup specializing in developing advanced sodium-ion battery materials and manufacturing technology. The company focuses on creating low-cost battery solutions using abundant minerals like manganese, iron, and aluminum. Their innovative approach aims to enable domestic manufacturing of sodium-ion batteries as a cost-effective alternative to traditional lithium-ion models. Bedrock targets various applications, including electric vehicles and industrial energy storage systems, with a focus on producing high-quality, reliable battery materials for underserved markets.

Name: Rune Aero
Description: Rune Aero is an aerospace technology company developing autonomous aircraft specifically designed for regional cargo operations. Based in Atlanta, GA, the company focuses on creating scalable, sustainable air transportation solutions with advanced propulsion and autonomous capabilities. Their purpose-built cargo aircraft aim to reduce operating costs and improve efficiency for air cargo carriers by leveraging AI-enabled design tools and autonomous technologies. The company emphasizes safety, reliability, and flexibility in their approach to transforming regional air cargo transportation.

Name: Tersa Earth
Description: Tersa Earth is a Vancouver-based net zero biotechnology solutions company specializing in mining industry environmental technologies. The company provides innovative solutions for treating mining tailings ponds, focusing on Acid Rock Drainage (ARD) mitigation and metal recovery. Their technology offers self-powered modules that efficiently handle toxic waste, reduce carbon emissions, and enable metal reclamation from mining waste. By improving the sustainability of mining operations, Tersa Earth aims to create environmental and health benefits while advancing more efficient waste remediation processes.

Name: Select Fuel
Description: Select Fuel is an innovative environmental technology company that specializes in converting waste and plastic materials into various biofuel products. Using a patented Advanced Plastics-2-Fuel Conversion Technology, the company transforms tires and plastic waste into low-carbon aviation fuel, passenger vehicle fuel, and biofuels for transportation and power generation. Their solution aims to address global plastic waste challenges while providing sustainable fuel alternatives for different sectors, including racing, luxury automotive, and aviation industries.

Name: Oxylusenergy
Description: Oxylus Energy is a climate technology company developing innovative carbon capture and conversion solutions. Using proprietary electrolyzer technology, the company converts CO2 into green e-methanol and other sustainable feedstocks. Their approach focuses on creating scalable, modular carbon conversion 'factories' powered by renewable electricity, with the goal of displacing fossil fuels. The technology enables the production of carbon-neutral fuels and chemical feedstocks for sectors like shipping, aviation, and petrochemicals.

Name: Pulsar Bio
Description: Pulsar Bio is a biotechnology company transforming drug discovery through an innovative platform that expands the capabilities of DNA Encoded Libraries (DELs) into ultrahigh-throughput functional assays. The company collaborates with global leaders in drug discovery and development, leveraging advanced technological approaches to enhance compound screening and pharmaceutical research processes.

Name: Phorum.AI
Description: Phorum.AI is an advanced technology platform dedicated to transforming drug production through AI-driven solutions. The company provides innovative biomanufacturing optimization tools that utilize sophisticated models to predict peptide synthesis risks, recommend purification strategies, and improve production processes across various therapeutic domains. Their platform leverages proprietary data analytics and automated recommendations to enhance drug development efficiency, supporting the entire lifecycle from early candidate stages to final production.

Name: Earnest Agriculture
Description: Earnest Agriculture is an innovative agricultural technology company that transforms farm waste into sustainable soil products using advanced microbe technology. The company develops probiotic seed coatings that enhance crop yields and soil health by combining eight probiotic microbes with essential nutrients. Their solutions are designed to improve plant growth, combat diseases and insects, and provide farmers with an easily integrated method to boost agricultural productivity. Earnest partners directly with farmers to create eco-friendly soil amendments that support both environmental sustainability and agricultural performance.

Name: Pando
Description: Pando is an AI-driven synthetic biology company specializing in enzyme engineering for pharmaceutical manufacturing and diagnostics. Using a high-throughput screening platform and generative AI, the company discovers and optimizes biological molecules with improved activity, stability, and performance. Their technology enables efficient enzyme design that is 75% faster and 80% cheaper than traditional methods, delivering industrial-grade enzymes that create new market value for the biopharma industry.

Name: UNIBIO Argentina
Description: Unibaio is a biotechnology company developing innovative microparticle technologies for agricultural inputs. Their proprietary biodegradable nanocarriers optimize the delivery of agrochemicals and fertilizers, reducing application doses and toxicity levels. Using natural compounds like shrimp waste and clay, Unibaio creates sustainable formulations that help pesticide companies meet strict environmental regulations while lowering farmer application costs. Their Tecosan microparticle technology can improve crop yields by up to 80% and works with both traditional chemical and organic agricultural products.

Name: Rubedo Life Sciences
Description: Rubedo Life Sciences is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing innovative therapies targeting age-related chronic diseases. Using their proprietary ALEMBIC™ drug discovery platform, the company engineers novel small molecules designed to selectively target senescent cells that drive various chronic disorders. Based in Sunnyvale, California, Rubedo aims to extend health-span by developing treatments for conditions like Alzheimer's, cancer, diabetes, and arthritis. The company employs advanced genomic, proteomic, and bioinformative approaches to analyze cellular mechanisms, with a leadership team comprising experienced scientists and entrepreneurs from top academic institutions and life sciences companies.

Name: Radical
Description: Radical develops high-altitude solar-powered aircraft designed to provide continuous telecommunications connectivity from the stratosphere. Their autonomous platforms offer a zero-emissions solution for expanding wireless network coverage, enabling telecommunications providers to deliver LTE and 5G connectivity to over 90% of the world's population. The stratospheric aircraft can fly continuously without landing, providing an innovative and cost-effective alternative to terrestrial networks for improving global communications infrastructure.

Name: MetaHelios
Description: Metahelios is a technology company specializing in advanced imaging technologies using nanotechnology and metasurface-integrated camera technologies. Their core innovation focuses on developing sophisticated camera chip color filters that enhance visual clarity and improve photography experiences. The company provides cutting-edge solutions for smartphone, tablet, and other device image sensors, with technologies that improve night-time photography, color definition, and image sharpness using innovative organic Bayer filter approaches.

Name: Calectra
Description: A Bay Area startup focused on decarbonizing industrial heat through innovative thermal storage technology. Calectra provides zero-carbon, low-cost process heat solutions for heavy industries like cement, chemicals, glass, and steel, using patent-pending thermal storage technology that converts off-peak renewable electricity into heat deliverable up to 1600°C. The company aims to electrify industrial processes and reduce fossil-based energy emissions.

Name: Solopulseco
Description: SoloPulse is a technology company developing advanced sensor technologies focused on radar imaging and magnetic field measurement. The company aims to revolutionize autonomous systems by creating innovative sensor technologies with superior safety profiles and cost-effective solutions. Their primary product, the SONOS Radar, utilizes proprietary mathematical wave theory algorithms to generate accurate data collection and visualization, with potential applications in various fields including autonomous navigation and advanced sensing technologies.

Name: Adaptilens
Description: Adaptilens is a medical device company developing an accommodating intraocular lens (A-IOL) that mimics the natural focusing ability of a young, healthy eye. The biomimetic lens is designed to restore vision for cataract patients by responding to the eye's natural focusing signals, providing clear vision at near, intermediate, and distance ranges without glasses or contact lenses. Led by a team of ophthalmologists, cataract specialists, scientists, and engineers, the company uses novel polymers to create a soft, flexible lens that avoids adverse effects like halos and glare. The product is currently in development with significant investment backing for clinical trials.

Name: AI Proteins
Description: AI Proteins is a Boston-based biotechnology company focused on designing and engineering synthetic miniprotein therapeutics using artificial intelligence-based design and high-throughput drug discovery platforms. The company combines computational protein design with advanced laboratory robotics to create de novo proteins optimized for specific therapeutic applications. AI Proteins develops inexpensive, durable, highly specific proteins with potential for oral delivery, accelerating the development of lead therapeutic candidates for IND-enabling studies. The company's pipeline focuses on oncology while exploring partnerships in inflammation and metabolic diseases.

Name: Catain Energy
Description: Captain Energy is a green energy technology company focused on delivering high-efficiency, zero-emissions heat and power solutions. The company specializes in using Solid Oxide Fuel Cell (SOFC) technology with ammonia-based fuel cells to produce hydrogen and high-quality heat. Their innovative approach aims to provide clean, affordable energy solutions for remote and industrial users, with a technology that achieves 85% energy efficiency and leverages existing ammonia supply chains to enable sustainable power generation.

Name: Climatemaps
Description: ClimateMaps is a technology platform that uses AI and public satellite data to measure greenhouse gas emissions with high-resolution accuracy (10m). The company focuses on mapping underground hydrogen supply and providing insights into climate resilience and fossil fuel reduction strategies. By analyzing historical emissions data spanning over 5 years, the platform aims to support environmental research and contribute to understanding global climate transitions.

Name: Mi Terro
Description: Mi Terro is a venture-backed advanced materials company that engineers agricultural waste into sustainable, eco-friendly biomaterials to replace microplastics. Their patented USDA Bio-based Certified technology upcycles non-food agricultural side streams into high-performance materials for packaging, textiles, and other industries. The company develops biomaterials with superior mechanical properties, lower CO2 emissions, and no harmful additives, supported by major industrial brands like Unilever and AB InBev.

Name: Staxel
Description: Staxel is a technology company specializing in interactive smart retail solutions that leverage AI and robotics to enhance customer engagement. Their modular stores feature transparent LED displays, AI-powered product recommendations, and a cloud management platform, designed to create innovative retail experiences across multiple sectors including food, beverage, and branded retail environments.

Name: Raven Space Systems
Description: Raven Space Systems is an aerospace manufacturing company specializing in advanced composite materials and 3D printing technologies. The company focuses on developing innovative manufacturing solutions, with a particular emphasis on creating 3D printed reentry capsules and aerospace-grade composite materials. Their key technological innovation is a patented Microwave Assisted Deposition (MAD) technology that enhances production efficiency and supports sustainable manufacturing processes. The company combines advanced 3D modeling, CAD design, and cutting-edge printing techniques to produce high-quality aerospace components with a commitment to reducing manufacturing waste.

Name: Ernest Pharmaceuticals
Description: Ernest Pharmaceuticals is a biotechnology company founded in 2016 by researchers at the University of Massachusetts Amherst. The company develops innovative bacterial platforms for cancer treatment, specifically focusing on a proprietary technology called Ernest Bacterial Vectors (EBV). Using genetically engineered Salmonella strains, the company creates targeted drug delivery systems that can directly infiltrate solid tumor cells, potentially offering breakthrough treatments for challenging cancers like liver, ovarian, and pancreatic tumors. Their approach leverages bacteria's natural ability to home in on tumors while sparing normal tissue.

Name: Khepra
Description: Khepra is an innovative renewable energy technology company focused on transforming waste into advanced, petroleum-equivalent fuels using a proprietary ultrasonic process. The company aims to end global reliance on fossil fuels by converting excess renewable electricity into fuel during low grid demand periods. Their technology can process waste from farms, forestry, and plastics to create renewable fuels capable of powering electrical generation plants, ships, planes, and gas generators, thereby addressing energy storage challenges and promoting sustainable energy solutions.

Name: Rebound Technologies
Description: Rebound Technologies is an advanced refrigeration and cooling solutions company that has developed the IcePoint® thermal storage technology. Their innovative cooling system offers a 3-in-1 solution combining agile freezing, humidity control, and demand response capabilities for food processors and cold chain logistics. The technology reduces energy consumption, lowers operational costs, and supports grid decarbonization by using ice as a thermal battery. Supported by funding from the National Science Foundation and U.S. Department of Energy, Rebound has commissioned its first full-scale commercial installation with Lineage Logistics and aims to revolutionize cooling across various industries.

Name: Pure Blue Tech
Description: Pure Blue Tech is a membrane technology company specializing in innovative water filtration solutions. They have developed self-cleaning membrane modules that affordably filter and reuse water from natural, industrial, and municipal sources. Using patented ultrasonic and nanopatterned membrane technologies, the company addresses membrane fouling challenges, reducing costs, chemical cleanings, energy consumption, and waste. Their solutions aim to make water reuse viable for corporate social responsibility and municipal water recycling programs across various industries.

Name: RFC Power
Description: RFC Power is a renewable energy technology company developing innovative long-duration hybrid flow battery systems for grid energy storage applications. Their patented technology focuses on creating low-cost, high-performance energy storage solutions that support the transition to 100% renewable energy. The company's key innovation is a hydrogen manganese tank system designed to store excess wind and solar energy efficiently, featuring high power density, long cycle life, and low capital costs through the use of non-toxic materials. Their mission is to enable widespread renewable energy adoption by providing cost-effective, long-duration energy storage solutions.

Name: GreenJets
Description: Greenjets is an innovative electric propulsion technology company developing advanced jet engines for aircraft. Their engines utilize ducted fan technology to achieve superior performance, with capabilities to reduce noise by up to 93% compared to traditional engines and reach speeds up to 125m/s. The company provides design and integration services, creating customized propulsion systems for different aircraft types, including drones and passenger vehicles, with a strong emphasis on sustainable aviation solutions that enhance safety and efficiency.

Name: Lithios
Description: Lithios is a technology company developing an advanced electrochemical platform for sustainable and low-cost lithium extraction. Their innovative approach focuses on selectively capturing lithium from complex mixtures, targeting vast untapped resources in the United States and beyond. The company aims to promote energy resilience by producing lithium with minimal carbon emissions and potential for significant production capacity and cost savings, reimagining lithium extraction for the electric future.

Name: Oso Semiconductor
Description: Oso Semiconductor is a Mountain View, CA-based technology company developing advanced chipsets for wireless communication and sensing applications. Founded in 2022 and spun out of UC Berkeley, the company specializes in ultra-low loss beamforming technology for phased array antennas. Their innovative semiconductor solutions target markets including satellite communications, defense, automotive, and radar systems, with a focus on reducing power consumption and system costs while improving performance and electronic resilience.

Name: Visionary Fiber Technologies
Description: Visionary Fiber Technologies (VFT) is an innovative industrial technology company headquartered in Lockhart, Texas, founded in 2018. The company specializes in advanced fiber reactor separation technology that enhances manufacturing efficiency through two-phase chemistry. VFT's proprietary technology increases production yields, reduces operational costs, and enables waste product transformation for industries including renewable energy, food and beverage, and pharmaceuticals. Their microfluidic networks and innovative purification methods provide significant improvements in chemical processing and industrial operations.

Name: Metal Fuels
Description: Metal Fuels is an innovative energy solutions company focused on developing zero-emissions technologies. The company specializes in commercializing aluminum as an alternative energy source, characterized by its low cost, easy transportability, and high energy density. Their offerings include green hydrogen production, battery energy storage systems, electric and solar power generation, EV charging infrastructure, and sustainable transportation solutions. The company aims to provide cost-effective, environmentally friendly energy options for businesses, municipalities, and building owners.

Name: CarbonScape
Description: CarbonScape is an innovative technology company focused on sustainable graphite production for lithium-ion batteries. Using a patented process, they create high-quality biographite from renewable forestry waste streams, specifically engineered for electric vehicle batteries. Their carbon-negative technology enables localized production, shortening and securing green battery technology supply chains while creating a sustainable alternative to fossil carbon-based materials.

Name: Project K
Description: Project K is a software development services provider specializing in Microsoft technology stack solutions. With over 25 years of experience, the company focuses on Windows desktop application development using technologies like WPF, MVVM, .NET, C#, and WinUI. Based in the San Francisco Bay Area, they offer comprehensive software development services across technology, healthcare, energy, and finance sectors. Their expertise includes creating and updating desktop applications, mobile app development with Xamarin/MAUI, and converting legacy applications to modern platforms.

Name: Lucidean
Description: Lucidean is a technology startup specializing in advanced hardware solutions for next-generation AI networks. The company develops transformative optical technologies designed to enhance the performance and efficiency of data center networks. Their primary focus is creating innovative optical link solutions that improve AI system capabilities, leveraging cutting-edge photonic technologies to address the growing computational demands of artificial intelligence infrastructure.

Name: 株式会社Planet Savers
Description: Planet Savers is a pioneering Direct Air Capture (DAC) technology startup specializing in innovative carbon dioxide removal solutions. The company develops a modular system capable of capturing CO2 directly from the atmosphere, producing concentrated CO2 and CO2-free air. As Japan's first DAC startup, they focus on creating advanced CO2 absorbents and machine technologies to address climate change through atmospheric carbon extraction.

Name: BlueQubit
Description: BlueQubit is a Quantum Software as a Service (QSaaS) platform that provides comprehensive access to quantum computing resources for enterprise, defense, and academic customers. The platform enables users to run gate-based quantum algorithms and quantum computing simulations across multiple quantum hardware providers, including IBM Heron and Quantinuum H2 QPUs. Key features include managed GPU simulators, support for various quantum computing hardware, and tools for early adopters to explore and leverage quantum computing capabilities. Users can run quantum computations with a single click and benefit from a free trial to test the platform's capabilities before subscribing.

Name: Bright Silicon Technologies
Description: Bright Silicon Technologies is an optical technology company specializing in the Lightfield Directing Array (LDA), a solid-state beam control platform. The technology offers high-speed, precision optical switching with a unique combination of large field-of-regard and low power consumption. Key applications include LIDAR for autonomous vehicles, 3D printing, laser communications, quantum computing, and national security sectors. The LDA replaces conventional optical technologies with an adaptive micromirror array, enabling enhanced performance in optical systems across various advanced technological domains.

Name: Wright Electric
Description: Wright Electric is a comprehensive electrical services company providing both commercial and residential electrical solutions. They offer a wide range of services including electrical audits, repairs, installations, code corrections, and specialized solutions such as electric vehicle charging stations, panel upgrades, and landscape lighting. The company emphasizes quality workmanship, utilizes advanced technology, and serves diverse sectors including mixed-use, retail, hospitality, and industrial spaces. Their experienced technicians ensure efficient project handling while maintaining compliance with local electrical regulations.

Name: Green Graphite Technologies
Description: Green Graphite Technologies specializes in sustainable production of lithium-ion battery (LiB) grade graphite through innovative and environmentally friendly processes. The company develops technologies like GraphPureTM and GraphRenewTM to transform natural flake graphite and recycle lithium batteries, providing high-purity graphite for electric vehicle and energy storage markets. Their mission is to reduce the environmental impact of graphite production while supporting the transition to clean energy technologies.

Name: FluoRok
Description: FluoRok is a University of Oxford spin-out founded in 2022, revolutionizing fluorochemical production through innovative and sustainable technologies. The company has developed a patented method to produce fluorochemicals without toxic hydrogen fluoride, making the process safer and more cost-effective. Focusing on industries like lithium-ion batteries, pharmaceuticals, and agrochemicals, FluoRok aims to develop disruptive fluorinating technologies that are environmentally friendly and contribute to global sustainability goals.

Name: Hydrophis UK
Description: Hydrophis is a cleantech company specializing in sustainable mineral extraction and water remediation technologies. The company converts problematic waste materials like fly ash and desalination brine into valuable products, including low-carbon cement additives, high-purity industrial minerals, reclaimed water, and carbon credits. Using ocean minerals and CO2, Hydrophis develops innovative processes that reduce energy and reagent consumption while supporting the circular economy. Their technology aims to contribute to environmental stewardship by creating eco-friendly mineral compounds that can be integrated into existing supply chains and support sustainable development.

Name: Phase Two Chemicals
Description: Phase Two Chemicals is a clean chemistry company developing breakthrough electrochemical technology for on-site hydrogen peroxide production. Their innovative approach allows for decentralized chemical manufacturing, reducing traditional distribution costs and safety risks associated with chemical transportation. The company's on-demand electrolyzer technology enables more sustainable and cost-effective hydrogen peroxide production, targeting industries seeking efficient and environmentally responsible chemical synthesis solutions.

Name: Novoloop
Description: Novoloop is a circular innovation company that transforms hard-to-recycle plastics into high-performance materials using its proprietary Lifecycling™ technology. Founded in 2015, the company chemically upcycles post-consumer polyethylene into low-carbon polyols and polyurethanes for applications in footwear, apparel, automotive, and other industries. Their innovative process reduces carbon emissions and enables the creation of virgin-quality materials from plastic waste, supporting a more sustainable circular economy.

Name: Verde Technologies
Description: Verde Technologies is an innovative solar panel manufacturer specializing in thin-film and flexible perovskite solar cells. The company produces lightweight, high-efficiency solar panels with a unique peel-and-stick design that can conform to various roof types. Manufactured domestically in the U.S., their panels offer improved efficiency (up to 28%) and are significantly lighter than traditional silicon panels, aiming to make solar energy more accessible and economical for diverse applications.

Name: Atlantic Fish Co
Description: Atlantic Fish Co is a cellular agriculture startup developing sustainable cultivated seafood using advanced biotechnology. The company uses innovative techniques to harvest fish cells and grow them in bioreactors, creating seafood products that offer an environmentally friendly alternative to traditional fishing. Their process involves cell harvesting, nutrient feeding, and using scaffolding to produce fish fillets with the texture and qualities of conventional seafood. The company's mission is to provide delicious protein options that are better for people, animals, and the planet.

Name: Tereform
Description: Tereform is a sustainable technology company focused on molecular recycling and decarbonization of chemical manufacturing. Specializing in transforming end-of-life textiles and waste materials into pristine chemical building blocks, the company enables circularity in plastics production. Their innovative deconstruction processes aim to reduce dependency on petroleum-based inputs by converting hard-to-recycle materials into valuable products, thereby supporting the development of a more sustainable circular economy and reducing greenhouse gas emissions.

Name: CyanoCapture
Description: Cyano Capture is a cutting-edge technology company specializing in low-energy carbon capture and biomanufacturing. Using patented genetically engineered cyanobacteria, the company develops innovative solutions for CO2 capture and conversion into high-value biomolecules. Their platform enables carbon-neutral pharmaceutical and biotechnology production by using photosynthetic cells to synthesize molecules powered by sunlight, with a strategic mission to contribute to global 'Net Zero' emissions by 2050.

Name: Wild Bioscience
Description: Wild Bioscience is an agricultural technology company specializing in crop design and enhancement. The company develops next-generation crops that address agricultural challenges by leveraging the adaptability of wild plants. Their platform focuses on creating crop varieties that can thrive in diverse environments, with an emphasis on increasing harvest yields while reducing environmental footprint. The company aims to develop sustainable agricultural solutions that improve food production and contribute to environmental conservation.

Name: Fractile
Description: Fractile is a technology company developing specialized hardware solutions for running large language models (LLMs) with unprecedented efficiency. Their innovative chip design addresses critical bottlenecks in AI model inference by fusing computation with memory, enabling two orders of magnitude faster processing compared to existing hardware. The company focuses on eliminating the time-consuming process of moving model weights and parameters, which traditionally slows down AI computations, thereby providing a revolutionary approach to high-performance computing for AI applications.

Name: Odqa Renewable Energy Technologies
Description: Odqa is an innovative renewable energy technology company that develops advanced solar thermal solutions for industrial applications. Spun out of the Oxford Thermofluids Institute, the company leverages expertise from jet engine research to create high-temperature solar thermal receivers. Their platform uses a modular air-based system to convert sunlight into continuous heat up to 800°C, offering a sustainable alternative to fossil fuels. Targeting industries like mining, cement, and chemical sectors, Odqa provides a zero-emission heat generation technology with high efficiency and the potential to significantly reduce carbon footprint.

Name: Salience Labs
Description: Salience Labs is a cutting-edge technology company developing innovative photonic-electronic chips designed to accelerate AI computation. Headquartered in Oxford, UK, the company specializes in creating high-speed, low-latency networking solutions for AI data center infrastructure. Their core technology combines photonics and electronics to develop massively parallel processing units that can overcome traditional semiconductor limitations. Funded by investors including Cambridge Innovation Capital and Silicon Catalyst, Salience Labs aims to solve computational challenges in AI by providing ultra-high throughput photonic tensor processing units.

Name: Archangel Lightworks
Description: Archangel Lightworks is a specialized laser communications company developing advanced optical communication technologies for space and ground networks. Their core product, TERRA-M, is a miniature optical ground station designed to solve critical connectivity challenges by providing secure, high-volume wireless data transmission between satellites and terrestrial networks. The company aims to address global connectivity issues, support economic inclusion, and create resilient communication infrastructure through innovative laser communication technologies.

Name: Amp X
Description: Amp X is an innovative digital energy platform that provides comprehensive grid software services to facilitate the energy transition. The company offers a unique ecosystem of interoperable solutions including Dynamic Load Shaping, asset management, and smart grid technologies that connect renewable energy resources, consumer appliances, and energy stakeholders. Their platform aims to create a decentralized, digital, and flexible grid powered by clean energy, enabling new business models and revenue streams for distribution network operators, energy retailers, and consumers.

Name: Scaffold Tx
Description: Scaffold Therapeutics is an innovative biotechnology company focused on developing RNA-targeting therapeutics using generative AI and machine learning technologies. The company specializes in creating small molecules that regulate pathogenic mRNA activity, with a particular emphasis on addressing complex diseases such as solid tumor cancers and neurodegenerative conditions. By leveraging proprietary asset identification and therapeutic discovery technologies, Scaffold Therapeutics aims to accelerate drug development and explore novel treatment approaches for challenging medical conditions.

Name: Avery Therapeutics
Description: Avery Therapeutics is a biotechnology company developing innovative immunomodulatory therapeutics to address diseases of aging, inflammation, and fibrosis. Their lead program focuses on developing treatments for heart failure, one of the world's leading causes of death. The company utilizes advanced technologies like Nanosome and Nanosomase to create biologic therapies that redirect the immune system. Their approach combines human and microbial cell therapies to develop potential treatments for conditions such as psoriasis and oncological disorders.

Name: Seloxium
Description: Seloxium is a University of Oxford spin-out company revolutionizing metal recovery and water purification technologies. Specializing in extracting high-purity metals from industrial wastewater and mine tailings, the company provides sustainable metal extraction solutions with a 90-98% lower carbon footprint. Using their proprietary Selectal™ technology, Seloxium helps mining, refining, and recycling companies reduce waste, lower carbon emissions, and improve metal production efficiency while supporting environmental sustainability goals.

Name: Puraffinity
Description: Puraffinity is an environmental technology company specializing in advanced materials for water treatment, particularly focused on removing PFAS (per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances) from water. Spun out from Imperial College London, the company develops innovative adsorbent media with high-efficiency pollutant capture capabilities. Their solutions serve multiple markets including municipal water, industrial manufacturing, groundwater remediation, and point-of-use applications, combining chemistry and material engineering to create sustainable environmental solutions for water contamination challenges.

Name: Seabound
Description: Seabound is a climate tech startup developing carbon capture equipment specifically designed for large cargo ships. Their innovative technology sits adjacent to a ship's funnel and can trap up to 95% of CO2 emissions using patent-pending methods. Addressing the International Maritime Organization's emissions reduction requirements, Seabound provides a practical near-term solution for decarbonizing shipping by retrofitting existing vessels. The system captures CO2 using solid carbonate pebbles, which can be offloaded at ports and potentially repurposed for electro-fuels or carbon sequestration.

Name: Gen 2 Carbon
Description: Gen2 Carbon (formerly ELG Carbon Fibre) is a materials technology company focused on developing advanced carbon fibre recovery systems and expanding carbon fibre nonwoven business. Their mission is to create innovative material solutions that support environmental sustainability and accelerate the transition to a circular economy.

Name: Jones Food Company
Description: Jones Food Company is a pioneering vertical farming enterprise specializing in sustainable herb and leafy green production. Utilizing advanced hydroponic technologies, energy-efficient LED lighting, and sophisticated environmental control systems, the company operates Europe's largest vertical farm. Their innovative approach reduces water usage by up to 95% compared to traditional agriculture, enabling year-round production of fresh, high-quality produce. The company focuses on maximizing crop yields in controlled environments while minimizing environmental impact, representing a cutting-edge solution to modern agricultural challenges.

Name: Circular Refining Company
Description: Circular Refining is an innovative energy technology company driving the hydrogen revolution through comprehensive solutions for decarbonization. The company develops green hydrogen production technologies using waste and renewable energy sources, with a focus on accelerating net-zero targets. Their flagship product, Hydrogen IQ, combines AI-powered tender management with technological solutions to help companies transition from diesel and natural gas equipment. Circular Refining provides digital and physical infrastructure solutions for hydrogen production and transport, emphasizing sustainable practices and data-driven decision-making to support both public and private sector organizations in achieving earlier decarbonization goals.

Name: Maverick BioMetals
Description: Maverick BioMetals is an innovative technology company developing advanced biological processes for metal extraction, with a focus on efficiently extracting lithium, rare earth elements, and other metals from hard rock deposits. The company utilizes cutting-edge bioextraction technology to process rock materials with minimal waste, optimizing metal recovery through innovative mineral processing solutions. Their LithX technology offers an environmentally friendly approach to metal extraction, supporting the clean energy sector by providing more sustainable and efficient methods for obtaining critical metals used in green technology applications.

Name: Offgrid.Works
Description: Offgrid.Works is a sustainable architecture and construction company specializing in zero-carbon, affordable housing solutions. They focus on addressing housing and climate crises through innovative deep-tech approaches that emphasize energy efficiency, sustainable living, and carbon-negative construction methods. The company integrates robotic construction techniques, architectural design, and property development to create environmentally responsible housing solutions that minimize carbon emissions and promote community engagement.

Name: CCm Technologies
Description: CCm Technologies is an environmental technology company based near Oxford, UK, specializing in Carbon Capture and Utilisation (CCU) solutions. The company develops innovative technologies that convert carbon dioxide from industrial power generation into valuable materials like ammonia and phosphates, creating low-carbon fertilizers and supporting sustainability across agriculture, food production, and water treatment industries. Their patented process features high carbon capture efficiencies, utilizing novel cellulose/amine materials to retain up to 95% of flue-sourced CO2, with potential applications in advanced materials, energy storage, and resource optimization.

Name: Volador FlyTech
Description: Volador FlyTech is a UK-based technology company developing electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) vehicles and advanced battery systems for urban air mobility. Operating from Cranfield Eagle Labs, the company aims to make flying transportation more affordable and accessible. Their strategic roadmap includes developing manned aerial vehicles, launching flying taxi services, and creating modular battery systems for electric vehicles. The company targets global markets, with a primary focus on the UK, Europe, Japan, USA, and UAE.

Name: Arculus Solutions
Description: Arculus Solutions is an infrastructure transformation startup focused on enabling efficient energy transitions, specifically targeting natural gas pipeline retrofitting for hydrogen transportation. The company's mission is to future-proof infrastructure in the gas industry, supporting the transition to net-zero emissions by 2050 through innovative pipeline modification technologies that enable safe hydrogen transportation, both in pure form and as a blend.

Name: VITRA LABS
Description: Vitra Labs is a venture-backed biotech startup focused on revolutionizing fertility treatments by developing innovative cell therapies for in vitro egg production. The company aims to make IVF more accessible and affordable by creating a novel approach to oogenesis that does not rely on traditional ovarian donor tissue. Their research seeks to reduce the cost and increase the efficacy of egg retrieval, addressing the growing challenges of infertility through advanced reproductive biology techniques.

Name: Optalysys
Engine Team: Sophie Meyer <sophie@engine.xyz>; Michael Kearney <michael@engineventures.com>; Madeleine Laitz <madeleine@engineventures.com>
Description: Optalysys is a technology company pioneering optical computing and data privacy solutions. Specializing in light-speed optical processors, the company develops innovative hardware that enables secure computation through Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) technology. Their core technology uses photon-based laser light processing to deliver high-performance, low-energy computing capabilities that allow analysis of encrypted data without exposing underlying information. Optalysys aims to revolutionize data processing by providing secure, energy-efficient computational solutions for developers and enterprises.

Name: Propel Aviation Solutions
Description: Unleashing next-gen mobility with energy dense electrochemistry

Name: Airthium
Description: Airthium is a technology company developing low-cost, carbon-free industrial heat solutions aimed at decarbonizing industrial processes. Founded in 2016, the company designs innovative heat engines and heat pump technologies that convert thermal energy with up to 86% efficiency. Their solutions target high-temperature industrial applications in sectors like food, paper, automotive, and mining, with the goal of replacing fossil-fired steam boilers and dryers with renewable energy alternatives. Airthium has received multiple innovation awards, including the Prix Gérondeau by Zodiac Aerospace and the Concours Mondial de l'innovation, and was part of the Y Combinator startup accelerator.

Name: ForeLight
Description: ForeLight is a biomanufacturing company that specializes in transforming microalgae into sustainable agricultural and industrial ingredients using proprietary photosynthetic production technology. Their Illumesis™ advanced bioreactor enables precise control of algae and cyanobacteria growth, producing high-purity biological components for food, pharmaceutical, cosmetic, and agricultural industries. The company focuses on creating naturally-derived, non-GMO replacements for synthetic ingredients, with a mission to develop sustainable, efficient, and traceable biomass production solutions that minimize carbon emissions and maximize resource efficiency.

Name: Huminly
Description: Huminly is an innovative textile recycling technology company that uses enzyme-based processes to enable infinite recycling of textile waste. Their unique method employs water, salt, and enzymes to separate and extract high-quality raw materials like pure polyester and cotton from blended textile waste. The company collaborates with textile manufacturers and fashion brands to provide sustainable recycling solutions that help clients reduce landfill waste, maintain material quality, and achieve sustainability targets without compromising cost-effectiveness.

Name: Peronova
Description: Peronova is an innovative renewable energy technology company focused on developing advanced perovskite photovoltaic innovations. The company has created patented ultra-thin solar films that demonstrate world-leading efficiency standards across multiple environments, including indoor, outdoor, and space applications. Their breakthrough technology addresses limitations of conventional silicon solar cells, offering improved power-to-weight ratios and opening up new opportunities in utility-scale, building-integrated photovoltaics, and space technology sectors.

Name: CARI Health
Description: CARI Health is a healthcare technology company developing advanced remote medication monitoring systems. Their innovative platform uses small, wireless sensors worn on patients' skin to continuously track medication levels in real-time. The technology enables clinicians to receive precise medication data, customize dosages, and provide more effective telehealth care. CARI's solution is particularly valuable for chronic disease management, offering a comprehensive system that allows healthcare providers to monitor patient medication adherence and make data-driven treatment decisions.

Name: Arctevity
Description: Arctevity provides an advanced digital solution for autonomous building management, integrating sensors and control systems to optimize building operations. The platform continuously monitors and directly controls critical building functions including lighting, HVAC, security, air quality, and access systems. Using a cloud-based network of microservices, Arctevity enables real-time adjustments to building systems, implements preventive maintenance, and aims to improve operational efficiency, reduce energy costs, and enhance overall building performance and sustainability.

Name: Resourcechemicalcorp
Description: ReSource Chemical is an innovative materials technology company focused on developing sustainable plastics using CO2 and inedible biomass. Their revolutionary process creates high-performance plastics that reduce environmental impact by eliminating traditional manufacturing steps. The company's technology converts CO2 into advanced plastic materials suitable for various applications including packaging, textiles, and industrial plastics, with a unique approach that reduces production costs and emissions while maintaining superior product performance.

Name: Natilus
Description: Natilus is an aerospace engineering company developing autonomous cargo aircraft designed to revolutionize freight transport. Their innovative blended wing aircraft aim to reduce air freight costs by 60%, lower carbon emissions by 50%, and increase cargo volume by 60%. The company focuses on creating efficient, sustainable aircraft that use existing ground infrastructure, with a goal of expanding the global air freight market and enabling improved cross-border trade and logistics.

Name: Farcast
Description: Farcast Biosciences is a precision cancer medicine research company specializing in tumor microenvironment analysis. Their advanced platform uses biochemistry and AI to analyze live human tumors, collecting multimodal data to predict clinical responses and support therapy development. With extensive experience evaluating over 25,000 human tumors, Farcast aims to provide comprehensive insights into tumor dynamics, helping researchers and clinicians understand tumor response and resistance mechanisms to improve patient outcomes.

Name: Li Industries
Description: Li Industries is a climate tech company focused on developing next-generation lithium-ion battery recycling technologies. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Pineville, NC, the company develops scalable direct recycling technologies for electric vehicle and consumer electronics batteries. Their innovative approach enables efficient recycling of lithium-ion batteries, generating high-purity commercial-grade battery materials while promoting a circular economy and sustainable supply chain practices.

Name: Mangrove Lithium
Description: Mangrove Lithium is a Vancouver-based technology company specializing in lithium refining and battery materials production. The company has developed a patented electrochemical platform for producing high-purity, battery-grade lithium hydroxide and carbonate from diverse input streams. Their modular solution can be scaled to work with upstream lithium producers, cathode manufacturers, and battery recyclers. The technology aims to reduce production costs and carbon emissions while enabling more efficient lithium processing from various sources including brines and hard rock minerals.

Name: OCO Corp
Engine Team: Lakshana Huddar <lakshana.huddar@gmail.com>; Patrick Sarver <patrick.sarver@engineventures.com>; Lisa Hansmann <lisa@engineventures.com>
Description: OCOchem is a climate tech company specializing in carbon dioxide transformation technology. The company develops innovative electrochemical solutions that convert carbon dioxide, water, and clean electricity into sustainable liquid organic molecules, primarily formic acid. Using their proprietary Carbon Flux Electrolyzer, they create green hydrogen and renewable energy products. Their technology aims to accelerate atmospheric decarbonization by regenerating CO2 into valuable chemical products, offering sustainable solutions for energy storage, agriculture, transportation, and chemical manufacturing sectors.

Name: Polymer-X
Description: Polymer-X Inc. is a climate technology company that specializes in innovative electrothermal methods for sustainable chemical manufacturing. Spun off from the University of Maryland and Princeton University, the company develops cutting-edge technologies for converting methane and plastic waste into high-value fuels and commodity chemicals. Their core innovations include electrified programmable heating and spatiotemporal heating techniques that enable waste upcycling with record-high yields. The company produces a range of products including jet fuel, diesel, hydrogen, and ammonia, using electrified reactors for modular and distributed chemical manufacturing while reducing carbon emissions.

Name: Hydropore
Description: Hydropore is an advanced electrolysis technology company developing innovative hydrogen production solutions. Their membrane-less electrolyzer design enables clean hydrogen generation using renewable energy sources, with a focus on supporting off-grid and intermittent energy markets. The company's technology can produce hydrogen using metals like zinc and iron, supporting sectors including transportation, energy storage, and refining. They are particularly focused on developing lightweight hydrogen generation systems for fuel-cell powered applications like unmanned aerial vehicles, aiming to deliver superior performance compared to traditional battery technologies.

Name: Enoverra
Description: Enoverra is an engineering company specializing in sustainable solutions for greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions reduction. The company focuses on converting biowaste into carbon-neutral fuels, renewable chemicals, and permanently sequestered carbon. Their innovative DeepWell Reactor can process over 5 billion tonnes of wet biowaste annually, utilizing abandoned oil wells and natural gas infrastructure. Enoverra's low-energy biomass conversion process supports the circular economy by providing an efficient waste disposal and recycling technology that promotes carbon neutrality and creates value from biowaste through innovative engineering solutions.

Name: Oxylum
Description: Oxylum is a University of Antwerp spin-off company focused on developing sustainable chemical production solutions. The company specializes in CO2 conversion technology that transforms low-energy carbon dioxide into high-value chemical products like formic acid and ethylene using renewable energy. By providing innovative technologies for industrial carbon neutrality, Oxylum helps companies reduce greenhouse gas emissions and transition towards more environmentally sustainable industrial processes.

Name: Sora Fuel
Description: Sora Fuel is a clean technology company producing sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) using an innovative carbon capture and utilization approach. The company creates carbon-neutral jet fuel by combining air, water, and renewable energy through a patented bicarbonate electrolyzer process. Their technology offers a scalable, cost-effective solution that directly captures CO2 from the atmosphere, significantly reducing the carbon footprint of aviation. Developed from research at the University of British Columbia, Sora Fuel aims to create an environmentally friendly alternative to traditional jet fuel that eliminates multiple feedstock sources and minimizes greenhouse gas emissions.

Name: NONA Technologies
Description: NONA is an innovative technology company specializing in portable desalination solutions developed in an MIT laboratory. The company focuses on creating sustainable water purification technologies that enable users to convert seawater into drinking water using solar power. Their electromembrane technology offers efficient desalination with reduced power consumption, targeting applications such as emergency preparedness, maritime use, and off-grid water access for small groups, with a mission to make water purification more accessible and environmentally friendly.

Name: Ayrton Energy
Description: Ayrton Energy is a Calgary-based energy technology company developing innovative hydrogen storage solutions. Their proprietary liquid organic hydrogen carrier (LOHC) technology enables hydrogen to be stored and transported like conventional fuel, addressing key challenges in hydrogen energy infrastructure. The company aims to provide energy security by creating a low-temperature, low-pressure storage system that can be integrated with existing fuel distribution networks, potentially replacing diesel generators and supporting net-zero energy transition.

Name: Z-Polymers
Description: Z-Polymers is an innovative polymer science company focused on solving critical challenges in mission-critical industries. Their primary focus areas include advanced applications in 3D printing and emerging technologies like the hydrogen economy. The company develops next-generation polymers designed to address fundamental technical problems, leveraging cutting-edge materials science to create specialized solutions for industrial and technological applications.

Name: Nimbus Engineering
Description: Nimbus Engineering is developing breakthrough wireless power technology that enables energy transmission over long distances using advanced optical technologies. The company is pioneering innovative power solutions that can transmit kilowatts of power across hundreds of meters, targeting increasingly autonomous and electrified systems. Their technology aims to revolutionize power delivery by creating rapid-charge capabilities and wireless energy transmission for industrial and consumer electronics applications.

Name: Next-gen direct air capture
Description: CleanCapture is a technology company developing innovative Direct Air Capture (DAC) solutions for carbon removal. Their next-generation technology utilizes renewable power to capture carbon from the atmosphere without requiring water or producing secondary emissions. The company's 2.0 system features an electric, absorbent heat exchange technology that reduces energy consumption and minimizes operational costs. Their primary business model involves developing intellectual property for licensing to operators of Direct Air Capture systems, with a focus on creating scalable carbon capture technologies that can be mass-produced using existing components and supply chains.

Name: Torev Motors
Description: Torev Motors is an engineering company specializing in the development of advanced axial flux electric motors for automotive, aerospace, marine, and industrial applications. The company focuses on creating high-performance motors characterized by low weight, high power output, and reduced rare earth metal consumption. Torev's innovative motor designs aim to improve efficiency, sustainability, and environmental impact across multiple high-technology industries.

Name: Triton Systems
