Description: Triton Systems is a global business venture company that launches innovative technologies across multiple sectors including defense, medical, energy, and environmental markets. Founded in 1992 and headquartered in Chelmsford, Massachusetts, the company focuses on developing breakthrough ideas in areas such as artificial intelligence, robotics, ocean systems, and engineered materials. With over thirty years of experience, Triton has worked extensively with the U.S. Department of Defense, creating commercial products and spin-off companies that have generated significant shareholder value through technological innovation.

Name: Stephanie Downs
Description: UNCAGED Innovations is a biomaterials startup that develops next-generation sustainable performance materials as an alternative to traditional leather. The company leverages structural proteins from grains to create a unique fiber that mimics the look, feel, and performance of leather. Their innovative approach focuses on providing customizable biomaterial solutions for industries such as fashion, home goods, and automotive, with an emphasis on environmental responsibility and sustainable material production.

Name: CREW Carbon
Description: CREW Carbon is a climate technology startup that develops innovative solutions for carbon dioxide removal in wastewater treatment facilities. Using proprietary technology developed through research at Yale University, the company enhances natural mineral weathering processes to permanently store CO2 while optimizing wastewater treatment. Their approach enables measurable and permanent carbon removal, working with municipal and industrial partners to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and support sustainable environmental practices.

Name: Oxford Quantum Circuits
Description: Oxford Quantum Circuits (OQC) is a UK-based quantum computing company that provides Quantum Computing-as-a-Service (QCaaS). The company has developed the UK's most advanced quantum computer, offering cloud-based quantum computing solutions for enterprises across sectors like finance, engineering, and healthcare. OQC aims to solve significant global challenges through quantum technology, providing secure and accessible quantum computing experiences with a focus on practical applications that leverage advanced computational capabilities.

Name: Aza Power Systems
Description: Aza Power Systems is an innovative energy technology company that develops advanced reactor technologies for carbon-free power generation. Specializing in industrial-grade ammonia-powered engines, the company provides fuel-handling solutions for original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and retrofits. Their technology enables clean energy production by utilizing anhydrous ammonia in existing generation equipment, offering a versatile solution for reducing carbon emissions across various industrial applications like generators, heavy vehicles, and renewable energy systems.

Name: HOPO Therapeutics
Description: HOPO Therapeutics is a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company focused on developing innovative treatments for heavy metal poisoning and advanced radioisotope delivery methods. Leveraging expertise in heavy metal chemistry and technology licensed from Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, the company aims to develop pharmaceutical solutions for exposures to lead, cadmium, mercury, and radioactive actinide elements. Their primary mission is to safeguard human health by creating treatments that mitigate the harmful effects of heavy metal contamination while exploring potential medical applications of metals.

Name: Innophore
Description: Innophore is a cutting-edge biotechnology company specializing in protein and drug discovery using advanced AI-driven point-cloud technology. Their proprietary CatalophoreⓇ platform enables efficient identification and optimization of protein candidates for various industries, including pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and specialty chemical sectors. Utilizing artificial intelligence and massive computing power, Innophore analyzes protein 3D structures, surface properties, and catalytic cavities to accelerate R&D processes, minimize screening experiments, and support drug discovery and enzyme optimization for global customers like Henkel, Continental, and Merck.

Name: Theheropatch
Description: Anodyne is a venture-backed, clinical-stage biotech company specializing in advanced transdermal drug delivery through its proprietary HeroPatch technology. The company focuses on developing innovative solutions for chronic disease treatments, with an initial emphasis on obesity. Their macroporous microneedle platform enables the delivery of large molecule medications and complex formulations, offering unique advantages such as tunable pharmacokinetic profiles, room temperature stability, and potential for combination therapies. Anodyne is expanding its pipeline through internal clinical development and strategic partnerships, aiming to simplify chronic care delivery and improve patient access to emerging therapeutic treatments.

Name: aperture space
Description: Aperture Space is an earth observation technology company specializing in advanced radio sensing analytics. Their innovative platform uses low-frequency radio signals to provide detailed soil moisture and environmental monitoring across agriculture, water management, and natural disaster mitigation sectors. The company develops proprietary mapping and detection capabilities that offer unprecedented insights into hard-to-access geographic areas.

Name: Aetherfuels
Description: Aether Fuels is a next-generation climate technology company focused on decarbonizing hard-to-abate industries like aviation and ocean shipping through innovative sustainable fuel production. Established in 2022 as a spin-out of Xora Innovation, the company develops breakthrough solutions that reduce production costs and improve economic viability of sustainable fuels. Their expertise spans bio-fuels, e-fuels, gasification, syngas production, and liquids synthesis, with proprietary technologies that optimize process flows, plant configurations, and catalysts to dramatically reduce capital expenditure and feedstock costs.

Name: Spaero
Description: Spaero Bio is a software solution designed to enhance scientific research and laboratory efficiency by automating liquid handling workflows. The platform enables scientists to scale automation using existing lab liquid handlers, allowing teams to rapidly iterate on complex experiments with improved accuracy. Key features include automated error recovery, instant email notifications, and the ability to integrate as a standalone system or scheduler, ultimately accelerating bio lab research and development processes.

Name: Tidal Flight
Description: Tidal is an aerospace company developing an electric amphibious aircraft called Polaris, designed to provide direct, affordable, and sustainable air transportation. The company aims to unlock access to city centers and coastal communities through innovative aircraft technology. Their hybrid-electric design targets both commercial and defense sectors, offering runway-independent transportation solutions with a focus on reducing environmental impact and expanding transportation options in urban and coastal regions.

Name: Cedar Carbon Co.
Description: Cedar Labs is a deep-tech innovation lab specializing in advanced energy and decarbonization technologies. Their flagship product, Vulcan, is a modular, sustainable turbine-based power generation system designed to provide carbon-free energy for energy-intensive facilities like AI data centers and manufacturing plants. The company focuses on developing cutting-edge planet technologies across carbon removal, transport, and energy verticals, with a mission to create more efficient, scalable, and cost-effective solutions. By leveraging a growing intellectual property portfolio and creative problem-solving, Cedar Labs aims to accelerate technological innovations that address critical climate challenges.

Name: PhysicsX
Description: PhysicsX is a deep-tech company that develops advanced machine learning applications to accelerate physics simulations and optimize engineering design processes. Originating from numerical physics and Formula One expertise, the company helps customers improve product design and performance across industries including aerospace, medical devices, electric vehicles, and renewable energy. By leveraging AI and advanced computational techniques, PhysicsX enables high-fidelity physics simulations that transform engineering workflows, reduce CO2 emissions, and drive innovation in complex technical domains through breakthrough optimization technologies.

Name: Xcimer Energy
Description: Xcimer Energy is a technology company developing innovative inertial fusion energy solutions using advanced laser technology. Their mission is to create economically viable, carbon-free energy by leveraging laser inertial confinement fusion approaches. The company focuses on developing a prototype laser system called Phoenix, which aims to overcome traditional obstacles in fusion power generation. Assembled from experts across national laboratories, academic institutions, and private industry, Xcimer seeks to advance fusion technology as a transformative solution to global energy challenges.

Name: XGS Energy
Description: XGS Energy is a geothermal energy technology company headquartered in Palo Alto, California. The company develops innovative solid-state geothermal power solutions that enable large-scale, efficient heat and power generation. Their proprietary heat harvesting technology features a modular, closed-loop system that can operate independently of specific geological conditions or water resources. XGS Energy aims to facilitate global deployment of terawatt-scale geothermal energy by creating advanced, scalable technologies that provide clean, continuous energy through thermally conductive materials and innovative well architecture.

Name: Juno Propulsion
Description: Juno Propulsion is a technology company focused on developing next-generation rocket propulsion systems. The company specializes in commercializing rotating detonation engines for rocket launch applications, with a primary focus on innovative combustion technologies. Their work involves enhancing engine performance through advanced methods, including the potential use of hydrogen in fuel cells to improve launch efficiency and reduce traditional engine-related costs.

Name: 4QT
Description: 4QT is an innovative technology company specializing in electric and hybrid powertrains for heavy equipment and construction vehicles. Their core product focuses on developing high-power electric drives with patented motor and battery technologies, targeting heavy machinery manufacturers seeking to electrify their fleets. The company aims to reduce carbon emissions in the heavy equipment industry by offering hybrid-electric drivetrain solutions that deliver improved fuel efficiency, lower emissions, and enhanced performance for construction and defense sector vehicles.

Name: ICODOS
Description: ICODOS is a technology development company specializing in sustainable e-methanol production through an innovative, patented hybrid process for CO2 capture and methanol synthesis. Their breakthrough technology enables carbon-neutral e-methanol production by converting harmful off-gases into liquid methanol, targeting the shipping and chemical industries. The company's process achieves over 95% CO2 capture, reduces operating costs, and supports dynamic production using renewable energy. ICODOS aims to de-fossilize transportation and chemical sectors by providing a scalable, low-cost solution for producing sustainable methanol that can significantly reduce CO2 emissions.

Name: Pomodyne
Description: Pomodyne is an innovative agricultural technology company specializing in indoor solutions for year-round fruit crop cultivation, developing advanced methods to enhance and optimize fruit production in controlled environments.

Name: Persimmons
Description: Persimmons, Inc. is a technology company specializing in advanced full-stack AI inference computing, launched in 2023. The company develops high-performance, scalable computing technology with a focus on AI applications. Their key product is the PL1000 chiplet, which provides modular, low-power, high-density computing solutions suitable for various applications from small devices to large data centers. Led by veteran technologists with expertise in semiconductors, algorithms, and AI software, the company aims to make generative AI more accessible and efficient.

Name: CALDER BIOSCIENCES
Description: Calder Biosciences is a molecular engineering company focused on developing innovative vaccine technologies, specializing in respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) and universal influenza vaccines. The company utilizes a proprietary nano-scale, targeted crosslinking technology to engineer vaccine immunogens with enhanced protective antibody responses. Their platform enables rapid design of vaccine candidates with improved thermo-stability and shelf life, targeting multi-billion dollar market opportunities while mitigating clinical risks through advanced molecular engineering techniques.

Name: Dakota Energy Systems
Description: Dakota Energy Systems specializes in renewable energy technology, offering a patented Hydro Electric Power System (HEPS) that captures and converts energy from fluid flow in existing piping systems into electricity. The system is designed for municipal, industrial, manufacturing, and commercial applications, providing a low-risk, carbon-free solution to reduce energy costs. HEPS can be implemented in water, oil & gas, wastewater treatment, and other industries, with the ability to generate 9 KW to 250 KW of power from closed or open-loop hydronic systems, enabling on-site energy use or grid energy selling.

Name: Atdepthmrv
Description: AtDepth is a marine carbon dioxide removal (CDR) technology company that develops advanced measurement and monitoring tools for ocean-based interventions. The company creates digital twin technologies to quantify ocean physical and biogeochemical processes, providing real-time performance metrics for ocean-based carbon removal operations. Their platform supports carbon credit issuance, operational design optimization, ocean condition forecasting, and comprehensive assessment of human interventions in marine environments.

Name: Veebot
Description: Veebot is a medical technology company specializing in robotic needle insertion procedures, focusing on improving patient care during venipuncture and IV placement. The company develops autonomous, image-guided robotic systems that utilize artificial intelligence to enhance vascular access accuracy and reduce patient discomfort. Their technology aims to address the challenges of traditional needle insertion, including multiple painful attempts and potential needlestick injuries, with a solution targeting the estimated $1.9B global venipuncture market. Veebot's innovative approach includes a real-time vein viewing system that accurately suggests and selects optimal insertion sites, potentially transforming medical blood draw and IV placement procedures.

Name: H2GO Power
Description: H2GO Power is a cleantech company developing innovative hydrogen energy storage technologies. Spun out from the University of Cambridge, the company focuses on creating safe, low-cost hydrogen production and storage solutions for zero-emission power supply. Their technology aims to develop compact hydrogen storage systems that are lighter and safer than traditional pressure tanks, targeting commercial applications in the renewable energy sector and supporting the transition to clean energy infrastructure.

Name: Terra Watts
Description: Terra Watts is an innovative technology company pioneering wireless power transmission using earth as a propagation medium. Their groundbreaking approach enables direct electrical device operation without traditional batteries or wires, extending the range of wireless power transmission. The company focuses on developing technologies for various applications including agriculture, medical devices, and industrial sectors. Their core mission is to reduce mineral dependency, expand energy grid capabilities, and facilitate a low-infrastructure global energy transition through advanced wireless power and data communication technologies.

Name: Leela AI
Description: Leela AI is a visual intelligence platform that leverages advanced machine learning technologies to transform manufacturing operations. Developed from research at the MIT AI Lab, the platform uses standard cameras to analyze production floor data, measuring worker performance, identifying safety issues, and optimizing operational efficiency. Its unique hybrid causal/neural network approach enables detailed operational insights, allowing manufacturers to understand root causes of problems while using significantly less data and processing time compared to traditional analytics solutions.

Name: Carba
Description: Carba is a climate technology company specializing in low-energy carbon dioxide removal (CDR) solutions. Using innovative low-temperature pyrolysis, they convert biomass and waste into solid biocarbon for industrial applications, permanent carbon storage, and pollution management. Their modular reactor technology transforms waste materials like trees and construction debris into high-quality carbon products that can be used in industries such as asphalt, steel, and concrete production. Carba aims to capture a gigatonne of carbon annually by 2032, contributing to climate change mitigation efforts.

Name: Airbuild
Description: Airbuild is an environmental technology company that develops innovative biopanels integrating carbon capture, energy generation, and water filtration technologies. Their solution transforms buildings into sustainable ecosystems by utilizing microalgae to sequester carbon, generate renewable energy through embedded solar cells, and purify water. The company aims to provide carbon-negative solutions for organizations seeking to decentralize environmental remediation, offering a comprehensive approach to addressing climate challenges through integrated green technology.

Name: Blue Energy
Description: Blue Energy is an innovative nuclear power technology company focused on developing modular, cost-effective nuclear power solutions. Their approach involves designing small modular reactors that can be mass-produced in shipyards, significantly reducing construction time and capital expenses. The company aims to make nuclear power more commercially viable by offering fully integrated, automated reactors with enhanced safety features, and a unique business model of financing, building, owning, and operating power plants through risk-managed power purchase agreements.

Name: UndesertDotCom
Description: From undrinkable water, unusable land, and unlimited sun, we created Undesert. With our patented technology, Undesert can turn the worlds dirtiest water into a valuable resource - fresh, pure water. REACH OUT TO PARTNER: nseet@undesert.com Key Reasons to Invest: Patented: 4 patents issued for water desalination technology Recognized: Semi-finalist in the MassChallenge 2021 cohort Proven: 2 years operating experience and 10 years growing our tree variety in our location Eco-friendly: Our operation has zero carbon footprint and zero waste products Experienced Leadership Team: Our team includes seasoned entrepreneurs, scientists, and inventors who all believe in helping the environment. Market: We will disrupt both the $200 billion market for wood products and the $200 billion carbon capture markets.

Name: Team Wildfire
Description: Team Wildfire is an innovative technology company focused on revolutionizing wildfire management through advanced engineering and cutting-edge solutions. They specialize in developing robotic fire-fighting equipment, including their signature 'Hurricane on Wheels' technology, which uses jet engine-powered systems to suppress vegetation fires. The company's mission is to reduce wildfire deaths and losses by creating and deploying powerful new technologies, offering services such as fire monitoring, remote control capabilities, and specialized training for fire crews to enhance operational effectiveness in managing wildfire situations.

Name: Reframe Systems
Description: Reframe Systems is a cleantech company specializing in net-zero carbon housing construction using advanced robotic microfactories. Their innovative approach enables building climate-resilient homes 2x faster and 2x cheaper with significantly lower carbon emissions. The company provides a comprehensive homebuilding process that includes zoning, design, engineering, permitting, and modular construction, with a focus on electric and solar-ready homes. Currently serving clients in New England and Southern California, Reframe Systems aims to make climate-friendly housing a basic human right through streamlined, efficient offsite manufacturing techniques.

Name: Metallosyn
Description: Metallosyn is a technology company focused on sustainable chemical synthesis, specializing in bio-inspired chiral porphyrin catalysts. Their innovative approach aims to advance asymmetric catalysis by developing novel methods for discovering biologically active ingredients across various industries. The company emphasizes the synergy between sustainability and advanced synthesis techniques, using electron-level catalyst technologies to enable more efficient and environmentally conscious chemical processes.

Name: Locus Lock
Description: Locus Lock is a technology company specializing in advanced GPS solutions for commercial and military applications. The company provides software-defined GPS technologies with precise positioning capabilities, offering a range of GNSS receivers like RadioLion and LEO100. Their solutions focus on delivering real-time location data with advanced interference mitigation, supporting flexible on-premise deployments across various computational platforms. Locus Lock serves critical industries including defense, aerospace, and maritime operations, with a focus on reliable and secure GPS tracking and navigation technologies.

Name: HyperTunnel
Description: HyperTunnel is a mixed reality collaboration platform that enables multi-dimensional remote work interactions through immersive digital twins. The platform allows technicians in the field to synchronously and asynchronously collaborate with remote experts inside shared virtual environments. By using 3D scanning, computer vision, and interactive 3D models, HyperTunnel creates immersive digital replicas of worksites. The technology leverages AI and machine learning to recognize worker actions, provide real-time guidance, and enhance safety and efficiency in remote work scenarios across various industries.

Name: ExLattice
Description: ExLattice is an advanced engineering software company specializing in metal additive manufacturing (AM) solutions. Their platform provides intelligent, real-time simulation tools that enable designers and engineers to optimize metal part designs, predict potential printing issues, and generate customizable lattice support structures. Founded by a team of PhDs, the software leverages cutting-edge computational algorithms to accelerate AM workflows and improve design iteration processes.

Name: Crow Industries
Description: Crow Industries is a technology company specializing in advanced robotics and data collection for extreme environments, with a focus on mining, defense, and space exploration. The company designs autonomous aerial and ground robots for comprehensive data gathering, offering innovative technology solutions for complex operational challenges. Their systems provide intelligent automation, advanced mapping, and AI-driven capabilities for long-distance transport and operations in challenging conditions like mining sites, battlefields, and potential planetary exploration scenarios.

Name: Allosense Inc.
Description: Allosense is a technology company founded in 2020 specializing in next-generation sensors and measurement solutions for electric vehicle battery manufacturing and industrial equipment monitoring. Their primary product is the Allosense Battery Test System, which provides real-time data collection and management for battery performance. The company offers connected devices and sensors with 360° coverage, supporting asset tracking and digital transformation in manufacturing, with a focus on helping industries improve operational efficiency through advanced sensor technology.

Name: WingDriver
Description: WingDriver is an Artificial Intelligence Software as a Service company focused on driver safety through advanced computer vision and AI technologies. The platform uses facial analysis, vehicle inertial data, and surrounding environment monitoring to detect and alert drivers about dangerous situations such as drowsiness and distraction. Designed for mobile devices, the solution generates real-time visual and sound alerts to help prevent accidents, with particular applications in ride-hailing, auto insurance, and fleet management industries. The system offers optional cloud-based data analysis for continuous algorithm improvement and personalized safety coaching.

Name: Jana Care
Description: Jana Care is a global digital health technology company focused on improving chronic disease management, particularly diabetes. The company develops a proprietary platform that combines low-cost diagnostics, smartphone-based testing, lifestyle coaching, and predictive analytics. Their innovative approach enables patients and healthcare providers to access actionable health information through paper-based tests and digital platforms. Operating between offices in Boston, MA and Bangalore, India, Jana Care aims to reverse diabesity by providing efficient, cost-effective solutions for chronic disease management with a commitment to using biodegradable products and enhancing patient care.

Name: Feon Energy
Description: Feon Energy is a technology company pioneering advanced battery electrolyte solutions through a pharmaceutical-inspired molecule design platform. Based in the Greater Boston area and originating from Stanford University research, the company develops innovative, non-flammable electrolytes for next-generation lithium-ion and lithium-metal batteries. Their approach enables tailored electrolyte molecules that improve battery safety, performance, and energy density, with potential transformative applications in electric vehicles, aviation, and other energy storage industries.

Name: Miraterrasoil
Description: Miraterra is an advanced agricultural technology company focused on soil measurement and analysis. Utilizing cutting-edge AI and innovative tools, the company provides detailed insights into soil health, including organic carbon, pH, nutrients, and potential contaminants. Their technology enables efficient and precise soil component measurement, supporting sustainable agriculture by helping growers manage and improve soil conditions. Miraterra's solutions are designed to simplify complex soil analysis, delivering lab-grade results that support regenerative agricultural practices and environmental sustainability.

Name: Coulomb Technology
Description: A battery technology company focused on developing innovative, sustainable energy storage solutions. Specializing in zinc-ion and sodium battery technologies, Coulomb Technology manufactures rechargeable cells designed to replace traditional lead-acid and lithium-ion batteries. The company provides high-performance, affordable battery solutions for electric mobility, stationary energy storage, commercial, industrial, and defense applications.

Name: Jeevan Technologies
Description: Jeevan Technologies is a comprehensive IT solutions company founded in 2000, providing software and services across multiple industries including tax, health, education, and transport. With offices in Brentwood, Tennessee and Chennai, India, the company offers IT consulting, infrastructure management, testing, and custom software packages. Their solutions include CRM systems, visual engineering, and specialized products like TaxGarden and TruckDues, focusing on delivering quality, creative, and reliable technology solutions to global clients.

Name: Power to Hydrogen
Description: Power to Hydrogen is a clean energy technology company specializing in advanced AEM (Anion Exchange Membrane) electrolysis technology for hydrogen production. Their core mission is to accelerate the transition to a clean energy economy by developing cost-effective and efficient solutions that convert renewable electricity and water into high-pressure hydrogen. The company focuses on creating sustainable hydrogen production methods for various applications, including bio-ethanol production and other industrial processes, with an emphasis on minimizing carbon footprints and utilizing renewable energy sources.

Name: Benchmark Labs
Description: Benchmark Labs is an AI-powered weather forecasting company that combines grid-level weather data with site-based IoT sensors to provide precise, asset-located weather predictions. Their proprietary software is designed to optimize renewable energy generation, water allocation, and spatial risk management. The company serves agriculture, energy, and land management sectors by offering real-time, location-specific forecasts that help clients enhance operational decision-making, reduce risks, and maximize financial benefits through advanced meteorological technologies.

Name: bootboxstore
Description: Boot is an innovative climate-neutral heat pump technology designed for vehicles and residential spaces, offering an eco-friendly alternative to traditional air conditioning. The compact device weighs approximately 25 pounds and uses no refrigerants, instead being powered by renewable energy. It provides efficient heating and cooling capabilities with a patented design that enables heat recovery and cooling, making it suitable for various applications including cars, homes, and other vehicles. The product is currently in prototype stage, with pre-orders and updates available for interested customers.

Name: Maticebio
Description: Reactivating human regeneration

Name: Mesodyne
Description: Mesodyne is an advanced power generation technology company that develops compact, high-energy-density generators designed for autonomous systems and tactical applications. Their flagship product, LightCell, is a breakthrough power solution developed at MIT's Institute for Soldier Nanotechnologies that converts various liquid and gaseous fuels into electricity. The lightweight, silent, and maintenance-free generators offer up to 10x the energy endurance of traditional batteries, making them ideal for military, drone, and remote operational environments. Each unit is roughly the size of a water bottle, operates on multiple fuel types, and can be modularly configured to meet specific power requirements.

Name: Apis Cor
Description: Apis Cor is an American construction technology company specializing in 3D printing technologies for housing development. Based in Melbourne, Florida, the company develops advanced robotic construction methods that enable rapid house building within 2-3 months. They hold the Guinness World Record for the largest 3D-printed building and have participated in NASA's 3D Printed Habitat Challenge. Apis Cor aims to revolutionize construction by increasing productivity, reducing costs, and making affordable housing more accessible through innovative 3D printing technologies.

Name: Vulcan Elements
Description: Vulcan Elements is a critical materials manufacturer specializing in rare earth magnets for aerospace, defense, and automotive industries. The company focuses on securing supply chains, enhancing technological resilience, and promoting sustainability. They develop advanced magnetic technologies with a commitment to quality, reliability, and transparency in manufacturing processes, aiming to support national security and innovation through strategic partnerships and cutting-edge magnetic solutions.

Name: Fortius Metals
Description: Fortius Metals is an advanced manufacturing company specializing in next-generation metal alloys for large-format 3D printing and robotic welding. They develop custom, patented welding wires that enable stronger and lighter fabrication across industries like aerospace, defense, and automotive. The company provides innovative alloy solutions addressing metallurgical challenges such as hot tearing and cracking, with capabilities in aluminum and titanium. They offer process consulting, prototype fabrication, and specialized alloys designed to enhance performance for high-impact metal manufacturing applications.

Name: Model Medicines
Description: Model Medicines is an AI-driven drug discovery company founded in 2019 and based in La Jolla, CA, that leverages advanced data science and biology to accelerate pharmaceutical research. The company uses unbiased AI and historical drug development data to create Phase II/III ready drug candidates across multiple therapeutic areas including oncology, virology, gastric disorders, neurological disorders, and weight disorders. With 67 validated assets across 12 therapeutic targets, they collaborate with researchers to develop innovative, AI-powered drug candidates using technologies like GALILEOTM to enhance drug safety and efficiency.

Name: Reservoir Neuroscience
Description: Reservoir Neuro is a venture-backed biotechnology company specializing in developing novel therapeutic treatments for brain diseases. The company's research focuses on innovative approaches to healing the blood-brain barrier and creating targeted neurological treatments that address complex brain health challenges.

Name: Nium
Description: Nium is a nanotechnology company focused on decarbonizing the global ammonia supply chain through innovative clean ammonia production. Founded in Cambridge in 2022, the company develops nanocatalytic solutions that provide an alternative to the traditional, fossil fuel-dependent Haber-Bosch process. Their 'Clean Ammonia on Demand' system aims to reduce emissions in agriculture and maritime industries by synthesizing ammonia using renewable power and novel nanocatalysts. The company seeks to eliminate fertilizer and shipping emissions while providing a versatile pathway to green hydrogen energy.

Name: Polyose Bio
Description: Polyose Bio is a biotech startup focused on sustainable transformation of food waste using synthetic biology. Their innovative process pairs engineered microbial cell factories with insects to convert food waste into high-value specialty chemicals like sugar polymers. By addressing the global challenge of food waste—which contributes significantly to greenhouse gas emissions—Polyose Bio aims to reduce carbon footprint by up to 95% while creating economically viable alternatives to traditional chemical production methods.

Name: Thintronics®
Description: Thintronics is an electronics technology company specializing in advanced interconnect insulator technologies for high-performance computing and communication systems. The company develops innovative dielectric materials that enable wider bandwidths, increased power efficiency, and more integrated form factors for next-generation electronics. Their solutions support various applications including AI, IoT, and wireless technologies, with capabilities to support high-speed data connections up to 224 Gbps and 6G wireless systems. By optimizing interconnect insulation, Thintronics helps electronics manufacturers reduce channel loss and power consumption while improving design flexibility across computing, networking, and communication platforms.

Name: Catagen
Description: Catagen is a pioneering emissions testing and green technology company based in Belfast, specializing in advanced emissions testing solutions for automotive, marine, and cement industries. The company develops innovative technologies to optimize catalyst development, reduce tailpipe emissions, and support net zero targets through advanced testing services and green hydrogen technologies.

Name: NearStar Fusion
Description: NearStar Fusion is a clean energy technology company developing a modular Magnetized Target Impact Fusion (MTIF) approach using hypervelocity plasma railguns. The company aims to create scalable fusion energy solutions designed to integrate with existing power grid systems. Their innovative approach focuses on generating clean, limitless, and always-on energy, with potential applications in power generation, interplanetary travel, and advanced transportation technologies.

Name: CERT Systems
Description: CERT Systems is an innovative chemical technology company developing a proprietary electrochemical process to transform captured carbon dioxide into high-value chemicals like ethylene. Using only electricity and water, their sustainable solution operates at mild conditions to produce essential chemicals without fossil fuels. The company aims to revolutionize chemical production by providing an environmentally friendly alternative to traditional manufacturing methods, positioning themselves as a key player in the transition to a more sustainable industrial future.

Name: OncoPrecision
Description: OncoPrecision is a biotechnology company focused on cancer research and personalized medicine. The company develops technologies to replicate cancer patients' diseases ex-vivo, allowing rapid and accurate testing of multiple treatments simultaneously. Utilizing high-throughput biology and AI/ML, OncoPrecision creates patient-derived models to help oncologists identify the most suitable treatments and support pharmaceutical companies in developing transformational cancer therapies.

Name: Terra Bio
Description: Terra Bioindustries is a Canadian sustainable food technology company specializing in upcycling agrifood byproducts. Their innovative platform focuses on transforming brewers' spent grains into valuable ingredients for food, fermentation, and chemical industries. Key products include malt syrup, barley-derived protein concentrate (Protina), high-fiber flour, and fermentation feedstock. The company aims to create a circular economy by reducing food waste and providing sustainable, scalable solutions for converting agricultural byproducts into functional ingredients.

Name: Quantum Sky
Description: Quantum Sky is a biotechnology company that offers the SkyEngine platform, which integrates Generative AI and Quantum Mechanics to enhance biomachine development. Their innovative technology focuses on creating dynamic biomachine structures and accelerating technological advancements in areas like CRISPR-Cas therapies and RNA editing systems. The platform provides interactive models that address specific challenges in biotechnology, enabling more efficient development of advanced biological solutions.

Name: Bullseye
Description: Bullseye Biosciences is a therapeutics discovery company revolutionizing drug development through advanced robotics and directed evolution technology. The company focuses on creating life-saving medicines for patients with critical needs in cardiometabolic, inflammation, and oncology fields. By incorporating automation, Next Generation Sequencing, and artificial intelligence, Bullseye Biosciences develops novel therapeutics by targeting challenging drivers of human disease, with a commitment to transforming scientific research into innovative medical solutions.

Name: Aja Labs
Description: Aja Labs is a materials science firm specializing in innovative sustainable fiber technologies, with a primary focus on developing biopolymer hair extensions. The company creates non-toxic, ethical materials for the cosmetic and textile industries, pioneering environmentally conscious solutions in the hair extension market. Their flagship product, Nourie, represents a breakthrough in sustainable synthetic hair technology, utilizing plant-based biopolymers that offer both aesthetic and health-conscious benefits while minimizing environmental impact.

Name: Vincere Biosciences
Description: Vincere Biosciences is a biopharmaceutical company focused on developing innovative small molecule therapeutics for age-related diseases, with a primary emphasis on Parkinson's disease. Utilizing advanced AI and computational tools alongside traditional drug discovery methods, the company develops molecules that enhance mitochondrial quality control mechanisms. Supported by funding from organizations like the National Institutes of Health and the Michael J. Fox Foundation, Vincere aims to create groundbreaking treatments that could potentially slow or halt the progression of neurodegenerative conditions.

Name: Lemurian Labs
Description: Lemurian Labs is an AI technology company developing innovative hardware and software solutions for advanced computational efficiency. The company specializes in creating the Spatial Processing Unit (SPU), an AI accelerator designed to deliver unprecedented performance and energy efficiency for edge AI applications. Their platform aims to simplify AI development across various hardware options, targeting industries like autonomous vehicles, robotics, and advanced computing. The company focuses on developing scalable, high-performance computing solutions that address current limitations in AI hardware and software development.

Name: Hoofprintbiome
Description: Hoofprint Biome is a biotechnology company focused on developing innovative probiotics and natural enzymes for livestock production. Their primary goal is to improve cattle health and digestive efficiency while simultaneously addressing environmental concerns by reducing methane emissions. The company applies biotechnological solutions to enhance sustainable agricultural practices through advanced microbiome research and targeted microbial interventions.

Name: Hen Nozzles
Description: HEN Nozzles Inc is a California-based technology company specializing in innovative fire suppression technologies. The company develops advanced fire-fighting equipment, including the world's first adjustable smoothbore nozzle and high-efficiency shutoffs for wildland and structural firefighting. Their products are designed to enhance firefighter and civilian safety by enabling faster fire suppression with reduced water usage, leveraging scientific principles and modern technology to create more effective fire-fighting solutions.

Name: Tiny Health
Description: Tiny Health is a pioneering microbiome health platform that provides at-home gut and vaginal health tests for families, with a specific focus on mothers and babies. Utilizing advanced next-generation sequencing and AI technology, the company offers personalized insights into microbiome health during the critical first 1,000 days of life. Their tests help identify potential risk factors for chronic conditions like eczema, allergies, and digestive issues. Backed by top scientists from leading medical institutions, Tiny Health has supported over 55,000 families in understanding and optimizing their microbiome health through evidence-based recommendations.

Name: Aurigaspace
Description: Auriga Space is a space launch technology company developing advanced linear electromagnetic accelerators for commercial and defense customers. The company specializes in cost-effective, high-cadence on-demand space launches using electrical acceleration technology. Their innovative approach enables full system reusability and high-speed launch capabilities, with systems capable of accelerating vehicles to over six times the speed of sound. Auriga Space aims to provide sustainable and affordable transport to low Earth orbit through pioneering electromagnetic launch technologies.

Name: Mushroom Material
Description: With the global shift towards sustainability, there is a demand for eco friendly materials. We have developed a sustainable mushroom based material as an alternative to polystyrene styrofoam and cardboard packaging. - Customizable to any shape, size and surface finish - Stronger than concrete pound for pound - Better thermal insulator than fiberglass - Limitless sustainable supply - Fire resistant, water proof, 100% compostable, odorless, mold resistant, non-toxic In order to address global climate change, the European Union, 25 other countries and over 100 US cities will ban non recyclable packaging materials, including polystyrene Styrofoam by 2025. Our mission is to eliminate non recyclable plastics from the environment by developing mushroom based packaging material. For more information visit our website or send us a message.

Name: Ki Hydrogen
Description: Ki Hydrogen is a deep-tech startup pioneering sustainable green hydrogen production through biomass electrolysis. The company develops innovative technology that reduces energy consumption in hydrogen production by up to 75% using biomass waste. Their mission is to create cost-effective, sustainable energy solutions that support industrial decarbonization by producing green hydrogen, green methanol, green ammonia, and carbon storage solutions, leveraging biomass from agriculture, forestry, and industrial waste streams.

Name: NeuroX1 Inc.
Description: NeuroX1 is a biotechnology company developing a target identification and drug discovery platform that leverages proprietary generative AI algorithms to create next-generation therapeutics for neurological disorders. The company utilizes data science and machine learning to identify molecular drivers of neurodegenerative diseases and design tailored therapeutic molecules. NeuroX1 operates a cloud-based technology platform that enables efficient development and analysis, with an early-stage pipeline consisting of several pre-clinical assets developed in partnership with pharmaceutical companies and research institutions to enhance clinical trial success rates.

Name: Advanced Microbubbles
Description: Our platform solves anticancer drug delivery to tumors using ultrasound triggered microbubbles that are uniform in size

Name: EnhancedGEO
Description: EGXFuels is a green energy technology company specializing in advanced renewable fuel production with a focus on zero-carbon emissions. The company develops innovative geothermal energy extraction technologies to produce hydrogen and green fuels at competitive prices. Their goal is to decarbonize industries globally by creating transportable green fuels that can replace fossil fuels, with a commitment to achieving net-zero transition goals by 2040. The company aims to develop energy production solutions with a modest plant footprint that are more equitable to local communities.

Name: EarthEn
Description: EarthEn Inc. is an innovative energy storage technology company developing novel CO2-based, flexible thermo-mechanical energy storage solutions. Their technology provides long-duration energy storage capabilities, capable of storing 4-100+ hours of renewable energy in a closed-loop system. As part of the CleanTech Open accelerator, the company aims to create scalable, low-cost, and safe energy storage solutions that support the transition to renewable energy infrastructure.

Name: SirenOpt
Description: SirenOpt is a manufacturing intelligence platform that provides non-destructive, real-time materials characterization and classification solutions. Founded in 2022 as a UC Berkeley spin-out, the company leverages cold atmospheric plasma, machine learning, and predictive analytics to create detailed material insights. Their technology enables manufacturers in industries like battery, aerospace, semiconductor, and electronics to optimize R&D, enhance product performance, and improve production quality through intelligent, real-time measurement of material properties across various manufacturing processes.

Name: Thylacine Bio
Description: Thylacine Bio is a biotechnology company developing an innovative peptide platform focused on combating respiratory viruses. Their approach targets conserved virus regions to create therapeutics that prevent infection and transmission. The company's pipeline includes commercial and biothreat treatments designed to be easily self-administered and rapidly adaptable to both existing and emerging pathogens, with a scalable approach to protecting against multiple viruses within a single family.

Name: Dioxycle
Description: Dioxycle is a climate tech company developing innovative carbon utilization technologies that convert industrial carbon emissions into sustainable chemicals. Their electrolyzer technology transforms CO2 into ethylene, which can be used in manufacturing processes for fabrics, plastics, pharmaceuticals, and packaging. Powered by renewable energy, the company aims to reduce global CO2 emissions by providing an economically viable alternative to fossil fuel-based chemical production, with potential to mitigate over 800 million tons of CO2 annually.

Name: Mach Industries
Description: Mac Industries appears to be a defense technology company focused on developing next-generation defense systems. The company is involved in creating advanced technologies for aerospace and defense sectors, with a particular emphasis on innovative defense solutions. They are exploring cutting-edge approaches such as hydrogen-powered systems and developing high-tech devices including drones, computers, and embedded systems. Their work aims to enhance operational capabilities for the US and its allies through advanced technological innovations in the defense and technology domains.

Name: Good Chemistry
Description: Good Chemistry is a computational chemistry technology company headquartered in Vancouver, Canada. Their core product is QEMIST Cloud, a cloud-based platform that enables high-throughput, high-accuracy computational chemistry calculations. The platform provides developers with tools for building chemical simulation applications and workflows, leveraging emerging technologies in quantum chemistry, machine learning, and quantum computing. The company's interdisciplinary team includes computational chemists, software developers, machine learning engineers, and quantum computing scientists, with a mission to accelerate new material designs and contribute to making the world cleaner, healthier, and more sustainable.

Name: UNEARTHLY MATERIALS
Description: Unearthly Materials is an innovative technology company specializing in superconductor development with applications across multiple industries. Their core research focuses on creating superconducting materials that can operate near ambient temperatures, with potential breakthrough applications in energy, medical imaging, transportation, and renewable energy technologies. The company aims to develop materials that can conduct electric current with zero resistance, potentially revolutionizing energy efficiency and advanced technological systems.

Name: Orbillion Bio
Description: Orbillion is a pioneering B2B cultivated meat technology company focused on producing sustainable, premium cell-cultured beef. Leveraging advanced high-density cell culture techniques, the company aims to revolutionize meat production by reducing capital expenses and achieving competitive pricing with conventional beef. With founders bringing 35 years of combined biopharma bioprocessing experience, Orbillion plans to scale production to over 4 million pounds of meat annually using renewable energy. The company targets global markets in the US, Asia, and Europe, offering an ethical and environmentally conscious alternative to traditional meat production.

Name: Olokun Minerals
Description: Olokun Minerals is an innovative environmental technology company focused on sustainable mineral extraction from desalination brine. The company addresses global water security challenges by harvesting valuable minerals from wastewater streams that would otherwise harm marine ecosystems. Their process creates products for multiple industries, including infrastructure materials for concrete, agricultural fertilizers, and battery components for electronics and vehicles. By capturing and processing brine waste before it is discharged into oceans, Olokun Minerals provides a renewable source of critical minerals while simultaneously mitigating environmental risks associated with desalination processes.

Name: Phoenixtailings
Description: Phoenix Tailings is a sustainable metals production company that specializes in extracting valuable metals and rare earth elements from mining waste. Their innovative approach creates zero carbon emission metals, including rare earth metals, iron, and pigments, by harvesting value from mining byproducts like Bauxite Residue. Using a modular system compatible with various ore types, the company aims to reduce environmental impact in traditional metal production while enabling a cleaner, more efficient supply chain for advanced technologies.

Name: Eonix
Description: Eonix is an innovative clean energy company based in Knoxville, TN, specializing in advanced battery technology development. The company has created a unique platform that uses deep learning and quantum mechanics calculations to rapidly design custom lithium-ion battery chemistries. Their key innovation includes developing non-flammable battery solutions for diverse industries such as consumer electronics, grid storage, and electric vehicles, with a focus on accelerating battery research through an automated material discovery process that is significantly faster and more cost-effective than conventional methods.

Name: Terragia
Description: Terragia is a biotechnology company developing advanced biological conversion systems for next-generation biofuels. The company specializes in using engineered thermophilic bacteria to convert non-food cellulosic biomass into fuels and chemicals with minimal pretreatment. Leveraging genetic engineering and innovative processing strategies, Terragia aims to dramatically reduce the cost of lignocellulose conversion by utilizing bacteria with superior capabilities to process biomass without added enzymes, positioning themselves at the forefront of sustainable and economically feasible biofuel production.

Name: Ultrasonic Technology Solutions
Description: Ultrasonic Technology Solutions (UTS) is developing advanced ultrasonic drying technologies for industrial and commercial applications. Their patented technology, licensed from Oak Ridge National Lab, offers dryers that are 5 times more efficient and 2 times faster than conventional heat-based methods. The company focuses on innovative drying solutions for various sectors including paper and pulp, chemical powder, and fabric industries, with key benefits of improved energy efficiency, reduced operational costs, enhanced sustainability, and improved worker safety.

Name: Avail Bio
Description: Avail Bio is a venture-backed genomic biotechnology company based in San Francisco, supported by Illumina Inc. and academic disease experts. The company specializes in immune therapeutic discovery, using proprietary genomic platform technologies to unlock new therapeutic targets. Their innovative approach focuses on translating novel immune targets into de-risked therapeutic assets with unprecedented scalability, leveraging advanced data science and genomic technologies to drive breakthrough research in medical treatments.

Name: Stratio, Inc.
Description: Stratio is a deep-tech startup specializing in shortwave infrared (SWIR) sensor technology, pioneering affordable and versatile infrared device creation. The company developed the world's first germanium-based SWIR sensor, enabling compact and energy-efficient imaging solutions. Their product line includes portable spectrometers (LinkSquare) and infrared cameras (BeyonSense) used in applications such as process efficiency, counterfeiting detection, food safety, and precision agriculture. Headquartered in San Jose, CA, with an office in Seoul, Stratio continues to innovate in hyper-spectral imaging technologies.

Name: florrent
Description: Florrent is a minority-owned DeepTech company developing next-generation high-energy density ultracapacitors for sustainable energy solutions. Based in Massachusetts, the company manufactures supercapacitors using domestically grown hemp biomass from Black and Indigenous farmers. Their technology aims to stabilize electrical grids, support renewable energy adoption, and address critical infrastructure challenges in electric vehicles and net-zero buildings. Florrent's innovative approach provides power quality and reliability at a lower cost compared to traditional battery technologies while supporting economic opportunities in underrepresented communities.

Name: Realtafusion
Description: Realta Fusion is an early-stage spin-out from the University of Wisconsin-Madison developing an innovative approach to fusion energy. The company is focused on creating a low-capital, simple linear fusion reactor configuration that leverages advances in superconducting materials, plasma physics, and computing power. Their goal is to develop a zero-carbon source of industrial heat and power using abundant fuel sources, with a modular design that enables flexible implementation for various industrial energy needs.

Name: Fluent Metal
Description: Fluent Metal is a technology company specializing in advanced metal additive manufacturing (AM) solutions. They have developed a unique wire-based metal printing technology that enables production-grade liquid metal printing with high scalability and process tunability. Their innovative approach allows for creating functional and sustainable metal parts without traditional laser printing technologies. The company aims to revolutionize metal 3D printing by offering a direct-wire to drop-on-demand method that reduces overhead costs and enables more economical and accessible metal manufacturing across various industries.

Name: Harbinger
Description: Harbinger Motors is a commercial electric vehicle (EV) manufacturer specializing in medium-duty trucks. The company develops a flexible chassis platform designed for commercial vehicles, offering electric trucks with up to 500 miles of range and a service life exceeding 450,000 miles. Their innovative approach focuses on sustainability, driver experience, and tailored battery solutions with modular 35kWh increments. Leveraging proprietary in-house vehicle technologies, Harbinger aims to transform the commercial EV market by providing cost-effective, zero-emissions trucks with advanced charging solutions for both en-route and home charging.

Name: Glimpse Engineering
Description: Glimpse is a technology platform specializing in battery quality control through advanced X-ray computed tomography (CT) scanning services. The platform enables manufacturers to monitor battery cell production, identify and fix defects efficiently, and provide real-time insights into cell quality and degradation mechanisms across high-volume manufacturing processes.

Name: Esper Bionics
Description: Esper Bionics is a New York-based human augmentation startup specializing in advanced robotic prosthetics and wearable technologies. The company develops innovative devices like the Esper Hand, an AI-driven prosthetic that uses EMG technology to provide precise, customizable movement for individuals with limb differences. Their product line includes the Esper Hand prosthesis, Esper Control brain-computer interface, and Esper Platform, a cloud-based software solution for personalizing wearable device control. FDA and PDAC approved, their devices are designed to enhance mobility, integration, and overall quality of life for users through cutting-edge engineering and self-learning technologies.

Name: REVOLUTION Turbine Technologies
Description: Revolution Turbine Technologies (RTT) develops innovative zero-emission power generation solutions for remote oil and gas operations. The company's micro-expansion turbine system converts excess gas pressure into clean electricity, eliminating CO2-emitting combustion generators and methane-emitting valves. RTT provides scalable, modular power solutions with advanced connectivity for applications like SCADA, process control, and remote telemetry. By increasing customer reliability, efficiency, and resilience while lowering carbon footprints, RTT is transforming power generation in remote industrial environments.

Name: A&I Power Group
Description: A&I Power Group is an R&D company focused on innovative energy technologies, specializing in electromagnetic energy solutions. The company develops patented technologies aimed at improving energy conservation and reducing CO2 emissions. Their primary goal is to promote energy independence through advanced power generation techniques, offering technology solutions and consulting services that help clients optimize electricity use and reduce reliance on fossil fuels through decentralized energy management approaches.

Name: PDA Ecolab - Natural Fiber Composite Reinforcements for Sporting Goods
Description: PDA Ecolab is a sustainable materials technology company focused on developing bio-based reinforcement materials that reduce greenhouse emissions in composite manufacturing. Founded in 2020 and backed by Alchemist Accelerator and Bpifrance, the company creates innovative natural-fiber composites that can enhance or replace traditional carbon fiber materials. Their solutions target industries including sporting goods, automotive, mobility, and wind power, offering manufacturers a way to improve product performance while significantly reducing environmental impact through sustainable material technologies.

Name: Metal Oxide Technologies
Description: MetOx International is a technology manufacturer specializing in High Temperature Superconducting (HTS) wire production, based in Houston, Texas. The company develops Xeus™ wire, an advanced conductor with exceptionally high current carrying capacity and near-zero electrical resistance. Their proprietary manufacturing technology enables production of cost-effective superconducting wire for applications across energy generation, grid expansion, fusion energy, medical devices, and clean technology sectors. MetOx aims to provide innovative wire solutions that dramatically improve electricity transmission efficiency and support the global transition to clean energy infrastructure.

Name: RockFix
Description: RockFix is an innovative mining technology company focused on sustainable waste management and decarbonization. The company develops advanced methods to transform rock waste in the mining industry by storing carbon dioxide permanently in mine waste minerals through a novel mineralization process. Their technology aims to reduce waste, improve metal and mineral quality, and support the energy transition by recovering critical metals while creating more environmentally sustainable mining practices.

Name: Vader Nanotech.
Description: Vader Environmental Nanotech is an innovative biotechnology startup focused on addressing environmental contamination, particularly PFAS (per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances) in water systems. The company develops advanced microbiological solutions for bioremediation, utilizing high-throughput screening and automation technologies to identify and cultivate bacterial strains capable of breaking down environmental contaminants. Their approach involves image processing, analytical chemistry, and advanced screening techniques to develop protocols for monitoring chemical degradation, with the ultimate goal of licensing their technology to chemical recycling and environmental remediation companies.

Name: RenuviEnergy
Description: Renuvi Energy is a renewable energy technology company specializing in long-duration energy storage solutions. The company develops a proprietary Salt-Matrix™ sodium-based battery system designed to be more efficient and sustainable than traditional lithium-ion batteries. Their technology aims to reduce energy consumption, lower CO2 emissions, and create more reliable distributed energy networks with improved safety features. Renuvi focuses on developing cheaper, cleaner energy storage solutions that enable continuous power supply and reduce inefficiencies in energy infrastructure.

Name: Dirac
Description: Dirac is a technology company that develops BuildOS, an innovative software platform for manufacturing. Their solution automatically generates high-quality work instructions for mechanical assemblies, dramatically reducing the time needed to create documentation from weeks to minutes. BuildOS uses advanced technology to automate instruction creation, preserve tribal knowledge, and streamline production workflows by generating interactive 3D renderings, animations, and detailed text descriptions for complex mechanical assembly processes.

Name: Cascade Biocatalysts
Description: Cascade Biocatalysts is a biotechnology company specializing in enzyme engineering and biomanufacturing solutions. The company develops innovative cell-free biocatalysts using a patent-pending enzyme immobilization platform, designed to enhance manufacturing process efficiency. Their core technology involves stabilizing enzymes on silica beads, which improves performance, sustainability, and reduces manufacturing costs. By combining advanced materials with enzymatic catalysts, the company aims to drive innovation in the bioeconomy, creating more productive and stable biocatalysts for sustainable chemical production.

Name: ScalVy
Description: Scalvy is an electric vehicle technology company developing innovative modular powertrains designed to simplify and optimize electric mobility solutions. Their technology features an advanced battery management system that enables local cell management, improved energy efficiency, and reduced complexity in electric vehicle power systems. Scalvy's products are characterized by low-cost design, high scalability, and minimal maintenance requirements, making them suitable for applications in electric mobility, energy storage, and data center infrastructure.

Name: Frontier Bio
Description: Frontier Bio is an advanced biomedical technology company specializing in 3D bioprinting and engineered human tissue development. The company creates lab-grown human tissues as an alternative to animal testing, developing innovative products including lung, neural, and blood vessel tissues. Their proprietary 3D bioprinting technology enables the creation of versatile human tissue models for medical research, working with leading institutions like Mayo Clinic. By providing advanced 3D bioprinting solutions, Frontier Bio aims to revolutionize healthcare research, accelerate drug development, and promote more ethical, accurate testing methodologies.

Name: Echogen Power Systems
Description: Echogen is a leading producer of large-scale heat-to-power systems specializing in waste heat recovery technology. The company develops innovative supercritical CO2 (sCO2) pumped thermal energy storage (PTES) systems that capture and convert otherwise wasted heat into usable power. Their solutions are designed for industrial companies seeking to improve energy efficiency, reduce costs, and meet environmental standards. Echogen's technology enables organizations to monetize waste heat through scalable, sustainable energy conversion systems that deliver significant performance improvements in energy efficiency and cost savings across various sectors including industrial, oil and gas, solar, and marine applications.

Name: Dimien
Description: Dimien is an advanced materials technology company focused on innovative battery and energy storage solutions. Specializing in chemical manufacturing, the company develops vanadium-based cathode materials (ZVO) that offer exceptional energy efficiency and safety. Committed to responsible sourcing and American manufacturing, Dimien creates advanced materials for various markets including batteries, optical LED devices, automotive adhesives, and plastic composites, with a core expertise in hydrothermal production and chemical product development.

Name: VALIS
Description: VALIS Insights is a technology company specializing in AI-powered software solutions for the metal recycling industry. Their platform helps recycling plants optimize operations through advanced data analysis and automation. Key products include VALI-Sort for procurement and production data collection, and VALI-Sample for quality analysis. The software integrates with existing systems to generate accurate statistics, improve operational efficiency, and support sustainability in metal fabrication by making recycling processes more profitable and data-driven.

Name: Waveguide
Description: Waveguide is a technology consulting firm specializing in audiovisual (AV) and communication technology solutions. Founded in 1996, the company provides comprehensive services including IT consulting, acoustics solutions, AV managed services, and data analytics. They serve diverse markets such as higher education, worship, government, legal, and corporate sectors. Waveguide focuses on enhancing communication experiences by designing technology environments that integrate people, processes, and technology, with a particular emphasis on creating seamless communication solutions across various settings.

Name: LintrinsIC Semiconductors Inc.
Description: LintrinsIC Semiconductors Inc. specializes in high linearity RF and millimeter-wave integrated circuits using SOI CMOS technology. The company develops advanced semiconductor components for critical applications including 5G networks, commercial and defense radar systems, and emerging technologies like quantum computing. Their primary focus is on creating high-performance RF switches and transceivers with low latency and enhanced signal quality.

Name: Raga
Description: RagaAI is a San Francisco-based AI startup that provides a comprehensive testing platform for enterprises to mitigate AI risks and improve model reliability. The platform offers end-to-end AI testing solutions that address current ad-hoc testing limitations, helping businesses prevent inefficiencies and risks in AI development. Key features include automated trace logging, real-time monitoring of AI agent interactions, customizable analytics, and enterprise-grade experiment management. RagaAI Catalyst enables organizations to enhance transparency and efficiency in AI workflow development by providing tools for visualizing trace data, evaluating AI performance, and ensuring secure and dependable AI applications.

Name: Caravel
Description: Caravel Bio is a biotechnology company focused on developing innovative protein engineering solutions. The company has created a groundbreaking protein evolution platform that enables high-throughput, cell-free protein development using advanced microfluidics and bacterial spore-display techniques. Their technology aims to create powerful catalysts and therapeutics, with specific applications in sustainable chemical production, carbon capture, and precision manufacturing of proteins with novel genetic capabilities.

Name: EDAC Labs
Description: EDAC Labs is a technology spin-out from Johns Hopkins University Engineering that specializes in negative-emission and decarbonization technologies. The company develops innovative solutions including a Carbon-Neutral Silicate Rock Refinery that produces pure silica and magnesium products. Their core technology, an electrosynthesizer, enables energy-efficient conversion processes with applications in carbon-negative mining, ocean alkalinity enhancement, and industrial decarbonization, focusing on scalable direct air capture of carbon dioxide.

Name: Carmine Therapeutics
Description: Carmine Therapeutics is a biotechnology company pioneering non-viral gene therapies using red blood cell extracellular vesicles. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Cambridge, MA, the company develops innovative genetic medicine approaches with a focus on creating disease-modifying therapies. In 2020, they established a significant research alliance with Takeda Pharmaceuticals worth up to $900 million and were recognized as one of FierceBiotech's Fierce 15 Biotech companies, highlighting their potential in developing advanced gene therapy solutions.

Name: Carbon Mobile
Description: Carbon Mobile is an innovative electronics manufacturer specializing in sustainable, lightweight materials for connected devices. Using their patented HyRECM technology, the company develops carbon fiber-based electronics that are exceptionally light and strong, with a focus on reducing e-waste and improving device design. Their breakthrough approach enables the creation of ultra-thin smartphones and other electronic products that are both environmentally friendly and technologically advanced, partnering with major technology providers to revolutionize hardware manufacturing with sustainable composite materials.

Name: Zymtronix
Description: Zymtronix is an industrial biotechnology company that revolutionizes biomanufacturing through advanced enzyme immobilization and biocatalysis technologies. Founded in 2013 as a Cornell University spin-off, the company develops innovative cell-free biocatalysis solutions that enable more sustainable and cost-effective production of molecules across multiple industries. Their platform allows multiple enzymes to work together to produce unique molecules for agriculture, nutrition, pharmaceuticals, and fine chemicals, significantly reducing production costs, time, and environmental impact through green chemistry approaches.

Name: Airhive
Description: Airhive is a direct air capture (DAC) technology company based in London, UK, developing innovative carbon removal solutions. Their modular DAC technology leverages a hybrid geochemical approach with fluidisation to capture carbon dioxide quickly and efficiently. The company aims to deploy systems capable of processing 1000 tonnes of CO2 per year, with a focus on low-cost carbon removal, producing carbon credits, and supporting sustainable fuel production through advanced carbon capture technologies.

Name: Enbiorganic Technologies
Description: EnBiorganic Technologies provides advanced bioaugmentation solutions for wastewater treatment across multiple sectors including municipal systems, lake restoration, animal agriculture, and industrial applications. Their proprietary technology uses custom-grown live bacteria tailored to specific environmental conditions, offering a compact and environmentally beneficial treatment system. The EBS-Di system enables significant improvements in water quality, reduces contamination, and addresses challenges like sludge buildup, odors, and infrastructure inefficiencies with a precision biological treatment approach.

Name: Heartland Industries
Description: Heartland is a material science and sustainability technology company that develops carbon-negative materials using natural fibers, primarily industrial hemp. Their innovative approach involves creating fiber additives that enhance the performance of plastics, rubber, and other materials while reducing carbon footprint. By partnering with manufacturers, Heartland provides solutions that improve product strength, reduce costs, and support sustainability goals through advanced material engineering and carbon reduction technologies.

Name: Makesunsets
Description: Make Sunsets is a climate technology startup that deploys biodegradable, reflective clouds in the stratosphere to combat global warming. The company uses high-altitude balloon launches to create reflective clouds above 12.4 miles from Earth's surface, aiming to cool the planet and provide an innovative approach to addressing climate change. Backed by prominent venture capital firms including Boost VC, Pioneer Fund, and Draper Associates, the startup seeks to offer a potential solution for reducing global temperatures and supporting the transition away from fossil fuels.

Name: DBOS
Description: DBOS is a serverless platform for building highly reliable cloud applications, founded by leading computer scientists including Postgres creator Mike Stonebraker and Databricks co-founder Matei Zaharia. The platform dramatically simplifies cloud backend development using TypeScript and PostgreSQL, enabling developers to create resilient applications with features like automatic retries, efficient event processing, Cron job hosting, and webhook management. DBOS allows developers to build scalable applications in minutes that would traditionally take days to develop on other cloud platforms like AWS.

Name: Spout
Description: Spout (fka Microlyze) is a biotech company created to provide consumers and utilities actionable data about one of the worlds most vital natural resources, water. Spout will empower water utilities to better provide the public with pure, safe and potable water. The key to better water lies in the understanding of what's coming out of each and every tap. Spout empowers utilities to make improvements to infrastructure, neighborhood by neighborhood by providing a cost effective, simple, hassle-free way to collect and harness the crucial information streaming from taps by collecting it, analyzing it and reporting back right from the source, in an instant. Spout is the first on-demand, from the source testing device that provides real results in real-time about the water consumed in-home. No more complicated test kits or mail-in samples. Spout easily attaches to a smart phone, analyzes tap water and identifies contaminants of concern within minutes. With the data that spout collects...... - CONSUMERS DISCOVER WHAT THEY'RE DRINKING - COMMUNITIES UNCOVER POTENTIAL THREATS - UTILITIES ACT BEFORE AN INCIDENT BECOMES AN OUTBREAK!

Name: Xibus
Description: Xibus Systems is a venture-backed startup specializing in food and beverage safety through advanced microbiological testing solutions. An MIT spin-out located in the Boston metropolitan area, the company develops innovative pathogen detection technology integrating proprietary biomolecules, fluorescent nano-beads, custom bacterial growth media, and AI analytical software. Their core technology enables high-throughput, low-cost quantitative testing with potential for small footprint and handheld hardware designs to rapidly detect pathogens, allergens, and spoilage organisms in food products.

Name: Bifidice
Description: Bifidice™ es un helado artesanal que refuerza el sistema inmunológico añadiendo bifidum bacteria a la dieta. Un congelado lácteo para niños de alta eficacia probiótica científicamente probada. Un producto único en su especie que combina un sabroso sabor y un medicamento, al mismo tiempo que previene la disbacteriosis tanto en niños como en adultos.

Name: ADAR Technologies
Description: ADAR Technologies is a sustainable waste management company that offers innovative environmental remediation solutions. Specializing in advanced waste processing technologies, the company provides niche drying, pulverizing, and sanitizing services that transform waste materials without using fossil fuels or harmful chemicals. Their core mission is to reduce carbon footprints and promote resource recovery by converting waste into valuable products such as livestock feed, seafood waste processing, and Zeolite powder.
