ADAR aims to revolutionize material processing for agricultural and commercial sectors by implementing cutting-edge technologies that support circular economy principles and environmental sustainability.

Name: Edge Foods Co.
Description: Edge Foods specializes in packaging and tailoring secretomes as conditioned media to support cell growth in human and cell culture applications. The company provides specialized biological media solutions designed to optimize cellular research and development processes.

Name: Sonorousnv
Description: Sonorous Neurovascular is a medical device company focused on innovative treatments for cerebral venous diseases. With a leadership team possessing over 50 years of combined expertise in the medical device industry, the company develops cutting-edge neurovascular devices. Their approach integrates advanced engineering, clinical research, and regulatory affairs to create pioneering medical solutions that address complex neurological challenges.

Name: Moxy OID Technology Management
Description: Moxy is an innovative materials technology company that develops CERLOS, a sustainable building material made from 70% forestry and agricultural waste. Using a proprietary mineralization process, they create fire-resistant, water-stable, and termite-resistant building products like home siding. The company's eco-friendly manufacturing approach sequesters carbon, offers materials at a 20-40% discount to fiber cement, and provides a non-toxic alternative with potential for recycling and reuse in construction.

Name: Optivolt Labs
Engine Team: Lakshana Huddar <lakshana.huddar@gmail.com>; Michael Kearney <michael@engineventures.com>; Rachel Field <rachel@engineventures.com>
Description: Optivolt Labs is a solar energy technology company developing an optimized and scalable platform for solar integration. The company focuses on creating self-charging machines through autonomous charging solutions, providing a comprehensive technology stack that enables efficient solar energy integration across various applications. Their platform aims to advance the future of solar energy by making autonomous solar charging more accessible and effective.

Name: Magsorbeo
Description: Magsorbeo Biomedical is a medical technology company specializing in high-performance absorbable metal implants. Using proprietary Curasorb alloy technology, the company develops innovative surgical solutions that are designed to safely dissolve after healing. Their implants are engineered to minimize long-term complications, reduce follow-up surgery risks, and restore natural physiology. Through partnerships with companies like Terves Inc., they are developing next-generation bioabsorbable metal technologies for medical applications.

Name: IC Innovations
Description: Chaski.fit is a health and sports technology company that develops advanced respiratory monitoring wearables for athletes. Their flagship product, CHASKi, is a portable device that democratizes respiratory performance testing by providing real-time insights into breathing conditions, including VO2max measurements. The wearable system enables athletes of all levels to access sophisticated aerobic assessment previously limited to elite sports professionals, allowing users to analyze breathing response, track physiological adaptations, and optimize training plans with individualized performance insights.

Name: Thermal Battery Corporation
Description: Fourth Power is an energy storage technology company developing innovative thermal battery solutions for renewable energy grid integration. Their modular battery technology offers low-cost, long-duration energy storage that can convert intermittent wind and solar production into on-demand power. The company's solution can provide 5 to 10 hours of storage, with potential scalability up to 100 hours, making renewable energy more reliable and cost-competitive with fossil fuel alternatives.

Name: Cell BioEngines
Description: Cell BioEngines is a clinical-stage biotech company developing innovative allogeneic stem cell therapies for human disease treatment. The company utilizes a proprietary platform technology that transforms universal donor blood stem cells from umbilical cords into high-quality, clinical-grade cell therapies. Their approach focuses on creating 'off-the-shelf' cell products that can potentially treat conditions like leukemia, with current research including Phase 1 trials for hematological neoplasms and pre-clinical development of a novel cell-based cancer vaccine. The company employs advanced technologies like epigenetic reprogramming and AI to enhance cell therapy accessibility and efficacy.

Name: KRONOS FUSION ENERGY
Description: Kronos Fusion Energy is an innovative energy technology company based in Los Angeles, California, focused on developing advanced aneutronic fusion energy solutions. The company aims to revolutionize the global energy landscape by commercializing modular fusion technologies that provide sustainable, clean, and reliable sources of industrial heat and electricity. Using digital twin technology and a comprehensive supply chain, Kronos develops fusion energy generators designed to deliver limitless power while minimizing environmental impact and addressing global energy needs.

Name: nectar
Description: Nectar specializes in mobile, battery-powered EV charging solutions designed to optimize fleet electrification. Their innovative chargers address the electrical capacity constraints faced by EV fleet operators, enabling them to potentially double or triple their fleet size without requiring extensive grid upgrades. The company provides both hardware and software solutions to support the expansion of electric vehicle fleets.

Name: Helical Fusion
Description: Helical Fusion is a Japanese nuclear fusion startup founded in 2021 as a spin-off from the National Institute for Fusion Science. The company aims to develop the world's first commercially viable helical fusion reactor, leveraging over 25 years of plasma research. Their innovative approach focuses on creating a sustainable and stable energy source using advanced technologies like high-temperature superconducting magnets, specialized heating systems, and novel fuel injection methods. Currently engaged in 14 collaborative research projects, Helical Fusion seeks to enable long-term human-earth coexistence through breakthrough fusion energy technologies.

Name: unspun
Engine Team: Lakshana Huddar <lakshana.huddar@gmail.com>; Fran Barros <fran@engineventures.com>; Milo Werner <milo@engineventures.com>
Description: Unspun is a California-based robotic manufacturing startup revolutionizing apparel production through innovative 3D weaving technology. The company aims to reduce global carbon emissions by creating zero-waste production processes for clothing. Using advanced body scanning technology, Unspun enables custom-fit jeans tailored to individual body measurements. Their FitOS software suite allows for precise, on-demand clothing production, reducing waste and improving fit. The company focuses on transforming yarn into clothes quickly, offering a sustainable and personalized approach to fashion manufacturing.

Name: Numina
Description: Numina is a data platform that provides real-time urban mobility insights using computer vision technology. The company specializes in measuring street-level activity, tracking how people and objects move through public spaces, and generating actionable data for urban planners, municipal departments, and mobility companies. Deployed in over 25 cities across three continents, Numina's standalone sensing platform collects multimodal data without surveillance, offering intelligence about traffic volume, safety, and urban efficiency. The company supports urban development by providing data that helps design more walkable, bikeable, and responsive cities.

Name: RUSHNU
Description: Rushnu is a cleantech company pioneering decarbonization solutions for heavy industries through its innovative CarbonCatalyze™ technology. The company develops modular carbon capture systems that convert CO2 emissions into high-demand industrial chemicals, creating a carbon-negative process. Backed by NSF and USDA, their solution targets biogas producers, wastewater treatment sites, and other industrial sectors, offering a financially viable approach to reducing carbon footprints while generating valuable chemical products.

Name: EvolOH
Description: EVOLOH Inc. is a clean technology company founded in 2020, revolutionizing water electrolyzer manufacturing for low-cost hydrogen production. The company develops Nautilus stacks, which use advanced liquid alkaline technology to enable large-scale, efficient clean hydrogen production. EVOLOH focuses on creating electrolyzers for green hydrogen fuels and sustainable feedstocks, serving industries such as steel, fertilizer, and mining. Supported by notable investors including Breakthrough Energy, NextEra Energy, and 3M, the company aims to make hydrogen production possible at gigawatt scale worldwide.

Name: SynTensor
Description: Syntensor is a biotechnology company that develops an advanced computational platform for modeling human physiology at the cellular level. The company's core technology creates a comprehensive mechanistic model that simulates metabolic interactions across all tissue types simultaneously. Its platform generates causal hypotheses for drug efficacy and systemic toxicity, enabling researchers to predict potential outcomes of pharmaceutical compounds by analyzing complex interactions between small molecules and cell lines with high precision.

Name: EnergyEne
Description: EnergyEne, Inc. is an industrial materials company focusing on the development, improvement, and commercialization of sustainable rubber and biomaterials from Guayule Natural Rubber emulation for use in first medical devices, second consumer products, and third in industrial sectors. EnergyEne will continue to participate in the basic research to improve the yield from the plants and the process. Rubber is essential to nearly all manufacturing and product sectors, ranking fourth overall for industrial natural resources, with global demand at over $100 billion divided approximately 58% / 42% between synthetic and natural rubber (Indian Rubber Board; Indian Rubber Statistics, Ministry of Commerce and Industry). Synthetic rubber does not have the strength, flexibility, or performance characteristics of natural rubber. The International Rubber Study Group (IRSG) is predicting a shortfall of 1.5 to 3 million metric tons by 2020, which would create significant disruptions and economic losses in the U.S. Additional barriers to increasing worldwide production is that new plantings of Hevea require significant lead time (5+ years) before the plants mature enough to tap. Clearly, more sustainable, domestically available, and rapidly scalable alternative sources and approaches are needed to fill the predicted shortfalls. Hevea rubber is handled and marked-up many times (as many as 29) before an end-product is produced. EnergyEne expects to limit the product handling (from farm to end product) to less than five intermediaries.

Name: Aptah Brazil
Description: Aptah Bio is a biotechnology company developing innovative RNA rejuvenation technology targeting age-related diseases such as Alzheimer's and cancer. The company utilizes a unique computational modeling approach to accelerate drug discovery, focusing on genome-wide transcription modulation. Their proprietary technology aims to restore RNA integrity and address unmet medical needs by developing therapeutic solutions that can correct multiple mRNAs and toxic proteins. Aptah operates as a virtual laboratory, using advanced in silico methods to reduce drug development time, costs, and risks while working with global scientists and laboratories.

Name: Clean Core Thorium Energy
Description: Clean Core Thorium Energy is an innovative nuclear technology company developing advanced nuclear fuel solutions. Their primary product, ANEEL fuel, uses a proprietary combination of thorium and enriched uranium to make existing nuclear reactors more efficient, safer, and environmentally friendly. The company aims to address climate and human development challenges by creating nuclear fuel that reduces operational costs and minimizes waste, ultimately transforming traditional nuclear power generation through cutting-edge technological innovations.

Name: HEROBOTICS
Description: Herobotics is a talent assessment service used by innovative HR teams to evaluate job candidates objectively. The platform helps companies discover and identify the most suitable talents for specific job positions through an efficient and unbiased screening process, leveraging technology to match candidate capabilities with organizational needs.

Name: High Throughput Multispectral Property Scan In Butterflies
Entanglement Technologies
Description: Entanglement Technologies develops advanced chemical sensing technology that brings precise, real-time chemical analysis from laboratory environments into field applications. Their innovative sensors provide high-quality data with improved mobility, sensitivity, and throughput compared to traditional analytical techniques. The company offers specialized monitoring technologies like AROMA analyzers for environmental monitoring, which can detect toxic chemicals in air and water, supporting applications in industrial compliance, air quality assessment, and comprehensive environmental monitoring.

Name: Rise Technology
Description: Rise Technology is an innovative medical technology company developing advanced wound healing solutions using electrical stimulation. Their core product is a Closed-Loop Electrostimulation Technology, a specialized bandage developed by researchers that utilizes the body's electrical energy to enhance wound healing and improve vascular health during surgical procedures. Supported by the National Science Foundation's National Innovation Corps program, the company is working to bring its platform technology for cosmetic and therapeutic electrostimulation to market.

Name: Synvect
Description: Synvect is a San Diego-based biotechnology startup focused on innovative mosquito control using CRISPR gene technology. The company develops safe, scalable solutions to eliminate disease-transmitting mosquitoes by creating non-biting male mosquitoes through genetic interventions. Their eco-friendly approach provides a cost-effective alternative to chemical pesticides, targeting vector-borne diseases with precision biological techniques. Founded by UC San Diego scientists, Synvect's technology aims to manage mosquito populations through advanced genetic methods that prevent breeding and reduce disease transmission globally.

Name: Elysium Robotics
Description: Elysium Robotics is an early-stage robotics company headquartered in Austin developing low-cost, high-dexterity robotic workers to assist the labor market. The company has developed proprietary muscle-like actuation technology that addresses decades-old robotic challenges, enabling unprecedented system-level advantages across the entire robotic stack. Their focus is on creating robots that simplify repetitive tasks, enhance productivity, and reduce labor-related stress across various industries. The company is currently developing robotic arm models and has received DARPA Phase II SBIR funding to support their revolutionary approach to robotics automation.

Name: Codomax
Description: Codomax Technology is a biotechnology company specializing in advanced protein production through its proprietary Epi-MAX platform. The company focuses on developing innovative solutions for producing difficult-to-express recombinant proteins by leveraging unique cellular stress response mechanisms. Their technology enables significant improvements in protein yields (up to 25-fold) across various applications including therapeutics, alternative foods, gene therapy, and cellular agriculture. The platform uses a multi-omics analytical approach to re-engineer expression systems and optimize protein synthesis under different manufacturing conditions.

Name: Drul
Engine Team: Lakshana Huddar <lakshana.huddar@gmail.com>; Rachel Field <rachel@engineventures.com>; Ericka Tamayo-Guevara <ericka@engineventures.com>

Name: SusMaX
Description: SusMaX is a US-based startup that specializes in innovative waste management and construction technology. The company uses patented processes to convert coal ash combustion products into lightweight construction aggregates. Their technology transforms waste materials into valuable, lightweight, and strong aggregates suitable for various construction applications, contributing to circular economy principles by repurposing industrial waste into useful building materials.

Name: Glacier
Description: Glacier is a technology company that develops advanced recycling robots and AI-driven solutions for Materials Recovery Facilities (MRFs). Their innovative robotics technology addresses critical challenges in waste management, including labor shortages, high contamination rates, and inefficient sorting processes. By utilizing AI and advanced robotics, Glacier can sort over 30 different materials with high precision, achieving 45 picks per minute. The company aims to revolutionize recycling operations, reduce operating costs for facilities, increase recyclable material recovery, and contribute to a more sustainable circular economy by keeping valuable materials out of landfills.

Name: Transcera landing page
Description: Transcera is a venture-backed biotech company founded in 2021 and located in Cambridge, Massachusetts. The company is focused on transforming chronic disease treatment through innovative approaches to biologic medicines. Their core technology leverages advanced biological principles to develop therapeutic peptides, proteins, and oligonucleotides with enhanced pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic properties, aiming to improve drug delivery and clinical outcomes for patients with various health conditions.

Name: Spintex
Description: Spintex is an innovative materials technology company that develops high-performance sustainable silk fibres inspired by spider silk production. The company creates advanced biomaterials for multiple industries, including sustainable fashion, technical textiles, aerospace, and medical applications. Their proprietary manufacturing process is energy-efficient, chemical-free, and produces lightweight, biocompatible materials that offer an environmentally friendly alternative to traditional synthetic fibres.

Name: BerkM
Description: BERKM is an advanced materials technology company focused on solving plastic pollution and environmental challenges. The company develops innovative additive technology that enables 8-20% reduction in plastic usage per packaging unit, while significantly improving material properties and recyclability. Their solution extends product shelf life 3-5 times and offers substantial cost savings. The technology has gained significant traction in the $234 billion plastic packaging industry, attracting interest from global brand owners by reducing CO2 emissions and improving packaging sustainability.

Name: Ontologic
Description: Ontologic is a bioinformatics technology platform developed by MIT-trained PhDs and ex-FAANG software engineers. The platform specializes in transforming scientific research workflows by providing advanced data management and analysis solutions for research teams. Its AI-powered bioinformatics tool can generate up to 90% of analysis code, enabling researchers to accelerate their work from manual notebooks to scalable high-throughput pipelines. The platform supports remote collaboration, offers automatic metadata tracking, and includes built-in workflows for efficient data analysis using technologies like Nextflow.

Name: Digit
Description: Digital Biology is a molecular engineering platform that uses advanced measurement techniques to analyze cellular interactions at scale. The company focuses on functional screening of genetically encoded systems and biotherapeutics, providing high-resolution molecular measurements that support precision medicine development. By enabling partners to screen and optimize therapies using detailed biopsy data and cellular function analysis, the platform contributes to advanced therapeutic research and development.

Name: Rapid Liquid Print
Description: Rapid Liquid Print (RLP) is an innovative manufacturing technology company that has developed a patented Gravity Free Manufacturing process for 3D printing. Their unique approach uses gel suspension technology to create high-quality, ultra-soft parts with unprecedented manufacturing speed and complexity. The technology can produce parts in over 10,000 thicknesses, reducing production time by up to 90% and enabling the creation of advanced components for medical, construction, and automotive industries. RLP's method allows for non-planar toolpaths, multi-hardness printing, and the production of large, soft, and stretchable products with high elongation and durability.

Name: ThruWave
Description: ThruWave is a technology company that develops innovative millimeter-wave imaging solutions for supply chain and security applications. Their advanced sensor technology enables automated detection and verification of contents inside sealed packages and containers. The company's key product is a high-speed 3D imaging system that provides unprecedented supply chain visibility, allowing warehouse and fulfillment center operators to inspect items through packaging in real-time. ThruWave's human-safe technology can detect contraband, optimize inventory management, and improve operational efficiency across logistics, manufacturing, and security industries.

Name: Minerva Lithium
Description: Minerva Lithium is a technology company focused on innovative water treatment and mineral extraction solutions, with a primary emphasis on lithium production. The company develops advanced platform technologies for selectively trapping valuable minerals from water, targeting the growing lithium market for electric vehicle and battery industries. Their approach aims to improve lithium supply chain efficiency, reduce carbon emissions, and provide sustainable extraction methods through collaboration with manufacturers and research laboratories.

Name: Pulsenics Inc
Description: Pulsenics is an advanced electrochemical technology company developing proprietary in-line characterization and analytical tools for industrial electrochemical systems. Their flagship product, the Pulse Probe Series, enables real-time monitoring and diagnostics of battery cells, stacks, and modules. Using advanced impedance spectroscopy and AI-powered predictive analytics, Pulsenics provides comprehensive insights into battery performance, material properties, and potential failure modes, supporting quality improvement and optimization in battery technology and related industrial applications.

Name: Atacama Biomaterials
Engine Team: Lakshana Huddar <lakshana.huddar@gmail.com>; Fran Barros <fran@engineventures.com>; Michael Kearney <michael@engineventures.com>
Description: Atacama Biomaterials is an innovative AI-robotics platform company developing sustainable renewable plastics from diverse regional biomass. Their core focus is creating clean energy polymers designed for various industrial applications, with a mission to accelerate the deployment of circular economy products globally. The company specializes in developing energy-efficient materials that promote environmental sustainability, leveraging advanced technologies to create renewable resources that address environmental challenges and support sustainable infrastructure development.

Name: OTORO Energy
Description: Otoro Energy is a technology company specializing in innovative flow battery solutions for energy storage. Their unique battery chemistry offers a safe, low-cost, and high-performance approach to energy storage that aims to enhance grid resiliency and support renewable energy deployment. The company develops non-flammable, non-toxic electrolyte solutions suitable for various applications including electric vehicle charging stations, solar power plants, and hybrid fuel systems, with a focus on providing reliable and scalable long-duration energy storage technologies.

Name: InEdita Bio
Description: InEdita Bio is an agricultural biotechnology company that develops nature-inspired, non-transgenic genome-edited crop varieties. Their innovative approach involves modifying genetic codes to create plant varieties with enhanced resistance to pests and diseases, and improved water and nutrient use efficiency. The company aims to reduce chemical pesticide use in food production by leveraging advanced genome editing techniques to develop more sustainable and resilient crop varieties.

Name: Inlyte Energy
Description: Inlyte Energy is a cleantech company specializing in developing innovative grid batteries made from sodium metal halide technology using abundant and inexpensive materials like iron and salt. Their batteries are designed for long-duration energy storage (4-8 hours), supporting renewable energy infrastructure by providing cost-effective and environmentally friendly solutions for grid storage. The company aims to transform battery technology to make wind and solar energy storage more powerful and accessible, focusing on creating sustainable energy solutions with low-cost manufacturing and improved performance for various applications including grid, industrial, and potentially vehicle energy storage.

Name: QDM
Description: Quantum Designed Materials (QDM) is a cutting-edge technology company specializing in developing room-temperature superconductors using advanced quantum principles. Led by renowned scientists, including two Nobel Prize laureates, QDM focuses on creating high energy-density superconductors by designing innovative crystal structures. The company is engaged in commercialization discussions with global companies in energy, transmission, and storage sectors. QDM owns several patents on room-temperature superconductor powders and is backed by high-tech investors, aiming to revolutionize energy efficiency and technological applications through quantum-inspired material design.

Description: Unemit is a climate technology company specializing in Direct Air Capture (DAC) technology to combat global warming. Their innovative approach aims to remove carbon dioxide from the atmosphere using scalable and sustainable methods. With an ambitious goal of capturing at least 60 gigatons of CO2 by 2060, the company utilizes renewable energy sources and existing supply chains to develop efficient carbon removal solutions that could potentially reduce greenhouse gas emissions by over 10% of historical levels.

Name: Molten Industries
Description: Molten Industries is a technology company focused on producing low-cost, clean hydrogen to support decarbonization efforts in heavy industrial sectors. The company specializes in developing breakthrough technologies for hydrogen production from natural gas, targeting critical industries such as steel, fertilizer, fuels, and plastics manufacturing. By creating innovative hydrogen production methods, Molten Industries aims to provide sustainable energy solutions that can help industrial sectors reduce their carbon footprint and transition to cleaner energy technologies.

Name: Aluminio
Description: Aluminio is an innovative cleantech company developing advanced materials for renewable energy solutions. Backed by the Breakthrough Energy Fellowship (associated with Bill Gates), the company focuses on addressing critical challenges in solar cell and battery technology. Their primary mission is to create next-generation materials that can enhance renewable energy production, with an active recruitment strategy for talented professionals passionate about sustainable technology and clean energy innovation.

Name: Kind Designs

Name: fuse
Description: Fuse Energy is a startup focused on advancing nuclear fusion technology to accelerate the global transition to clean, sustainable energy. The company develops innovative fusion energy solutions, including the TITAN nuclear generator and Z-Star fusion generator, which aim to address critical challenges in fusion power production. By utilizing advanced MagLif technology, Fuse seeks to reduce costs, improve efficiency, and create reliable energy solutions. Their approach emphasizes iterative development of fusion technologies to promote global energy abundance, reduce carbon emissions, and support US technological competitiveness in the emerging fusion energy sector.

Name: LIFTE H2
Description: LIFTE H2 is a hydrogen infrastructure solutions provider specializing in designing, deploying, and operating comprehensive hydrogen transportation and fueling systems. The company develops integrated technologies for compressed hydrogen fueling stations, mobile refuelers, and transport trailers. Their solutions span the entire infrastructure lifecycle, focusing on optimizing cost, reliability, and sustainability across mobility, utilities, and renewable energy sectors through advanced engineering and a digital Asset Performance Management platform.

Name: Alveolus Bio
Description: Alveolus Bio is a biotherapeutic development company focused on pioneering innovative treatments for chronic and infectious lung diseases. The company develops preclinical stage live biotherapeutics targeting conditions like Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis (IPF), Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD), and Non-Cystic Fibrosis Bronchiectasis. Using a proprietary platform called resMIT, Alveolus Bio specializes in inhaled delivery methods that effectively target lung regions, bypassing first-pass metabolism to enhance drug efficacy and reduce adverse effects. Their multidisciplinary team of scientists, physicians, and engineers aims to transform lung disease treatment through cutting-edge biotherapeutic solutions.

Name: Vine Medical
Description: Vine Medical is a healthcare company based in Santa Barbara, CA, focusing on innovative medical technologies and treatments. The company explores emerging medical approaches including epigenetic therapies and soft robotics, with a patient-centered approach to healthcare. Their work aims to improve healthcare systems and develop novel solutions for disease treatment and prevention through cutting-edge technological innovations.

Name: Menten AI
Description: Menten AI is an innovative drug discovery company that leverages advanced computational methods, including machine learning and quantum computing, to design peptide therapeutics for medical conditions with high unmet needs. Their generative AI platform enables the efficient creation and optimization of novel peptides, focusing on developing computational approaches that can design proteins not found in nature. The company aims to accelerate drug development by using sophisticated AI and computing technologies to improve the design of therapeutic molecules.

Name: Bexorg
Description: Bexorg is a pioneering techbio company focused on revolutionizing brain research through a proprietary whole-brain perfusion technology. Spun out of Yale's Kavli Institute for Neuroscience, the company develops innovative platforms for studying brain connectivity, circuit function, and neurological disease processes. Their core technology allows for metabolically active brain research, creating high-fidelity molecular datasets ideal for machine learning and AI-driven drug discovery. Initially targeting Parkinson's disease, Bexorg aims to develop novel therapeutic solutions for central nervous system disorders by creating comprehensive, dynamic models of brain function.

Name: Skyline Nav AI
Description: Skyline Nav AI is an advanced navigation technology company specializing in GPS-independent positioning solutions for commercial and military applications. Their core product, Pathfinder™️, utilizes computer vision algorithms and reference datasets to provide precise navigation in GPS-denied environments. The technology can localize positions within centimeters using visual positioning across ground vehicles, drones, boats, and aircraft. With partnerships including US Air Force, NASA, and major defense contractors, Skyline Nav AI offers robust navigation capabilities that work effectively without GPS, cellular, or Wi-Fi connectivity.

Name: Nulyzer
Description: Nulyzer is a Silicon Valley-based startup developing advanced electrolysis technology for green hydrogen production. The company focuses on creating low-cost, high-performance electrolyzers that can significantly reduce both capital and operational expenses in hydrogen production. Their innovative technology aims to enable more affordable green hydrogen, targeting a production cost of $1 per kilogram, and contributing to more sustainable and efficient clean energy solutions.

Name: Electric Sky
Description: Electric Sky is an innovative transportation technology company developing novel grid energy transmission techniques for high-speed mobile applications. Their core focus is creating sustainable energy solutions that enable power transmission to moving platforms like electric aircraft, urban air mobility vehicles, drones, electric vehicles, and robotic systems. The company aims to provide lower-cost, zero-emission energy solutions by developing methods to tap electrical grid power during high-speed movement.

Name: SafeBeat Rx
Description: SafeBeat Rx is a telehealth platform specializing in cardiac care monitoring using advanced artificial intelligence technology. The platform enables clinicians to access and manage cardiac monitoring devices remotely via mobile phones, including ECG, cardiac telemetry, and implantable cardiac monitors. Comprised of heart rhythm physicians, data scientists, software engineers, and clinical trial specialists, SafeBeat Rx aims to transform cardiac care by providing real-time insights, customized treatment recommendations, and improving patient outcomes through innovative remote monitoring solutions.

Name: Lelantos
Description: Lelantos is a technology company developing advanced miniaturized, ultra-low power gas sensors based on proprietary CMOS-integrated MEMS devices. Their innovative technology enables environmental and air quality monitoring, threat detection, and potential medical diagnostic applications. The company's sensors are distinguished by their exceptional portability, competitive pricing, and high performance. Lelantos collaborates on cutting-edge projects with organizations like the NSF Convergence Accelerator and Bigelow Laboratory for Ocean Sciences, focusing on revolutionizing gas sensing technology for IoT and environmental monitoring applications.

Name: Nanuvo
Description: Nanuvo is a specialized skincare contract manufacturer and formulation lab that integrates cosmetics and technology to create innovative personal care therapies. The company offers comprehensive services from product ideation to launch, including formulation development, manufacturing, prototyping, filling, and labeling. They focus on creating customized skincare lines with options for vegan and cruelty-free products, catering to clients with varying levels of product development needs - from those with completed formulations to those with just initial ideas.

Name: Pascal Technologies
Description: Pascal is an innovative technology company developing solid refrigerant solutions for the HVAC industry. Their breakthrough technology focuses on creating solid refrigerants that undergo phase transitions in response to pressure, operating within the same ranges as standard gas refrigerants. By eliminating direct greenhouse gas emissions, Pascal offers a more sustainable and efficient alternative to traditional cooling systems. The company's technology addresses critical environmental challenges in the HVAC sector, which currently accounts for 40% of global energy usage, by providing refrigerants that are solid, safe, and can be contained without atmospheric release.

Name: AC Biode
Description: AC Biode is a cleantech start-up specializing in innovative chemical technology solutions for sustainability. The company develops advanced battery systems and catalytic technologies for plastic chemical recycling, operating across Luxembourg, Japan, and the UK. Their core focus includes creating catalysts for depolymerizing plastic waste, developing AC batteries for mobility and energy storage, and producing innovative materials that support decarbonization and circular economy initiatives. The company leverages expertise in chemistry, material science, and electronics to create environmentally friendly solutions for waste management and energy production.

Name: Zordi
Description: Zordi is an agricultural technology company specializing in advanced greenhouse farming using robotics, AI, and machine learning. The company focuses on producing high-quality, sweet strawberry varieties through fully autonomous greenhouse operations. By combining cutting-edge technologies like robotic control and environmental optimization, Zordi aims to enhance agricultural efficiency and sustainability. Their innovative approach involves picking berries at peak ripeness and delivering fresh produce within 24 hours to retail stores. The team comprises experts from top technology companies, bringing together expertise in agriculture, robotics, and artificial intelligence to revolutionize indoor farming and food production.

Name: NK Labs
Description: NK Labs is a product design and engineering consulting firm based in Cambridge, MA. Specializing in electrical, mechanical, and software engineering, the company helps clients develop innovative products across various industries including consumer electronics, aerospace, and medical devices. Their expertise encompasses electronic and mechanical design integration, embedded systems, electromagnetic design, wearable sensors, optics, and imaging. NK Labs works with technology companies ranging from startups to established global brands, bringing complex product ideas to life.

Name: Marvel Fusion
Description: Developing a commercially-viable nuclear fusion power plant.

Name: Canopy Aerospace
Description: Canopy Aerospace is an advanced manufacturing startup specializing in high-performance thermal protection systems for the space and hypersonic industries. The company leverages additive manufacturing, robotics, and software to produce critical ceramic materials and components for U.S. Space and Defense applications. Their innovative approach reduces lead time and manufacturing costs while enhancing performance for space vehicles, propulsion systems, semiconductors, and radar technologies.

Name: River Otter Renewables,
Description: River Otter aims to destroy toxic forever PFAS chemicals in wastewater through transformation into renewable fuels, such as gasoline, diesel, and jet fuel. Our patented waste-to-renewable-fuel process could reduce landfill waste and greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions while driving forward the green energy transition through local renewable fuel production for immediate use. We will remove cancer-causing toxic chemicals from waste and water while harnessing the power of a green circular economy.

Name: Tiba Biotech
Description: Tiba Biotech is a pre-clinical stage biotechnology company developing innovative RNA vaccine technologies with a focus on creating safer, more effective nucleic acid products for human and animal health. Headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, and emerging from MIT's Koch Institute, the company has developed a unique biodegradable nanoparticle delivery platform that enables rapid development of vaccines and RNA therapeutics. Tiba has strategic partnerships with the U.S. Army Medical Research Institute of Infectious Diseases and other leading research institutions, specializing in advanced RNA design that improves gene expression and reduces drug use through more targeted treatment methods.

Name: Domi
Description: Domi is a digital platform designed to optimize the rental management process for property managers and tenants. Using next-generation digital identity technology, the platform provides a comprehensive digital passport that simplifies rental applications and tenant selection. Key features include establishing identity, conducting financial and credit checks via verifiable digital credentials, and ensuring privacy and transparency. The platform eliminates paperwork, enables efficient tenant identification, and supports rental management across multiple cities and countries with a self-sovereign identity system.

Name: Agrematch
Description: Agrematch is an artificial intelligence (AI) company focused on providing sustainable products for the Ag & Food industries. Agrematch’s pioneering and proven AI predictive system and validation platform is disrupting the Ag/Food industries by discovering and developing active ingredients in a fraction of the time, costs and risks compared to the industry standard. Led by an outstanding team, Agrematch is monetizing its technology by developing a promising pipeline of agricultural products for the $130B+ market. Agrematch’s pipeline of crop protection and nutrition products includes leading natural and sustainable products.

Name: Seatrec
Description: Seatrec is a technology company that designs and manufactures innovative energy harvesting systems that generate renewable electricity from ocean temperature differences. Founded in 2016 and originating from NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory, the company creates thermal engine technologies for powering scientific research equipment like underwater drones, floats, and autonomous vehicles. Their patented technology enables enhanced data collection in remote, off-grid marine locations by converting natural ocean temperature gradients into clean, sustainable power for research, industry, and defense applications.

Name: Known Medicine
Description: Known Medicine is an oncology-focused technology platform that leverages advanced 3D cell culture datasets and machine learning to optimize cancer treatment selection. The company breaks down patient tumors into micro tumors, testing multiple drug responses to identify the most effective personalized treatment approach. By building a comprehensive database of cancer cells and their drug interactions, Known Medicine helps oncologists determine faster and more precise treatment strategies using advanced imaging, sensitivity assays, and predictive biomarker analysis.

Name: Preverna_V2
Description: Preverna Inc. is a biotechnology company specializing in innovative cancer therapies, focusing on developing advanced cell-based treatments for solid tumors. The company leverages unique Chimeric Adapter Proteins (CAP-TTM) technology to enhance immunotherapy efficacy. By utilizing a proprietary intracellular mechanism, Preverna aims to offer more personalized and effective cancer treatment options, with a strategic approach to targeting specific cell signaling pathways and improving oncological research and therapeutic interventions.

Name: Omch2
Description: OMC Hydrogen is an innovative clean energy technology company developing a scalable thermochemical platform for producing green hydrogen and hydrocarbons. Their proprietary process leverages domestically abundant materials and sustainable sources of heat, water, and carbon dioxide. Built on over two decades of research at the University of Colorado, the technology builds upon existing industrial processes to create an innovative approach to hydrogen and syngas production, with the goal of providing affordable and environmentally friendly energy solutions.

Name: Celadynetech
Description: Celadyne is an American technology company specializing in hydrogen energy solutions, focusing on advanced membrane technologies for fuel cells and electrolyzers. The company develops innovative nanocomposite membranes that improve hydrogen production efficiency and durability across heavy-duty industries including energy, manufacturing, and transportation. Their core technology enables more compact and simplified hydrogen systems by extending operational ranges and reducing hydrogen crossover rates, with the ultimate goal of advancing the hydrogen economy through material innovation.

Name: 4D Path
Description: 4D Path is a precision oncology technology company developing an advanced AI-powered platform for cancer diagnostics. Their patented Q-Plasia OncoReader (QPOR™) provides breakthrough technology that analyzes H&E whole slide biopsy images to extract detailed biomarker and tumor microenvironment data. The FDA-designated breakthrough device aims to eliminate additional molecular testing, accelerate precision medicine, and improve diagnostic accuracy for cancer features. The platform combines physics, biology, and mathematical principles to identify tumor-specific fingerprints, enabling more personalized treatment selection and patient stratification across various cancer types.

Name: Cyklos Materials
Description: Cyklos Materials is a California-based startup founded in 2022 that develops innovative bio-renewable plastics for the circular economy. Their proprietary polydiketoenamine (PDK) materials offer sustainable alternatives to traditional hard-to-recycle plastics like polyurethane and polyamide. Targeting industries including automotive, apparel, footwear, and home goods, the company provides circular material solutions that deliver premium quality, low-carbon sustainability, and zero-waste manufacturing capabilities.

Name: ChloBis Water
Description: Chlobis is an innovative water technology company developing an energy-efficient desalination solution that addresses challenges in the water-energy nexus. Their unique technology features a rechargeable desalination cell capable of membrane-free desalination while simultaneously using salt ions for energy storage and release. Based on a patented discovery involving bismuth as a chloride-storage electrode, the company aims to provide novel approaches for seawater desalination and wastewater treatment.

Name: Bluefin Foods
Description: Bluefin Foods is a cell-cultured seafood company focused on developing high-quality, nutritious alternative seafood products. The company aims to address environmental and animal welfare concerns in traditional seafood production by creating innovative cell-cultured seafood solutions. Their primary focus is on producing cultivated seafood products, with a particular emphasis on developing bluefin tuna sushi products that offer a more sustainable and ethical alternative to conventional seafood.

Name: Charge Robotics
Description: Charge Robotics is a technology company that develops autonomous robots to automate labor-intensive aspects of solar construction. By addressing the primary bottleneck in solar energy installation—labor logistics and bandwidth—their robotic solutions enable construction companies to efficiently scale solar energy projects. The company's technology streamlines the entire solar installation process, from planning and design to execution, helping to accelerate renewable energy adoption by removing manual labor constraints and improving project efficiency.

Name: Offbeast
Description: Mooji Meats is a plant-based food technology company developing next-generation meat alternatives. The company focuses on creating plant-based, hybrid, and cultured meat products that go beyond traditional ground meat alternatives. Their goal is to produce ethical and sustainable meat substitutes across a wide range of categories, including chicken breast, tuna fillet, and wagyu steak, without requiring livestock farming or butchering. Mooji aims to provide high-protein, low-fat alternatives that look, feel, and taste like real meat.

Name: SkyNano
Description: SkyNano is a Tennessee-based clean energy technology startup focused on transforming carbon dioxide emissions into valuable solid carbon materials. The company develops innovative solutions for carbon capture and electrochemical conversion, creating materials for applications in batteries, automotive, and coating industries. Their core mission is to provide a sustainable, free-market approach to carbon pollution by converting CO2 into high-value functional materials. SkyNano aims to help businesses and individuals achieve sustainability goals while improving the performance of everyday products through advanced carbon nanotechnology.

Name: MetaSeismic
Description: METAseismic is an innovative technology startup specializing in developing cost-effective metamaterials designed specifically for earthquake protection. The company creates engineered materials with unique properties that go beyond natural materials, focusing on safeguarding buildings and valuable assets from seismic events. As a pioneering venture in metamaterial technology, they aim to provide advanced solutions for structural protection and risk mitigation in earthquake-prone regions.

Name: Alloyenterprises
Description: Alloy Enterprises is an innovative manufacturing company specializing in high-performance thermal management solutions. Using a patented Stack Forging process, they produce aluminum components including cold plates, vapor chambers, and electronics enclosures for industries like data centers, photonics, semiconductor equipment, and defense. Their novel manufacturing system enables high-throughput production of fully-dense parts, allowing manufacturers to efficiently scale from prototyping to series production with enhanced heat dissipation capabilities.

Name: Artimus Robotics
Description: Artimus Robotics is an innovative technology company developing advanced soft electric actuators and high voltage electronics for robotics and automation. Their core technology involves nature-inspired HASEL artificial muscles that provide life-like motion through thin plastic films and liquids. The company creates customizable actuation solutions for diverse applications including bio-inspired robotics, wearables, fluid control, medical devices, and industrial automation. Their specialized electronic products, such as amplifiers and digital controllers, are designed for research and original equipment manufacturer (OEM) applications.

Name: Persephone Biosciences
Description: Persephone Biome is a medical research company focused on microbiome studies, with a particular emphasis on developing equitable precision medicine for cancer treatment. Their mission centers on understanding how gut microbiome interactions can impact cancer therapies, aiming to improve treatment outcomes across different ethnic and racial groups by conducting comprehensive clinical studies that map disease progression and microbiome interactions.

Name: Refiberd
Description: Refiberd is an innovative textile recycling technology company that uses artificial intelligence and hyperspectral imaging to enable efficient textile-to-textile recycling. Their solution helps the fashion industry achieve circularity by accurately sorting and processing textile waste, potentially diverting up to 70% of textile waste into new products. The company develops advanced AI-driven systems that convert discarded textiles into reusable thread, focusing on sustainable manufacturing processes that are cost-effective and easily integrated into existing production workflows.

Name: chipiron
Description: Chipiron is a deeptech startup revolutionizing medical imaging by developing ultra-low field MRI technology. Their mission is to democratize MRI access by creating lightweight, portable MRI machines that are more affordable and practical for local care centers and clinics. The company aims to fundamentally transform healthcare by making MRI diagnostics 100x more accessible, with plans to begin clinical trials by 2026. Their innovative approach includes a miniaturized MRI scanner with advanced technologies like SQUID detection and AI noise cancellation to enhance image quality and reduce acquisition times.

Name: SpIntellx
Description: SpIntellx is a precision pathology company that applies unbiased spatial analytics and explainable AI to transform computational pathology. The platform provides powerful tools for clinicians and researchers to identify novel cell types, biomarkers, and targets through advanced AI-driven analysis. Focused on oncology research, the company enables more precise companion diagnostics, personalized therapeutic options, and improved clinical workflows. Their technology helps accelerate drug discovery, optimize clinical trials, and provide deeper insights into cellular interactions and functional states.

Name: O2 RegenTech
Description: O2 RegenTech is a medical technology company developing innovative wound care solutions. Their flagship product OXAID™ is a novel biopolymer wound dressing that provides a unique combination of oxygen delivery, moisture retention, and antimicrobial protection. Designed to promote chronic wound healing, the technology offers a cost-effective and easy-to-use solution for medical professionals treating conditions like diabetic foot ulcers and other chronic wounds.

Name: PlazMod Technologies
Description: A technology company developing innovative battery manufacturing processes, with research origins from Yale University. The firm specializes in plasma-based green manufacturing techniques for batteries and energy materials, targeting global electrification efforts.

Name: Alphaotto
Description: Alpha-Otto Technologies is an advanced energy solutions company specializing in innovative power generation technologies focused on decarbonization and sustainability. The company develops fuel-flexible, high-efficiency energy systems that can operate on multiple fuel types including hydrogen, biofuels, and traditional fuels. Their core technology includes advanced electric power generation solutions, particularly for small-scale applications (under 250kW), with a mission to provide resilient and scalable power solutions for diverse sectors including transportation, military, data centers, and renewable energy projects.

Name: Dimensional Energy
Description: Dimensional Energy is a technology company specializing in carbon transformation, converting carbon dioxide into sustainable aviation fuels and other industrial products. Their innovative platform uses carbon utilization technology to produce synthetic fuels and materials for industries like cosmetics, coatings, and transportation. With operations in Houston, Ithaca, and Tucson, the company aims to reduce fossil fuel dependency by creating circular economy solutions. Their technology focuses on producing low-carbon intensity products, supporting industries in transitioning to more sustainable and environmentally responsible operations.

Name: NemaLife
Description: NemaLife's mission is to accelerate and de-risk R&D for companies in the food, nutraceutical, microbiome and pharma industries. In these industries, performing human-relevant high throughput biology and doing so with efficiency and speed has been a mutually exclusive affair. NemaLife has solved this major challenge by developing an AI-assisted microfluidics-based in vivo platform based on the microscopic worm C. elegans that has strong relevance for human biology. This 3R-compliant cruelty-free technology capable of testing a variety of compounds and their combinations is an alternative to expensive and time-consuming mouse models. We work with companies as their R&D partner, accelerating the value-chain from early-phase discovery to assessment of product potency and health claims. Our interdisciplinary team of engineers and biologists work with you to achieve your R&D objectives as well as co-create assets by developing custom biological readouts and new tech platforms. We have significant pre-clinical expertise in human wellness areas related to gut health, brain health, muscle health, metabolic health, cognitive health and healthy aging. We would be happy to share more details in a 15 min call.

Name: CaviSense
Description: CaviSense is a dental technology company developing an innovative oral health platform for early cavity detection and monitoring. Their patented technology, developed in collaboration with Harvard-Tufts, enables real-time at-home and professional cavity diagnostics, focusing on identifying reversible early-stage tooth decay. The product empowers patients and dentists by providing a simple, accessible tool for proactive oral health management.

Name: Atomic Machines
Description: Atomic Machines is a cutting-edge manufacturing technology company dedicated to advancing humanity's capability to manipulate matter at the micro-scale. They are developing an innovative digital micro-device manufacturing platform that redefines production processes, with a focus on creating micro-electromechanical (MEMS) devices. Their mission is to enable rapid prototyping and large-scale manufacturing of advanced technologies, including medical micro-robotics, lab-on-chip microfluidics, tunable antennas, and high-frequency RF switching devices.

Name: Distributedspectrum
Description: Distributed Spectrum is a defense technology company founded in 2020 that develops advanced sensor platforms for radio signal detection and tracking. Their technology integrates low-cost hardware with patent-pending algorithms to identify and monitor signals across various environments. The platform offers AI-driven signal detection, real-time threat alerts, and supports integration with existing systems, enabling stakeholders to understand and analyze radio spectrum signals for tactical and security applications.

Name: Dig
Description: Dig Energy is a renewable energy company specializing in distributed geothermal energy solutions for global markets. The company develops innovative low-cost geothermal power systems that integrate renewable energy technologies like geothermal heat pumps and solar panels. Their primary focus is creating accessible and sustainable energy solutions that can potentially provide clean energy to billions of people worldwide, with an emphasis on developing scalable and cost-effective geothermal power technologies.

Name: MOLG
Description: Molg is a circular manufacturing technology company that addresses the e-waste problem through innovative robotics and artificial intelligence. Their core technology involves autonomous robotic microfactories capable of disassembling complex electronic products for reuse and recycling. Using advanced systems like the OriginMark™ tracking platform, Molg enables efficient lifecycle management of electronic devices, promoting sustainable manufacturing practices by ensuring valuable components can be reintegrated into new production cycles.

Name: Stranded Solutions
Description: Stranded Solutions LLC is an energy technology company specializing in methane to methanol conversion at wellheads. They offer a patented technology that enables small-scale gas conversion with capacities ranging from 400 to 2,000 MSCFDs, focusing on maximizing returns and minimizing regulatory obstacles in the oil and gas industry. The company's solution allows for efficient conversion of flared natural gas, providing an innovative approach to utilizing stranded gas resources.

Name: Planck Energies
Description: Planck Energies is a renewable energy technology company focused on developing sustainable solutions for commercial and residential environments. Founded by Dr. Yi Zheng, a mechanical engineering professor with extensive energy research experience, the company develops innovative technologies such as passive radiative cooling additives and other renewable energy products. Their core mission is to reduce greenhouse gas emissions, address climate change, and alleviate global water scarcity by applying advanced research in nanotechnology and nature-derived materials to create energy-efficient devices that minimize ecological impact and operational costs.

Name: NTP TECHNOLOGIES
Description: NTP develops affordable, sustainable, salt-free nitrogen fertilizer on-site and on-demand, replacing synthetic alternatives for agricultural producers and environmentally-conscious landowners. By employing non-thermal plasma technology in a modular and repeatable design, NTP maximizes nitrate production efficiency to deliver unrivaled scalability and affordability for end markets while offering our customers a sustainable solution.

Name: Allonnia
Description: Allonnia is a bio-ingenuity company focused on solving environmental challenges through innovative biotechnology solutions. Specializing in waste management and environmental remediation, the company develops cutting-edge technologies for PFAS removal, mining waste treatment, and sustainable waste disposal. Their approach leverages microorganisms to extract value from waste, with key focus areas including mining, industrial waste, and plastics. Allonnia creates biotechnological solutions that address complex environmental problems, such as naphthenic acid reduction in oil sands tailings and contaminant removal from water, with a mission to transform waste management through nature-inspired technological innovations.

Name: Cyclenium Pharma
Description: Cyclenium Pharma is a pharmaceutical research and development company specializing in macrocyclic drug discovery technology. The company focuses on developing novel small molecule therapeutics for challenging disease targets in oncology, infectious diseases, and inflammation/pain. Cyclenium leverages its proprietary CMRT™ technology and QUEST™ screening library to collaborate with academic institutions, non-profit organizations, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide, aiming to address unmet medical needs through innovative drug development approaches.

Name: EdiTy Therapeutics
Description: Edity is developing a novel delivery platform that uses immune cells to transfer therapeutic proteins to the target cells of patients. Our technology allows for precise modulation of intracellular pathways of disease using a range of proteins including gene editors, immune sensors, enzymes and intrabodies.

Name: iSono Health
Description: iSono Health develops an innovative AI-driven platform featuring an automated, portable, and wearable ultrasound device designed for breast cancer detection and monitoring. Their patented compact scanner automatically captures full 3D breast volume images in just two minutes, connecting to mobile devices and transferring data to a secure cloud. The system uses machine learning algorithms to identify potential abnormal masses, offering a radiation-free solution for point-of-care diagnostics in radiology centers, walk-in clinics, and mobile healthcare settings. The technology aims to empower women to take charge of their breast health through intelligent, efficient, and user-friendly imaging.

Name: bTECH
Description: bTECH is a medical technology company dedicated to advancing wound care through innovative research and product development. Their primary focus is reducing chronic non-healing wounds by developing breakthrough technologies like the Halcyon SMART Patch (HSP), which uses far-infrared wavelengths to enhance tissue healing. The company works across healthcare sectors, offering consulting services in wound care, regenerative medicine, and developing medical devices with a particular emphasis on government and hospital partnerships.

Name: Bloomer Health Tech
Description: Bloomer Tech is a healthcare technology company focused on women's cardiovascular health. They have developed an innovative medical-grade wearable technology integrated into everyday bras that can perform continuous electrocardiogram (ECG) monitoring. Leveraging over 30 years of research on sex and ethnicity-related cardiovascular differences, their patented textile-based sensor technology provides real-time heart health insights. The device aims to generate novel digital biomarkers and address health conditions that uniquely or disproportionately affect women.

Name: Vysioneer
Description: Vysioneer is an oncology-focused AI company that leverages an FDA-cleared AI platform to improve understanding of tumor heterogeneity in cancer treatment. The company helps pharmaceutical firms analyze lesion-level tumor characteristics to de-risk and accelerate clinical trials. By creating a comprehensive database of lesion-level drug efficacy, Vysioneer aims to enhance treatment outcomes through precise, automated tumor measurement and tracking, ultimately providing more accurate insights for oncology research and drug development.

Name: Generate
Description: Generate is a tech-enabled architecture platform specializing in mass timber design and construction optimization. The company provides a digital platform that automates design and quoting processes for project teams, featuring a generative configurator that enables rapid building design. Key capabilities include a collaborative interface for communication with supply chain partners, a comprehensive digital product catalog, and tools for managing structural grid layouts and addressing complex design challenges with a focus on sustainable urban development.

Name: Cellibre
Description: Cellibre is a cutting-edge manufacturing technology company that leverages biological engineering to create sustainable solutions across multiple industries. Using an organism-agnostic approach, the company transforms cells into specialized, sustainable factories for manufacturing globally significant products. Their world-class scientific team pioneers breakthroughs in strain engineering, precision fermentation, and biochemistry, focusing on developing innovative solutions that enhance product efficiency while supporting environmental sustainability across energy, ingredients, and medical sectors.

Name: Averroes.ai
Description: Averroes AI is an advanced artificial intelligence platform specializing in automated visual inspection and virtual metrology for manufacturing industries. The company provides a no-code AI solution that enables users to create and deploy custom defect detection models with over 99% accuracy. Their platform supports various sectors including semiconductor manufacturing, oil and gas, and food and beverage, offering seamless integration with existing inspection systems to improve product quality, reduce labor costs, and enhance operational efficiency.

Name: Opcondys
Description: Opcondys is an innovative power electronics startup developing the Optical Transconductance Varistor (OTV), a next-generation power switching device. The company leverages advanced materials and government-funded research to create more energy-efficient, faster, and cost-effective electronic components. Their technology aims to revolutionize high-voltage electricity control across various markets including grid modernization, energy storage, and high-voltage power supplies, with potential applications in HVDC systems and advanced power management.

Name: En Solución
Description: En Solución is an Austin-based startup revolutionizing food safety through nanotechnology. The company has developed and patented a novel chemical-free method for cleaning fresh produce, proteins, and food processing equipment. Their innovative solution utilizes ozone and nanobubble technology to effectively sanitize food environments, eliminating germs, viruses, bacteria, allergens, and molds. By offering environmentally sound alternatives to traditional chlorine-based sanitization methods, the company provides a safer and more sustainable approach to microbial control in the food processing industry.

Name: DexMat
Description: DexMat is a climate tech materials company specializing in Galvorn, an advanced carbon nanomaterial with unique properties. Developed from research at Rice University, their proprietary carbon nanotube technology produces high-performance fibers and films that are 10x stronger than steel, lightweight, and electrically conductive. The material offers significant potential for carbon reduction across industries including aerospace, automotive, electronics, and energy by providing sustainable alternatives to traditional metals. DexMat's mission is to drive industrial innovation through carbon-negative materials that can be customized for diverse applications like signal wires, EMI shielding, and flexible electronics.

Name: Entropy Bio
Description: At Entropy Bio, we find each cancer’s resistance playbook before the game is played, allowing us to design therapies that give patients the best chance of winning. Treatment-resistance is responsible for 90% of cancer deaths – which is why it’s the sole focus of our company. To beat cancer, we need to beat resistance before it has the chance to develop. Using the first and only preclinical cancer model that determines the drivers of resistance, we design multi-targeted therapies that not only kill cancer, but also block the escape pathways we can see coming.

Name: Genome-wide CRISPR Screening In A Living Mouse
EcoaTEX
Description: Ecoatex is a technology-driven sustainable textile materials company that develops innovative fabrics using green chemistry and nanotechnology. Specializing in transforming agricultural waste into advanced textile materials, the company aims to reduce reliance on petroleum-based fibers and promote a circular, low-impact future for fashion, home, and performance textiles. Their approach combines material science, textile engineering, and sustainable design to create eco-friendly clothing and textile products that minimize environmental impact while maintaining high performance and quality standards.

Name: SilarTek
Description: Silartek is a technology company focused on developing an innovative silicon production process using molten salt electrolysis. Their groundbreaking method aims to produce high-purity silicon (4-6N purity) from quartzite with remarkable efficiency, consuming less than 30 kWh/kg and generating zero direct greenhouse gas emissions. The technology promises to significantly reduce silicon production costs by 75-80% compared to current methods, while addressing safety and environmental concerns. The process yields pure oxygen as a by-product and enables direct production of solar-grade silicon suitable for boule/wafer manufacturing.

Name: Enrich Bioscience
Engine Team: Ian Johnston <ian@engine.xyz>; Vinny Beranek <vinny@engineventures.com>; Ann DeWitt <ann@engineventures.com>
Description: Enrich Bioscience develops an innovative molecular blood test-kit for early cancer detection, offering a breakthrough in medical diagnostics. Their liquid biopsy test uses over 1,000 DNA biomarkers to screen multiple cancer types before symptoms appear, with claims of being 100 times more sensitive and 70% less expensive than current diagnostic methods. The technology aims to enhance early cancer detection, providing more therapeutic options and potentially improving survival rates across various cancer types.

Name: Wild Microbes
Description: Wild Microbes is a synthetic biology company that transforms microbes into production factories for sustainable manufacturing of chemicals, cosmetics, food ingredients, fragrances, plastics, and proteins. The company sources microbes from diverse ecosystems and uses cutting-edge technology to develop new microbial chassis that can replace petroleum and animal-based products. Wild Microbes offers consulting services to help companies leverage microbial strains for sustainable manufacturing solutions, aiming to create cost-effective, renewable alternatives that reduce dependency on traditional materials while scaling sustainable products faster and cheaper than conventional methods.

Name: Gigantor Technologies
Description: Gigantor Technologies is an AI acceleration and computer vision solutions provider specializing in innovative hardware systems for edge AI applications. Their signature technology, GigaMAACS, enables high-performance processing of AI models with near-zero latency, processing speeds over 240 FPS, and optimal power efficiency. The company serves multiple industries including defense, surveillance, and autonomous vehicles, offering cutting-edge solutions that overcome traditional hardware limitations for AI-powered devices and computer vision models.

Name: Quoherent
Description: Quoherent is a quantum computing technology company developing innovative quantum processors designed for mobile platforms. The company has created a unique quantum computing approach using topological materials that enable ambient temperature operation with low quantum noise. Their technology allows for quantum processor construction on silicon, making them scalable and compatible with standard PCB technology. Quoherent aims to deploy high-fidelity, scalable quantum processors that can operate at the edge, representing a significant advancement in quantum computing accessibility and performance.

Name: Space Kinetic
Description: Space Kinetic is a space technology company that specializes in developing advanced electromechanical deployment systems for space operations. Their proprietary system enables rapid, cost-effective payload deployment within 90 minutes, supporting flexible and dynamic space missions. The company focuses on creating more resilient in-space supply lines and providing quick-response capabilities for dual-use applications across various space vehicle platforms.

Name: Rnav8bio
Description: RNAV8 is a biotechnology company specializing in mRNA engineering, focused on enhancing mRNA expression and optimization for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and academic research applications. The company develops advanced toolkit solutions that improve mRNA translation efficiency through non-coding sequence optimization, enabling the development of new therapeutic approaches. Their technology aims to provide a competitive advantage in mRNA-based treatments by maximizing expression potential and collaborating with partners across various scientific domains.

Name: Meili Technologies
Description: Meili Technologies is an enterprise safety and compliance software platform that specializes in driver health monitoring and emergency detection systems. Using advanced machine learning techniques like computer vision and anomaly detection, the company develops in-cabin technologies to identify medical emergencies in vehicles, particularly for fleet and automotive clients. Their solutions automate safety reporting, reduce administrative time, and provide comprehensive personnel and asset tracking while enabling proactive medical emergency response and intervention.

Name: Simplifyber
Description: Simplifyber is an innovative sustainable manufacturing technology company transforming the fashion industry's supply chain. Using a patented process, the company creates entire 3D-shaped soft goods directly from plant-based fibers in a single manufacturing step. Their breakthrough technology eliminates traditional textile production steps like spinning, weaving, and extensive sewing, offering a cost-competitive alternative to plastic and polyester. By enabling direct 3D manufacturing of garment and shoe uppers from cellulose-based liquids, Simplifyber aims to make fashion production more sustainable and technologically advanced.

Name: AuraBlue
Description: 75% of women experience sleep disruptions and discomfort as a result of hot flashes. AuraBlue is the first device that combines wearable sensor technologies and intelligent algorithms with a cooling solution to preemptively counteract sweating and awakening, and ultimately maximize women’s sleep quality.

Name: Keliomics: Functional Onconostics
Description: Keliomics is a biotechnology company specializing in innovative cancer research and drug development. Their core technology enables keeping human tissues and tumors alive outside the human body, allowing pharmaceutical companies to develop and test therapeutic approaches more effectively. By utilizing donated human tissues, Keliomics provides a unique platform that enhances the speed and translatability of drug development, supporting the creation of advanced cancer treatments through innovative tissue preservation and research techniques.

Name: Kumuda
Description: Kumuda is a bioinformatics software company focused on accelerating drug discovery and pharmaceutical research. Utilizing advanced computational technologies, the company develops actionable insights for developing new medical treatments. Their AI-driven platform supports pharmaceutical research teams by providing innovative solutions to streamline and enhance the drug development process, leveraging bioinformatics and artificial intelligence to potentially speed up the creation of new therapeutic interventions.

Name: Axion Ray
Description: Axion Ray is an AI-powered observability platform for global manufacturing companies, specializing in detecting and resolving quality issues in automotive and other industrial products. Their advanced AI technology contextualizes customer feedback and identifies emerging product problems early, helping companies reduce downtime, warranty costs, and improve customer satisfaction. The platform provides a comprehensive observability hub that breaks down organizational silos, enables cross-team collaboration, and offers high-precision issue detection and resolution capabilities. Designed to support product integrity management, Axion Ray helps manufacturing leaders leverage AI to enhance creative problem-solving and maintain product quality.

Name: Northwood Space
Description: Northwood is a space technology company founded in 2022 by Bridgit Mendler, Griffin Cleverly, and Shaurya Luthra. The company aims to expand space accessibility by developing an advanced, scalable ground network powered by phased array technology. Their innovative approach focuses on transforming satellite backhaul infrastructure to deliver enhanced connectivity and resilience for space operations. The company plans to deploy its first network sites in 2025, with a mission to improve the efficiency of satellite communication networks.

Name: H Quest Vanguard
Description: H Quest Vanguard is an early-stage technology company in Pittsburgh developing innovative decarbonization solutions using a proprietary low-temperature plasma conversion process. The company transforms natural gas and coal into clean hydrogen, advanced carbon materials like graphene and carbon fiber, and other valuable products. Their modular systems can be integrated with industrial infrastructure, offering significant CO2 emissions reduction and cost-effective hydrogen production for manufacturing, energy, and other industrial sectors.

Name: HiT Nano
Description: HiT Nano Inc. is an advanced manufacturing company specializing in next-generation lithium-ion batteries and energy materials. The company develops low-cost, high-performance battery technologies using sustainable manufacturing processes like MACHT (Micro-Aerosol Controlled High Temperature Processing). Their innovative approach focuses on creating high-energy cathode and anode materials with reduced chemical input and CO2 emissions, as demonstrated by their ISO 9001:2015 certification. The company's core competencies include thermochemical energy storage solutions and advanced manufacturing technologies that prioritize sustainability and efficiency in energy storage systems.

Name: Circuit Mind
