Description: Circuit Mind is an artificial intelligence company developing an electronics design automation platform that streamlines circuit board development. Their AI-powered software automates the creation of printed circuit board (PCB) schematics, enabling engineering teams to design electronic systems faster and more efficiently. The platform generates complete circuit board designs by automatically selecting components based on criteria like size, cost, and availability. Circuit Mind aims to revolutionize hardware design by reducing development time and complexity, supporting innovations across industries like renewable energy, telecommunications, and advanced electronics.

Name: FAR Biotech
Description: FAR Biotech is a preclinical computational drug discovery company specializing in identifying novel molecules for hard-to-drug targets across therapeutic areas like neurodegeneration, oncology, and infectious diseases. The company leverages a unique quantum mechanical approach combined with AI and machine learning to rapidly identify structurally diverse lead molecules. Their proprietary quantum biomodelling platform enables more efficient drug discovery by applying advanced computational techniques to analyze drug-target interactions and optimize potential pharmaceutical compounds.

Name: Empallo
Description: Empallo is a telehealth platform focused on cardiovascular care, leveraging AI technology to provide personalized medical services for patients with heart-related conditions. As an MIT spinoff, the company offers online consultations with cardiovascular specialists, managing conditions like heart failure, arrhythmias, and hypertension. Their services include medication management, lab test coordination, ongoing care programs, and patient referrals, with a goal of improving heart health management through innovative digital healthcare solutions.

Name: PonyPak Systems
Description: Life-Support Systems, Inc. designs specialized life-support equipment for extreme environments, with a focus on subsea and terrestrial applications. The company offers advanced micro-umbilical technology supporting critical human intervention services such as breathing, temperature control, and biometric analysis. Key products include the GasPak, which can accommodate multiple technicians under high-pressure conditions, and the ReelPak, a compact and portable platform that enables efficient equipment deployment and integration. The company provides real-time data analytics to enhance operational safety and situational awareness.

Name: Inclusifi
Description: Inclusifi is a team collaboration platform that uses data and communication sciences to help organizations conduct more inclusive and effective meetings. The platform focuses on improving team communication dynamics and ensuring more equitable participation in workplace interactions.

Name: AD Knight
Description: A.D Knight is a technology company focused on improving road safety and traffic management through innovative mobile device tracking. Their SpotBeam technology uses connected devices to monitor vulnerable road users in low visibility conditions, providing real-time alerts and analytics for municipalities, road operators, and asset owners in Israel and the European Union.

Name: Chi Botanic
Description: Chi Botanic is a biotechnology company specializing in plant cell culture technology, which enables the production of high-quality plant compounds without traditional agriculture. By cultivating plant cells in controlled lab environments, the company creates sustainable ingredients for various industries, eliminating the need for soil, extensive water resources, and pesticides. Their innovative approach focuses on producing pure plant-based compounds from diverse plant types like citrus and vanilla, with a core mission of reducing agriculture's environmental impact through advanced cell culture techniques.

Name: Gradient
Description: Gradient is an innovative home comfort technology company focused on transforming HVAC systems with sustainable heat pump solutions. Their flagship product is an all-weather window heat pump designed to provide efficient heating and cooling while significantly reducing carbon emissions. The company's technology enables easy installation without requiring contractors or major infrastructure changes, utilizing R-32 refrigerant with lower global warming potential. Gradient aims to make climate-friendly home upgrades accessible, with proven success in multifamily buildings, public housing, and schools, ultimately working to decarbonize building climate control systems.

Name: Embryome
Description: Embryome is a reproductive technology company focused on advanced embryo testing using whole genome and transcriptome sequencing. Their innovative approach aims to improve upon current euploid embryo testing methods, which have limited success rates. The company seeks to empower prospective parents by providing more comprehensive genetic analysis and insights into embryo selection for fertility treatments.

Name: Matrisome
Description: Matrisome Bio is a seed-stage biotechnology startup located in Cambridge, Massachusetts, focused on harnessing the properties of the extracellular matrix (ECM). The company aims to transform therapeutic approaches by exploring innovative applications of the extracellular matrix, with an emphasis on developing new medical technologies. They are currently in a growth phase, seeking to expand their team of doctors and scientists to advance their research and development efforts.

Name: Devorto
Description: Devorto is an aerospace technology startup developing an innovative solar-powered aircraft concept called the Tethered Uni-Rotor Network (TURN). Designed by a former NASA engineer and supported by NASA and US Air Force R&D funding, the aircraft aims to achieve persistent stratospheric flight. The unique design enables global internet connectivity, telecommunications relay, environmental monitoring, and enhanced communication capabilities with superior efficiency compared to traditional fixed-wing aircraft.

Name: Wright Electric Airplanes
Description: Wright Electric is a U.S.-based aerospace company developing zero-emissions commercial aircraft. The company is pioneering electric propulsion systems for commercial aviation, with plans to retrofit existing aircraft and create new electric airliners. Their roadmap includes the Wright Spirit (a 100-passenger aircraft planned for 2026) and the Wright 1 (a 186-seat airliner targeting 2030), focusing on short to medium-range electric flight solutions. Founded in 2016, the company has received venture capital backing and is working to transform commercial aviation through battery-powered aircraft technology.

Name: Silvis Materials
Description: Silvis Materials is a sustainable materials technology company specializing in developing 100% bio-based adhesives for industrial applications. Their patented technology creates biodegradable cellulose emulsions that can decarbonize building products and packaging by up to 80%. The company focuses on creating recyclable, compostable solutions that match petroleum-based emulsion prices while reducing environmental pollution. Silvis Materials aims to accelerate corporate sustainability goals by offering innovative, environmentally responsible adhesive solutions that support the transition to a circular economy.

Name: Runwise
Description: Runwise is a wireless building control platform that provides an end-to-end boiler and heating system management solution. The company combines proprietary hardware, a sensor network, and machine learning systems to help building owners reduce fuel consumption by 20-25%. Serving over 6,000 buildings in New York City, Runwise offers remote infrastructure monitoring, safety management, and energy optimization through a single integrated interface. The platform provides rapid deployment with payback in under five months, helping customers save on energy costs while improving tenant comfort and reducing carbon output.

Name: ThermoLift
Description: ThermoLift is an innovative clean energy technology company developing an advanced natural gas-powered heating, cooling, and hot water system. Their patented TCHP™ technology combines multiple functions into a single appliance, delivering 30-50% reduction in building HVAC energy consumption and costs. The company's unique approach uses helium instead of traditional refrigerants, resulting in zero global warming potential, zero ozone depletion, and zero toxicity. Based at Stony Brook University's Advanced Energy Center with additional engineering facilities, ThermoLift has received funding from the U.S. Department of Energy and New York State Research and Development Authority.

Name: Catalyx
Description: catalyx llc objective is to address the infrastructure bottlenecks to unlock the full social and economic potential of the sub-saharan africa communities, providing superior risk-adjusted returns to its investors catalyx llc is an independent project developer and asset manager with a focused strategy limited in geography and activity sectors.

Name: ALGAE BIODIESEL
Description: Algbio is an environmental technology company that utilizes microalgae for wastewater treatment, CO2 capture, and sustainable product development. Their core services include treating industrial wastes, reducing chemical and biochemical oxygen demand, removing heavy metals and coliform bacteria, and capturing atmospheric carbon. The company produces biofuels, bioplastics, biomaterials, and carbon credits, supporting the transition from fossil-based economies to sustainable manufacturing practices through circular economy principles and innovative algae-based solutions.

Name: Deeplite
Description: Deeplite is an AI software company that develops advanced optimization technologies for deep learning systems, focusing on making AI more accessible and affordable. Their flagship product Neutrino is an AI-driven optimizer that streamlines production deployment of sophisticated deep learning systems for real-time, large-scale, and resource-limited environments. Specializing in creating faster, smaller, and more energy-efficient AI models, Deeplite enables deployment of high-performance neural networks across various sectors including consumer electronics, automotive, and IoT devices.

Name: NewEdge Signal Solutions
Description: NewEdge Signal Solutions is a high-tech wireless communications company specializing in developing advanced radio frequency (RF) front-end modules and systems for telecommunications and defense markets. Founded in 2011 and headquartered near Boston, MA, the company creates innovative technologies that solve complex wireless communication challenges. Their key offerings include tunable filters, 5G modules, and adaptive RF solutions that improve efficiency, enhance cell coverage, and support the deployment of advanced wireless infrastructure across multiple frequency bands.

Name: Everywhere Apparel
Description: Everywhere Apparel is a sustainable clothing manufacturer specializing in 100% recycled cotton products. The company produces eco-friendly apparel including t-shirts, hoodies, and sweatshirts designed for screen printing and embroidery. They offer wholesale options for custom projects and uniform programs, with a focus on transparent recycling services. Everywhere Apparel supports businesses in their sustainability journey by providing environmentally conscious clothing solutions made entirely in the USA, featuring innovative recycling programs including a QR code tracking system.

Name: Tenet
Description: Tenet is a financial technology platform focused on accelerating the energy transition by providing innovative, digital financing solutions for electric vehicles (EVs). The company works with mission-aligned financial institutions to offer fast, affordable, and fully-digital EV financing options for consumers and businesses nationwide. Their marketplace aims to make sustainable choices economically attractive, providing scalable access to high-quality ESG assets for institutional investors. Founded by professionals with experience at leading tech and financial companies, Tenet's mission is to build a financial system that supports climate-positive initiatives.

Name: Ebb Carbon
Description: Ebb Carbon is an innovative climate technology company developing a groundbreaking carbon removal solution using electrochemical ocean alkalinity enhancement. Their method leverages the ocean's natural ability to safely store CO2, offering a scalable and cost-effective approach to reducing atmospheric carbon and mitigating ocean acidification. Operating across the United States, Canada, and Europe, the company aims to provide one of the most promising large-scale carbon removal technologies, with potential significant benefits for marine ecosystems and global climate mitigation efforts.

Name: Greenfield Robotics
Description: Greenfield Robotics is an agricultural technology company focused on developing robotic solutions for row crop farming. Their mission is to create sustainable and economical farming practices by introducing innovative robotics technology. The company aims to transform agricultural processes by providing chemical-free farming solutions that capture carbon and support regenerative agricultural practices.

Name: Uviquity
Description: Uviquity is a deep tech startup specializing in semiconductor and photonics technology that develops innovative far-UVC light disinfection solutions. The company creates proprietary semiconductor chips that generate human-safe, pathogen-eliminating light capable of disinfecting air, food, and water. Their technology effectively inactivates viruses, bacteria, fungi, and mold across various environments including hospitals, food service centers, and public spaces. Based in Research Triangle Park, NC, Uviquity aims to improve environmental safety through advanced light technology that can be integrated into existing systems.

Name: Spadxtech
Description: SpadXTech is a sustainable materials technology company that engineers innovative, nature-derived materials using microbes and synthetic biology. The company focuses on creating high-performance, circular materials designed to reduce pollution and greenhouse gas emissions. Their proprietary biotechnology combines green fermentation techniques to produce materials suitable for various applications including insulation, filtration, and apparel. SpadXTech is committed to building a sustainable world by developing innovative materials that align with circular economy principles.

Name: GenoTwin
Description: GenoTwin is a next-generation genomics platform founded at Columbia University, specializing in combining genomics expertise with data science to provide advanced research insights. The company has published over 100 high-impact publications, focusing on innovative approaches to genomic research and analysis.

Name: Xsphera Biosciences Inc
Description: Xsphera Biosciences is a biotechnology company focused on revolutionizing oncology drug development through an innovative ex vivo platform. Leveraging cloud computing and AI-driven analytics, the company uses human tissue samples to create microfluidic devices that capture tumor microenvironments. Their platform enables precise drug testing by integrating complex multi-omic response data, allowing researchers to study therapeutic responses with greater accuracy than traditional in vivo mouse models. The technology aims to reduce clinical trial failure rates by providing deeper insights into drug mechanisms and patient-specific treatment responses.

Name: Downtown.AI
Description: Downtown.AI is a technology company that disrupts urban mobility and traffic management through advanced machine learning and location data analytics. Their platform leverages millions of anonymized mobile device locations to analyze and predict human movements across various transportation modes in cities. The company provides predictive analytics for mobility services, transportation authorities, and automotive manufacturers, helping them optimize operations, forecast customer demand, improve urban planning, and support autonomous vehicle navigation. Based in Vancouver and Palo Alto, Downtown.AI generates visualized traffic patterns by correlating location data with weather, events, census information, and road infrastructure.

Name: Better Ion
Description: Better-Ion, specializes in designing advanced 3D printing solutions tailored specifically for the research community. Our 3D printers are engineered to meet the unique needs of academic and scientific research, enabling precise, reliable, and innovative outputs for complex projects. With a commitment to quality , customization, and cutting-edge technology, we empower researchers to push the boundaries of their work and achieve breakthrough results.

Name: Memcus
Description: Memcus is an early-stage R&D cybersecurity startup based in Cambridge, MA, focusing on advanced technology development in quantum cryptography, semiconductor AI memory, and blockchain systems. The company specializes in creating custom AI-powered chips and quantum computing technologies with applications across multiple industries including cybersecurity, finance, energy infrastructure, healthcare, and telecommunications. Their primary market focus is developing ultra-secure management solutions for energy grid infrastructure and financial transaction security using innovative hardware semiconductor devices and quantum technology.

Name: Scroobious
Description: Scroobious is a virtual platform designed to connect early-stage founders with investors and partners, focusing on increasing diversity in the startup ecosystem. The platform offers tools like the Pitch it Plan™ (PiP) to help underserved founders create investor-ready pitch decks, access a community of over 1,000 founders, and leverage AI-powered startup discovery. It provides structured guidance for pitch development, storytelling, and aims to break down structural barriers in traditional startup networking.

Name: Interon Laboratories, Inc.
Description: Interon Laboratories is a biotechnology company based in Boston, Massachusetts, specializing in neuro-immunology research and therapeutic development. The company focuses on creating treatments for neurological disorders, including Autism Spectrum Disorder, by leveraging an exclusive non-invasive technology developed through research collaborations with MIT and Harvard Medical School. Their innovative approach combines neurobiology and immunology to develop biologics and small molecule therapeutics targeting neurological and immune system disorders.

Name: AV SPACETECH
Description: AV Space Tech is an innovative space technology company focused on developing advanced power and propulsion systems for space exploration. Their primary focus is creating high-efficiency nuclear propulsion technologies that enable deeper space travel and more significant orbital operations. The company aims to push the boundaries of space exploration by providing cutting-edge propulsion solutions that can help companies and organizations achieve more ambitious space missions with improved technological capabilities.

Name: Obatala Sciences
Description: Obatala Sciences is a biotechnology research company founded in 2017, specializing in contract research services and innovative research products for medical and academic laboratories. Their expertise spans obesity, diabetes, energy metabolism, musculoskeletal biology, and wound healing. The company offers unique research tools like ObaCell™, a specialized fat tissue model for disease modeling and drug screening. Clients include pharmaceutical companies, government entities, research organizations, and academic institutions. Committed to advancing medical research, Obatala Sciences provides comprehensive data services in proteomics, genomics, and cell biology, with a focus on creating accurate human tissue research models.

Name: IOSight
Description: IOSight is a leading data management and analytics solutions provider specializing in the utilities sector, particularly water and energy industries. With over 100 global installations, the company offers advanced analytics platforms like iGreen that collect, process, and analyze data to provide real-time insights. Their solutions focus on water quality monitoring, operational optimization, anomaly detection, and regulatory compliance, with specialized modules such as iShed for watershed monitoring and decision support systems for water treatment plants.

Name: Aepnus Technology
Description: Aepnus Technology is an innovative chemical manufacturing technology company dedicated to electrifying and decarbonizing industrial chemical production processes. Their core technology uses electricity, preferably from renewable sources, to convert sulfate salts into metal hydroxides and concentrated sulfuric acid through electrolysis. Particularly focused on lithium mining, battery recycling, and cathode active materials processing, the company aims to reduce waste, secure domestic supply chains, and improve operational efficiency for manufacturers by providing a scalable, low-CAPEX, and energy-efficient alternative to conventional chemical procurement methods.

Name: LiBAMA
Description: libama is an early-stage startup with sbir/sttr supports from nsf and dod to develop and commercialize next-generation lithium metal batteries. originated out of the ancient chinese legend of yu the great in his taming of the great flood, libama's bi-functional advanced metal anode (ama) is the perfect hybrid of graphite, lithium metal and 3d electrode technologies. unlike other band-aid, patched-up methods for lithium metal, ama provides a fundamental structural-based solution for dangerous lithium dendrite and its associated problems through mechanical, thermodynamic and kinetic factors. it promises extremely high energy density, low cost and safety, while cycle life is being steadily improved with structure, component and operation optimization. it is a drop-in replacement anode for the assembly of full batteries, and can be combined with common cathodes, separators and electrolytes, including solid electrolyte. the ama based rechargeable lithium batteries will provide unprecedented mobile power for smart phones, notebooks, tablets, electric vehicles (evs) and drones / electric airplanes. with your investment, guidance and our endless efforts, libama will completely disrupt the anode industry for secondary lithium battery as we know it today and grow into a $10b company in 10 years.

Name: Sunchem
Description: Sunchem is a nanotechnology organization based at Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory specializing in innovative metal separation technologies. The company develops advanced Nano Leach and Nano Filter solutions for precision extraction of critical metals from waste and wastewater. Their technology addresses global water contamination challenges by providing cost-effective, energy-efficient methods for improving water quality and capturing valuable metal resources. Sunchem's solutions target high-value markets including water purification, energy, and critical metal extraction, with a mission to revolutionize metal sourcing and protect communities from toxic water pollution.

Name: nanopathdx
Description: Nanopath is a molecular diagnostics company focused on women's health, developing an innovative point-of-care diagnostic platform. Their technology aims to revolutionize disease diagnosis by providing granular, clinically actionable information within a single office visit. The company is committed to improving healthcare accessibility and equity by partnering with healthcare providers to deliver scalable diagnostic solutions specifically designed to address women's health challenges.

Name: Innotech Precision Medicine
Description: InnoTech Precision Medicine is a healthcare technology company dedicated to revolutionizing disease diagnosis, with a particular focus on cancer, especially head and neck cancer. The company develops advanced molecular diagnostic solutions that combine cutting-edge technology with engineering to provide rapid, accurate, and accessible multimodal diagnostic platforms. Their mission is to empower patients and healthcare providers by delivering personalized, user-friendly diagnostic tools that improve treatment outcomes and accessibility.

Name: Trillium Renewable Chemicals
Description: Trillium Renewable Chemicals is a sustainable chemical technology company developing innovative processes to manufacture green chemical intermediates like acrylonitrile and acetonitrile from renewable feedstocks such as glycerol. By replacing traditional oil and gas-derived chemicals with bio-based alternatives, the company helps customers meet sustainability goals. Their drop-in replacement molecules have wide-ranging applications in industries including apparel, automotive, toys, sporting goods, and water treatment, focusing on reducing carbon emissions and providing safer, cost-effective chemical solutions.

Name: Electrified Thermal Solutions
Description: Electrified Thermal Solutions | Joule Hive | United States

Name: Solarea Bio
Description: Solarea Bio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company based in Cambridge, MA, focused on developing microbiome-based solutions for inflammatory diseases. Founded in 2017, the company leverages genomic and bioinformatic tools to mine novel microbial strains from fruits and vegetables. Solarea's innovative approach involves identifying synergistic combinations of microbes and prebiotic plant fibers to create products addressing health challenges, with current research targeting conditions like rheumatoid arthritis and psoriatic arthritis through clinical trials and preclinical testing.

Name: Mineral Forecast
Description: Mineral Forecast is a geosciences AI platform that enhances mining exploration and management through advanced data analytics. The platform provides intelligent insights for drilling and exploration, utilizing artificial intelligence to improve discovery rates and optimize existing mining sites. Key capabilities include a Geo Insights Hub for data visualization, an AI Advisor for identifying high-value deposits, and analytics supporting both greenfield and brownfield exploration campaigns. The solution aims to increase drilling efficiency, accelerate resource discovery, and reduce costs associated with traditional mining operations.

Name: MicroEra Power
Description: MicroEra Power is an energy technology company developing THERMAplus, an innovative Thermal Energy Storage system for commercial buildings. Their solution uses smart software and Phase Change Materials to provide low-cost, low-carbon heating and cooling by leveraging off-peak energy. The system enables building owners to store surplus renewable energy, reduce energy costs up to 50%, and enhance grid efficiency. Designed for commercial and campus energy systems, MicroEra Power's technology supports the transition to renewable energy by providing a flexible energy management tool with environmental benefits and economic advantages.

Name: Heat Inverse
Description: Heat Inverse develops innovative cooling technologies focused on passive cooling solutions using thin-film technology. The company creates zero-energy input cooling materials designed to reduce heat absorption and improve efficiency across multiple industries. Their CoolFilm technology can be applied to various applications including refrigerated trucking, transformers, battery energy storage systems, food production, and electric vehicles. The company's mission is to revolutionize cooling technologies and reduce greenhouse gas emissions by providing an environmentally friendly cooling solution that can be easily integrated into different sectors.

Name: N.O.V.A. Hydrogen Solutions
Description: NOVA Hydrogen Solutions is a renewable energy company specializing in hydrogen and solar battery systems designed to support sustainable energy solutions. The company provides reliable battery systems for various vehicles including cars, trucks, and electric vehicles, with a focus on enabling zero-carbon power generation. Their technology aims to deliver independent and environmentally friendly energy solutions through hydrogen fuel cells and solar technologies, supporting the transition to renewable energy infrastructure.

Name: Corvus Robotics
Description: Corvus Robotics develops autonomous drone technology for warehouse inventory management, providing fully self-navigating drones that scan, count, and track inventory without human intervention. Their innovative solution enables warehouses to achieve near-perfect inventory accuracy, reduce manual counting efforts, and gain real-time visibility into inventory levels. Designed for various industries including manufacturing, retail, and logistics, the system uses AI-driven navigation to autonomously scan pallet labels and provide comprehensive inventory tracking, helping businesses optimize their supply chain operations.

Name: Hyfé Foods
Description: Hyfé is a sustainable biotechnology company that transforms food processing waste streams into high-value chemical intermediates and specialty materials. Using advanced fungal fermentation technologies, the company upcycles water byproducts from food manufacturers to create sustainable chemicals, materials, and potential food ingredients. Their innovative process reduces carbon footprint, promotes circular economy principles, and generates valuable resources for industries including nutraceuticals, personal care, and chemical manufacturing. Hyfé's locally produced, traceable products aim to make sustainable bioproducts economically competitive with traditional carbon-intensive alternatives.

Name: ReynKo
Description: ReynKo is a technology company focused on addressing complex challenges in turbulent fluid flows through innovative software, modeling, and hardware solutions. Founded by CEO Justin Beroz, the company has developed a unique physical theory for turbulent fluids that aims to resolve longstanding technical problems. Their solutions target industries including petroleum, chemicals, and energy, with a focus on optimizing fluid dynamics to enhance energy efficiency and improve industrial processes through advanced computational technologies.

Name: Pecos Wind Power
Description: Pecos Wind Power is a renewable energy technology company that designs, manufactures, and sells wind turbines for distributed generation. Specializing in the PW85 turbine optimized for low wind speeds, the company aims to make wind power more accessible to schools, businesses, towns, and various institutions. Their innovative approach focuses on reducing turbine levelized cost of electricity, increasing capacity factors, and providing financially viable renewable energy solutions for commercial, industrial, utility, agricultural, and community applications.

Name: Polarisrenewables
Description: Polaris Renewables is developing proprietary technology for the production of fully renewable non-isocyanate polyurethanes (NIPUs) for use in foams, coatings, and adhesives with the fashion industry chosen as the initial target market. This technology eliminates the use of toxic petrochemical isocyanates which provides significant sustainability advantages. The cost of production is comparable to commercial polyurethanes and manufacturing should require little or no changes to existing facilities . www.PolarisRenewables.com

Name: LactaLogics
Description: LactaLogics is a healthcare technology company specializing in human milk-based nutrition for premature and at-risk infants. They provide innovative solutions including 100% human milk products, ready-to-feed formulations, and a patented Pouch-to-Nipple Connector that enables efficient sharing of breast milk. Founded in 2012, the company addresses a critical need in neonatal care by connecting mothers with excess milk to infants in hospital NICUs, utilizing advanced technology to ensure safe, precise milk delivery and minimize waste.

Name: eXaer Carbon
Description: Exaer Carbon is a technology company focused on converting greenhouse gases (GHGs) into advanced structural materials. The company develops innovative solutions for transforming environmental pollutants into valuable industrial resources, contributing to carbon reduction and sustainable materials development.

Name: harmony baby nutrition
Description: Harmony Baby Nutrition is a food-tech company revolutionizing infant formula by developing the first human breast milk-based alternative to traditional cow's milk formulas. Using biotechnology and precision fermentation, they produce hypoallergenic, non-GMO infant nutrition that closely mimics human breast milk. Their innovative approach addresses the limitations of existing formulas, particularly for the 17% of newborns with cow's milk allergies. By extracting and reproducing human breast milk components, Harmony creates a more natural, allergen-free nutrition solution that provides babies with a healthier, more digestible formula option.

Name: Aeternal Upcycling
Description: Aeternal Upcycling is a sustainability-focused company that transforms single-use plastic waste into valuable products through innovative recycling technologies. Using patented hydrogenolysis processes, the company converts plastic waste into high-value chemical goods such as waxes, surfactants, lubricants, packaging, cosmetics, and home goods. Their mission is to reduce fossil fuel dependence, increase sustainability, and improve the circular carbon economy by preventing plastic waste from ending up in landfills or incineration, with a goal of recycling up to 95% of processed plastic materials.

Name: Biocurie
Description: BioCurie is an AI-driven biopharma technology company that specializes in transforming cell and gene therapy manufacturing. Using advanced artificial intelligence, the company aims to enhance the development and production of lifesaving therapies by improving efficiency and reducing costs. Their innovative approach empowers biopharma companies to accelerate and optimize the production of complex medical treatments through intelligent, data-driven decision-making processes.

Name: ZILA Works
Description: ZILA BioWorks is an innovative biomaterials company that develops sustainable bio-epoxy resins derived from industrial hemp. Their patented technology creates eco-friendly materials with superior performance for various industries, including outdoor recreational equipment, floor coatings, and industrial composites. The company focuses on creating high-performance, low-carbon materials that offer environmental benefits by reducing toxins, capturing carbon, and providing economic advantages to farmers through hemp seed oil utilization.

Name: cheMastery Group
Description: CheMastery is a technology company revolutionizing chemical research and manufacturing through advanced robotic automation. Their platform automates up to 90% of chemical laboratory processes, enhancing efficiency, reproducibility, and knowledge retention across scientific and industrial applications. By developing infrastructure that standardizes chemical workflows, CheMastery aims to empower scientists, improve research productivity, and make advanced technological solutions more accessible to businesses in biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, and related industries.

Name: Acel Power
Description: ACEL Power is a Canadian manufacturer specializing in electric outboard motors for boats, committed to sustainable maritime technology. Based in Vancouver, the company designs and engineers intelligent electric propulsion systems for the marine industry. Their product line includes electric motors for both domestic and international markets, focusing on low-maintenance, environmentally friendly solutions. ACEL Power aims to advance carbon-neutral maritime technologies by providing innovative electric comprehensive systems, software, and infrastructure for forward-thinking boat builders, distributors, and marine enthusiasts.

Name: Talkingheadswireless
Description: Talking Heads Wireless develops energy-efficient smart network towers for cellular carriers deploying 5G networks. The company provides innovative technology that significantly reduces power consumption and operational costs for wireless network infrastructure. Their patented solution focuses on optimizing remote radio heads and network tower energy usage, helping carriers meet sustainability goals and reduce greenhouse gas emissions while improving the overall efficiency of 5G network deployments.

Name: Modern Synthesis
Description: Modern Synthesis is a London-based biotechnology company specializing in innovative, sustainable material production. They develop eco-friendly materials using microbes that convert agricultural sugars into customizable textiles and alternatives to traditional fabrics and plastics. The company focuses on creating circular, low-carbon materials for the fashion and textile industries, leveraging biological processes, material science, and engineering. Their key offerings include nanocellulose-based materials designed for sustainability and performance, with applications in clothing, footwear, and accessories.

Name: Glanris Water Systems
Description: Glanris is a climate-tech company that manufactures sustainable biocarbon from agricultural waste, particularly rice husks, using a patented process. Their innovative technology creates a multi-functional filtration media that can remove both organic contaminants and metals from water at a significantly lower cost than traditional methods. The company provides environmentally friendly solutions for water filtration, soil amendment, and carbon dioxide removal, with a mission to create meaningful carbon sequestration globally while generating renewable electricity from their manufacturing process.

Name: Låkril Technologies
Description: Lakril Technologies is a sustainable chemical technology company that develops bio-based alternatives to petrochemicals. The company specializes in creating sustainable acrylic acid and acrylate derivatives using innovative catalyst technology. Their Amber Process enables the production of bio-based chemicals for industries including paints, coatings, adhesives, and superabsorbents, with a primary goal of reducing CO2 emissions and providing cost-competitive, environmentally friendly chemical solutions.

Name: Cellens
Description: Cellens is a Tufts University spinout startup focused on advanced cancer diagnostics using nanoscale imaging and machine learning technologies. The company develops noninvasive cancer detection methods, with a key product called Octosense that can detect cancer cells in bodily fluids by identifying unique physical fingerprints at the nanoscale. Their platform aims to provide more accurate, non-invasive cancer monitoring through advanced biophysical markers, with potential for at-home and mail-in testing capabilities.

Name: Mirá Biotech
Description: Mira Biotech is a biotechnology startup focused on sustainable energy solutions, developing innovative biofuel technologies using proprietary PhytoCy enzymatic processes. The company specializes in creating carbon-neutral biomass pellets, aiming to reduce carbon emissions and promote more environmentally responsible energy production through scalable and cost-effective technological approaches.

Name: Ionic Solutions / ChemFinity
Description: Ionic Solutions is a Calgary-based water technology company that has developed a breakthrough desalination technology called Capacitive Electrodialysis Reversal (C-EDR). Their innovative solution dramatically reduces energy consumption in water desalination, using up to 40 times less energy than traditional reverse osmosis methods. The technology offers high water recovery rates and has potential applications across energy, manufacturing, and agriculture sectors, with a focus on sustainable water treatment, lithium extraction, and addressing global water scarcity challenges.

Name: Natrx
Description: Natrx is a technology platform specializing in nature-based solutions for climate resilience and environmental restoration. The company provides advanced technologies for coastal resilience, offering tools for engineers, contractors, and landowners to address landscape-scale environmental challenges. Key offerings include the Nat Rx platform for identifying and monitoring resilience issues, ExoFormsTM for living shoreline solutions, and a comprehensive Living Shoreline program. Their innovative approach focuses on creating sustainable, cost-effective restoration methods that enhance environmental resilience through technology-driven nature-based interventions.

Name: Shyp
Description: Shyp is a shipping and logistics service that simplifies package delivery for businesses and individuals. The company offers convenient pickup, packaging, and shipping solutions at competitive prices, operating in major metropolitan areas like San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles, and Chicago. Customers can use web and mobile platforms to arrange shipments with minimal hassle.

Name: Current Lab
Description: Current Lab is an oceanography company specializing in high-resolution ocean modeling and forecasting. They provide advanced computational physics models that generate accurate, real-time predictions of tidal currents, wind forces, and maritime conditions. Their services support scientific, defense, and recreational applications, with flow models that have been utilized by professional sailors in major international competitions like the America's Cup and Tokyo Olympics. The company offers web-based forecasts, GRIB file downloads, and produces detailed 3D sound speed data for underwater acoustics research.

Name: GROW Oyster Reefs
Description: Grow Oyster Reefs is a coastal ecosystem restoration company specializing in innovative concrete reef-building technologies. Founded in 2015, the company develops patent-pending substrate products that enhance oyster reef productivity, improve water quality, and support aquatic ecosystem services. Their biomimetic concrete solutions are used for shoreline protection, carbon sequestration, and marine habitat restoration. Collaborating with scientific institutions and conservation organizations, Grow Oyster Reefs creates customizable products like Reef Tile and Reef Disk to support marine biodiversity and coastal resilience.

Name: Smartville
Description: Smartville is a sustainable energy technology company focused on electric vehicle (EV) battery circularity and reuse. Founded in 2019 and based in Carlsbad, CA, the company develops innovative solutions for assessing, repurposing, and managing EV batteries. Their technologies include Battery Connect system, Smartville 360™ energy storage system, and Smartville Periscope mobile testing kit, which help reduce waste, minimize reliance on foreign supply chains, and support the transition to sustainable transportation through data-driven battery lifecycle management.

Name: Intecells
Description: Intecells is a battery manufacturing technology company based in Troy, Michigan, founded in 2018. The company specializes in developing an innovative plasma-based manufacturing platform for dry electrodes and solid-state batteries. Their breakthrough technology uses a cold-plasma powder coating process to create 3D printable electrodes, promising significant improvements in battery production. Intecells aims to revolutionize battery manufacturing by reducing energy-intensive processes, cutting manufacturing costs by up to 60%, and reducing carbon emissions. Their scalable solution targets multiple industries including e-mobility, energy storage, and consumer electronics, with a focus on improving battery energy density, charging speed, and safety.

Name: South 8 Technologies
Description: South 8 Technologies is a battery technology innovator specializing in liquefied gas electrolyte (LiGas) chemistry for lithium-ion batteries. Their patented technology enables high-performance batteries with exceptional performance in extreme temperatures, operating from -80 to +60°C. The company develops advanced battery solutions for defense, aerospace, automotive, and e-mobility markets, offering improved energy density, safety, and charging capabilities through its unique electrolyte technology developed as a spin-out from UC San Diego.

Name: Ten-Nine Technologies
Description: Ten-Nine Technologies is an innovative materials science company based in Tulsa, Oklahoma, specializing in developing breakthrough materials for energy and chemical industries. Their flagship product, TENIX™, is a proprietary nano additive that dramatically improves battery performance by enhancing cathode efficiency. The company focuses on sustainable, domestically produced powders that can be integrated into manufacturing lines for various battery types, from single-use alkaline cells to rechargeable electric vehicle batteries. Founded in 2014, Ten-Nine aims to transform energy storage technology through advanced material solutions.

Name: Planetary Emissions Management - PEM
Description: Planetary Emissions Management (PEM) is a research and development company based in Cambridge, MA, specializing in greenhouse gas emissions measurement technology. The company develops patented hardware and software tools for real-time CO2 measurements, creating verifiable environmental financial products. Their Global Monitor Platform can track and measure emissions across multiple industries, supporting carbon capture, storage facilities, and providing precise data collection for carbon financial instruments and emissions reporting.

Name: Alex Shalek NewCo (LamplightTx)
Engine Team: Vinny Beranek <vinny@engineventures.com>; Ian Johnston <ian@engine.xyz>; Ann DeWitt <ann@engineventures.com>

Name: Theonys
Description: Theonys is a frontier biotech company founded in 2020 by tRNA pioneers from MIT and Harvard, focusing on leveraging deep insights into gene and protein interactions. The company specializes in reprogramming transfer RNA (tRNA) networks to develop targeted, redosable medicines for complex, multigenic diseases. Their innovative approach aims to restore cellular homeostasis and unlock new treatment paradigms for patients suffering from genetic disorders, including cancer, inflammatory conditions, and rare diseases. Backed by prominent investors like Leaps (Bayer), Xora Innovation, and Alexandria Venture Investments, Theonys is pioneering a novel therapeutic approach in the biotechnology sector.

Name: ThinkGenetic
Description: ThinkGenetic is an award-winning digital health company that uses artificial intelligence to identify individuals at risk of rare genetic conditions. Established in 2015 and headquartered in Virginia, the company develops advanced algorithms to detect patients for evaluation, treatment, and clinical trials. ThinkGenetic collaborates with biopharma companies, research institutions, healthcare systems, and patient advocacy organizations, leveraging AI technology and deep expertise in genetic and rare diseases to provide innovative patient discovery solutions.

Name: Light Bio
Description: we are creating bioluminescent plants for home and garden. our plants glow with perpetual organic light, giving a magical experience of amazement and delight.

Name: Salient Predictions
Description: Salient Predictions is a weather analytics company that provides advanced subseasonal weather forecasting using machine learning and deep learning technologies. The company analyzes complex climate data to generate accurate precipitation and temperature predictions ranging from 3 weeks to 9 months ahead, supporting critical decision-making for industries including agriculture, energy, finance, and supply chain management.

Name: xinterratech
Description: Xinterra is a materials innovation company that accelerates materials research and development using an AI-driven platform called Xinterra Design Factory (XDF). Combining artificial intelligence, high-throughput experimentation, and materials science expertise, the company develops sustainable materials for various applications. Their business model focuses on manufacturing and commercializing innovative materials, with a particular emphasis on creating solutions like CO2 removal materials through advanced research and development techniques.

Name: URB-E
Description: URB-E is a mobility solutions company based in Pasadena, California, specializing in innovative last-mile delivery and urban transportation. The company develops compact, pedal-powered delivery containers designed to replace traditional truck-based logistics in urban environments. By offering efficient, environmentally-friendly delivery solutions, URB-E serves major retailers and e-commerce companies, enabling faster and cleaner urban logistics. Their technology focuses on creating space-saving, maneuverable delivery containers that can navigate crowded city streets more effectively than traditional transportation methods.

Name: Piction Health
Description: Piction Health is a telemedicine platform specializing in dermatological care, leveraging AI and expert dermatologists to provide virtual consultations for various skin, hair, and nail conditions. Patients can receive personalized care plans within 24-48 hours, with services covering treatments for acne, eczema, psoriasis, and skin rejuvenation. The platform offers online check-ins, flexible scheduling, and uses computer vision technology to enable remote skin condition evaluations at an expert level, allowing patients to access top-tier dermatological care from the comfort of their home.

Name: Huue
Description: Huue is a biotechnology company that specializes in creating sustainable dyes, with a primary focus on producing environmentally friendly indigo blue for the denim industry. Founded on UC Berkeley bioengineering research, the company uses innovative microbe-based biotechnology to convert sugar into natural dyes, significantly reducing the toxic potential of traditional indigo production. Supported by investors like IndieBio and Fashion for Good, Huue aims to revolutionize sustainable textile manufacturing by offering an eco-friendly alternative to petroleum-based dye production that minimizes environmental impact.

Name: Zing
Description: Zing Drone Solutions is a drone technology company focused on compliance, detection, and airspace security solutions. The company develops products including the Z-RID Lite remote ID broadcast module for FAA and EASA regulatory compliance, and the Z.SCAN system for detecting unauthorized drones using RF scanning technology. Zing provides tailored solutions for airports, government buildings, logistics, education, and public safety sectors to ensure safe drone operations. The company also offers drone detection services and compliance products to enhance airspace security in critical areas, helping communities and organizations maintain safer skies through advanced drone monitoring and identification technologies.

Name: Tensixty
Description: TenSixty Bio is a biotechnology company dedicated to developing innovative cancer therapies through a biology-first approach. The company utilizes advanced technologies like machine learning and sophisticated cell models to create a comprehensive database of antibody targets on cancer cell surfaces. By combining high-throughput experiments and cutting-edge data analysis, TenSixty Bio aims to transform oncology research and develop more effective therapeutic strategies for cancer treatment.

Name: Quino Energy
Description: Quino Energy is a technology company developing innovative aqueous flow battery solutions using specially designed quinone-based reactants dissolved in water. Licensed from Harvard University, their battery technology offers cost-effective energy storage for grid resiliency applications, ranging from residential to large solar farm scales. The batteries are made from low-cost coal and wood tar, feature ultralow capacity degradation, and can be deployed in areas with fire risks where conventional lithium-ion batteries are unsuitable. Their solution aims to support renewable energy storage and grid stability with a sustainable, scalable approach.

Name: Foundation Alloy
Description: Foundation Alloy is an advanced metal manufacturing company that specializes in innovative alloy design and production technologies. Leveraging proprietary metallurgy processes developed through collaborations with MIT and UC Irvine, the company creates high-performance metal parts with superior mechanical properties. Their advanced manufacturing approach eliminates traditional melting processes, reducing energy consumption and production time. Targeting industries including automotive, aerospace, and defense, Foundation Alloy provides scalable, efficient metal fabrication solutions with enhanced durability and performance. The company is backed by venture capital firms like The Engine, Material Impact, and Safar Partners.

Name: Zulu Pods
Description: Zulu Pods Inc. is an engineering company specializing in innovative fluid delivery systems, focusing on developing advanced lubrication solutions for mechanical applications. Their technology simplifies engine architecture by creating self-contained units that reduce weight, cost, and complexity while improving performance, with particular applications in military and aerospace industries.

Name: The Live Green Co
Description: The Live Green Co is a technology-driven company focused on developing innovative plant-based food solutions using artificial intelligence and advanced research. Their proprietary Charaka platform leverages big data, AI, and machine learning to research and develop clean, functional ingredients for the food, nutraceutical, and healthcare industries. The company aims to create sustainable, natural alternatives to synthetic food additives, aligning with UN Sustainable Development Goals and using technology to accelerate plant-based food research and development.

Name: wild.
Description: Wild is an emerging technology company in the electric vehicle industry, focusing on innovative solutions for electric mobility and charging systems. The company develops technologies aimed at improving transportation efficiency and safety, with a particular emphasis on electric vehicle charging solutions designed to enhance cargo transport and reduce operational costs in the transportation sector.

Name: ReMo Energy, Inc
Description: ReMo Energy develops distributed-scale green ammonia plants that utilize renewable energy to produce nitrogen fertilizers. The company addresses food security and climate change challenges by creating ammonia production facilities that use only renewable electricity, air, and water. Their innovative technology optimizes plant design and electrolyzer integration, enabling lower energy costs and reduced emissions compared to traditional ammonia production methods.

Name: GreenBlu
Description: An innovative technology company specializing in sustainable mineral extraction from seawater, with a focus on developing decarbonized magnesium production using renewable energy and brine sources. Founded by physicists, the company has developed patented technologies to extract magnesium from seawater without generating waste, aiming to provide a competitive and environmentally friendly metal production method. Their approach supports the energy transition by creating low-carbon magnesium crucial for industries like automotive, defense, and renewable energy technologies.

Name: Limax Biosciences
Description: Limax Biosciences is a biotechnology company developing advanced biomaterials, specifically innovative hydrogel-based tissue adhesive technologies for medical applications. Their patent-protected platform creates high-performance hydrogel adhesives that offer superior wet tissue adhesion, stretchability, and biocompatibility. The company aims to revolutionize healthcare treatments by providing solutions for tissue healing, surgical procedures, and localized drug delivery, with technologies that address current limitations in hemostatic dressings and surgical sealants.

Name: Modularity Space
Description: Modularity Space is an innovative technology company specializing in wireless connectivity and reusable space systems. Their solutions include machine-to-cloud connectivity platforms that provide secure wireless connections for equipment and smart systems across industries like aerospace and industrial automation. The company develops modular, reusable satellite technologies and offers comprehensive connectivity solutions that enable remote monitoring, system integration, and operational insights.

Name: Nebula Compute, Inc.
Description: NEXT is a space technology company specializing in high-performance cloud computing for space operations. They are developing ServerSats (Space Operations and Computing Services) to provide data infrastructure for government, aerospace, and scientific research sectors. The company focuses on cybersecurity, efficient service delivery, and sustainable operations, with plans to launch the first commercial server to operate on the exterior of the International Space Station.
