Description: Yok

Name: Athena
Description: Athena Integrated Systems is a technology company focused on developing tools for sustainable resource management in heavy industries. Their mission is to enable more efficient decision-making through advanced robotics and smart data solutions. The company aims to redefine industrial operations by providing technological insights that support more sustainable and intelligent resource utilization across various industrial sectors.

Name: Quaxys
Description: Quaxys is an educational technology platform focused on training engineers in advanced technical fields, including quantum computing, microwave and RF engineering, radio astronomy, and microwave plasma technology. Founded in 2020 and located in Maryland, the company offers self-paced online curriculum combined with hands-on exercises and a specialized Quaxys Kit. Their platform provides training, custom RF design, cloud-based RF testing services, and supports career development for hardware professionals through practical, skills-based learning experiences.

Name: Felix Biotechnology
Description: Felix Biotechnology is a cutting-edge biotech research company collaborating with leading universities like Yale and UC Berkeley. The company is focused on developing innovative biotherapeutics to address critical microbial challenges in human health. Their primary mission is to create programmable therapies aimed at combating the growing threat of antimicrobial resistance, leveraging advanced scientific research to develop novel therapeutic solutions that can potentially transform approaches to managing microbial diseases.

Name: Cbiochar Enr.
Description: Biochar is a sustainable technology focused on carbon dioxide removal and environmental preservation. The company develops biochar solutions that enhance food security by creating renewable energy sources and removing carbon dioxide from the atmosphere. Their approach is designed to be straightforward and accessible, supported by certified professionals in the carbon removal and sustainable energy sectors.

Name: Siphox
Description: SiPhox is a next-generation biosensing platform developing advanced diagnostic technologies. Founded in 2020, the company specializes in creating handheld devices with disposable cartridges capable of multiplexing multiple biomarkers on a single silicon photonic chip. Their technology enables highly sensitive readouts of immunoassays and RNA/DNA tests, with the goal of bringing sophisticated laboratory-grade testing capabilities into portable, cost-effective formats. The company leverages extensive experience in optical chip technology to translate cutting-edge research into practical, mass-producible diagnostic solutions for point-of-care and at-home health monitoring.

Name: Labby
Description: Labby is an innovative food technology company developing AI-powered spectrometer solutions for rapid and accurate food testing. Founded by scientists from top institutions like MIT and Harvard, the company offers portable devices that transform smartphones into advanced food and beverage analytics laboratories. Their key product enables real-time testing solutions, particularly for dairy farms, using optical sensing and machine learning to analyze milk composition, detect mastitis, and provide instant nutritional insights. Labby's technology aims to revolutionize food testing by offering fast, affordable, and accessible solutions for consumers and businesses across various industrial applications.

Name: Uniphage
Description: Uniphage aims to become a leader in curing fungal and bacterial diseases across agriculture and beyond. Our first goal is to reduce the use of dangerous fungicides, bactericides, and antibiotics in plant agriculture by developing significantly safer and more efficient microbe-based alternatives. Our current R&D program is focused on curing citrus greening disease, a bacterial disease crumbling the US citrus industry, and developing novel microbe-based solutions to cure fungal diseases. - NSF SBIR Phase I - Plug&Play Agritech Accelerator - MassChallenge US, Summer 2021 - MassChallenge DoD-sponsored track - MassChallenge & IBM AI Program - Halcyon Fellow - Panacea Stars Develop SS2021, Oxford University - Project Enginuity, fall 2021 (SBIR Accelerator) - Hangar Incubator by the National University of Singapore - iGEM Venture Creation Lab - Winner and Finalist in a range of startup competitions & Extensive non-dilutive funding recipient - The most accurate & precise deep learning model to date to predict phages (safe viruses infecting bacteria only) to kill target bacterial pathogens

Name: coflowjet
Description: CoFlow Jet is an aerospace technology company developing innovative active flow control systems for enhancing aircraft efficiency and sustainability. Specializing in coflow jet (CFJ) technology, the company focuses on creating advanced solutions for electric VTOL and STOL aircraft that improve aerodynamic performance, reduce noise, and minimize fossil fuel consumption. Based in Miami, Florida, the company has multiple patents and aims to transform aviation through cutting-edge technology applicable to aerospace, wind energy, and marine transportation sectors.

Name: Ocean Minerals
Description: Ocean Minerals is a sustainable deep-sea resource development company focused on mining polymetallic nodules in the Cook Islands. The organization aims to responsibly extract critical minerals that support the transition to low-carbon technologies while minimizing environmental impact. Utilizing world-class technology and expertise, the company is committed to creating long-term value through responsible ocean resource exploration, with a particular emphasis on sustainable practices and supporting global mineral needs.

Name: Next Generation Quantum
Description: Next Generation Quantum (NGQ) is a technology company specializing in quantum computing interconnection solutions. The company develops systems to link multiple quantum computers into a single network, enabling enhanced computational capabilities for data centers and tech companies. Their technology aims to provide significant computational acceleration and dramatically reduce energy consumption, supporting advanced applications in artificial intelligence, finance, cybersecurity, and biotechnology.

Name: NUMiX MATERIALS
Description: Numix is an innovative materials technology company that develops advanced sorbent solutions for heavy metal removal from aqueous streams. Their proprietary technology offers ten times greater efficiency in metal extraction compared to competing methods, reducing water treatment additives and hazardous waste by up to 95%. The company provides critical metal recovery solutions that enhance water treatment processes, minimize operational costs, and support environmental sustainability efforts.

Name: Impossible Mining
Description: Impossible Metals is a sustainable deep-sea mining technology startup focused on responsible mineral extraction using robotic systems. The company's core mission is environmental preservation, utilizing the Eureka II robotic collection system to harvest critical metals from the seabed while minimizing marine habitat destruction. Their approach emphasizes technological innovation to support a green, circular economy by developing more sustainable methods of mineral extraction that prioritize environmental protection and responsible resource management.

Name: Drut Technlogies
Description: Drut Technologies is an early-stage data center solutions company developing innovative software-defined resource management systems. Their technology enables dynamic attachment and detachment of computing resources, focusing on overcoming legacy data center deployment limitations. The company offers products like the Drut Fabric Manager and 2500 Series workstations, providing advanced photonic fabric technology for AI and high-performance computing applications. Their solutions aim to enhance infrastructure performance, reduce costs, and improve operational efficiency for cloud service providers and enterprise customers.

Name: Arkam
Description: Arkam is a technology company specializing in automated UV-C disinfection solutions for various sectors including healthcare, commercial offices, public transport, and sports facilities. Their innovative products eliminate 99.99% of viruses and bacteria using ultraviolet light, providing a sustainable and chemical-free alternative to traditional disinfection methods. The company offers smart, programmable disinfection systems with online management, real-time tracking, and monitoring capabilities, focusing on creating efficient and environmentally friendly sanitation solutions.

Name: Vertimass
Description: Vertimass is a California-based biotechnology company focused on developing innovative biofuel technologies that convert renewable ethanol into sustainable transportation fuels and chemicals. Their proprietary technology aims to expand ethanol production from multiple biomass sources, reduce greenhouse gas emissions, and improve energy security. The company develops breakthrough solutions to overcome current limitations in ethanol production, targeting new markets in aviation, heavy-duty vehicles, and chemical industries. By licensing advanced technologies, Vertimass seeks to create low-cost sustainable fuel alternatives that can be integrated into existing facilities.

Name: Aixscalephotonics
Description: uniquely enabled by waferscale precision glass molding technology, aixscale photonics supplies proprietary ultra-high precision optical glass interposer solutions for reliable, low loss and cost effective assembly of transceiver optical subassemblies and co-packaged optics. we serve the needs of current and next generation high-volume datacom and telecom applications. want to make your custom photonic integrated circuit (pic) a plug & play device? we provide scalable and low cost optical interfacing to a standard mpo connector. aixscale photonics was founded in 2017 by jeremy witzens and florian merget as a spin-off from the institute of integrated photonics of rwth aachen university, germany.

Name: BamCore
Description: BamCore is a sustainable building materials manufacturer specializing in innovative, carbon-negative structural framing systems for commercial and residential low-rise construction. Their Prime Wall™ technology utilizes engineered bamboo to create customizable, code-compliant framing solutions that dramatically improve energy efficiency, reduce thermal bridging, and minimize construction time and job site waste. The company's mission is to decarbonize the built environment by leveraging rapidly renewable, deforestation-free materials and advanced industrialized construction technologies.

Name: Engora
Description: Engora.tech is an AI-driven platform designed to simplify and streamline product data management for manufacturing and distribution companies. The platform uses artificial intelligence to reduce complexity in product catalogs and data sheets, enabling users to more efficiently manage technical information. By automating and simplifying product data processes, Engora.tech helps companies save time and focus on more strategic aspects of their business operations.

Name: Prezerv Technologies
Description: A technology services provider offering ground-penetrating radar (GPR) technologies and scalable solutions for businesses. The company specializes in providing flexible technological services that support infrastructure and underground mapping capabilities.

Name: Neurovation Labs
Description: Neurovation Labs is a biotechnology company dedicated to developing precision neuromodulators for treating brain-related disorders, with an initial focus on Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD). The company leverages advanced neuroscience and receptor biology research to develop innovative diagnostic and treatment solutions. Their research platform aims to identify root causes of mental health disorders, with a particular emphasis on creating a molecular diagnostic and companion targeted treatment for PTSD. Founded in 2016, the company is at the forefront of transforming psychiatric disorder diagnosis and treatment through cutting-edge biomarker discovery and therapeutic technologies.

Name: Ocean-Based Climate Solutions
Description: Ocean-based Climate Solutions is a climate technology company that develops Autonomous Upwelling Pumps (AUPs) to address carbon removal and ocean ecosystem restoration. Founded in 2018 as a spinoff of Atmocean, Inc., the company leverages renewable wave energy to fertilize phytoplankton and remove CO2 from the atmosphere. Their technology aims to help corporations and governments meet climate goals by creating a carbon-negative solution that enhances marine biomass. The company has conducted extensive ocean and wave tank testing across multiple global locations and has received grants from national laboratories and wave energy trusts.

Name: Coralgenomics
Description: Coral Genomics is a precision medicine company founded in 2018 in San Francisco that leverages genomic data to improve drug development and deployment. The company generates novel datasets to address gaps in biobanks, focusing on clinical diagnostics that facilitate medication selection for diverse populations. By integrating molecular, functional, and clinical factors, Coral provides end-to-end precision medicine support, including next-generation sequencing and patient/provider healthcare reports. The company is distinguished by its extensive diverse database that functionally associates genetic variation with clinical outcomes, enabling more personalized and efficient healthcare delivery.

Name: Mantel
Description: Mantel is an innovative carbon capture technology company developing a unique molten-salt based solution for reducing industrial emissions. Their technology operates at high temperatures in boilers, kilns, and furnaces, enabling highly efficient carbon capture across various sectors including natural gas, bioenergy, and renewable energy. By reducing energy losses by over 60% and cutting costs in half, Mantel's solution aims to help industries achieve net-zero emissions and support global climate goals.

Name: Planetarians
Description: Planetarians is a food technology company that transforms unavoidable food industry side streams into sustainable, affordable protein alternatives. Using a patented process, they convert spent yeast from beer fermentation and spent beans from soybean oil production into a nutritious protein ingredient that is 10x cheaper than beef. Founded in 2013 and headquartered in San Francisco, the company produces vegan, gluten-free protein products with a significantly reduced carbon footprint. Their technology aims to address food security by utilizing discarded crop components, creating protein solutions that are allergen-free, nutritionally dense, and environmentally sustainable.

Name: Full Cycle Bioplastics
Description: Full Cycle Bioplastics is a biotech company that converts organic waste into compostable polyhydroxyalkanoate (PHA) biopolymers. Their patent-pending biotechnology produces cost-competitive, high-performance bioplastics that can replace petroleum-based polymers. By licensing their technology to organizations with large waste streams, they help companies generate revenue, reduce waste, lower greenhouse gas emissions, and contribute to a more circular economy through sustainable plastic alternatives.

Name: TriAxia Health
Description: TriAxia Health is a healthcare technology company focused on improving care for patients with rare, complex, and high-impact conditions. Their AI-enabled platform combines longitudinal clinical and administrative data with genomics to support clinical trial recruitment and patient insights. The company provides advanced analytics tools for payers, providers, and life science companies, enabling hypothesis generation for drug targets, patient sub-segmentation, and creation of virtual control groups for clinical studies.

Name: Trillbit Inc
Description: Trillbit is a Boston-based technology startup specializing in innovative authentication solutions using Data-over-Sound technology. As a member of the FIDO Alliance, the company provides software solutions that enable secure, passwordless authentication for people and devices across multiple industries. Their proximity intelligence platform allows communication between devices using ultrasonic sound waves, supporting multi-factor authentication and offering integration through developer portals and SDKs.

Name: Deep Isolation
Description: Deep Isolation is an innovative nuclear waste disposal technology company that offers a safe, cost-effective solution for securing spent nuclear fuel. Using advanced horizontal drilling technology, the company proposes storing nuclear waste deep underground in geologically stable rock formations. Founded in 2016, their approach emphasizes safety, environmental stewardship, and community engagement. Deep Isolation's patented method allows for secure, long-term storage of radioactive waste, potentially creating a pathway for private sector participation in nuclear waste management solutions.

Name: Hydronic Shell Technologies
Description: Hydronic Shell Technologies develops an innovative HVAC and facade system designed to transform building energy efficiency, particularly for multi-family buildings. Their modular system enables deep energy retrofits that can dramatically reduce heating and cooling energy consumption while improving thermal comfort and indoor air quality. The exterior-installed solution minimizes tenant disruption, offers architectural flexibility, and aims to address significant CO2 emissions from buildings through a cost-effective, scalable technology.

Name: Revterra
Description: Revterra is an innovative energy storage technology company developing next-generation kinetic battery systems for grid resilience and electric vehicle charging. Their modular, environmentally friendly system uses patented magnetic bearing technology to convert and store electric energy efficiently. Initially targeting rapid EV charging markets, Revterra aims to enable DC-fast charging in areas with weak grid infrastructure, with a first product offering a 400kW/100kWh base unit that can be expanded modularly.

Name: Stemloop
Description: Stemloop is a synthetic biology company that develops advanced biosensors for detecting small molecules across various industries. Their proprietary ROSALIND™ platform enables high-performance molecular sensing by leveraging cell-free synthetic biology techniques. The company creates biosensors capable of detecting molecules ranging from 20 to 2,000 Daltons, with applications in water quality monitoring, food safety, environmental monitoring, and pharmaceutical industries. Stemloop's technology provides real-time chemical data access through cost-effective and scalable biosensing solutions that replace traditional analytical chemistry methods.

Name: LEADOPTIK
Description: Leadoptik is a deep-tech startup based in San Jose, California, specializing in advanced imaging technology for medical diagnostics, particularly lung cancer detection. The company has developed a miniature imaging platform with novel metasurface materials, featuring their proprietary Last Inch Assessment (LIA) Technology. Their solution provides ultra-thin, high-resolution imaging capabilities for minimally invasive procedures, delivering 50 times higher resolution than legacy technologies. Leadoptik aims to improve early cancer detection through AI-powered imaging consoles and innovative single-use probes that enable precise diagnostics and targeted therapeutic interventions.

Name: Tensorfield Agriculture
Description: Tensorfield Agriculture is an innovative agricultural technology company developing next-generation machines for specialty row crop management. Their primary focus is precision weed control using advanced thermal micro-jetting technology. The company's semi-autonomous machines offer organic-approved, low-impact weed treatment with exceptional precision, covering an acre with 1/4 inch accuracy. Developed through research collaborations with universities, their technology represents a forward-looking approach to agricultural machinery design, particularly in a post-herbicide agricultural landscape.

Name: Nia Therapeutics
Description: Nia Therapeutics is developing an advanced neurotechnology platform focused on restoring memory for patients with brain injuries or degenerative diseases. Their Smart Neurostimulation System uses artificial intelligence to create personalized brain stimulation therapies, interpreting individual brain activity patterns to enhance memory encoding. The system involves a neural implant designed to provide targeted stimulation when memory loss is detected, with plans for clinical trials and eventual home use.

Name: Resvitabio
Description: ResVita Bio is a therapeutics company specializing in developing treatments for chronic skin diseases using synthetic biology and engineered skin probiotics. Their innovative platform uses genetically modified bacteria to deliver targeted therapeutic proteins directly to affected skin areas, providing continuous treatment for inflammatory conditions like Netherton Syndrome, atopic dermatitis, psoriasis, acne, and rosacea. By leveraging metabolic engineering, the company aims to restore skin vitality and address the physical and emotional challenges patients face, particularly children, through a safe and versatile microbial platform.

Name: GhostWave
Description: GhostWave is a technology startup developing advanced radar systems with innovative radio frequency technologies. Specializing in pseudo-random RF generators, the company creates radar solutions for unmanned air systems, automotive collision detection, and specialized sensing applications. Their patented technology solves interference problems by using dynamically generated radio frequencies, with key applications in drone technology, vehicle safety systems, and advanced object detection and prioritization.

Name: Southie
Description: Southie Autonomy provides a software platform designed for the contract packaging industry that simplifies robot arm deployment. Their no-code solution enables businesses to easily automate packaging, kitting, and palletization tasks without requiring specialized programming skills. The platform addresses labor shortages by offering a flexible, quick-changeover robotic automation solution that increases productivity in production lines.

Name: RotorX
Description: RotorX is an aerospace engineering company focused on developing autonomous drone technologies. Their primary product, Palledrone, is a heavy-lift unmanned aerial vehicle designed for various applications including research, commercial, humanitarian, and military missions. The company specializes in electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) vehicle development, creating advanced unmanned systems capable of carrying significant payloads.

Name: centeye
Description: Centeye is a Washington, DC-based technology company specializing in developing ultra-compact vision sensors and neuromorphic vision chips for autonomous robotics and IoT applications. The company is known for pioneering lightweight vision technologies for small drones and robotics, creating vision systems that enable GPS-denied navigation, obstacle avoidance, and environmental sensing. Their custom-designed hardware solutions include mixed-signal neuromorphic chips and advanced image processing algorithms, supporting applications in drone autonomy, industrial vision sensing, and emerging IoT technologies.

Name: Rubi Laboratories
Description: Rubi Laboratories is an innovative sustainability technology company that transforms carbon emissions into carbon-neutral cellulosic textiles for the fashion industry. Their patent-pending technology sequesters carbon and produces textiles with minimal environmental impact, removing approximately 10 tons of CO2 per ton of textile produced. The company creates sustainable fabric alternatives that can mimic cotton, linen, silk, and wool, offering fashion brands a scalable solution to meet critical sustainability goals with textiles that are carbon-, water-, and land-neutral.

Name: Endeavor Composites
Description: Endeavor Composites is an innovative manufacturing company in Knoxville, TN specializing in advanced carbon fiber nonwoven fabrics for automotive, aerospace, and maritime industries. The company develops zero-waste, high-performance composite materials using long-fiber production techniques. Their unique technology enables processing of multiple fiber types, including carbon, basalt, Kevlar, and natural fibers, with exceptional quality control. Supported by Department of Energy grants and collaborations with Oak Ridge National Lab and University of Tennessee, Endeavor Composites focuses on sustainable, high-precision composite manufacturing solutions.

Name: Atargis Energy Corporation
Description: Atargis Energy is a renewable energy technology company specializing in ocean wave power generation. Their innovative Cycloidal Wave Energy Converter (CycWEC) is a submerged hydrofoil-based technology that can convert up to 95% of ocean wave power into electricity. Founded in 2010 by U.S. Air Force Academy researchers, the company develops grid-scale wave energy converters that are invisible from the water surface, storm-survivable, and designed to provide affordable, clean electricity to coastal regions using advanced sensor and predictive algorithm technologies.

Name: Spiral Technology
Description: Spiral Technology develops an augmented reality (AR) platform for industrial automation and technical knowledge management. Their flagship product, SpectorNext, utilizes computer vision and AR to enhance quality inspection processes in manufacturing. The platform enables spatial marking, automatic measurements, real-time annotations, and AI-driven repair validation. Designed for technical personnel, the software helps technicians access critical information hands-free, improving efficiency, accuracy, and compliance in industrial settings. Key applications include quality assurance, maintenance training, and technical task validation across complex manufacturing environments.

Name: Acoustic Wells
Description: Acoustic Wells is a technology company focused on developing optimization solutions for the oil and gas industry using advanced IoT, AI/ML, and cloud technologies. Their core offering is a remote automation and monitoring system for oilfield assets, utilizing wireless sensors and an AI-driven platform to provide real-time data on well conditions. The solution enables remote control and monitoring of pumps and production, with key features including automated well testing, leak detection, and cost-effective workflow improvements. The company aims to enhance efficiency and profitability in the energy sector through innovative technological approaches.

Name: Atlantic Quantum
Description: Atlantic Quantum is a quantum computing technology company focused on developing scalable, fault-tolerant quantum computing hardware. Their approach centers on addressing critical challenges in quantum computing, including reducing error rates and system complexity. Utilizing superconducting qubit technology, the company aims to create advanced quantum systems capable of solving complex computational problems. They have established strategic partnerships with organizations like the US Air Force and IARPA, demonstrating their commitment to pushing the boundaries of quantum computing technology.

Name: Luxsonic Technologies
Description: Luxsonic is a healthcare technology company focused on developing immersive virtual reality solutions for medical education, training, and clinical applications. Founded by medical research scientists, the company creates innovative software platforms like Luxsonic VIP that enhance healthcare professional training through high-resolution medical simulations and interactive virtual environments. Their technology enables real-time patient interactions, complex medical procedure training, and aims to improve healthcare access and engagement through cutting-edge immersive technologies across North America.

Name: Simularge Inc.
Description: Simularge is a digital engineering platform providing advanced simulation and digital twin solutions for manufacturing and industrial sectors. The company offers software tools that leverage AI, machine learning, and connectivity to optimize research and development processes. Their platform includes mechanical simulation, data analytics, and a low-code/no-code development environment that helps businesses reduce manufacturing costs, predict maintenance needs, and accelerate digital transformation. With patented algorithms and solutions for industrial applications, Simularge enables factories to adapt quickly to changing production scenarios without requiring extensive data collection.

Name: Leap Photovoltaics
Description: Leap Photovoltaics is an innovative solar manufacturing company developing a revolutionary process for producing crystalline silicon solar cells without traditional wafers. Their additive manufacturing approach aims to reduce solar cell production costs by up to 50% while maintaining high performance and reliability. The company focuses on creating solar technology with local supply chains, addressing current manufacturing challenges in the renewable energy sector. Their unique method supports decarbonization goals by potentially accelerating solar manufacturing growth and improving the economic viability of solar energy production.

Name: ZebraKet
Description: ZebraKet is a cleantech startup that specializes in advanced technology solutions, initially developing inventory optimization tools for retail and subsequently pivoting to environmental technology. The company focuses on sensor fusion and placement optimization for methane leak detection in the energy industry, leveraging quantum computing and AI methods to develop innovative solutions for environmental monitoring and optimization.

Name: Stochastic
Description: Stochastic is an AI technology company founded by Harvard University researchers, specializing in intelligent platforms for regulated industries like financial services and real estate. Their AI-powered solution provides real-time, domain-specific intelligence through adaptive conversational interfaces. The platform offers features such as transparent decision-making, regulatory compliance monitoring, and integration with existing systems. Founded on extensive AI research funded by NSF, DARPA, Intel, and IBM, Stochastic enables efficient interactions with machines and data, supporting operations like mortgage application processing, account verification, and fraud prevention.

Name: Foray
Description: Foray is a biotechnology startup pioneering innovative biomanufacturing techniques to generate wood and forest products without cutting down trees. Using advanced cell cultivation technologies, the company develops methods to grow specific plant-based materials in bioreactors, focusing initially on high-value wood products like oils and resins. Their approach aims to address deforestation by creating sustainable alternatives to traditional logging, with potential applications in textiles, paper production, and specialized wood products. By cultivating plant cells efficiently, Foray seeks to reduce environmental impact, preserve biodiversity, and provide a more resilient solution to plant-based material production.

Name: Type One Energy
Description: Type One Energy is a mission-driven fusion energy company founded in 2019 by leading fusion scientists and business experts. The company develops sustainable and affordable fusion power using optimized stellarator fusion energy systems. By applying advanced manufacturing methods, computational physics, and high-field superconducting magnets, Type One Energy aims to create clean, grid-deployable fusion power plants within a decade. Their FusionDirect development program focuses on a low-risk, capital-efficient approach to commercializing fusion technology, with the goal of providing a scalable and sustainable solution to global energy challenges.

Name: TRIC Robotics
Description: TRIC Robotics is an agricultural technology company that provides automated pest and disease control solutions for farmers using ultraviolet light as a non-chemical alternative to pesticides. The company's platform delivers UV-C light treatments to crops, particularly strawberry farms, to control pathogens and pests without chemical agents. Their service includes automated treatment systems, a six-row bug vacuum that enhances UV light effectiveness, smart assistant technology for efficient pest management, and bi-weekly analytics for informed decision-making. TRIC Robotics focuses on promoting sustainable farming practices while improving crop productivity and environmental health.

Name: Yogi Surendranath NewCo (Mid-temp H2)
Engine Team: Lakshana Huddar <lakshana.huddar@gmail.com>; Michael Kearney <michael@engineventures.com>; Richard Collins <richard@engineventures.com>
Description: Hydrogen generation technology

Name: Perry Ellis & Rohan Thakur NewCo
Description: Perry Ellis International, Inc. is a leading designer, distributor and licensor of a broad line of high quality men's and women's apparel, accessories and fragrances. The company's collection of dress and casual shirts, golf sportswear, sweaters, dress pants, casual pants and shorts, jeans wear, active wear, dresses and men's and women's swimwear is available through all major levels of retail distribution. The company, through its wholly owned subsidiaries, owns a portfolio of nationally and internationally recognized brands, including: Perry Ellis®, An Original Penguin by Munsingwear®, Laundry by Shelli Segal®, Rafaella®, Cubavera®, Ben Hogan®, Savane®, Grand Slam®, John Henry®, Manhattan®, Axist® and Farah®. The company enhances its roster of brands by licensing trademarks from third parties, including: Nike® for swimwear, and Callaway®, PGA TOUR® and Jack Nicklaus® for golf apparel. Additional information on the company is available at www.pery.com.

Name: Aaron Persad & Chun Man Chow NewCo
RedoxBlox
Description: Redoxblox is a technology company developing advanced thermochemical energy storage solutions designed to decarbonize industrial thermal processing and power generation. Their modular and scalable system enables high-temperature energy storage without toxic materials, supporting renewable energy integration for industries like chemicals, mining, and food production. By helping industrial processors and power plant operators reduce carbon and nitrogen oxide emissions, Redoxblox promotes grid resiliency and enables more sustainable energy infrastructure.

Name: Hydrovatech
Description: Hydrova is a climate technology startup based in Orange County, California, dedicated to waste reduction and clean energy production. The company focuses on innovative solutions for aluminum recyclers, helping them achieve sustainability goals efficiently and profitably. Supported by grants from EPA, MIT, and the 776 Foundation, and backed by investors like 1517 Fund and Climate Capital, Hydrova is committed to diverting waste from landfills and developing environmentally sustainable technologies in the aluminum recycling sector.

Name: TPL Inc
Description: Fetzer & Co. is a financial advisory firm founded in 1999 that provides alternative asset advisory services for emerging growth and middle-market companies across the USA, Asia, and Europe. The firm specializes in capital raising, strategic financial planning, and helping businesses navigate complex financial landscapes. With a team of experienced professionals, they offer services including private placements, mergers and acquisitions, and strategic financial consulting across industries such as digital media, healthcare, and consumer products.

Name: Gustav Graeber NewCo
Description: In the case of NewCo, Inc, the investors offer to invest $4 million at a $6M pre-money valuaton. In addition, the investors require the very typical early stage company option pool equaling 20% of all the shares issued to founders, employees as well as to the investors following the financing also known as the fully diluted number of shares. That means that instead of splitting the $6 million pre money valuation evenly across all the existing company share holders (founders and employees), it is split between all the existing shareholders such as the founders and employees as well as the shares in the option pool set up for future use. Below is a table which compares what happens to ownership stakes both without and with an option pool.

Name: BLUE DOT MOTORWORKS
Description: Blue Dot Motorworks is an automotive technology company developing retrofit hybrid systems that convert conventional vehicles into plug-in hybrids. Their innovative solution allows existing fossil-fuel vehicles to be transformed with electric propulsion, providing an all-electric range for most daily driving while maintaining the original engine for longer trips. The company aims to address greenhouse gas emissions by offering a scalable solution for the estimated 1.5 billion fossil-fuel vehicles expected to be on roads by 2030, focusing on cost-effective and sustainable mobility technologies.

Name: Sensory Robotics
Description: Sensory Robotics develops advanced industrial robotics solutions focused on worker safety and productivity. The company specializes in transforming heavy industrial robots into collaborative robots (cobots) that can safely operate alongside human workers. Their SR-1 Safety Solution provides unparalleled worker protection, enhanced productivity, and seamless integration, offering a cost-effective and time-efficient approach to implementing safer industrial automation technologies.

Name: Kuleana
Description: Kuleana is a San Francisco-based food technology company creating plant-based seafood alternatives using biotechnology. Their flagship product is a plant-based tuna that aims to deliver an uncompromising taste, texture, and nutritional profile high in omega-3 DHA, iron, and vitamin B12. Currently available in sushi rolls at select markets and restaurants, the company is backed by notable investors including Y-Combinator and Reddit co-founder Alexis Ohanian, focusing on sustainable and innovative seafood alternatives.

Name: Organicin Scientific
Description: We discover and develop bacteriocins. CinThesis is Organicin’s proprietary machine learning system designed for predictions in bacteriocin biological activity and physicochemical properties, focused on delivering an enhanced and accessible system for new product development to our customers.

Name: Atom Computing
Description: Atom Computing is a quantum computing startup specializing in building scalable quantum computers using optically trapped neutral atoms. The company develops advanced quantum computing solutions designed to solve complex computational challenges across various applications. By leveraging innovative atomic array technologies, Atom Computing aims to deliver quantum computing systems that can potentially breakthrough traditional computational limitations, offering more efficient processing for data analysis, image processing, and other high-performance computing needs.

Name: Dirac Technologies
Description: Dirac is an early-stage quantum software company developing innovative algorithms and software for quantum computers. Their focus is on pioneering new approaches to quantum computing technology, aiming to create advanced computational solutions that can potentially transform technological capabilities across various industries.

Name: Haystack Ag
Description: Haystack Ag is an agricultural technology company specializing in soil carbon measurement and carbon market development. Using innovative sensing technology, the company provides high-accuracy, cost-effective solutions for measuring soil carbon and understanding the impact of regenerative farming practices. Their systems aim to reduce soil carbon testing costs while maintaining precision, facilitating carbon offset markets where agricultural producers can be compensated for ecosystem services through carbon credit mechanisms.

Name: Rosotics
Description: Rosotics is an advanced manufacturing technology company specializing in hyper-efficient metal additive manufacturing solutions. Using a proprietary Rapid Induction Printing™ technology, the company develops large-scale 3D printing systems for aerospace and defense industries. Their innovative approach dramatically reduces energy and material requirements, enabling production of complex metal components with no scale limitations, and pushing the boundaries of industrial engineering and off-world manufacturing capabilities.

Name: Symbrosia
Description: Symbrosia is a CleanTech startup developing an innovative seaweed-based solution to reduce methane emissions from livestock. Their platform produces red macroalgae as a feed supplement that can eliminate up to 90% of methane emissions from cattle. By combining sustainable agriculture with climate change mitigation, the company offers a natural product called SeaGraze that not only reduces environmental impact but also provides health benefits and potential productivity improvements for livestock operations.

Name: EvoDenovo
Description: EvoDenovo is a biopharmaceutical company developing innovative non-addictive therapies for pain management and mental health disorders. Specializing in advanced scientific research, the company focuses on creating treatments that target alternative biological pathways to provide safe, effective pain relief without the risks of opioid addiction. Supported by government grants and collaborating with top researchers and institutions, EvoDenovo aims to transform pain treatment by developing groundbreaking analgesic options that address critical unmet medical needs.

Name: Enrich Therapeutics
Description: EnrichTX is a biotechnology company developing innovative cell discovery platforms, specializing in high-throughput cellular imaging and analysis technologies. Their primary focus is creating microfluidics-free cell capture solutions that simplify scientific workflows and improve research confidence. The company develops novel single-cell isolation technologies designed to address critical gaps in existing cell research methodologies.

Name: prinsta
Description: Prinsta is a technology startup located in Brooklyn, NY, focused on advancing electronics manufacturing through innovative circuit board printing technology. The company has developed proprietary automated circuit board printers designed for Industry 4.0, offering a 'factory-in-a-box' desktop solution for electronic circuit board production. Their technology aims to revolutionize electronic manufacturing by providing more accessible and advanced printing capabilities for circuit board development.

Name: axiontechnologies
Description: Axion Technologies is a cybersecurity company developing advanced encryption technologies using quantum mechanics principles. The firm offers innovative security solutions including proprietary software platforms like Secure and Managed Security System, which enable secure communication and data protection. Their technology focuses on providing users with advanced encryption methods and data control capabilities without requiring complex downloads or installations.

Name: Esya
Description: Esya Labs is a precision biomarker company developing advanced proteomic and DNA nanotechnology solutions for diagnosing and treating neurodegenerative diseases. Their primary focus is on developing molecular diagnostic technologies, with a key product called NULISA (NUcleic Acid Linked Immuno-Sandwich Assay) that analyzes cellular functions and provides insights into brain health. The company specializes in creating high-sensitivity biomarker platforms for biopharma and clinical research, with expertise in diseases like Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, and other conditions requiring advanced molecular analysis.

Name: EnZinc Inc
Description: Enzinc is an advanced battery technology company developing next-generation zinc-air batteries using cutting-edge nanotechnology. Their innovative battery solution offers improved energy density, safety, and cost-effectiveness compared to traditional lead-acid and lithium-based batteries. The company's proprietary three-dimensional nanotechnology foam structure enables batteries with higher energy-to-weight ratios, enhanced safety, and recyclability. Enzinc's technology has potential applications across multiple sectors, including electric vehicles, mobility, microgrids, medical devices, and energy storage solutions.

Name: Atmoszero
Description: AtmosZero is an innovative clean energy technology company developing modular electrified boilers designed to decarbonize industrial steam production. Their Boiler 2.0 technology converts existing heat from the air into steam with reduced carbon emissions, offering a drop-in solution applicable across various industries including food and beverage, pharmaceuticals, and district heating. The company focuses on reimagining industrial heating systems to support carbon neutrality goals through scalable, electrified heat pump technologies.

Name: BSure Technologies
Description: BSure Technologies is a biotechnology company based in Houston, TX, focused on developing gluten-related health solutions. The company is developing a #bsuregluten test for foods, targeting consumers concerned about gluten sensitivity and celiac disease, with the aim of providing a reliable method for testing food safety for gluten-intolerant individuals.

Name: Avalon Holographics
Description: Avalon Holographics is a Canadian technology company pioneering advanced holographic display technology. Based in St. John's, NL, the company develops innovative 3D display solutions that enable users to view and interact with content without glasses or headsets. Their platform creates realistic, immersive holographic experiences across various applications including defense, medical imaging, emergency management, and entertainment. The technology aims to revolutionize visual content production by offering comfortable, headgear-free 3D experiences that reduce the physical limitations associated with traditional virtual and augmented reality systems.

Name: Zeta Surgical
Description: Zeta Surgical is a digital surgery company that develops advanced surgical navigation and robotics tools to enhance minimally invasive procedures. Their primary innovation is an AI-powered computer vision system called RealTrack, which provides sub-millimeter precision and automatic registration for surgical environments. The technology aims to make surgeries easier, faster, and more accessible by improving accuracy, reducing procedure times, and ensuring patient safety through advanced navigation technology.

Name: BioFeyn
Description: BioFeyn is a life sciences company pioneering innovative nutrient delivery solutions for sustainable food systems, with a primary focus on aquaculture and agriculture. Specializing in customized nutritional solutions for salmon farming, the company develops advanced biotechnology to improve ingredient efficiencies and reduce environmental impact. Their modular platform allows for targeted nutrient delivery, supporting sustainable practices by optimizing existing ingredients and adhering to principles that promote environmental and nutritional improvements.

Name: AlgiKnit
Description: AlgiKnit is a sustainable textile innovation company founded in 2017, focused on creating eco-conscious, renewable yarns for the circular economy. Specializing in developing durable and biodegradable textiles derived from kelp, the company aims to transform the fashion industry's environmental impact. Located in Brooklyn, New York, AlgiKnit works at the intersection of design and science to produce materials with a significantly lower environmental footprint than conventional textiles, envisioning a future where textile production operates in a closed-loop lifecycle.

Name: Firehawk Aerospace
Description: Firehawk Aerospace is a defense technology company that develops and manufactures high-performance hybrid and solid rocket engines. The company utilizes patented 3D-Ultra rocket technology and additive manufacturing to create stable, cost-effective hybrid rocket fuel systems that combine the efficiency and reliability of liquid bi-propellant engines with the safety and simplicity of hybrid engines. Firehawk's rocket propulsion systems are designed for defense industry applications, military missions, and commercial launch vehicles. The company focuses on making space transportation safe, reliable, and affordable through innovative manufacturing processes and custom-engineered solutions.

Name: Lunar Outpost
Description: Lunar Outpost is an advanced technology company specializing in space robotics, lunar surface mobility, and space resource exploration. Founded in 2017 and based in Golden, Colorado, the company develops innovative technologies with dual-use applications for both space and Earth. Their key products include the Mobile Autonomous Prospecting Platform (MAPP) rover and the Canary air quality sensor. Lunar Outpost is working on multiple lunar surface missions, aiming to be the first commercial rover on the Moon and exploring the lunar South Pole. The company collaborates with NASA, the U.S. Department of Defense, and partners like General Motors to advance space exploration and develop technologies that can operate in extreme environments.

Name: Geminus.AI
Description: Geminus is an industrial AI optimization platform that combines measurement data with physics to create powerful digital twins for complex cyber-physical systems. The company's technology enables rapid model creation, reducing development time from months to hours by using a data-augmented computational physics approach. Their platform provides real-time intelligence for industrial operations, allowing autonomous control and optimization across sectors like oil and gas, defense, and utilities by creating scalable, self-updating models that achieve highly accurate results with minimal training data.

Name: BluumBio
Description: BluumBio is a biotechnology company specializing in advanced bioremediation technologies that leverage natural organisms to clean up environmental pollution. Their platform focuses on organism discovery, enzyme optimization, and product development to address environmental challenges. The company develops solutions for removing industrial chemicals and pollutants from soil, air, and water, including specialized treatments for petroleum, PCBs, PFAS, heavy metals, and microplastics, with the goal of restoring ecosystems and promoting biodiversity.

Name: Verility
Description: Verility is an animal health technology company developing innovative fertility analysis products for livestock producers. Their flagship product is a mobile, AI-powered platform called Fertile-Eyez that provides immediate sperm quality checks and ovulation detection. The technology aims to improve animal breeding efficiency by offering rapid, accurate, and cost-effective reproductive performance assessments using image recognition and artificial intelligence.

Name: Transitional Energy
Description: Transitional Energy is an innovative energy solutions company that transforms oil and gas infrastructure into sustainable geothermal power generators. They provide technologies like the Sedna Sled and HXC Geothermal system to help energy operators reduce carbon footprints and generate on-site, emissions-free electricity. By recycling existing wellbores and infrastructure, the company offers services including geothermal leasing, energy sales, consulting, and research to support sustainable energy transformation across civic, residential, commercial, and agricultural sectors.

Name: Disa
Description: Disa is an innovative materials liberation company that provides advanced technology solutions for mining and reclamation industries. Utilizing patented High-Pressure Slurry Ablation (HPSA) technology, the company specializes in isolating targeted geologic materials ranging from precious and industrial metals to hydrocarbons. Their platform focuses on improving mineral recovery, reducing environmental impacts, and delivering efficiency in resource extraction. Disa aims to optimize resource use through clean and responsible technology that supports energy independence and reduces waste generation in mining and remediation sectors.

Name: Nohbo
Description: Nohbo is an innovative personal care technology company that creates waste-free, water-soluble products designed to eliminate single-use plastic packaging. Their flagship product, NOHBO Drops, are single-use personal care capsules containing shampoo, conditioner, and body wash that dissolve completely in water. The company works with consumer packaged goods (CPG) and beauty brands to encapsulate products in water-soluble films, targeting environmentally conscious consumers and hospitality industries seeking to reduce plastic waste. Patented and globally recognized, Nohbo aims to combat pollution by providing sustainable, chemical-free personal care solutions.

Name: Nexteon Technologies (formerly Route Dynamics)
Description: Nexteon Technologies is an aviation technology company specializing in route optimization solutions for commercial and general aviation. Their flagship SmartRoutes product uses advanced cloud-based technology to automatically analyze and optimize aircraft routes, reducing flight time, fuel consumption, and operational complexity. The system provides real-time route advisories considering factors like wind, weather, traffic congestion, and airspace restrictions, enabling airlines to achieve significant cost savings, lower emissions, and improved operational efficiency without requiring complex avionics integration.

Name: Talus Bioscience
Description: Talus Bioscience is a venture-backed biotechnology startup focused on drug discovery for gene regulators, specifically in oncology. Spun out of the University of Washington and Altius Institute in 2020, the company has developed a unique data-enabled drug development platform that measures drug activity across 1,000 gene regulators simultaneously. Their innovative approach combines cell processing, quantitative proteomics, and advanced analytics to target previously undruggable gene regulators, with efforts split between internal cancer research programs and partnerships with pharma, biotech, and academic laboratories.

Name: Valqari
Description: Valqari is a Chicago-based technology company specializing in drone delivery infrastructure and logistics solutions. The company offers a patented drone delivery station and intelligent mailbox system that enables secure, automated package delivery and returns. Their technology features a secure vault for theft-prevention, AI-based software for package tracking, and digital signature capabilities. Valqari's solutions support various sectors including emergency response, healthcare, military, and transportation, with infrastructure that allows safe drone landings and package handling. The company holds utility patents in 14 countries and provides comprehensive drone delivery infrastructure to solve 'last inch' logistics challenges.

Name: Sensai Analytics
Description: Sensai Analytics is an enterprise AI platform specializing in electric vehicle (EV) battery analytics and machine learning model development. The company develops financial digital twin technologies that help EV battery owners extend battery life and optimize residual value. Their platform enables predictive modeling with small data sets, partnering with vehicle manufacturers, leasing companies, telematics providers, and fleet owners to provide insights into battery health, performance optimization, and fleet electrification strategies. By addressing challenges in machine learning adoption, they aim to help businesses extract more value from their data through advanced AI technologies.

Name: Takachar
Description: Takachar is an environmental technology company that develops innovative solutions for converting agricultural and forest biomass waste into valuable bioproducts. Their portable, low-cost systems enable rural communities to locally process crop and forest residues into high-value commodities like fertilizer blends, biofuels, and chemicals. By transforming waste that would otherwise be burned, Takachar helps reduce air pollution, mitigate wildfire risks, and create economic opportunities in underserved areas. The company's technology requires no external energy and aims to promote environmental justice by empowering rural communities to participate in the bioeconomy through sustainable waste management practices.

Name: Parallel Bio
Description: Parallel Bio is a biotechnology company that has developed a groundbreaking 'immune system in a dish' platform for drug discovery and immunotherapy development. Using immune organoids, AI, and robotics, the company creates in-vitro replicas of human lymph nodes to model disease complexity and generate diverse immune responses. Their innovative approach aims to accelerate drug development by providing more accurate and efficient alternatives to traditional animal testing.

Name: Fork
Description: Fork is a career development platform that leverages artificial intelligence to help individuals optimize their career pathways. The platform provides personalized tools to discover new job opportunities, gain insights into career growth, and advance professional development. By utilizing AI technology, Fork assists users in identifying potential career moves, exploring job market trends, and finding more fulfilling and higher-paying employment opportunities.

Name: Freightflows
Description: FreightFlows is a maritime technology platform that provides predictive analytics for global trade. Utilizing advanced machine learning models, the company tracks, analyzes, and predicts vessel behavior and market performance by aggregating data from multiple sources. Its key features include real-time monitoring of vessel movements, market intelligence for informed decision-making, and tools for tracking cargo flows and supporting decarbonization efforts in the maritime industry.

Name: Redesign Science
Description: Redesign Science is a computational chemistry and biotechnology platform founded in 2017, specializing in drug discovery through advanced AI and molecular simulation technologies. The company combines physics-based modeling and deep learning to develop generative AI solutions for creating small molecule therapeutics. Their primary focus is on generating first-in-class Protein Interaction Modulators targeting oncogenic and inflammatory diseases, leveraging innovative computational approaches to advance early-stage drug discovery.

Name: Carbix
