Name: Cx Therapeutics
Description: Cx Therapeutics is a medical device company focused on developing innovative solutions for treating cervical insufficiency, a condition associated with preterm birth. The company collaborates with medical professionals and engineers to create safer and more effective cerclage technologies that aim to reduce complications and improve patient outcomes. Their research is dedicated to addressing the critical medical challenge of preventing premature births by developing advanced medical devices that offer improved efficacy compared to traditional treatment methods.

Name: RareCyte
Description: RareCyte is an innovative precision biology company headquartered in Seattle, Washington, specializing in advanced spatial biology and liquid biopsy solutions. The company develops technologies for analyzing rare single cells, with a focus on oncology, immuno-oncology, maternal-fetal health, and cell and gene therapy. Their key products include highly multiplexed fluorescent imaging systems and integrated platforms that enable researchers to unlock spatial context of biomarkers and develop advanced therapeutics and diagnostic tools.

Name: Mobius
Engine Team: Michael Kearney <michael@engineventures.com>; Ian Johnston <ian@engine.xyz>; Orin Hoffman <orin@engine.xyz>
Description: Mobius is a mission-driven company focused on creating value from industrial organic waste streams by developing renewable materials and chemicals. Specializing in recycling waste from agriculture, forestry, paper, and biofuel industries, the company transforms organic waste components into valuable resources for the circular economy. Their primary innovation is a proprietary, biodegradable polymer made from lignin, a natural material produced as waste by paper and biofuel industries. This biopolymer enables the creation of bio-based plastic pellets for applications in horticulture, agriculture, food service packaging, and other sustainable material solutions.

Name: Trace Matters Scientific
Description: Trace Matters is a technology startup focused on developing next-generation mass spectrometry technologies for demanding scientific and industrial applications. The company specializes in innovative mass spectrometry hardware, methods, and applications designed to solve complex analytical challenges. Their technologies include advanced devices that enable direct analysis of mass parameters, with a focus on improving accuracy and efficiency in mass spectrometry research and industrial testing.

Name: Oculi
Description: Oculi is a deep-tech, fabless semiconductor company specializing in AI and visual intelligence technologies. The company produces the OCULI SPU™ (Sensing & Processing Unit), a novel architecture for real-time video processing and AI applications. Oculi's technology focuses on delivering high-performance visual AI at the edge, with solutions designed for industries including automotive, medical, and smart home. Their Software-Defined Vision Sensors (SDPS) technology aims to enhance AI applications by improving efficiency and ensuring privacy in visual data transmission.

Name: DropGenie
Description: DropGenie is a biotechnology company specializing in advanced microfluidics and automation solutions for scientific research. Their primary product is an automation-compatible microfluidics chip designed to enable non-viral transfection and whole genome arrayed CRISPR screening. The company focuses on reducing time and costs associated with traditional lab processes by offering precise liquid handling tools that improve efficiency in biological research, particularly in drug discovery workflows. Their innovative technology allows researchers to perform complex genetic screening with significantly reduced input material and improved processing times.

Name: BIOMILQ
Description: BIOMILQ is a women-owned, science-led mammary biotechnology startup focused on revolutionizing early-life nutrition. Using a patented technology platform, the company produces cell-cultured human milk components outside the body, aiming to bridge the nutritional gap between breast milk and infant formula. Their core mission is to develop bioactive ingredients that promote gut, immune, and brain health by leveraging human mammary cells and advanced biotechnology, with potential applications in infant nutrition and related health products.

Name: CarbonQuest
Description: CarbonQuest is a technology company focused on decarbonization solutions for urban building owners. They provide advanced distributed carbon capture technologies that can capture up to 95% of CO2 emissions from systems like CHP, fuel cells, and boilers. Founded by experienced environmental technology entrepreneurs, the company offers scalable carbon reduction solutions that enable immediate decarbonization without disrupting operations. Their technology is applicable across various sectors including healthcare, commercial, and residential facilities.

Name: CarbonFree
Description: CarbonFree is a clean technology company developing innovative carbon capture and mineralization solutions for industrial emissions. Their patented technologies, including SkyCycle and SkyMine, enable the transformation of CO2 from stationary industrial sources into valuable carbon-negative chemicals like sodium bicarbonate and precipitated calcium carbonate. The company offers a modular, scalable approach to carbon capture that requires minimal infrastructure modifications, supporting industries' net-zero carbon emission goals while creating marketable industrial minerals.

Name: Air Company
Description: Air Company is a pioneering carbon conversion technology firm focused on transforming CO₂ into valuable resources through its innovative AIRMADE™ Technology. The company develops carbon-negative chemicals and fuels by mimicking photosynthesis, using renewable energy to convert carbon dioxide and water. With commercial partnerships including JetBlue and Virgin Atlantic, and government contracts from NASA and the U.S. Department of Defense, Air Company has received multiple awards for its sustainable technology, including recognition from the Environmental Protection Agency and the World Economic Forum.

Name: Paragon Pure
Description: Paragon Pure is a food ingredient technology company focusing on developing plant-based and sustainable alternatives for the food industry. Specializing in innovative ingredients derived from rice bran, the company offers products like OléBK (a palm oil alternative), SproutedByNature rice flour, and other natural solutions for sugar reduction and food binding. Their approach centers on understanding natural science to create genuine ingredients that enhance the health, taste, and sustainability of food products across various applications.

Name: Excellims
Description: Excellims is a scientific instrumentation company founded in 2005 and located in Acton, Massachusetts. They specialize in high-performance ion mobility spectrometry (HPIMS) solutions for chemical detection and analysis. The company manufactures a range of analytical instruments for chemical and pharmaceutical industries, research institutions, and government applications. Their products include standalone IMS analyzers, ion mobility add-ons for mass spectrometers, and innovative chemical analysis tools that provide rapid, flexible detection for liquid, solid, and gas samples.

Name: STAC Technology
Description: STAC Technology is a research and development company specializing in sustainable thermal cooling systems that use water as a refrigerant. Their innovative decentralized cooling solutions are designed to transform district heating and cooling industries by enabling power plants to provide on-site cooling services. The company focuses on developing net-zero cooling technologies that replace harmful refrigerants with water, aiming to create more environmentally friendly and cost-effective energy solutions for industrial and commercial applications.

Name: Natrion
Description: Natrion is a battery research and development startup founded in 2018, specializing in advanced solid-state and lithium-metal battery technologies. Based in Binghamton, New York, with roots at the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, the company develops innovative battery components for electric mobility and energy storage solutions. Their core focus is creating scalable, high-performance battery technologies with improved charging times, thermal stability, and compatibility with existing manufacturing processes. Natrion aims to enhance battery performance and safety through application-driven research, targeting markets in electric vehicles and renewable energy storage.

Name: Meltek
Description: Meltek is a climate tech startup focused on helping users reduce energy consumption in high-demand areas. The platform allows individuals to save electricity by adjusting their energy usage during peak hours, with a focus on lowering carbon emissions. Users can sign up for free and earn rewards by implementing energy-saving actions such as reducing unnecessary lighting and adjusting thermostats. Partnering with electric utility companies, Meltek provides a sustainable energy program that enables residents to contribute to environmental conservation while potentially saving money on their electricity bills.

Name: Innovia GEO
Description: Innovia GEO is an energy solutions company specializing in geothermal heating and cooling technologies. They provide comprehensive services for designing, implementing, and supporting geothermal systems for buildings and homes. The company's focus is on promoting energy efficiency, increasing building sustainability, and enabling energy independence through innovative geothermal solutions for owners, developers, and stakeholders.

Name: Hydronic Shell Technologies
Description: Hydronic Shell Technologies develops an innovative HVAC and facade system designed to transform building energy efficiency, particularly for multi-family buildings. Their modular system enables deep energy retrofits that can dramatically reduce heating and cooling energy consumption while improving thermal comfort and indoor air quality. The exterior-installed solution minimizes tenant disruption, offers architectural flexibility, and aims to address significant CO2 emissions from buildings through a cost-effective, scalable technology.

Name: Biovert Protein
Description: Biovert Protein is an insect technology company founded in 2020 that focuses on upcycling organic waste into sustainable raw materials for industrial customers. The company aims to transform the linear economy into a circular product ecosystem by converting waste into valuable resources. Founded by experienced food industry executives Peter Hamilton and Craig Thomas, Biovert Protein leverages expertise from FMCG companies and multinational food corporations to develop scalable ecological solutions that minimize environmental impact.

Name: Aqualumos
Description: Aqualumos is a technology company focused on eliminating harmful PFAS (Per- and Polyfluoroalkyl Substances) from water systems. The company develops photocatalysis-based technologies to break down and remove these persistent 'forever chemicals' from ecosystems. Their innovative approach provides water utilities and manufacturers with cost-effective solutions to remediate PFAS and meet regulatory requirements. Aqualumos aims to improve water quality and safety by addressing the significant health risks associated with PFAS contamination through advanced technological interventions.

Name: RIDECOMMERCE
Description: Ride Commerce is a mobility platform focused on transforming urban transportation through data-driven solutions. The company aims to enhance transportation services by connecting users with public transit options and leveraging technology to support sustainable urban environments. Their platform provides services including ride booking, transportation data analysis, and strategies to reduce traffic congestion while promoting more efficient and environmentally friendly mobility solutions.

Name: Novaurum Biosciences
Description: Novaurum Biosciences is a biotech company developing advanced nanotechnology-based coatings for medical implants. Their proprietary AuPEC platform combines microbiology and nanotechnology to create cell-based encapsulation for orthopedic devices. The company aims to improve patient health outcomes by reducing implant failure rates through innovative coating solutions that enhance device performance, tissue integration, and healing potential for medical manufacturers and healthcare providers.

Name: VerImmune
Description: VerImmune is a biotechnology company developing an innovative cancer therapy called Anti-tumor Immune Redirection (AIR). Their novel approach leverages a proprietary virus-inspired particle (ViP) technology platform that strategically redirects pre-existing immune memory from childhood vaccinations or past infections towards targeting tumors. This groundbreaking therapeutic strategy aims to enhance cancer treatment by utilizing the body's existing immune responses to potentially improve treatment efficacy and patient outcomes.

Name: InventWood
Description: InventWood is a materials technology company focused on developing advanced, sustainable wood solutions through cellulose-based nanotechnologies. Their flagship product, SUPERWOOD, is an innovative building material that enhances wood's natural properties, creating high-performance, environmentally sustainable alternatives to conventional construction materials. The company transforms wood at the molecular level to improve strength, durability, and resilience, enabling the creation of more sustainable, fire-resistant, and pest-resistant buildings while supporting domestic forestry and promoting carbon-lock technologies.

Name: BraneCell Systems
Description: BraneCell is a quantum computing technology company specializing in developing application-specific AI chips with unique quantum properties. The company focuses on creating quantum neural network (QML) and quantum secure direct communications (QSDC) chips that can operate at ambient temperatures, overcoming the limitations of traditional cryogenic quantum systems. BraneCell offers innovative chip manufacturing solutions at significantly lower costs, with a mission to advance quantum computing technologies for various applications.

Name: ZwitterCo
Description: ZwitterCo is an innovative water treatment technology company founded in 2018 and headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts. The company specializes in advanced membrane filtration solutions using zwitterionic technology for industrial water treatment and recycling. Their breakthrough membranes offer unprecedented fouling resistance and chemical tolerance, enabling filtration in challenging industrial environments like dairy processing, food and beverage, and power generation. ZwitterCo's innovative technology enhances membrane performance, reduces maintenance costs, and supports sustainable water reuse across multiple industries by creating filtration solutions for historically unmanageable process and waste waters.

Name: Perceptive Automata
Description: Perceptive Automata is an artificial intelligence technology company founded in 2016 by Harvard and MIT researchers specializing in developing AI that understands human behavior for autonomous vehicles. Their flagship product SOMAI™ (State of Mind AI) enables autonomous vehicles to interpret the intentions and awareness of pedestrians, cyclists, and other road users, making split-second decisions to ensure safer driving experiences. By combining behavioral science techniques with machine learning and visual psychophysics, the company addresses a critical challenge in autonomous driving: reading human state of mind to support large-scale deployment of self-driving vehicles from levels L2 to L5.

Name: Transfoam
Description: Transfoam is an innovative biotechnology company dedicated to addressing plastic pollution through advanced sustainable materials technology. The company develops cutting-edge bio-based solutions that transform plastic waste into biodegradable polymers using engineered microorganisms and renewable feedstocks. Their primary focus is on creating polyhydroxybutyrate (PHB), a fully biodegradable polymer that helps accelerate decarbonization efforts. By upcycling plastic waste and leveraging biotechnology, Transfoam aims to provide an environmentally friendly alternative to traditional plastics, targeting microplastic pollution reduction and promoting circular economy principles.

Name: Gencores
Description: Gencores is an advanced materials technology company that develops ultra-light structural composite metamaterials using innovative material chemistry and robotics. The company aims to revolutionize transportation and manufacturing industries by creating lightweight materials that significantly reduce vehicle and turbine blade weight. Their technology focuses on supporting the transition to net-zero emissions by developing advanced manufacturing techniques that enhance vehicle performance, efficiency, and sustainability through cutting-edge material science and robotics.

Name: Envirobe
Description: Envirobe is a cleantech startup focused on developing microbial technologies that address environmental challenges. The company's primary mission is to create innovative solutions for closing the loop on plastics production and developing technologies to remediate environmental pollution through advanced biotechnological approaches.

Name: Dephy
Description: Dephy is a robotics technology company founded in 2016, specializing in performance-enhancing wearable robotics and human augmentation technologies. The company develops advanced exoskeletons and powered systems designed to improve human mobility and physical capabilities. Dephy collaborates with over 20 global research institutions, focusing on applications across military, academic, medical, and consumer markets. Their innovative approach involves designing and commercializing wearable technologies that enhance human physical performance and support individuals with mobility challenges.

Name: PhasorLab
Description: PhasorLab is a technology company founded in 2014 specializing in high-precision Position, Navigation, and Timing (PNT) solutions. Their flagship product, Hyper Sync Network (HSN), is a self-organizing wireless mesh network that provides sub-nanosecond time synchronization and centimeter-level positioning accuracy. The technology enables advanced applications including autonomous drone guidance, infrastructure inspection, autonomous vehicle navigation, 5G positioning, and mobile communication networks. HSN operates without relying on existing infrastructure and is designed to IEEE 1588 standards, offering high-precision synchronization capabilities for various communication and navigation scenarios.

Name: Activ Surgical
Description: Activ Surgical is a digital surgery technology company founded in 2017 and headquartered in Boston. The company pioneered the world's first autonomous robotic soft tissue surgery and develops hardware-agnostic surgical software. Their ActivSight™ Intelligent Light platform uses augmented reality, artificial intelligence, and machine learning to provide surgeons with enhanced real-time visualization, helping reduce surgical complications and make world-class surgical insights more accessible.

Name: Mach9 Robotics
Description: Mach9 is a geospatial technology platform that automates the production of engineering models using mobile LiDAR scans and image analysis. The company transforms large-scale geospatial datasets into actionable CAD and GIS solutions, enabling rapid and cost-effective mapping. Its key features include automated feature extraction from camera images and LiDAR data, precise measurements, and real-time map generation. Primarily serving surveying, engineering, and construction firms, Mach9 leverages intelligent mapping software to make subsurface and large-scale mapping faster, safer, and more accurate.

Name: Candelytics
Description: Candelytics is a technology startup specializing in 3D data infrastructure and analytics, focusing on LIDAR-based technology. The company develops advanced platforms for managing and sharing point cloud data, offering tools for capturing, mapping, and visualizing geospatial information. Their solutions enable secure collaboration through features like real-time multiplayer 3D viewers, georeferenced mapping, and support for multiple data formats including LIDAR beams, GPS coordinates, and various visualization options. Partnered with the Navy Information Warfare Center's research lab, the company aims to make 3D data more accessible and intelligent across diverse operational environments.

Name: Pure Lithium
Description: Pure Lithium is a vertically integrated battery technology company developing next-generation lithium metal vanadium oxide (LVO) batteries. Based in Boston, the company uses its proprietary Brine to Battery™ electrodeposition technology to create battery-ready electrodes from unconventional lithium sources. Their innovative approach eliminates the need for graphite, nickel, cobalt, and manganese, promoting sustainable battery manufacturing with locally sourced materials. Led by industry experts, Pure Lithium aims to reduce reliance on international battery material supply chains while creating safer, more energy-efficient battery solutions for various applications.

Name: Titan Advanced Energy Solutions
Description: Titan Advanced Energy Solutions is an innovative battery manufacturing technology company that develops cutting-edge battery cell inspection solutions. Their flagship IonSight platform leverages advanced ultrasound sensing technology and AI-driven analytics to monitor battery cell morphology during production. The system collects over 500,000 data points per cell, enabling real-time defect detection, root cause analysis, and quality control. By providing unprecedented insights into cell properties and manufacturing processes, Titan helps battery manufacturers optimize yields, improve product quality, and reduce production cycle times.

Name: Storelectric
Description: Storelectric is a renewable energy technology company specializing in advanced grid-scale energy storage solutions. Their primary focus is developing highly efficient Compressed Air Energy Storage (CAES) technologies that support renewable energy integration. The company's innovative systems can store excess electricity by compressing air, which can be later released to generate power, addressing intermittency challenges in renewable energy. Storelectric's technologies aim to make green energy more reliable, reduce carbon emissions, and provide flexible, cost-effective energy storage solutions for power grids.

Name: Conamix
Description: Conamix is a venture-backed battery technology company specializing in innovative lithium-sulfur (Li-S) and lithium-ion battery materials. The company develops low-cost, high-energy electrode materials that reduce electric vehicle battery costs without using expensive or constrained supply chain resources. Founded in 2014, Conamix focuses on improving battery performance for applications like electric vehicles, drones, and micromobility through proprietary technologies that enhance energy efficiency, charging speed, and manufacturing sustainability.

Name: Mitra Chem
Description: Mitra Chem is a lithium-ion battery materials manufacturer specializing in developing iron-based cathode materials for electrification in transportation and energy storage. The company is pioneering a breakthrough approach to battery material development, dramatically reducing the lab-to-production timeline by over 90%. Focused on sustainable manufacturing and improving the U.S. battery supply chain, Mitra Chem aims to accelerate innovation in battery technology for electric vehicles, consumer electronics, and grid-scale energy storage applications.

Name: Dara Scientific
Description: DPR is a company focused on developing sustainable, plant-based solutions for various industries including agriculture, forestry, and marine sectors. Their core functionality involves creating effective green products that address specific business challenges, with a particular emphasis on environmental sustainability. The company distinguishes itself by using recycled materials and demonstrating a commitment to reducing waste through innovative product development.

Name: Biodevek
Description: BioDevek is a medical device company specializing in developing advanced surgical and topical adhesive materials. The company creates proprietary biomaterial-based solutions that react dynamically with different tissue types, providing adaptive adhesion while maintaining biocompatibility. Their innovative platform combines materials science, biology, and medicine to engineer degradable biomaterials that can be injected or sprayed to enhance surgical healing, protect wounds, and potentially deliver drugs with reduced systemic side effects.

Name: Mote
Description: Mote is a clean energy company specializing in carbon-negative hydrogen production using wood waste biomass. The company transforms agricultural and forestry waste into clean hydrogen and removes carbon dioxide from the atmosphere through its innovative biomass carbon removal and storage (BiCRS) technology. By utilizing existing supply chains, Mote produces utility-scale hydrogen while contributing to grid resilience, energy security, and domestic supply chain strengthening. Their process focuses on sustainability, economic growth, and developing a reliable clean energy future through innovative biomass conversion techniques.

Name: Novilla Pharmaceuticals
Description: Novilla Pharmaceuticals is a biotechnology company focused on developing innovative pain therapeutics that address the opioid epidemic. The company utilizes patented drug delivery methods to create alternative pain management solutions with reduced side effects and addiction risks. By developing therapeutics that bypass traditional administration routes, Novilla aims to provide more effective and safer pain treatment options. Their research and development efforts are centered on creating pharmaceutical solutions that maintain full therapeutic efficacy while minimizing potential negative health impacts associated with conventional pain medications.

Name: SanaRx Biotherapeutics
Description: Home | SanaRx BioTherapeutics, Inc.

Name: Robigo
Description: Robigo is an early-stage biotechnology company focused on agricultural innovation through genetic engineering and data science. The company develops biological solutions for crop protection by engineering microbes to combat crop diseases while maintaining environmental safety. Their approach aims to increase farm productivity, improve soil health, and create sustainable crop protection methods using CRISPR technology. With over 20 years of combined biotechnology expertise, Robigo seeks to develop microbial solutions that protect crops, reduce yield loss, and support environmentally friendly agricultural practices.

Name: Spear Bio
Description: Spear Bio is a biotechnology startup founded in 2021, specializing in ultra-sensitive protein biomarker detection technology. Their proprietary Successive Proximity Extension Amplification Reaction (SPEAR) platform enables precise measurement of protein biomarkers at attomolar levels using minimal sample volumes. The technology features a unique two-factor authentication mechanism, wash-free workflow, and the ability to detect single-molecule range biomarkers, making it a promising solution for early disease diagnosis, medical research, and advancing global health diagnostics.

Name: Astrileux
Description: Astrileux is an engineering technology company specializing in advanced semiconductor manufacturing processes. The company designs revolutionary technologies for producing next-generation integrated circuit (IC) chips at nanoscale levels, including 14 nm and smaller configurations. Their strategic focus is on accelerating computing technology development, with the goal of creating faster, smaller, and more powerful mobile devices. Astrileux's work aims to drive evolutionary advances in electronic technologies, potentially enabling future developments in artificial intelligence and machine learning through innovative chip manufacturing techniques.

Name: Cognixion
Description: Cognixion is an award-winning neurotechnology company developing innovative brain-computer interface (BCI) and assistive technology solutions. Specializing in AI-powered non-invasive neural interfaces, the company creates wearable devices and software that help individuals with communication challenges, particularly those affected by neurodevelopmental disorders or brain and spinal cord injuries. Based in Santa Barbara, California, and Toronto, Ontario, Cognixion aims to solve critical healthcare challenges by enabling communication and device control for people with complex disabilities through advanced augmented reality and AI technologies.

Name: Otomagnetics
Description: Otomagnetics is a medical technology startup developing a non-invasive magnetic drug delivery system for challenging medical targets, particularly focusing on the inner ear, middle ear, and eye. Originating as a University of Maryland College Park spin-out, the company has demonstrated innovative drug delivery capabilities in animal models, addressing conditions like tinnitus, noise-induced hearing loss, and middle ear infections. Their proprietary magnetic injection technology enables drug transport across biological barriers without puncturing tissue, potentially reducing the need for surgical interventions and improving targeted therapeutic treatments.

Name: XGenomes Corp.
Description: XGenomes is a DNA sequencing technology company founded in 2017 and headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts. The company develops advanced molecular analysis platforms that utilize superresolution technology and machine learning to analyze single-molecule interactions and epigenetic modifications. Their technology provides real-time insights into health, disease detection, and aging by examining molecular signals across an individual's lifetime, with a focus on delivering accurate data about health and lifestyle changes through sophisticated imaging and analytical techniques.

Name: Abalytics
Description: Abalytics Oncology is a biotechnology company specializing in computational antibody design and biomolecular engineering for cancer therapies. Their core focus is developing next-generation bispecific treatments, particularly targeting CTLA-4 and utilizing advanced computational methods. The company uses real-time data analysis and innovative engineering techniques to optimize therapy development, with the ultimate goal of improving cancer treatment outcomes and patient survival rates through cutting-edge molecular research and design.

Name: Auraisystems
Description: Aura Systems is a Boston-based technology company specializing in advanced radar technology solutions. The firm develops high-resolution mmWave imaging radar systems primarily targeting autonomous driving applications. Their innovative approach focuses on digital disruption in radar technologies, creating cutting-edge perception solutions for mission-critical radar applications with a emphasis on next-generation sensing technologies.

Name: Dispersa
Description: Dispersa is a Canadian cleantech startup that transforms food waste into sustainable, circular biosurfactants. Founded in 2019, the company produces palm and petroleum-free biosurfactants using food waste instead of food-grade sources. Their primary goal is to offer more sustainable and affordable biosurfactant solutions for various applications including cleaning, hygiene, and personal care products. Dispersa is pioneering waste-derived biosurfactant manufacturing in Canada, focusing on reducing dependence on fossil-fuel and palm-derived chemicals while creating innovative, environmentally friendly ingredient solutions.

Name: Evercloak
Description: Evercloak is a cleantech startup specializing in advanced nanomaterial manufacturing, focusing on producing high-performance graphene and 2D nanomaterial films. Their breakthrough technology develops low-cost, energy-efficient nanofilms and membranes with applications in dehumidification, energy storage, electronic devices, and climate technology. The company aims to reduce energy consumption, particularly in air conditioning, by developing innovative membrane technologies that can decrease energy use by more than 50%. Evercloak is recognized for its potential to address environmental challenges through advanced material solutions.

Name: Open Ocean Robotics
Description: Open Ocean Robotics develops solar-powered autonomous surface vehicles for ocean monitoring and data collection. Their uncrewed vessels can operate continuously for months, equipped with sensors and communication technologies to gather real-time environmental data. The company's solutions support marine research, environmental monitoring, maritime security, and climate change studies by providing zero-emission boats that can track marine biodiversity, detect illegal fishing, optimize shipping routes, and collect critical oceanographic information.

Name: Solistra
Description: Solistra is a cleantech startup developing innovative solar-driven chemical reactors that efficiently recycle carbon dioxide into commodity chemicals traditionally sourced from fossil fuels. Their revolutionary nanomaterial technology enables simultaneous conversion of carbon dioxide and methane into green chemicals and fuels, offering a potentially transformative approach to industrial chemical production that is carbon-negative and reduces greenhouse gas emissions.

Name: Summit Nanotech
Description: Summit Nanotech is a cleantech company specializing in direct lithium extraction (DLE) technology for the global energy transition. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Calgary, Alberta, the company develops innovative solutions for lithium production with a focus on sustainability and efficiency. Their technology aims to optimize lithium extraction processes in Chile and Argentina, supporting the growing electric vehicle market by providing a more environmentally friendly approach to lithium ion battery production through advanced nanotechnology and modular commercial systems.

Name: BNNT Materials
Description: BNNT, LLC is a technology startup based in Newport News, Virginia, specializing in the manufacture and development of boron nitride nanotubes (BNNTs) for scientific research, commercial product development, and advanced applications. The company's synthesis technologies were developed through collaboration with NASA's Langley Research Center, the U.S. Department of Energy's Jefferson Lab, and the National Institute of Aerospace. BNNT Materials produces high-temperature, high-crystallinity nanotubes suitable for diverse fields including electronics, metals, energy, aerospace, thermal protection, and biotechnology.

Name: Electroninks
Description: Electroninks Incorporated is the market-leader in the production and scaled manufacturing of metal-complex conductive inks. We have developed a full suite of proprietary conductive ink solutions, world-class manufacturing partners, and complimentary equipment ecosystems, thus accelerating time to market for new products and additive manufacturing breakthroughs. For General Inquiries please email: Contact@Electroninks.com For Sales Inquiries please email: Sales@Electroninks.com

Name: Ultra Safe Nuclear
Description: Ultra Safe Nuclear Corporation (USNC) is a global nuclear energy technology company based in Seattle, Washington. The company specializes in developing and deploying safe, commercially competitive micro-modular nuclear energy systems for remote locations, industries, and communities. USNC vertically integrates nuclear power production stages, focusing on technological innovation in fuels, materials, and design practices. Operating globally with subsidiaries in multiple countries, the company aims to provide reliable, clean, and secure nuclear energy solutions worldwide.

Name: Metawave
Description: Metawave is a technology company founded in 2017 and headquartered in Carlsbad, CA, specializing in advanced millimeter wave technologies for automotive and telecommunications sectors. The company develops high-performance radar sensing technologies using AI and metamaterials, creating innovative SPEKTRA radar modules for autonomous vehicles and smart transportation. Additionally, Metawave produces 5G communication solutions like TURBO active repeaters and KLONE passive reflectors to enhance wireless connectivity and network performance.

Name: Phuclabs
Description: Phuc Labs is a technology company that develops an innovative water separation and particle reclamation system using robotics, machine vision, and computer vision. Their patented Vision Valve technology enables filterless digital separation of particles from water streams, utilizing real-time data and AI to improve material recovery efficiency. The solution eliminates traditional filtering methods, offering a more energy-efficient approach to water management and material separation across various industries, including potential applications in hospitals and other sectors seeking advanced water processing technologies.

Name: Eden GeoTech
Description: Eden is a sustainable technology company specializing in innovative natural resource recovery through electrical rock stimulation. Using high-voltage electricity and proprietary modeling techniques, the company enhances subsurface rock permeability with minimal environmental impact. Their technology targets applications in geothermal energy, geologic hydrogen production, carbon storage, and mining. Eden's approach aims to create carbon-neutral solutions by providing precise reservoir stimulation that reduces water consumption and environmental risks associated with traditional hydraulic fracturing methods, working with industry leaders to transform natural resource extraction.

Name: Adapt-IP
Description: Adapt provides advanced wireless communication systems specifically designed for Industrial Internet of Things (IoT) applications. Their technology delivers high-performance, long-range wireless connectivity solutions using protocols like Wi-Fi HaLow, Bluetooth, and LoRa. Specializing in industrial sectors such as construction, agriculture, logistics, and security, Adapt's chips and systems enable reliable, secure, and cost-effective data transmission over extended distances, supporting video and voice communication with high throughput and low latency.

Name: MolyWorks
Description: MolyWorks is a sustainable metal powder production company founded in 2015, specializing in recycling metallic scrap materials into high-quality alloy powders for additive manufacturing. The company has developed a mobile foundry system called the Greyhound, which can process metal waste streams into AM-grade powders for aerospace, defense, and other advanced manufacturing applications. With SBIR contracts from the US Army and Air Force, MolyWorks has successfully demonstrated recycling of twelve unique alloys, producing powders with high sphericity and flowability that meet material specifications for various manufacturing processes including LENS, DMLS, cold-spray, EBM, and MELD technologies.

Name: iBeam Materials, Inc.
Description: iBeam Materials is a technology startup specializing in advanced LED and semiconductor manufacturing technologies. The company develops innovative processes for crystalline alignment of thin films on various substrates, enabling the creation of high-performance electronic devices, particularly flexible LED displays and advanced superconductors. Their proprietary ion beam-assisted deposition (IBAD) technology allows for creating LED devices on metal surfaces and flexible substrates, with applications in lighting, display, and wearable electronics. Founded in 2011 as a spin-out from Los Alamos National Laboratory, iBeam collaborates with research institutions and has attracted investment from Samsung Venture Investment Corporation.

Name: Maatenergy
Engine Team: Phil Inagaki <phil@xora.vc>; Lakshana Huddar <lakshana.huddar@gmail.com>; Michael Kearney <michael@engineventures.com>
Description: MAAT Energy is a technology company specializing in microwave power solutions for decarbonization, converting natural gas, biogas, and CO2 into valuable fuels like syngas, hydrogen, and carbon. Their innovative systems operate directly at the point of use, reducing logistics and operational costs. The company focuses on industrial applications in chemical, cement, and power generation sectors, leveraging federal research and development to enhance system efficiency for converting hydrocarbons into usable energy products.

Name: Universal Hydrogen
Description: Universal Hydrogen is an aviation technology company pioneering carbon-free flight through hydrogen-powered commercial aircraft solutions. The company develops innovative hydrogen logistics infrastructure, including modular capsule transportation and retrofit conversion kits for existing regional airplanes. Their approach aims to accelerate hydrogen adoption in aviation, providing a scalable and flexible solution to decarbonize the aviation industry and support global climate agreement objectives.

Name: Genbiotics
Engine Team: Ian Johnston <ian@engine.xyz>; Ann DeWitt <ann@engineventures.com>; Theresa Tribble <ttribble@dropletbiosci.com>

Name: Unravel Biosciences
Description: Unravel Biosciences is a drug discovery company that uses AI and RNA sequencing to identify novel therapeutic targets for complex disorders. Their innovative platform integrates computational drug prediction with advanced screening technologies to rapidly connect behavioral and cognitive symptoms to potential treatments. Specializing in areas like Rett syndrome, the company enables unbiased identification of drug targets across organ systems, focusing on restoring metabolism, reducing inflammation, and developing targeted therapies through comprehensive RNA sample analysis and advanced computational methods.

Name: Scalable Robotics
Description: Scalable Robotics develops advanced human-robot interaction technologies that enable intuitive programming of complex manufacturing processes. Their innovative system allows users to demonstrate tasks to robots, which then automatically generate robust and high-quality programs for complex industrial applications like welding, painting, and deburring. Unlike traditional robotics systems that focus on simple pick-and-place operations, Scalable's platform supports intricate processes with hundreds of motions, helping manufacturers of all batch sizes to improve production efficiency, safety, and cost-effectiveness.

Name: Electrontransport
Description: Electron Transport focuses on electrification solutions for commercial and specialty vehicle industries. The company develops advanced electric vehicle chassis and powertrain technologies, offering integrated solutions that help businesses reduce environmental impact. Their platform includes customizable electric chassis, proprietary battery packs with long service life, and smart charging solutions designed to support sustainable transportation across various commercial sectors.

Name: Farm to Flame Energy
Description: Farm to Flame Energy provides scalable, emission-free electricity generation solutions using biowaste, specifically targeting remote communities. The company offers a universal biomass solution designed to address energy needs in areas with limited infrastructure, focusing on sustainable and clean energy production through innovative waste-to-energy technologies.

Name: Droplet Biosciences
Description: Droplet is a medical technology company focused on advancing cancer care through innovative liquid biopsy techniques. Their primary innovation involves harnessing lymphatic fluid to provide powerful diagnostic insights. By analyzing lymphatic fluid, the company aims to improve cancer treatment strategies, potentially enhancing chemotherapy effectiveness and reducing cancer recurrence. Their approach represents a novel approach to understanding and treating cancer by exploring the diagnostic potential of lymphatic systems.

Niron focuses on creating sustainable manufacturing processes that provide a secure domestic supply chain for advanced magnetic materials.

Name: Alchemr
Description: Alchemr is a green hydrogen technology company developing industrial-scale water electrolyzers that enable low-cost, sustainable hydrogen production. Their innovative technology can operate on intermittent power sources without using precious metals, making green hydrogen production more accessible and economically viable. Targeting hard-to-decarbonize sectors like chemicals and heavy-duty transport, Alchemr aims to simplify the hydrogen supply chain and support the transition to clean energy solutions.

Name: Andluca Technologies
Description: Andluca Technologies is an innovative clean technology company specializing in transparent photovoltaic solutions for windows and glass surfaces. Their core technology involves creating UV-harvesting coatings that convert ultraviolet light into electricity, enabling self-powered, intelligent window systems. The company's mission is to revolutionize building design by providing smart glass technologies that enhance energy efficiency, privacy, security, and sustainability through seamlessly integrated solar-powered solutions for both residential and commercial applications.

Name: Atomic Industries
Description: Atomic Industries is a manufacturing services company specializing in precision cutting technologies, including laser and waterjet cutting. Operating primarily in the industrial, commercial, and oil and gas sectors, the company provides custom cutting, prototyping, and manufacturing solutions. They emphasize quality and precision in their fabrication services, catering to diverse industrial needs with a commitment to delivering high-quality custom fabrication and cutting solutions.

Name: Last Energy
Description: OPEN100 is an open-source development framework focused on creating a standardized pressurized water reactor design for nuclear energy deployment. The platform aims to accelerate nuclear power plant development by providing engineering drawings, ongoing research, and a collaborative approach that connects reactor startups, engineering firms, and utilities. Its primary goal is to reduce construction costs and complexity in nuclear energy infrastructure by offering a replicable, accessible template for nuclear plant development.

Name: Skylark
Description: Skylark Creative is a digital transformation agency specializing in helping brands grow through innovative technological solutions. Based in London, the agency offers comprehensive services including UX design, branding, and content strategy across various industries such as finance, entertainment, health, and sports. Their approach combines technical innovation, design expertise, and creative energy to develop elegant, data-driven digital experiences including websites, apps, and interactive platforms that challenge industry assumptions and inspire customer engagement.

Name: Altus Thermal
Description: Altus is an energy technology company focused on innovative home energy solutions, based at Greentown Labs. The company aims to rethink and optimize residential energy use through advanced technologies that maximize resource performance. Their primary focus appears to be developing energy-efficient systems, with a particular interest in heat pump technologies and solutions that reduce carbon footprint while improving home energy management.

Name: JARO FLEET TECHNOLOGIES
Description: Jaro Fleet Technologies is a company focused on accelerating the electrification of semi-trucking in the United States. The company provides innovative solutions to address challenges in electric truck adoption, including charging infrastructure, utility delays, and high costs. Jaro aims to optimize the transition to electric trucks by offering cost-effective approaches that can save up to $50 per mile compared to diesel, ultimately supporting the scaling of electric trucking technology.

Name: Battery Resourcers
Description: Battery Resourcers, founded in 2015 and based in Worcester, Massachusetts, is a innovative lithium-ion battery recycling company revolutionizing battery material production. Using a patented Hydro-to-Cathode process, they transform discarded lithium-ion batteries into high-value battery materials with improved performance. Their technology directly synthesizes new cathode materials from spent cells, offering over 50% better cycle life and 88% higher power capabilities compared to traditional methods. The company serves lithium-ion battery manufacturers, energy storage system installations, commercial fleet managers, and battery aggregators, with a focus on creating a sustainable, closed-loop circular battery economy.

Name: Hudson Space Systems
Description: Hudson Space Systems is an aerospace technology company focused on providing microgravity research and manufacturing services. The company develops reusable launch vehicles and offers end-to-end logistics for scientific payloads, enabling more accessible and affordable space research. Their mission involves leveraging advanced propulsion and manufacturing technologies to support scientific exploration and innovation in microgravity environments.

Name: Pluton Biosciences
Description: Pluton Biosciences is a St. Louis-based biotechnology company specializing in microbial research and discovery using their proprietary Micromining™ technology. The company focuses on identifying and developing novel microbes for sustainable solutions in agriculture, carbon sequestration, pharmaceuticals, biomaterials, and bioremediation. Their innovative platform allows for rapid and cost-effective discovery of microbes with potential applications in addressing global challenges such as climate change, crop improvement, pest control, and disease reduction.

Name: Stratagen Bio
Description: Stratagen Bio is a medical technology company developing innovative oxygen sensing technologies for oncology and medical imaging. Their primary focus is transforming MRI capabilities through advanced tissue oxygen sensors and AI-enabled data engines. The company aims to provide personalized medical solutions by creating quantitative biomarker assessment tools that enhance clinical decision-making and enable more customized patient care approaches.

Name: Blackburn Energy
Description: Blackburn Energy is a clean energy technology company founded in 2014 in Amesbury, Massachusetts, specializing in innovative hybrid charging solutions for transportation. Their flagship product, RelGen™, is a kinetic energy recovery system (KERS) that generates and stores energy from truck drive shafts, producing 5X more energy than standard truck alternators. The technology transforms trucks into mobile platforms for renewable electricity, helping fleet owners reduce fuel costs and emissions by providing efficient charging solutions for electric accessories like APUs and liftgates. With multiple industry awards, Blackburn Energy focuses on creating accessible, robust clean energy technologies that address environmental challenges.

Name: Keystonemab
Description: Keystonemab is an AI-driven big-data analytics platform specializing in pharmaceutical research and drug development. Using advanced artificial intelligence, the company analyzes millions of scientific, clinical, and patent documents to accelerate drug discovery and development. Their platform enables identification of synergistic drug combinations, drug repositioning, novel drug target discovery, and biomarker analysis. Key capabilities include designing multi-API drug formulations, performing clinical project rescue, expanding drug indications, and conducting comprehensive commercial product portfolio analysis across various disease signaling pathways.

Name: Fork & Goode
Engine Team: Ann DeWitt <ann@engineventures.com>; Reed Sturtevant <reed@engineventures.com>; Ally Yost <ally@cfs.energy>; Ian Johnston <ian@engine.xyz>
Description: Fork & Good is a food technology company specializing in creating clean, traceable, and delicious animal proteins and fats through innovative production methods. The company focuses on developing sustainable meat production solutions that enhance quality and affordability while supporting future generations of farmers. Their approach aims to reduce the environmental impact of traditional meat production by creating alternative protein sources that are both nutritionally comparable and environmentally responsible.

Name: The Routing Company
Description: The Routing Company is an innovative transit technology platform founded by MIT researchers that partners with cities to transform public transportation. Their core product, the Pingo™ App, offers advanced on-demand vehicle routing solutions using proprietary AI to optimize transit efficiency. The platform supports multiple transit modes including on-demand, flex, fixed, and paratransit services, enabling greater accessibility, cost efficiency, and sustainability. Operating internationally across eight countries, they leverage cutting-edge routing technology to make public transit more reliable and adaptable to diverse urban mobility needs.

Name: Seam
Description: Seam is a travel-focused clothing rental service that revolutionizes travel experiences by offering travelers pre-arranged wardrobes delivered directly to their hotel. The service aims to reduce travel baggage, promote sustainability by minimizing clothing waste, and provide convenient, stylish clothing options that are delivered before travelers arrive at their destination, addressing challenges of packing and luggage transportation.

Name: Atomic-6
Description: Atomic-6 is an advanced composites manufacturing firm specializing in developing innovative, high-performance materials for extreme environment applications. The company focuses on aerospace, space, hypersonics, and ballistics industries, leveraging a proprietary manufacturing process to create composite solutions that are lighter, stronger, and more customizable. Their technology enables the production of advanced materials with optimized fiber-to-resin ratios, reduced porosity, and expedited production times, with notable products like the Light Wing™ solar array designed for space exploration and satellite power systems.

Name: AdaViv
Description: Adaviv is an AI-powered agricultural technology company that develops intelligent plant management solutions for controlled environment agriculture. Originating from MIT, the company offers a crop-agnostic platform that uses computer vision and artificial intelligence to digitize crop scouting, detect early plant health issues, and optimize farm productivity. Their software provides real-time insights and automation for greenhouse and indoor farming operations, initially focusing on high-value crops like cannabis. The platform aims to improve yield consistency, reduce labor costs, and increase overall farm efficiency through advanced data analytics and automated monitoring technologies.

Name: AgroBeads
Description: AgroBeads is a research-driven technology company developing innovative agricultural solutions focused on water conservation and plant nutrition. The company creates biodegradable spheres made from natural ingredients that optimize irrigation by reducing water usage while providing essential nutrients directly to plants. Their work combines agricultural technology with sustainable practices to improve crop productivity and resource efficiency.

Name: Manta Biofuel
Description: Manta Biofuel is a biotechnology startup that produces renewable crude oil derived from algae using a proprietary manufacturing technique. The company offers a unique, cost-competitive approach to biofuel production that creates carbon-neutral crude oil at prices below current market rates. Their three-step process of growing, harvesting, and converting algae enables the creation of renewable fuel alternatives that can be processed into various fuel products while maintaining environmental sustainability.

Name: Bitome
Description: Bitome is a Boston-based life sciences and consumer diagnostic company that develops innovative technologies for biomanufacturing and personal health monitoring. The company leverages metabolomic insights and magnetic-resonance/neural-network technologies to provide quantitative analysis of biological environments. Their platform supports efficient bio-based product development and creates consumer diagnostic products that offer personalized health insights, with an initial focus on real-time, non-invasive hydration monitoring for athletes and professionals.

Name: Stoke Space
Description: Stoke Space is an innovative aerospace company developing fully reusable rockets designed to revolutionize satellite deployment. Their flagship product, Nova, is a medium-lift rocket aimed at providing affordable and sustainable access to space. The company focuses on creating rockets that can be rapidly reused, delivering satellites directly to their final orbit at significantly reduced costs. With an emphasis on environmental stewardship and high-performance propulsion systems, Stoke Space aims to transform space transportation by enabling daily rocket flights and minimizing atmospheric impact.

Name: Auto Motive Power
Description: We are an energy management solutions provider, dedicated to the evolution of e-mobility. Since 2017 we have advanced battery management technology, through industry-leading software and hardware. From intelligent battery management platforms, to robust fast-charging systems, to complete cloud solutions, we continue to push mobility further. Our technology underpins offerings from e-mobility pioneers and those on the verge of disrupting the market. Headquartered in Los Angeles, CA, with offices in Detroit, MI, Bangalore, India, Pune, India, and Shanghai, China, we are a truly global provider. No matter the segment nor the size, we have the solutions to accelerate development. We are driven to electrify the world. We are AMP.

Name: Onvector
Description: Onvector is a science-driven cleantech company specializing in advanced water treatment technologies. Their proprietary Plasma Vortex and Ion Pinch systems use innovative approaches in advanced materials, electronics, and fluid dynamics to address complex industrial wastewater treatment challenges. The company focuses on developing economically and environmentally sustainable solutions, with a particular emphasis on PFAS destruction and water purification technologies that reduce treatment costs and improve environmental compliance.

Name: Induction Food Systems
Description: Decarbonizing the hardest to reach areas of industry by redefining the fundamentals of how we heat flowing fluids. IFS tech harnesses electromagnetic energy to heat flowing fluids from the middle-out and improve heating performance by 8-10x over the current state of the art. Better heating performance unlocks productivity that that makes existing manufacturing assets more profitable and reduces their carbon and resource intensity.

Name: Circe
Description: Circe is a contemporary women's boutique offering a comprehensive shopping experience with a curated selection of clothing and accessories. The online retailer provides a wide range of fashion items including tops, dresses, denim, pants, skirts, jackets, and handbags. Key features include seasonal collections, sale items, and premium services like free shipping on orders over $300. The boutique also offers a newsletter for exclusive discounts and updates, catering to fashion-conscious customers seeking personalized and convenient shopping experiences.

Name: Upstart Power
Description: Upstart Power is a technology company designing and manufacturing solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) generators for residential and industrial applications. Their Upgen NXG® line of energy appliances provides sustainable, carbon-efficient power generation that works collaboratively with renewable sources like solar and battery storage. The company focuses on enabling energy independence, providing 24/7 backup power, and supporting the transition to distributed energy solutions with low-emission, virtually silent generators that can operate on various fuels.

Name: 6K
Description: 6K Inc. is a materials technology company specializing in UniMelt, an innovative microwave plasma processing technology for advanced material manufacturing. Their proprietary method enables sustainable, high-efficiency production of materials for industries like renewable energy, aerospace, and electronics. The technology offers significant environmental advantages, including reduced waste, lower energy consumption, and faster production times compared to traditional manufacturing processes.

Name: Living Carbon
Description: Living Carbon is a public benefit company focused on fighting climate change through innovative reforestation and carbon removal services. The company specializes in genetically enhancing trees to improve CO2 capture and storage capabilities. By working with landowners, Living Carbon develops custom-grown native plant species, including hybrid poplar trees, to promote sustainable practices and reduce environmental impact. Their approach combines genetic engineering with ecological restoration, offering carbon-neutral solutions for businesses and landowners seeking to address climate change through advanced forestry techniques.

Name: MelliCell
Description: MelliCell is a biotechnology company focused on developing innovative therapeutics for chronic diseases, particularly diabetes and obesity. The company utilizes proprietary technology to engineer human fat cells, enabling discovery of novel therapeutic targets and drug development. Their core innovation efficiently transforms human stem cells into fat cells, allowing for advanced research into fat cell size and metabolism. MelliCell differentiates itself by targeting adipocyte-intrinsic mechanisms, developing potential treatments that shrink fat cell size and prevent compromised metabolism in enlarged cells.

Name: Yesse Tech
Engine Team: Ann DeWitt <ann@engineventures.com>; Ally Yost <ally@cfs.energy>; Orin Hoffman <orin@engine.xyz>

Name: Minutia
Engine Team: Ann DeWitt <ann@engineventures.com>; Ally Yost <ally@cfs.energy>; Rachel Field <rachel@engineventures.com>
Description: Minutia is a biotechnology company developing an innovative cell therapy solution for diabetes treatment. Their approach combines insulin-producing cell transplants with advanced nanosensors, enabling in vivo monitoring of cell replacement therapy. The company aims to create robust, controlled insulin-producing cells that can be safely monitored over time, with the goal of revolutionizing diabetes treatment. Their research focuses on developing a more effective therapeutic approach that enhances cell therapy efficiency and reduces inflammation, potentially providing a groundbreaking solution for diabetes management.

Name: Artificial Axons
Engine Team: Ian Johnston <ian@engine.xyz>; Michael Kearney <michael@engineventures.com>; Ann DeWitt <ann@engineventures.com>

Name: blkS▴IL
Description: blkSAIL is a maritime technology company that develops AI-powered software solutions for the shipping industry. Their platform focuses on improving maritime operations through advanced technology, with capabilities that enhance vessel safety, operational efficiency, and environmental sustainability. The company provides maritime AI solutions that can serve as decision support tools for ship captains or enable autonomous vessel management.

Name: Bluefield (NY → move)
Engine Team: Ann DeWitt <ann@engineventures.com>; Reed Sturtevant <reed@engineventures.com>; Ally Yost <ally@cfs.energy>; Michael Kearney <michael@engineventures.com>

Name: CaCHE
Description: The UK Collaborative Centre for Housing Evidence (CaCHE) is a multidisciplinary research consortium led by the University of Glasgow, connecting academia with housing policy and practice. Established in 2017, the center conducts comprehensive research on UK housing challenges, focusing on social housing, private renting, sustainability, and homelessness. Funded by the Economic and Social Research Council and Arts and Humanities Research Council, CaCHE produces evidence-based research to address housing problems at national, regional, and local levels through collaborative partnerships with academic and non-academic institutions.

Name: Concerto Bio
Description: Concerto Biosciences is a pioneering biotechnology company focused on understanding and manipulating microbial interactions to develop innovative health solutions. Using their proprietary kChip technology, the company can map complex microbial interaction networks to discover and develop novel microbe-based products. Their initial focus is on skin microbiome rehabilitation, with potential applications in treating conditions like eczema. The company aims to revolutionize how we understand and utilize microbial communities for health improvements across various domains including skincare, chronic diseases, and nutrition.

Name: Elysium
Description: Elysium Fund Management Limited is a specialized corporate services firm based in Guernsey, offering comprehensive financial management solutions. Established in 2006, the company provides accounting, company secretarial, corporate finance, and administrative services to niche clients. Wholly owned by its management and staff, Elysium is licensed by the Guernsey Financial Services Commission and focuses on delivering high-level, professional services for complex multi-jurisdictional financial structures, with a team of professionally qualified accountants and chartered secretaries.

Name: HEVO
Description: HEVO is a Dutch real estate and housing consultancy specializing in strategic property management for public and private sectors. With over 100 specialists, they provide comprehensive services from initial strategy to implementation, focusing on education, healthcare, sports, and municipal infrastructure. Their expertise includes risk-managed project management, sustainable and circular building design, healthy housing solutions, and complex property development, with a core mission of creating inspiring spaces that enhance user well-being.

Name: Celestial AI
Description: Inorganic Intelligence develops advanced AI computing platforms that enhance performance, energy efficiency, and economic capabilities for technology applications. Their primary offering is the Photonic Fabric platform, which provides high-performance optical interconnectivity for AI computing and memory infrastructure. The technology reduces power consumption and latency while enabling scalable computing, with features like nanosecond-level latency for advanced AI models and high-throughput AI clusters. The platform supports various applications including AI accelerator packages and high-availability computing environments.

Name: LECT
Engine Team: Reed Sturtevant <reed@engineventures.com>; Michael Kearney <michael@engineventures.com>; Phil Inagaki <phil@xora.vc>

Name: Peach
Description: Peachinc is a UK-based technology company specializing in mobile SMS/text ticketing solutions for various entertainment and event sectors. Their innovative platform provides online mobile ticketing services for football clubs, theatres, cinemas, concerts, sports events, and corporate gatherings. The company aims to revolutionize the traditional ticketing industry by offering a modern, digital approach to ticket purchasing and management through mobile technology.

Name: Rbimedical
Description: rbi medical (now known as juniper biomedical) is developing dramatically better therapies for the millions of women and men who suffer in silence with pelvic health conditions, like urinary incontinence, bowel incontinence, pelvic pain, sexual dysfunction and pelvic floor disorders. our solutions leverage a highly precise, low power neuromodulation micro-implant that delivers a unique type of therapy to pelvic nerves.

Name: SiTration
Engine Team: Michael Kearney <michael@engineventures.com>; Lakshana Huddar <lakshana.huddar@gmail.com>; Patrick Sarver <patrick.sarver@engineventures.com>
Description: SiTration develops advanced silicon membrane technology for ultra-efficient material separation in demanding industrial environments. The company's core innovation enables low-cost and sustainable recovery of critical minerals such as lithium, cobalt, nickel, and copper across mining, refining, and battery recycling industries. Their electrified silicon technology provides high-efficiency extraction of valuable metals and minerals through innovative filtration membranes.

Name: skyTran (SoCal)
Engine Team: Ann DeWitt <ann@engineventures.com>; Reed Sturtevant <reed@engineventures.com>; Katie Rae <katie@engineventures.com>; Ally Yost <ally@cfs.energy>; Michael Kearney <michael@engineventures.com>

Name: Solclarityeds
Description: Provides transparent Electrodynamic Screen (EDS™) as overlays for solar panels that automatically remove dust and improve the energy yield/output power of solar panels without the need to wash the panels with water

Name: Sublime Systems
Description: Sublime Systems is an innovative cleantech company that has developed a groundbreaking electrochemical process for manufacturing low-carbon cement. Founded at MIT in 2020, the company eliminates traditional fossil-fuel-intensive cement production by extracting reactive calcium and silicates from abundant raw materials at ambient temperatures using renewable electricity. Their technology reduces energy consumption by 30-40% and waste by up to 50%, offering an environmentally friendly alternative to traditional portland cement that addresses the cement industry's significant CO2 emissions challenge.

Name: Sunthetics
Description: Sunthetics is a machine-learning platform designed to accelerate chemical and materials research and development. The platform enables scientists to optimize experimental processes by leveraging advanced algorithms that can work with minimal data points (as few as 5). Its key capabilities include rapid process optimization, generative design of chemical pathways, and data analysis tools that help R&D teams develop new medicines, materials, and chemical processes up to 32 times faster than traditional methods. The web-based platform provides user-friendly features like data visualization, experiment configuration, and actionable insights without requiring advanced coding knowledge.

Name: VEIR
Description: VEIR is an innovative energy infrastructure technology company developing advanced high-temperature superconductor (HTS)-based transmission lines. Their solutions dramatically increase power delivery capacity for data centers, renewable energy projects, and utilities by offering transmission lines with 5-10 times more power than conventional systems. Using unique evaporative cooling architecture and commercial superconducting tape, VEIR aims to revolutionize power infrastructure by enabling lower-cost, more easily deployable electrical transmission with reduced energy losses and enhanced grid reliability.

Name: Veloxint
Description: Veloxint is a materials science and advanced manufacturing company specializing in developing next-generation nanocrystalline metal alloys with extraordinary properties. Founded on fundamental research from MIT, the company creates high-performance components using innovative powder metallurgy techniques. Their proprietary processes produce alloys with 2-5x the strength of traditional metals, offering enhanced stability at elevated temperatures. Veloxint focuses on creating cutting-edge metal alloys, particularly nanocrystalline tungsten and copper compositions, for applications in industries requiring lightweight, corrosion-resistant, and high-strength materials.
